gloss_note: going to 的口語縮寫，非正式，多用於口說與簡訊

sentences.en: I'm gonna grab some coffee. Want one?
sentences.zh: 我去買杯咖啡，你要來一杯嗎？

sentences.en: What are you gonna do this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這個週末打算做什麼？

sentences.en: It's gonna rain all day tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天會下一整天的雨。

sentences.en: We're not gonna make it on time.
sentences.zh: 我們來不及準時趕到了。

sentences.en: Are you gonna eat that last slice?
sentences.zh: 你要吃最後那一片嗎？

sentences.en: She's gonna be so happy when she sees this.
sentences.zh: 她看到這個一定會很開心。

gloss_note: got to／have got to 的口語，表必須或強烈建議

sentences.en: I gotta go. My ride is here.
sentences.zh: 我得走了，我搭的車到了。

sentences.en: You gotta try this pizza. It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 你一定要試試這個披薩，超好吃。

sentences.en: Sorry, I gotta go. My mom's calling me.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我得走了，我媽在叫我。

sentences.en: We gotta leave by six to catch the show.
sentences.zh: 我們六點前得出發才趕得上表演。

sentences.en: Hey, I gotta ask you something.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我得問你一件事。

sentences.en: You gotta be kidding me!
sentences.zh: 你一定是在開玩笑吧！

gloss_note: want to 的口語縮寫，非正式

sentences.en: I wanna go home and sleep.
sentences.zh: 我想回家睡覺。

sentences.en: Do you wanna grab lunch together?
sentences.zh: 你要不要一起去吃午餐？

sentences.en: What do you wanna order?
sentences.zh: 你想點什麼？

sentences.en: They don't wanna wait any longer.
sentences.zh: 他們不想再等下去了。

sentences.en: I wanna try on this jacket.
sentences.zh: 我想試穿這件外套。

sentences.en: Hey, you wanna watch a movie tonight?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你今晚想看電影嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數名詞，沒有 stuffs；口語極常用

sentences.en: I left my stuff in the car.
sentences.zh: 我把東西留在車上了。

sentences.en: What's all this stuff on the table?
sentences.zh: 桌上這些東西是什麼？

sentences.en: We have a lot of stuff to do today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天有很多事要做。

sentences.en: Do you sell camping stuff here?
sentences.zh: 你們這裡有賣露營用品嗎？

sentences.en: That's good stuff. Where did you get it?
sentences.zh: 這個很棒耶，你在哪買的？

sentences.en: Please keep your stuff off the seat.
sentences.zh: 請不要把你的東西放在座位上。

gloss_note: be supposed to + 原形；表預期、規定或安排

sentences.en: I'm supposed to meet Mark at six.
sentences.zh: 我應該六點要跟馬克碰面。

sentences.en: What time are we supposed to arrive?
sentences.zh: 我們應該幾點到？

sentences.en: You're not supposed to park here.
sentences.zh: 你不可以把車停在這裡。

sentences.en: The package was supposed to come yesterday.
sentences.zh: 包裹照理說昨天就該到了。

sentences.en: Isn't he supposed to be at work?
sentences.zh: 他不是應該在上班嗎？

sentences.en: This medicine is supposed to help you sleep.
sentences.zh: 這個藥照理說能幫助你入睡。

gloss_note: 回話常單獨說 Exactly!；也可修飾數字與疑問詞

sentences.en: Exactly! That's what I was thinking.
sentences.zh: 沒錯！我正是這麼想的。

sentences.en: That's exactly what I ordered.
sentences.zh: 這正是我點的東西。

sentences.en: What exactly happened last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚到底發生了什麼事？

sentences.en: It costs exactly ten dollars.
sentences.zh: 這個剛好十美元。

sentences.en: Do you know exactly where we are?
sentences.zh: 你確切知道我們在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: So you want a refund? Exactly.
sentences.zh: 所以你要退款嗎？沒錯。

gloss_note: 轉換話題用 Anyway,；句尾表示「還是」

sentences.en: Anyway, how was your weekend?
sentences.zh: 總之，你週末過得怎麼樣？

sentences.en: It's raining, but we're going anyway.
sentences.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是要去。

sentences.en: Thanks anyway for trying to help.
sentences.zh: 還是謝謝你試著幫忙。

sentences.en: Anyway, I should get back to work.
sentences.zh: 總之，我該回去工作了。

sentences.en: I didn't like it, but I bought it anyway.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜歡，但還是買了。

sentences.en: Sorry I'm late. Anyway, let's get started.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我遲到了。總之，我們開始吧。

gloss_note: a bit + 形容詞，或 a bit of + 名詞；語氣委婉

sentences.en: I'm a bit tired today.
sentences.zh: 我今天有點累。

sentences.en: Could you speak a bit slower?
sentences.zh: 你可以說慢一點嗎？

sentences.en: This soup is a bit too salty.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯有點太鹹了。

sentences.en: Wait a bit. I'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 等一下，我馬上回來。

sentences.en: Can I have a bit of sugar?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一點糖嗎？

sentences.en: It's a little bit cold in here.
sentences.zh: 這裡面有點冷。

gloss_note: figure out 想出、弄懂；I figured 我以為

sentences.en: I can't figure out how this phone works.
sentences.zh: 我搞不懂這支手機怎麼用。

sentences.en: Did you figure out the Wi-Fi password?
sentences.zh: 你有搞懂 Wi-Fi 密碼了嗎？

sentences.en: I figured you'd be home by now.
sentences.zh: 我以為你現在已經到家了。

sentences.en: Can we figure it out together?
sentences.zh: 我們可以一起想辦法嗎？

sentences.en: It took me an hour to figure out the map.
sentences.zh: 我花了一小時才看懂這張地圖。

sentences.en: That makes sense. I figured as much.
sentences.zh: 有道理，我想也是。

gloss_note: I wonder if／what… 自言自語或委婉詢問；I was wondering 更客氣

sentences.en: I wonder what time the store opens.
sentences.zh: 不知道這家店幾點開門。

sentences.en: I was wondering if you could help me.
sentences.zh: 不知道你能不能幫我一下。

sentences.en: I wonder where I left my keys.
sentences.zh: 我在想我把鑰匙放哪了。

sentences.en: She wondered why nobody answered her text.
sentences.zh: 她納悶為什麼沒人回她的訊息。

sentences.en: Have you ever wondered how they make this?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有好奇過這是怎麼做的？

sentences.en: Don't you wonder where he gets all that energy?
sentences.zh: 你不好奇他哪來那麼多精力嗎？

gloss_note: I bet 我敢說／我猜；You bet 當然（回應道謝或請求）

sentences.en: I bet it's going to rain later.
sentences.zh: 我猜等一下會下雨。

sentences.en: Thanks for the ride! You bet.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你載我！別客氣。

sentences.en: I bet you're hungry after that long drive.
sentences.zh: 開了那麼久的車，我猜你餓了。

sentences.en: Do you think he'll show up? I bet he will.
sentences.zh: 你覺得他會出現嗎？我敢說他會。

sentences.en: Can you cover my shift? You bet.
sentences.zh: 你能幫我代班嗎？沒問題。

sentences.en: I'll bet she forgot the tickets again.
sentences.zh: 我敢說她又忘了帶票。

gloss_note: 多用於否定句或疑問句，放句尾

sentences.en: I don't live there anymore.
sentences.zh: 我已經不住那裡了。

sentences.en: He doesn't call me anymore.
sentences.zh: 他不再打電話給我了。

sentences.en: Why don't you drive to work anymore?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼不再開車上班了？

sentences.en: We can't afford that place anymore.
sentences.zh: 我們再也負擔不起那個地方了。

sentences.en: This phone doesn't work anymore.
sentences.zh: 這支手機壞了，不能用了。

sentences.en: Why don't they sell it anymore?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他們不再賣這個了？

gloss_note: stick around 留下；stick with 堅持、繼續用

sentences.en: Can you stick around for a few minutes?
sentences.zh: 你可以多留幾分鐘嗎？

sentences.en: I'll stick with water, thanks.
sentences.zh: 我喝水就好，謝謝。

sentences.en: Stick with it. You're almost there!
sentences.zh: 堅持下去，你快成功了！

sentences.en: Why don't you stick around for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你何不留下來吃晚餐？

sentences.en: We decided to stick with the same hotel.
sentences.zh: 我們決定繼續住同一家飯店。

sentences.en: She stuck with her diet for a month.
sentences.zh: 她堅持節食了一個月。

gloss_note: sort of 有點（口語）；what sort of 哪一種；a sort of 一種

sentences.en: I'm sort of nervous about the test.
sentences.zh: 我對這場考試有點緊張。

sentences.en: It's sort of like a small bus.
sentences.zh: 它有點像一輛小巴士。

sentences.en: What sort of music do you like?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡哪一種音樂？

sentences.en: Are you sort of scared of heights?
sentences.zh: 你是不是有點怕高？

sentences.en: It's sort of like a noodle soup.
sentences.zh: 它有點像麵湯。

sentences.en: The movie was sort of boring, honestly.
sentences.zh: 說真的，這部電影有點無聊。

gloss_note: Good luck 祝你好運；bad luck 運氣差；with any luck 運氣好的話

sentences.en: Good luck on your interview tomorrow!
sentences.zh: 祝你明天面試順利！

sentences.en: I had no luck finding a taxi.
sentences.zh: 我一直叫不到計程車。

sentences.en: Do you believe in luck?
sentences.zh: 你相信運氣嗎？

sentences.en: With any luck, we'll get there early.
sentences.zh: 運氣好的話，我們會提早到。

sentences.en: That was pure luck. I didn't study.
sentences.zh: 那純粹是運氣，我根本沒念書。

sentences.en: Any luck with the tickets?
sentences.zh: 票有買到嗎？

gloss_note: I suppose 語氣不太確定；I suppose so 表示勉強同意

sentences.en: I suppose you're right about that.
sentences.zh: 我想你說得沒錯。

sentences.en: Do you suppose they'll be late?
sentences.zh: 你猜他們會遲到嗎？

sentences.en: Is it ready? I suppose so.
sentences.zh: 好了嗎？我想是吧。

sentences.en: I suppose we could take the train.
sentences.zh: 我想我們可以搭火車。

sentences.en: I don't suppose you have a pen?
sentences.zh: 你該不會剛好有筆吧？

sentences.en: I suppose it's too late to change the order.
sentences.zh: 我想現在要改餐點太晚了吧。

gloss_note: force 作動詞是強迫，作名詞是力量；forced 為勉強的

sentences.en: Don't force yourself to eat it all.
sentences.zh: 不要勉強自己把它全吃完。

sentences.en: Why force yourself to run in this rain?
sentences.zh: 幹嘛勉強自己在這種雨裡跑步？

sentences.en: I had to force the stuck door open.
sentences.zh: 我只好把卡住的門硬推開。

sentences.en: Nobody can force you to decide today.
sentences.zh: 沒人能逼你今天就做決定。

sentences.en: The force of the wind pushed me back.
sentences.zh: 風的力量把我往後推。

sentences.en: Did he force you to sign this?
sentences.zh: 他有逼你簽這個嗎？

gloss_note: 客氣回應 Certainly 比 Sure 正式；也可加強語氣

sentences.en: Certainly! I'll bring it right away.
sentences.zh: 當然！我馬上幫您送來。

sentences.en: That's certainly a good idea.
sentences.zh: 這確實是個好主意。

sentences.en: Could you hold this for me? Certainly.
sentences.zh: 可以幫我拿一下這個嗎？當然。

sentences.en: She's certainly not shy around strangers.
sentences.zh: 她對陌生人可一點也不害羞。

sentences.en: We will certainly be there on time.
sentences.zh: 我們一定會準時到的。

sentences.en: Could you help me with my bag? Certainly!
sentences.zh: 可以幫我拿一下行李嗎？當然可以！

gloss_note: 口語，男性間常用；對陌生人說 buddy 可能帶不耐煩

sentences.en: Hey, buddy, how's it going?
sentences.zh: 嘿，老兄，最近怎麼樣？

sentences.en: He's my best buddy from college.
sentences.zh: 他是我大學時最要好的朋友。

sentences.en: Thanks for the help, buddy.
sentences.zh: 謝啦，老兄，多虧你幫忙。

sentences.en: Come on, buddy, let's go home.
sentences.zh: 來吧，夥伴，我們回家吧。

sentences.en: Do you want to be my workout buddy?
sentences.zh: 你想當我的運動夥伴嗎？

sentences.en: Hey buddy, you dropped your wallet.
sentences.zh: 嘿，老兄，你的皮夾掉了。

gloss_note: 加強語氣；回話 Absolutely! 表示完全同意或「當然可以」

sentences.en: Absolutely! I'd love to join you.
sentences.zh: 當然！我很樂意加入你們。

sentences.en: This soup is absolutely delicious.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯真是太好喝了。

sentences.en: Are you sure about this? Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 你確定嗎？百分之百確定。

sentences.en: I absolutely hate waiting in long lines.
sentences.zh: 我真的超討厭排長隊。

sentences.en: It was absolutely freezing last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚真的冷得要命。

sentences.en: You're absolutely right about that.
sentences.zh: 你說得完全正確。

gloss_note: mess up 搞砸；make a mess 弄得亂七八糟

sentences.en: Sorry about the mess in here.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，這裡有點亂。

sentences.en: My room is a total mess.
sentences.zh: 我的房間亂得一塌糊塗。

sentences.en: I really messed up the order.
sentences.zh: 我真的把訂單弄砸了。

sentences.en: Don't worry, I'll clean up the mess.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，我會把這團亂收乾淨。

sentences.en: Did I mess up the directions?
sentences.zh: 我是不是把路線搞錯了？

sentences.en: What a mess! Who spilled the juice?
sentences.zh: 亂成這樣！誰打翻了果汁？

gloss_note: I swear 用來強調自己說的是真的；swear to 發誓做到

sentences.en: I swear I locked the door.
sentences.zh: 我發誓我有鎖門。

sentences.en: I swear I didn't take your pen.
sentences.zh: 我發誓我沒拿你的筆。

sentences.en: Do you swear to keep it secret?
sentences.zh: 你發誓會保密嗎？

sentences.en: She swore she'd never be late again.
sentences.zh: 她發誓再也不會遲到了。

sentences.en: I swear this is the best pizza ever.
sentences.zh: 我發誓這是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

sentences.en: I could swear I saw him here.
sentences.zh: 我敢發誓我在這裡見過他。

gloss_note: 年輕人口語，不分男女朋友都能叫，也可表驚訝

sentences.en: Dude, you won't believe this!
sentences.zh: 老兄，你絕對不會相信這件事！

sentences.en: Hey dude, what are you doing tonight?
sentences.zh: 嘿，老兄，你今晚要幹嘛？

sentences.en: That was so cool, dude.
sentences.zh: 那真的超酷，老兄。

sentences.en: Thanks, dude. I owe you one.
sentences.zh: 謝啦，老兄，我欠你一次。

sentences.en: That dude over there is my cousin.
sentences.zh: 那邊那個傢伙是我表哥。

sentences.en: Dude, did you see that goal?
sentences.zh: 老兄，你有看到那個進球嗎？

gloss_note: 口語常用，語氣比 strange 輕鬆

sentences.en: That's weird. I just saw him.
sentences.zh: 好奇怪，我剛剛才看到他。

sentences.en: This tastes a little weird.
sentences.zh: 這個吃起來有點怪怪的。

sentences.en: Isn't it weird how quiet it is?
sentences.zh: 你不覺得這裡安靜得很奇怪嗎？

sentences.en: I had a weird dream last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚做了一個怪夢。

sentences.en: It's weird, but I like it.
sentences.zh: 雖然很怪，但我喜歡。

sentences.en: Why is my phone acting so weird?
sentences.zh: 我的手機為什麼怪怪的？

gloss_note: 可指事情艱難或人堅強；Tough luck 表示「真倒楣」

sentences.en: It was a tough week at work.
sentences.zh: 這週工作很辛苦。

sentences.en: You're tougher than you think.
sentences.zh: 你比你想像的還堅強。

sentences.en: How tough was the hike yesterday?
sentences.zh: 昨天的健行有多辛苦？

sentences.en: Is the exam going to be tough?
sentences.zh: 這次考試會很難嗎？

sentences.en: Moving to a new city is tough.
sentences.zh: 搬到新城市很不容易。

sentences.en: It's tough to find parking here.
sentences.zh: 這裡很難找到停車位。

gloss_note: 過去式 proved，過去分詞 proved 或 proven

sentences.en: Can you prove what you just said?
sentences.zh: 你能證明你剛剛說的話嗎？

sentences.en: She proved everyone wrong in the end.
sentences.zh: 她最後證明了大家都錯了。

sentences.en: I'll prove that I can do this.
sentences.zh: 我會證明我做得到。

sentences.en: The test results proved it's safe.
sentences.zh: 檢驗結果證明它是安全的。

sentences.en: You don't have to prove anything to me.
sentences.zh: 你不需要向我證明什麼。

sentences.en: How can I prove this is my bag?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼證明這是我的包包？

gloss_note: Relax! 也用來叫人別緊張、冷靜

sentences.en: Just relax. Everything will be fine.
sentences.zh: 放輕鬆，一切都會沒事的。

sentences.en: I want to relax at home tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚想在家放鬆一下。

sentences.en: Can you relax for a minute?
sentences.zh: 你可以先冷靜一下嗎？

sentences.en: We relaxed by the pool all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊放鬆。

sentences.en: How do you usually relax after work?
sentences.zh: 你下班後通常怎麼放鬆？

sentences.en: Relax! We still have plenty of time.
sentences.zh: 別緊張！我們時間還很多。

gloss_note: airport security 機場安檢；home security 居家安全

sentences.en: We have to go through security first.
sentences.zh: 我們得先過安檢。

sentences.en: Where is the security checkpoint?
sentences.zh: 安檢站在哪裡？

sentences.en: The hotel security guard was very helpful.
sentences.zh: 飯店的保全人員幫了很大的忙。

sentences.en: This app has better security than the old one.
sentences.zh: 這個軟體的安全性比舊的好。

sentences.en: Can I keep my laptop in my bag at security?
sentences.zh: 過安檢時筆電可以放在包包裡嗎？

sentences.en: The building has 24-hour security cameras.
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓有二十四小時監視器。

gloss_note: worried about + 事物／人；也可說 I'm worried that…

sentences.en: I'm worried about my flight tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我很擔心明天的班機。

sentences.en: I'm a little worried about my job interview tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我有點擔心明天的工作面試。

sentences.en: Are you worried about the weather?
sentences.zh: 你擔心天氣嗎？

sentences.en: She looked worried when she got the call.
sentences.zh: 她接到電話時看起來很擔心。

sentences.en: Mom was worried because I didn't text back.
sentences.zh: 我沒回訊息，媽媽很擔心。

sentences.en: I'm a little worried about the price.
sentences.zh: 我有點擔心價格。

gloss_note: 常用 Don't mention it（不客氣）；mention to 某人

sentences.en: Did he mention what time the party starts?
sentences.zh: 他有提到派對幾點開始嗎？

sentences.en: She never mentioned that she was moving.
sentences.zh: 她從來沒提過她要搬家。

sentences.en: Don't mention it to Tom yet.
sentences.zh: 先別跟湯姆提這件事。

sentences.en: The manager mentioned a new schedule at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理在會議上提到新的排班表。

sentences.en: Did I mention I got a new job?
sentences.zh: 我有跟你說我找到新工作了嗎？

sentences.en: He mentioned a good pizza place near here.
sentences.zh: 他提過這附近有間不錯的披薩店。

gloss_note: owe 某人 + 金額；I owe you one 我欠你一次

sentences.en: How much do I owe you for lunch?
sentences.zh: 午餐我欠你多少錢？

sentences.en: I owe my sister fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 我欠我姊姊五十美元。

sentences.en: You don't owe me anything.
sentences.zh: 你什麼都不欠我。

sentences.en: He still owes the bank a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 他還欠銀行很多錢。

sentences.en: I owe you one for helping me move.
sentences.zh: 你幫我搬家，我欠你一次人情。

sentences.en: Do you owe anyone money right now?
sentences.zh: 你現在有欠誰錢嗎？

gloss_note: grab lunch／a coffee／a bite 指隨意吃點東西，很口語

sentences.en: Let's grab lunch after the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開完會我們去吃個午餐吧。

sentences.en: Can I grab a coffee before we go?
sentences.zh: 出發前我可以先買杯咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: Grab your jacket, it's cold outside.
sentences.zh: 拿件外套，外面很冷。

sentences.en: He grabbed my arm to stop me.
sentences.zh: 他抓住我的手臂要攔住我。

sentences.en: Do you want to grab a bite?
sentences.zh: 要不要隨便吃點東西？

sentences.en: She grabbed a sandwich on her way to work.
sentences.zh: 她上班路上順手買了個三明治。

gloss_note: a difficult／tricky situation 棘手的情況

sentences.en: I'm in a difficult situation right now.
sentences.zh: 我現在處境很為難。

sentences.en: What's the situation with our flight?
sentences.zh: 我們的班機現在狀況如何？

sentences.en: Let me explain the situation to my boss.
sentences.zh: 讓我向老闆說明一下狀況。

sentences.en: It's a complicated situation, so be careful.
sentences.zh: 這情況有點複雜，要小心。

sentences.en: Can you handle this situation by yourself?
sentences.zh: 這個狀況你能自己處理嗎？

sentences.en: The situation at home is getting better.
sentences.zh: 家裡的情況漸漸好轉了。

gloss_note: take forever 花超久；waiting forever 等好久

sentences.en: This line is taking forever.
sentences.zh: 這個隊伍排好久。

sentences.en: I'll remember this trip forever.
sentences.zh: 我會永遠記得這趟旅行。

sentences.en: Do you always take forever to get ready?
sentences.zh: 你準備出門都要花這麼久嗎？

sentences.en: The food took forever to come.
sentences.zh: 餐點等了好久才送來。

sentences.en: We've been waiting here forever.
sentences.zh: 我們在這裡等了超久。

sentences.en: I wish this weekend could last forever.
sentences.zh: 真希望這個週末可以永遠不結束。

gloss_note: 口語常當強調或同意：Totally! 沒錯！

sentences.en: I totally forgot about the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我完全忘了開會的事。

sentences.en: That movie was totally awesome.
sentences.zh: 那部電影超讚的。

sentences.en: Are you totally sure about this?
sentences.zh: 你真的完全確定嗎？

sentences.en: She totally ignored my text message.
sentences.zh: 她完全不理我的訊息。

sentences.en: Totally! I'd love to come with you.
sentences.zh: 當然！我很想跟你一起去。

sentences.en: Wait, you totally forgot my birthday?
sentences.zh: 等等，你完全忘了我的生日？

gloss_note: 比 totally 稍正式，可修飾形容詞或動詞

sentences.en: I completely understand how you feel.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解你的感受。

sentences.en: The restaurant was completely empty.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳一個客人也沒有。

sentences.en: Are you completely sure you locked the door?
sentences.zh: 你完全確定有鎖門嗎？

sentences.en: My phone is completely dead.
sentences.zh: 我的手機完全沒電了。

sentences.en: That's a completely different story.
sentences.zh: 那是完全不同的另一回事。

sentences.en: Did the snow completely block the road?
sentences.zh: 雪完全把路堵住了嗎？

gloss_note: 常用被動 be involved in（參與；牽涉其中）

sentences.en: Does the job involve a lot of travel?
sentences.zh: 這份工作要常出差嗎？

sentences.en: I don't want to get involved in this.
sentences.zh: 我不想攪進這件事。

sentences.en: The plan involves a lot of risk.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫牽涉到很大的風險。

sentences.en: Why did you involve me in your argument?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要把我扯進你們的爭執？

sentences.en: My job doesn't involve much paperwork.
sentences.zh: 我的工作沒什麼文書作業。

sentences.en: Who else was involved in the accident?
sentences.zh: 還有誰牽涉在這場意外裡？

gloss_note: 複數；Hi folks 招呼大家；my folks 我爸媽（口語）

sentences.en: Hi, folks! Welcome to our store.
sentences.zh: 各位好！歡迎光臨本店。

sentences.en: My folks are visiting us this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽這個週末要來看我們。

sentences.en: How are you folks doing tonight?
sentences.zh: 各位今晚好嗎？

sentences.en: That's all for today, folks.
sentences.zh: 各位，今天就到這裡。

sentences.en: Do your folks live nearby?
sentences.zh: 你爸媽住在附近嗎？

sentences.en: Hey folks, dinner is ready!
sentences.zh: 各位，晚餐好了！

gloss_note: 口語常用來稱讚，比 good 更強烈

sentences.en: The view from here is amazing.
sentences.zh: 這裡的風景太美了。

sentences.en: You did an amazing job today.
sentences.zh: 你今天表現得超棒。

sentences.en: Isn't this pasta really amazing?
sentences.zh: 這個義大利麵是不是超好吃？

sentences.en: It's amazing how fast kids grow up.
sentences.zh: 小孩長大的速度真驚人。

sentences.en: Her new apartment looks amazing.
sentences.zh: 她的新公寓看起來超棒。

sentences.en: Have you seen that amazing new show?
sentences.zh: 你看過那部很棒的新影集嗎？

gloss_note: a happy marriage 幸福的婚姻；婚禮是 wedding

sentences.en: Their marriage has lasted thirty years.
sentences.zh: 他們的婚姻維持了三十年。

sentences.en: A good marriage takes work and patience.
sentences.zh: 好的婚姻需要用心經營和耐心。

sentences.en: What's the secret to a happy marriage?
sentences.zh: 幸福婚姻的祕訣是什麼？

sentences.en: Are you ready for marriage?
sentences.zh: 你準備好步入婚姻了嗎？

sentences.en: My parents' marriage was a happy one.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽的婚姻很幸福。

sentences.en: Honest talk is important in a marriage.
sentences.zh: 誠實溝通對婚姻很重要。

gloss_note: ought to + 動詞；語氣比 should 稍強，否定 ought not to

sentences.en: You ought to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 你應該去看醫生。

sentences.en: We ought to leave before it gets dark.
sentences.zh: 我們該在天黑前離開。

sentences.en: Do you think I ought to apologize?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我該道歉嗎？

sentences.en: He ought to be here by now.
sentences.zh: 他現在應該到了。

sentences.en: You really ought to try the cheesecake here.
sentences.zh: 你真的該試試這裡的起司蛋糕。

sentences.en: I ought to bring a gift, right?
sentences.zh: 我應該帶份禮物，對吧？

gloss_note: screw up 搞砸、弄糟；口語，語氣輕微

sentences.en: Please don't screw up this time.
sentences.zh: 這次拜託別搞砸了。

sentences.en: I screwed up the interview yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天把面試搞砸了。

sentences.en: Don't worry, everyone screws up sometimes.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，每個人都有搞砸的時候。

sentences.en: Did I screw up the order again?
sentences.zh: 我又把訂單搞砸了嗎？

sentences.en: He screwed up and missed the flight.
sentences.zh: 他搞砸了，錯過了班機。

sentences.en: Sorry, I screwed up the plan.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我把計畫搞砸了。

gloss_note: be upset about／with 為…難過、生…的氣

sentences.en: She was upset about the bad news.
sentences.zh: 她聽到壞消息很難過。

sentences.en: Are you still upset with me?
sentences.zh: 你還在生我的氣嗎？

sentences.en: Don't be upset, it's no big deal.
sentences.zh: 別不高興，沒什麼大不了。

sentences.en: He got upset when I was late.
sentences.zh: 我遲到時他不高興了。

sentences.en: Why do you look so upset?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼看起來這麼心煩？

sentences.en: My dog gets upset during thunderstorms.
sentences.zh: 我的狗遇到打雷會很不安。

gloss_note: 放在名詞前：the entire day／team

sentences.en: I spent the entire weekend cleaning.
sentences.zh: 我整個週末都在打掃。

sentences.en: The entire team stayed late last night.
sentences.zh: 整個團隊昨晚都留到很晚。

sentences.en: Did you read the entire book?
sentences.zh: 你整本書都讀完了嗎？

sentences.en: She ate the entire pizza by herself.
sentences.zh: 她一個人把整個披薩吃完了。

sentences.en: The entire street was closed for the parade.
sentences.zh: 整條街為了遊行封閉了。

sentences.en: Is the entire hotel booked this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末整間飯店都訂滿了嗎？

gloss_note: in a relationship 在交往；也指人際關係

sentences.en: How long have they been in a relationship?
sentences.zh: 他們交往多久了？

sentences.en: I have a good relationship with my boss.
sentences.zh: 我跟老闆的關係很好。

sentences.en: A long-distance relationship can be really hard.
sentences.zh: 遠距離戀愛真的很辛苦。

sentences.en: We're not in a relationship; we're just friends.
sentences.zh: 我們沒在交往，只是朋友。

sentences.en: Trust is key to any relationship.
sentences.zh: 信任是任何關係的關鍵。

sentences.en: What's your relationship with that guy?
sentences.zh: 你跟那個人是什麼關係？

gloss_note: do me a favor 幫我個忙；ask a favor 請託

sentences.en: Can I ask you a favor?
sentences.zh: 我能拜託你一件事嗎？

sentences.en: I need a favor from you.
sentences.zh: 我想請你幫個忙。

sentences.en: Thanks for the favor. I owe you one.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你幫忙，我欠你一次。

sentences.en: Could you do me a favor and watch my bag?
sentences.zh: 可以幫我看一下包包嗎？

sentences.en: He asked me for a big favor.
sentences.zh: 他請我幫一個大忙。

sentences.en: Do me a favor and call me back.
sentences.zh: 幫個忙，回我電話。

gloss_note: breathe in 吸氣、breathe out 吐氣；名詞是 breath

sentences.en: Just relax and breathe slowly.
sentences.zh: 放輕鬆，慢慢呼吸。

sentences.en: I can't breathe in this crowded room.
sentences.zh: 這個擠滿人的房間讓我喘不過氣。

sentences.en: Why is it so hard to breathe here?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這裡這麼難呼吸？

sentences.en: Can you breathe okay with that mask on?
sentences.zh: 戴著那個口罩你呼吸還好嗎？

sentences.en: Let's open a window so we can breathe.
sentences.zh: 我們開個窗吧，才有新鮮空氣。

sentences.en: The doctor asked me to breathe in deeply.
sentences.zh: 醫生請我深吸一口氣。

gloss_note: 口語罵人，對朋友開玩笑可，勿對陌生人說

sentences.en: I felt like such an idiot at the party.
sentences.zh: 我在派對上覺得自己像個笨蛋。

sentences.en: Don't be an idiot, put your coat on.
sentences.zh: 別傻了，把外套穿上。

sentences.en: Some idiot parked right behind my car.
sentences.zh: 有個笨蛋把車停在我車子正後面。

sentences.en: Am I an idiot for trusting him?
sentences.zh: 我相信他，是不是很蠢？

sentences.en: He called himself an idiot for losing his keys.
sentences.zh: 他罵自己是笨蛋，竟然弄丟鑰匙。

sentences.en: Why did I act like such an idiot?
sentences.zh: 我剛剛怎麼表現得像個笨蛋？

gloss_note: for the sake of 為了；for…'s sake 看在…份上

sentences.en: Let's do it for the sake of the kids.
sentences.zh: 為了孩子們，我們就這麼做吧。

sentences.en: For goodness' sake, calm down!
sentences.zh: 拜託，冷靜一點！

sentences.en: I moved here for the sake of my career.
sentences.zh: 我是為了事業才搬來這裡的。

sentences.en: Don't argue just for the sake of arguing.
sentences.zh: 別為了吵而吵。

sentences.en: Did he stay for the sake of his family?
sentences.zh: 他是為了家人才留下來的嗎？

sentences.en: Would you quit your job for the sake of travel?
sentences.zh: 你會為了旅行辭掉工作嗎？

gloss_note: 單獨回答 Definitely! 表示「當然」

sentences.en: I'll definitely be there by six.
sentences.zh: 我六點一定會到。

sentences.en: Are you definitely coming tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚一定會來嗎？

sentences.en: That's definitely my bag over there.
sentences.zh: 那絕對是我的包包。

sentences.en: I'll definitely be there on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 我星期五晚上一定會到。

sentences.en: It's definitely going to rain today.
sentences.zh: 今天肯定會下雨。

sentences.en: We definitely need a bigger table.
sentences.zh: 我們肯定需要更大的桌子。

gloss_note: 服務業、公司業務對象；商店顧客多用 customer

sentences.en: I have a call with a client at three.
sentences.zh: 我三點要跟一位客戶通電話。

sentences.en: Our client wants to change the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我們的客戶想改截止日。

sentences.en: Is the client coming to the office today?
sentences.zh: 客戶今天會來公司嗎？

sentences.en: She is having lunch with an important client.
sentences.zh: 她正在跟一位重要客戶吃午餐。

sentences.en: The client loved our new design.
sentences.zh: 客戶很喜歡我們的新設計。

sentences.en: How did the meeting with the client go?
sentences.zh: 跟客戶的會議如何？

gloss_note: admit + that 子句／V-ing；admit it 承認吧

sentences.en: I have to admit, I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我得承認，是我錯了。

sentences.en: He wouldn't admit that he was lost.
sentences.zh: 他不肯承認他迷路了。

sentences.en: Did you break the vase? Just admit it.
sentences.zh: 花瓶是你打破的嗎？承認吧。

sentences.en: She admitted that she forgot the date.
sentences.zh: 她承認她忘了日期。

sentences.en: Come on, just admit it.
sentences.zh: 少來了，承認吧。

sentences.en: Why is it so hard to admit mistakes?
sentences.zh: 為什麼承認錯誤這麼難？

gloss_note: press a button 按按鈕；press and hold 長按

sentences.en: Press the red button to stop.
sentences.zh: 按紅色按鈕就會停。

sentences.en: Just press the power button twice.
sentences.zh: 只要按兩下電源鍵就好。

sentences.en: Which button do I press to start it?
sentences.zh: 我要按哪個鍵才能啟動？

sentences.en: Press and hold for three seconds.
sentences.zh: 按住三秒鐘。

sentences.en: I pressed the wrong button by mistake.
sentences.zh: 我不小心按錯鈕了。

sentences.en: Could you press the elevator button for me?
sentences.zh: 可以幫我按電梯鈕嗎？

gloss_note: get drunk 喝醉；喝醉開車是 drunk driving

sentences.en: He got drunk at the party last night.
sentences.zh: 他昨晚在派對上喝醉了。

sentences.en: Don't drive if you're drunk.
sentences.zh: 喝醉了就別開車。

sentences.en: Is she drunk, or just really sleepy?
sentences.zh: 她是喝醉了，還是只是很睏？

sentences.en: My roommate came home drunk and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 我室友喝得醉醺醺回家就睡著了。

sentences.en: Are you drunk? You're acting really silly.
sentences.zh: 你喝醉了嗎？你表現得好蠢。

sentences.en: Nobody was drunk, just a little loud.
sentences.zh: 沒人喝醉，只是有點吵。

gloss_note: back to normal 恢復正常

sentences.en: Is it normal to feel this tired?
sentences.zh: 會這麼累是正常的嗎？

sentences.en: Everything looks normal to me.
sentences.zh: 我看一切都很正常。

sentences.en: It's normal to be nervous before a trip.
sentences.zh: 旅行前緊張很正常。

sentences.en: The doctor said my test results are normal.
sentences.zh: 醫生說我的檢查結果正常。

sentences.en: Is it normal for the bus to be this late?
sentences.zh: 公車晚這麼久，正常嗎？

sentences.en: Is that a normal price for a hotel here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的飯店一般都這個價錢嗎？

gloss_note: freak out 口語，驚慌失控；名詞 freak 指怪人

sentences.en: Don't freak out, it's just a spider.
sentences.zh: 別嚇壞了，只是隻蜘蛛。

sentences.en: I freaked out when I lost my passport.
sentences.zh: 我弄丟護照時整個抓狂。

sentences.en: Why are you freaking out about this?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼為這件事抓狂？

sentences.en: My mom will freak out if I'm late.
sentences.zh: 我要是晚到，我媽會抓狂。

sentences.en: Did you freak out during the exam?
sentences.zh: 你考試時有慌掉嗎？

sentences.en: Calm down, there's no need to freak out.
sentences.zh: 冷靜點，不用這麼慌。

gloss_note: deserve + 名詞／to + 動詞；You deserve it 你應得的

sentences.en: Don't you think you deserve a long vacation?
sentences.zh: 你不覺得你該放個長假嗎？

sentences.en: She really deserves that promotion.
sentences.zh: 她真的應得那次升遷。

sentences.en: Do you think he deserves a second chance?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他值得再有一次機會嗎？

sentences.en: We deserve better service than this.
sentences.zh: 我們應該得到更好的服務。

sentences.en: Nobody deserves to be treated that way.
sentences.zh: 沒有人該被那樣對待。

sentences.en: You've worked hard, so you deserve a break.
sentences.zh: 你一直很努力，休息一下是應該的。

gloss_note: settle down 安定、安靜下來；也指定居

sentences.en: Kids, settle down; dinner is almost ready.
sentences.zh: 孩子們，安靜下來，晚餐快好了。

sentences.en: They settled down in Texas after retiring.
sentences.zh: 他們退休後在德州定居下來。

sentences.en: Do you plan to settle down someday?
sentences.zh: 你打算哪天安定下來嗎？

sentences.en: The baby finally settled down and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 寶寶終於安靜下來睡著了。

sentences.en: I need a minute to settle in.
sentences.zh: 我需要一點時間安頓一下。

sentences.en: Can you settle down for a minute, please?
sentences.zh: 你可以安靜一下嗎？

gloss_note: 指班機、火車、巴士等離站出發；日常說 leave 較口語

sentences.en: Our flight departs from Gate 24 at 6:40.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機六點四十分從二十四號登機門出發。

sentences.en: What time does the last bus depart for downtown?
sentences.zh: 最後一班往市區的巴士幾點發車？

sentences.en: The train will depart in five minutes, so hurry up.
sentences.zh: 火車五分鐘後就要開了，快一點。

sentences.en: We departed late because of the snow.
sentences.zh: 因為下雪，我們很晚才出發。

sentences.en: Does the ferry depart every hour on the hour?
sentences.zh: 渡輪是每個整點都有一班嗎？

sentences.en: Passengers departing from Terminal 2 should check in here.
sentences.zh: 從第二航廈出發的旅客請在這裡報到。

gloss_note: 也可指航線業者；問哪家航空常說 which airline

sentences.en: Which airline are you flying with tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天搭哪一家航空公司？

sentences.en: The airline lost my suitcase on the way here.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在來的途中把我的行李弄丟了。

sentences.en: This airline lets you bring one free carry-on bag.
sentences.zh: 這家航空公司讓你免費帶一件隨身行李。

sentences.en: I'll call the airline and ask about a refund.
sentences.zh: 我來打給航空公司問問退費的事。

sentences.en: Is there an airline desk near the exit?
sentences.zh: 出口附近有航空公司的櫃檯嗎？

sentences.en: Several airlines offer cheap flights to Chicago in March.
sentences.zh: 好幾家航空公司三月都有飛芝加哥的便宜機票。

gloss_note: 常見 confirm a reservation／your flight；名詞 confirmation

sentences.en: I'm calling to confirm my reservation for tonight.
sentences.zh: 我打電話來確認今晚的訂位。

sentences.en: Can you confirm my flight is still on time?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我確認班機還是準時嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel emailed me to confirm the booking.
sentences.zh: 飯店寄了信跟我確認訂房。

sentences.en: Please confirm your name and the date of arrival.
sentences.zh: 請確認您的姓名和抵達日期。

sentences.en: We confirmed our table for six at seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我們確認了七點六個人的位子。

sentences.en: Did they confirm the pickup time with you?
sentences.zh: 他們有跟你確認接送時間嗎？

gloss_note: 即 economy class；商務艙是 business class

sentences.en: I booked an economy seat to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我訂了一張飛洛杉磯的經濟艙座位。

sentences.en: How much extra is it to upgrade from economy?
sentences.zh: 從經濟艙升等要多付多少錢？

sentences.en: Economy is cheaper, but the seats are pretty tight.
sentences.zh: 經濟艙比較便宜，但座位滿擠的。

sentences.en: We flew economy and still got a free snack.
sentences.zh: 我們坐經濟艙，還是有免費的點心。

sentences.en: Is the extra legroom in economy worth the price?
sentences.zh: 經濟艙多出來的腿部空間值這個價錢嗎？

sentences.en: I'm flying economy this time to save money.
sentences.zh: 這次我坐經濟艙，想省點錢。

gloss_note: 餐廳、飯店、租車都用；make a reservation 是常用說法

sentences.en: Do you have a reservation for tonight?
sentences.zh: 請問您今晚有訂位嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to make a reservation for two at eight.
sentences.zh: 我想訂八點兩個人的位子。

sentences.en: The reservation is under the name Johnson.
sentences.zh: 訂位是用強森這個姓。

sentences.en: Can I change my reservation to Saturday instead?
sentences.zh: 我可以把預訂改成星期六嗎？

sentences.en: We made a reservation a month ago for the cabin.
sentences.zh: 我們一個月前就訂了那間小木屋。

sentences.en: Sorry, we can't find your reservation in the system.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，系統裡找不到您的預訂紀錄。

gloss_note: 較正式，口語常說 book；reserve a table／room

sentences.en: I'd like to reserve a table by the window.
sentences.zh: 我想預訂一張靠窗的桌子。

sentences.en: Can I reserve a rental car for next weekend?
sentences.zh: 我可以預訂下週末的租車嗎？

sentences.en: We reserved two rooms near the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了兩間靠海灘的房間。

sentences.en: You should reserve a table for Friday night.
sentences.zh: 你應該預訂星期五晚上的位子。

sentences.en: Did you reserve seats for the show tonight?
sentences.zh: 你有幫今晚的表演訂位子嗎？

sentences.en: This table is reserved for a family of five.
sentences.zh: 這張桌子已經被一家五口預訂了。

gloss_note: 常說 tourist attraction（觀光景點）

sentences.en: What's the best tourist attraction in this city?
sentences.zh: 這座城市最棒的觀光景點是哪裡？

sentences.en: The museum is the main attraction downtown.
sentences.zh: 那間博物館是市中心的主要景點。

sentences.en: Is there any attraction within walking distance?
sentences.zh: 走路可到的範圍內有什麼景點嗎？

sentences.en: We visited three attractions in one day.
sentences.zh: 我們一天逛了三個景點。

sentences.en: This park is a popular attraction for families.
sentences.zh: 這座公園是很受家庭歡迎的景點。

sentences.en: Do the attractions here close early in winter?
sentences.zh: 這裡的景點冬天會提早關門嗎？

gloss_note: App 與網站上的星星評價；five-star rating

sentences.en: This hotel has a rating of 4.5 stars.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店的評分是四點五顆星。

sentences.en: What's the rating of that Thai restaurant?
sentences.zh: 那家泰式餐廳的評價幾顆星？

sentences.en: The driver has a perfect five-star rating.
sentences.zh: 這位司機有滿分的五星評價。

sentences.en: I only book places with a high rating.
sentences.zh: 我只訂評價高的地方。

sentences.en: Why is the rating so low for this place?
sentences.zh: 這個地方的評分為什麼這麼低？

sentences.en: Check the ratings before you pick a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 挑餐廳之前先看一下評價。

gloss_note: prefer A to B；也常用 I'd prefer...（我比較想要）

sentences.en: Do you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡靠窗還是靠走道的座位？

sentences.en: I'd prefer a room away from the elevator.
sentences.zh: 我比較想要離電梯遠一點的房間。

sentences.en: Most of my friends prefer coffee to tea.
sentences.zh: 我大部分朋友比較愛喝咖啡而不是茶。

sentences.en: She prefers to walk when the weather is nice.
sentences.zh: 天氣好的時候，她比較喜歡走路。

sentences.en: Would you prefer to pay by card or cash?
sentences.zh: 您想用刷卡還是付現？

sentences.en: We preferred the small hotel over the big resort.
sentences.zh: 比起大型度假村，我們更喜歡那間小飯店。

gloss_note: standard room 指基本房型；也可指一般規格

sentences.en: I'd like a standard room with two beds, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一間兩張床的標準房。

sentences.en: What's the difference between standard and deluxe rooms?
sentences.zh: 標準房和豪華房有什麼差別？

sentences.en: A standard room costs about one hundred dollars here.
sentences.zh: 這裡一間標準房大約一百美元。

sentences.en: Is breakfast included in the standard rate?
sentences.zh: 標準房價有含早餐嗎？

sentences.en: A standard room has one queen bed.
sentences.zh: 標準房有一張雙人床。

sentences.en: Can I upgrade from a standard room to a suite?
sentences.zh: 我可以從標準房升等到套房嗎？

gloss_note: rental car 租來的車；也可當名詞指出租

sentences.en: Where is the rental car counter, please?
sentences.zh: 請問租車櫃檯在哪裡？

sentences.en: We picked up our rental car at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我們在機場領了租來的車。

sentences.en: Does the rental price include gas?
sentences.zh: 租車費用有含油錢嗎？

sentences.en: Don't forget to return the rental car by noon.
sentences.zh: 別忘了中午前把租來的車還回去。

sentences.en: Our rental house is only two blocks from the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們租的房子離海灘只有兩個街區。

sentences.en: A weekly rental is cheaper than paying by the day.
sentences.zh: 一週的租期比按天算便宜。

gloss_note: in detail 詳細地；details 也指詳細資料

sentences.en: Can you send me the details of the trip?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這趟旅行的細節寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: Please check the details of your booking carefully.
sentences.zh: 請仔細確認您訂單的詳細資料。

sentences.en: I forgot one small detail about the flight.
sentences.zh: 我忘了班機的一個小細節。

sentences.en: The guide explained every detail of the tour.
sentences.zh: 導遊把行程的每個細節都解釋了一遍。

sentences.en: Is there more detail about the hotel's cancellation policy?
sentences.zh: 有關於飯店取消規定的更多說明嗎？

sentences.en: What other details do you need from me?
sentences.zh: 你還需要我提供哪些細節？

gloss_note: 與 arrival（抵達）相對；departure time／gate

sentences.en: What's the departure time for the morning train?
sentences.zh: 早上那班火車的發車時間是幾點？

sentences.en: Our departure was delayed by two hours.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機延後兩個小時起飛。

sentences.en: Check the departures board for your gate number.
sentences.zh: 看一下出發看板，找你的登機門號碼。

sentences.en: Is there a fee for changing my departure date?
sentences.zh: 更改出發日期要收費嗎？

sentences.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
sentences.zh: 請在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

sentences.en: Where do I go for international departures?
sentences.zh: 請問國際線出境要往哪走？

gloss_note: have no other option 別無選擇；options 可指各種方案

sentences.en: Do you have any cheaper options for tonight?
sentences.zh: 你們今晚有比較便宜的選擇嗎？

sentences.en: The cheapest option is the bus, but it's slow.
sentences.zh: 最便宜的選擇是搭巴士，但很慢。

sentences.en: Is there a vegetarian option on the menu?
sentences.zh: 菜單上有素食的選項嗎？

sentences.en: We have two options: take a taxi or walk.
sentences.zh: 我們有兩個選擇：搭計程車或走路。

sentences.en: Which option would you recommend for a family?
sentences.zh: 對一家人來說，你會推薦哪個方案？

sentences.en: Free cancellation is a great option if plans change.
sentences.zh: 如果行程有變，免費取消是很好的選擇。

gloss_note: 也指旅遊勝地，如 a popular destination

sentences.en: What's your final destination today?
sentences.zh: 你今天最後要到哪裡？

sentences.en: Please enter your destination on your phone.
sentences.zh: 請在手機上輸入你的目的地。

sentences.en: Hawaii is a popular vacation destination.
sentences.zh: 夏威夷是很受歡迎的度假勝地。

sentences.en: We finally reached our destination around midnight.
sentences.zh: 我們午夜左右才終於抵達目的地。

sentences.en: Is this bus going to my destination?
sentences.zh: 這班巴士有到我要去的地方嗎？

sentences.en: Which destinations are cheapest to fly to in winter?
sentences.zh: 冬天飛哪些地方最便宜？

gloss_note: 英式較常用，美式也通；booking confirmation 訂單確認

sentences.en: I have a booking under the name Lee.
sentences.zh: 我有一筆用李這個姓訂的預訂。

sentences.en: Can I cancel my booking for free?
sentences.zh: 我可以免費取消訂房嗎？

sentences.en: The booking confirmation should be in your email.
sentences.zh: 訂單確認信應該已經在你的信箱裡了。

sentences.en: We made the booking three months in advance.
sentences.zh: 我們提前三個月訂好的。

sentences.en: Did you get the booking number from the website?
sentences.zh: 你有從網站上拿到訂單編號嗎？

sentences.en: Bookings for the summer fill up very fast.
sentences.zh: 夏天的預訂很快就額滿了。

gloss_note: do you have a preference? 你有特別想要的嗎

sentences.en: Do you have a seat preference?
sentences.zh: 你對座位有偏好嗎？

sentences.en: Any preference for a high floor or a low floor?
sentences.zh: 樓層有偏好高樓層還是低樓層嗎？

sentences.en: I have no preference, so you choose.
sentences.zh: 我沒有特別偏好，你決定吧。

sentences.en: Please tell us your meal preference before the flight.
sentences.zh: 請在搭機前告訴我們您的餐點偏好。

sentences.en: My preference is a quiet room on a high floor.
sentences.zh: 我比較想要高樓層的安靜房間。

sentences.en: What are your preferences for the hotel location?
sentences.zh: 你對飯店位置有什麼偏好？

gloss_note: 多用被動 be located in／at；也有「找出」義

sentences.en: The hotel is located right next to the station.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店就位在車站旁邊。

sentences.en: The car rental office is located inside the parking garage.
sentences.zh: 租車辦公室就在停車場大樓裡面。

sentences.en: Our room is located on the third floor.
sentences.zh: 我們的房間位在三樓。

sentences.en: Is the restaurant located inside the mall?
sentences.zh: 那間餐廳是在購物中心裡面嗎？

sentences.en: The beach is conveniently located ten minutes from here.
sentences.zh: 海灘離這裡只要十分鐘，位置很方便。

sentences.en: Is your hotel centrally located?
sentences.zh: 你們飯店位置在市中心嗎？

gloss_note: 發音似 sweet；比一般房間大，有客廳

sentences.en: We upgraded to a suite for our anniversary.
sentences.zh: 我們為了週年紀念升等到套房。

sentences.en: How much is the suite for one night?
sentences.zh: 套房一晚多少錢？

sentences.en: The suite has a living room and a kitchen.
sentences.zh: 這間套房有客廳和廚房。

sentences.en: Is there a suite available this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末還有套房嗎？

sentences.en: A family suite is perfect for four people.
sentences.zh: 家庭套房很適合四個人住。

sentences.en: Our suite has a great view of the city.
sentences.zh: 我們的套房可以看到很棒的城市景色。

gloss_note: 比 buy 正式；名詞指所買的東西或購買行為

sentences.en: You can purchase tickets at the booth over there.
sentences.zh: 你可以到那邊的窗口買票。

sentences.en: I purchased this travel pass online last week.
sentences.zh: 我上週在網路上買了這張交通票卡。

sentences.en: Can I purchase a day pass on the bus?
sentences.zh: 我可以在巴士上買一日票嗎？

sentences.en: Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
sentences.zh: 請保留收據當作購買證明。

sentences.en: Did you purchase insurance for the trip?
sentences.zh: 你有幫這趟旅行買保險嗎？

sentences.en: Once you purchase the ticket, you can't change it.
sentences.zh: 票一旦買了就不能更改。

gloss_note: pickup location／time；機場接機也說 airport pickup

sentences.en: Is airport pickup included in the price?
sentences.zh: 價格有含機場接送嗎？

sentences.en: Where is the pickup location for the shuttle?
sentences.zh: 接駁車的上車地點在哪裡？

sentences.en: Your driver will arrive at the pickup point in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 你的司機五分鐘後會到上車地點。

sentences.en: What time is the pickup tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 明天早上幾點來接？

sentences.en: I set the pickup spot near the main entrance.
sentences.zh: 我把上車地點設在大門口附近。

sentences.en: We arranged a car pickup for our whole group.
sentences.zh: 我們幫全團安排了派車接送。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 地鐵、巴士換車；also 機場與飯店間的接駁

sentences.en: Do I need a transfer to get to the stadium?
sentences.zh: 我去體育場需要轉車嗎？

sentences.en: Ask the driver for a free transfer ticket.
sentences.zh: 跟司機要一張免費轉乘票。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a free transfer from the airport.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供免費的機場接駁。

sentences.en: We have to transfer at Union Station.
sentences.zh: 我們得在聯合車站換車。

sentences.en: Where can I transfer to the blue line?
sentences.zh: 我要在哪裡轉搭藍線？

sentences.en: The transfer from the train to the bus was easy.
sentences.zh: 從火車換搭巴士很順利。

gloss_note: 轉機時在中途機場等待的時間

sentences.en: I have a three-hour layover in Dallas.
sentences.zh: 我在達拉斯要轉機停留三個小時。

sentences.en: How long is the layover in Denver?
sentences.zh: 在丹佛要停留多久？

sentences.en: A short layover is risky if your first flight is late.
sentences.zh: 如果第一班飛機延誤，轉機時間太短就有風險。

sentences.en: We used our layover to grab dinner at the airport.
sentences.zh: 我們利用轉機的空檔在機場吃了晚餐。

sentences.en: Is it okay to leave the airport during the layover?
sentences.zh: 轉機停留時可以離開機場嗎？

sentences.en: Her layover was so long that she took a nap.
sentences.zh: 她轉機等了很久，所以小睡了一下。

gloss_note: 小型、有特色的住宿；常出現在店名如 Country Inn

sentences.en: We stayed at a cozy inn near the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們住在湖邊一間舒適的小旅館。

sentences.en: The inn serves breakfast from seven to ten.
sentences.zh: 這間小旅館的早餐從七點供應到十點。

sentences.en: Is there a small inn in this town?
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮上有小旅館嗎？

sentences.en: An inn is usually cheaper than a big hotel.
sentences.zh: 小旅館通常比大飯店便宜。

sentences.en: The old inn has only eight rooms.
sentences.zh: 這間老旅館只有八個房間。

sentences.en: Can you recommend a good inn near the park?
sentences.zh: 你能推薦公園附近不錯的小旅館嗎？

gloss_note: 飯店／租車的單日價格；room rate、daily rate

sentences.en: What's your rate for a double room tonight?
sentences.zh: 你們今晚雙人房的房價是多少？

sentences.en: The weekend rate is higher than the weekday rate.
sentences.zh: 週末房價比平日高。

sentences.en: Does the rate include tax and breakfast?
sentences.zh: 這個價格有含稅和早餐嗎？

sentences.en: We got a special rate because we booked early.
sentences.zh: 因為提早訂，我們拿到了優惠價。

sentences.en: The daily rate for this compact car is forty dollars.
sentences.zh: 這輛小型車的日租費率是四十美元。

sentences.en: Are there any cheaper rates for longer stays?
sentences.zh: 住比較久有沒有比較便宜的價格？

gloss_note: 飯店評價常說 great location；pickup location 上車處

sentences.en: The hotel's location is perfect for sightseeing.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店的位置很適合觀光。

sentences.en: Can you share your location with the driver?
sentences.zh: 你可以把你的位置分享給司機嗎？

sentences.en: What's the exact location of the museum?
sentences.zh: 博物館的確切位置在哪裡？

sentences.en: We chose this place for its quiet location.
sentences.zh: 我們選這裡是因為位置很安靜。

sentences.en: Is there another location of this store downtown?
sentences.zh: 這家店在市中心有別間分店嗎？

sentences.en: Which location is closer, the airport branch or this one?
sentences.zh: 機場分店和這家，哪個位置比較近？

gloss_note: 美國酒吧常需出示證件確認年齡

sentences.en: There's a nice bar on the roof of our hotel.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店的屋頂上有一間不錯的酒吧。

sentences.en: Let's meet at the bar after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們在酒吧碰面吧。

sentences.en: Is there a quiet bar near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有安靜一點的酒吧嗎？

sentences.en: The bar closes at midnight on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 這間酒吧平日午夜關門。

sentences.en: They asked to see my ID at the bar.
sentences.zh: 他們在酒吧要我出示證件。

sentences.en: We watched the game at a sports bar.
sentences.zh: 我們在一間運動酒吧看了比賽。

gloss_note: travel insurance 旅遊險；租車常問要不要加買

sentences.en: Do you want to add insurance to the rental?
sentences.zh: 您要幫這次租車加購保險嗎？

sentences.en: I bought travel insurance before the trip.
sentences.zh: 我出發前買了旅遊保險。

sentences.en: Does my insurance cover a lost suitcase?
sentences.zh: 我的保險有包含行李遺失嗎？

sentences.en: Please show me your driver's license and insurance card.
sentences.zh: 請出示您的駕照和保險卡。

sentences.en: The insurance costs ten dollars a day.
sentences.zh: 這個保險一天十美元。

sentences.en: What kind of insurance do I really need?
sentences.zh: 我到底需要哪種保險？

gloss_note: do laundry 洗衣服；飯店有 laundry service

sentences.en: Does the hotel offer laundry service?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有提供洗衣服務嗎？

sentences.en: I need to do laundry before we leave.
sentences.zh: 我們出發前得洗一下衣服。

sentences.en: Where's the laundry room in this building?
sentences.zh: 這棟樓的洗衣間在哪裡？

sentences.en: How much is laundry per bag here?
sentences.zh: 這裡洗衣一袋多少錢？

sentences.en: I left my laundry in the dryer.
sentences.zh: 我把洗好的衣服忘在烘乾機裡了。

sentences.en: Can I get my laundry back by tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 我明天早上前可以拿到洗好的衣服嗎？

gloss_note: 租車等級 compact car，比 economy 大一點

sentences.en: I'd like to rent a compact car for three days.
sentences.zh: 我想租一輛小型車三天。

sentences.en: A compact is easier to park in the city.
sentences.zh: 小型車在市區比較好停。

sentences.en: Do you have a compact with an automatic transmission?
sentences.zh: 你們有自排的小型車嗎？

sentences.en: We booked a compact, but they gave us an SUV.
sentences.zh: 我們訂的是小型車，結果他們給了我們一輛休旅車。

sentences.en: This compact car gets great gas mileage.
sentences.zh: 這輛小型車很省油。

sentences.en: Is the compact big enough for four suitcases?
sentences.zh: 小型車放得下四個行李箱嗎？

gloss_note: 反義 non-refundable（不可退款）

sentences.en: Is this ticket refundable if I cancel?
sentences.zh: 如果我取消，這張票可以退款嗎？

sentences.en: The cheaper fare is not refundable.
sentences.zh: 比較便宜的票價不能退款。

sentences.en: I picked a refundable room just in case.
sentences.zh: 我為了保險起見選了可退款的房型。

sentences.en: Are these tickets refundable or exchangeable?
sentences.zh: 這些票可以退款或改期嗎？

sentences.en: The deposit is fully refundable until Friday.
sentences.zh: 訂金到星期五前都可以全額退回。

sentences.en: Always look for a refundable option when plans are uncertain.
sentences.zh: 行程還沒確定時，記得選可退款的方案。

gloss_note: 中途不停；也常當副詞「不停地」

sentences.en: Is there a nonstop flight to Seattle?
sentences.zh: 有直飛西雅圖的班機嗎？

sentences.en: I'd pay more for a nonstop flight.
sentences.zh: 我願意多付錢搭直飛班機。

sentences.en: The nonstop trip takes about five hours.
sentences.zh: 直飛的行程大約要五個小時。

sentences.en: Nonstop flights are more expensive than ones with layovers.
sentences.zh: 直飛班機比要轉機的貴。

sentences.en: We took a nonstop bus straight to the city.
sentences.zh: 我們搭直達巴士直接進城。

sentences.en: Which airline has nonstop service to Boston?
sentences.zh: 哪家航空公司有直飛波士頓的服務？

gloss_note: 較正式的說法；口語多半直接說 help

sentences.en: Can someone assist me with my bags, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請人幫我拿一下行李嗎？

sentences.en: The front desk will assist you with check-in.
sentences.zh: 櫃檯會協助您辦理入住。

sentences.en: Excuse me, could you assist us with directions?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，可以請你幫我們指個路嗎？

sentences.en: A staff member assisted me at the rental counter.
sentences.zh: 租車櫃檯有位店員協助了我。

sentences.en: Is there anyone here who can assist with tickets?
sentences.zh: 這裡有人可以協助處理票務嗎？

sentences.en: Thanks for assisting us during the long delay.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你在漫長的延誤期間協助我們。

gloss_note: 常見搭配 beach resort、ski resort

sentences.en: We booked a beach resort for our honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了一間海灘度假村度蜜月。

sentences.en: Does the resort have a pool and a spa?
sentences.zh: 這間度假村有游泳池和水療中心嗎？

sentences.en: The ski resort is about two hours from here.
sentences.zh: 那個滑雪度假村離這裡大約兩小時車程。

sentences.en: How much is the resort fee per night?
sentences.zh: 度假村費每晚要多少錢？

sentences.en: This resort offers a free shuttle to the airport.
sentences.zh: 這間度假村提供免費機場接駁車。

sentences.en: Many families stay at resorts during summer break.
sentences.zh: 許多家庭暑假會住在度假村。

gloss_note: 口語很常用；原義是令人敬畏的

sentences.en: The view from the top is awesome!
sentences.zh: 山頂的景色超讚！

sentences.en: Your hotel sounds awesome. Is it near the beach?
sentences.zh: 你住的飯店聽起來超棒。離海灘近嗎？

sentences.en: That was an awesome trip. Thanks for planning it.
sentences.zh: 那趟旅行太棒了，謝謝你規劃。

sentences.en: You got a free upgrade? That's awesome!
sentences.zh: 你拿到免費升等？太棒了！

sentences.en: The tacos at this place are awesome.
sentences.zh: 這家店的塔可超好吃。

sentences.en: Is the new theme park really as awesome as everyone says?
sentences.zh: 新的主題樂園真的像大家說的那麼棒嗎？

gloss_note: arrival time 抵達時間；與 departure（出發）相對

sentences.en: What's our arrival time in Chicago?
sentences.zh: 我們幾點會抵達芝加哥？

sentences.en: Our arrival at the hotel was delayed by traffic.
sentences.zh: 因為塞車，我們比預定時間晚到飯店。

sentences.en: Check the arrivals board to see if her flight landed.
sentences.zh: 看一下抵達看板，確認她的班機降落了沒。

sentences.en: Upon arrival, go straight to immigration.
sentences.zh: 抵達後請直接前往入境審查。

sentences.en: Is there a shuttle available on arrival?
sentences.zh: 抵達時有接駁車可以搭嗎？

sentences.en: We'll text you after our arrival in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我們抵達芝加哥後會傳訊息給你。

gloss_note: 常說 price range；in the range of 表示大約在某範圍

sentences.en: What price range are you looking at for the hotel?
sentences.zh: 你想找什麼價位的飯店？

sentences.en: Is there a restaurant in this price range nearby?
sentences.zh: 附近有這個價位的餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: Our price range is about a hundred dollars a night.
sentences.zh: 我們的預算大約是一晚一百美元。

sentences.en: These rental cars are all in the same price range.
sentences.zh: 這些租車的價格都落在同一個區間。

sentences.en: Do you have anything in a lower price range?
sentences.zh: 你們有價位低一點的嗎？

sentences.en: Tickets come in a wide range of prices.
sentences.zh: 票價從低到高差很多。

gloss_zh: 歷史悠久的；具歷史意義的
gloss_note: 景點、古蹟用 historic；historical 指與歷史有關的（如 historical museum）

sentences.en: We visited a historic site in Boston.
sentences.zh: 我們參觀了波士頓的一處古蹟。

sentences.en: Is this building considered historic?
sentences.zh: 這棟建築算是歷史建築嗎？

sentences.en: Do you offer tours of the historic district?
sentences.zh: 你們有帶團參觀歷史街區嗎？

sentences.en: I love the historic downtown, with its old brick buildings.
sentences.zh: 我很愛歷史悠久的市中心，那裡有老磚造建築。

sentences.en: The hotel is in a historic building from 1850.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店位在一棟 1850 年的歷史建築裡。

sentences.en: How old is this historic bridge?
sentences.zh: 這座古橋有多久的歷史了？

gloss_note: 也可指具歷史意義的建築物

sentences.en: The Golden Gate Bridge is a famous landmark.
sentences.zh: 金門大橋是知名地標。

sentences.en: Use the clock tower as a landmark.
sentences.zh: 把那座鐘樓當作地標就找得到了。

sentences.en: Is there a landmark near your hotel?
sentences.zh: 你住的飯店附近有什麼地標嗎？

sentences.en: We took photos of every landmark in the city.
sentences.zh: 我們把城裡每個地標都拍了照。

sentences.en: Which landmarks should we see before we leave?
sentences.zh: 離開之前我們該去看哪些地標？

sentences.en: This old theater is a local landmark.
sentences.zh: 這間老戲院是當地的地標。

gloss_note: outbound flight 去程班機；相對於 return（回程）

sentences.en: Our outbound flight leaves at seven in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我們的去程班機早上七點起飛。

sentences.en: Is your outbound flight on the same airline?
sentences.zh: 你的去程班機是同一家航空公司嗎？

sentences.en: The outbound trip takes about six hours.
sentences.zh: 去程大約要六個小時。

sentences.en: I booked the outbound flight but not the return.
sentences.zh: 我只訂了去程班機，還沒訂回程。

sentences.en: Traffic on the outbound lanes is really slow.
sentences.zh: 往城外的車道塞得很嚴重。

sentences.en: Can I change my outbound date to Friday?
sentences.zh: 我可以把去程日期改成週五嗎？

gloss_note: 海關義用複數形、不加 a；go through customs 通關

sentences.en: We had to go through customs after landing.
sentences.zh: 降落後我們得先通過海關。

sentences.en: How long is the line at customs?
sentences.zh: 海關那邊排隊要排多久？

sentences.en: The customs officer asked what was in my bag.
sentences.zh: 海關人員問我包包裡裝了什麼。

sentences.en: Do I need to show this form at customs?
sentences.zh: 我需要在海關出示這張表格嗎？

sentences.en: Customs was fast, so we caught an earlier shuttle.
sentences.zh: 海關很快就過了，所以我們搭上了較早的接駁車。

sentences.en: You can't bring fresh fruit through customs.
sentences.zh: 你不能把新鮮水果帶過海關。

gloss_note: 機場的入境查驗；go through immigration 通過入境審查

sentences.en: The immigration line was really long today.
sentences.zh: 今天入境審查的隊伍超長。

sentences.en: Which way is immigration, please?
sentences.zh: 請問入境審查往哪個方向走？

sentences.en: The immigration officer checked my passport and smiled.
sentences.zh: 入境官員檢查了我的護照，還對我微笑。

sentences.en: Do we fill out this card before immigration?
sentences.zh: 我們要在入境審查之前先填這張卡嗎？

sentences.en: It took an hour to get through immigration.
sentences.zh: 通過入境審查花了一個小時。

sentences.en: Have your documents ready for immigration.
sentences.zh: 入境審查時請把文件準備好。

gloss_note: boarding pass 登機證；boarding gate 登機門

sentences.en: Boarding starts in twenty minutes at gate twelve.
sentences.zh: 二十分鐘後在十二號登機門開始登機。

sentences.en: Please have your boarding pass ready.
sentences.zh: 請先準備好您的登機證。

sentences.en: Is boarding on time, or has it been delayed?
sentences.zh: 會準時登機，還是延後了？

sentences.en: I lost my boarding pass in the terminal.
sentences.zh: 我在航廈裡把登機證弄丟了。

sentences.en: Final boarding call for the flight to Denver.
sentences.zh: 飛往丹佛班機的最後登機廣播。

sentences.en: Where is the boarding gate for this flight?
sentences.zh: 這班飛機的登機門在哪裡？

gloss_note: aisle seat＝靠走道座位；window seat＝靠窗座位

sentences.en: I'd like an aisle seat, please.
sentences.zh: 麻煩給我靠走道的座位。

sentences.en: Do you prefer the window or the aisle?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡坐靠窗還是靠走道？

sentences.en: Please keep the aisle clear during takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛時請讓走道保持暢通。

sentences.en: The flight attendant pushed the cart down the aisle.
sentences.zh: 空服員推著餐車走過走道。

sentences.en: Sorry, may I get out into the aisle?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我可以到走道上嗎？

sentences.en: I always book an aisle seat for long flights.
sentences.zh: 長途飛行我總是訂靠走道的座位。

gloss_note: 不可數名詞；baggage claim＝行李提領處

sentences.en: Where is baggage claim for the Dallas flight?
sentences.zh: 達拉斯那班飛機的行李提領處在哪裡？

sentences.en: Our baggage still hasn't come out yet.
sentences.zh: 我們的行李還沒出來。

sentences.en: How much is the fee for extra baggage?
sentences.zh: 多帶一件行李要收多少費用？

sentences.en: Wait for me by the baggage carousel.
sentences.zh: 在行李轉盤那邊等我。

sentences.en: The baggage handlers damaged my bag on the way here.
sentences.zh: 行李搬運人員在運送途中弄壞了我的包包。

sentences.en: Free carry-on baggage is limited to one bag.
sentences.zh: 免費的隨身行李限帶一件。

gloss_note: 不可數；一件行李說 a piece of luggage；美式也常說 bags

sentences.en: Can you watch my luggage for a minute?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我看一下行李嗎？

sentences.en: My luggage is heavy, so I need a cart.
sentences.zh: 我的行李很重，所以需要推車。

sentences.en: The bellhop carried our luggage up to the room.
sentences.zh: 行李員把我們的行李搬上房間。

sentences.en: Her luggage didn't arrive with the flight.
sentences.zh: 她的行李沒有跟著班機一起到。

sentences.en: Is there a place to store luggage after checkout?
sentences.zh: 退房後有地方可以寄放行李嗎？

sentences.en: I bought new luggage before our big trip.
sentences.zh: 出遠門前我買了新的行李箱。

gloss_note: 機場常說 Terminal 2；也指巴士或火車的終點站

sentences.en: Which terminal does your flight leave from?
sentences.zh: 你的班機從哪個航廈起飛？

sentences.en: Our flight is at terminal two.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機在第二航廈。

sentences.en: The shuttle runs between all the terminals.
sentences.zh: 接駁車往返所有的航廈。

sentences.en: I'll meet you outside the terminal near the exit.
sentences.zh: 我在航廈外面靠出口的地方等你。

sentences.en: The terminal was crowded with people coming home.
sentences.zh: 航廈裡擠滿了返鄉的人。

sentences.en: How long does it take to walk across the terminal?
sentences.zh: 走過整個航廈要花多久？

gloss_note: 行程計畫；機票確認信上也常有 itinerary

sentences.en: Could you send me the itinerary by email?
sentences.zh: 可以用電子郵件把行程表寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: Our itinerary includes three cities in five days.
sentences.zh: 我們的行程五天內要跑三個城市。

sentences.en: I printed our itinerary in case my phone dies.
sentences.zh: 我把行程表印出來，以防手機沒電。

sentences.en: What's on the itinerary for tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 明天早上的行程有什麼？

sentences.en: The tour guide changed the itinerary because of rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，導遊更改了行程。

sentences.en: Your itinerary shows a connection in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 您的行程顯示會在西雅圖轉機。

gloss_note: tourist visa 觀光簽證；apply for a visa 申請簽證

sentences.en: Do I need a visa to visit Canada?
sentences.zh: 去加拿大玩需要簽證嗎？

sentences.en: My tourist visa is good for six months.
sentences.zh: 我的觀光簽證有效期限是六個月。

sentences.en: She applied for a work visa last spring.
sentences.zh: 她去年春天申請了工作簽證。

sentences.en: The officer asked to see my visa.
sentences.zh: 官員要求查看我的簽證。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get a student visa?
sentences.zh: 辦學生簽證要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Both of our visas arrived in the mail today.
sentences.zh: 我們兩個人的簽證今天都寄到了。

gloss_note: Anything to declare? 有東西要申報嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have anything to declare?
sentences.zh: 您有任何東西需要申報嗎？

sentences.en: I have nothing to declare, officer.
sentences.zh: 官員，我沒有東西要申報。

sentences.en: You must declare cash over ten thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 超過一萬美元的現金必須申報。

sentences.en: Where do I declare the food I brought?
sentences.zh: 我帶的食物要在哪裡申報？

sentences.en: She forgot to declare the gifts she bought.
sentences.zh: 她忘了申報自己買的禮物。

sentences.en: We declared the apples and filled out the form.
sentences.zh: 我們申報了蘋果，並填好了表格。

gloss_note: currency exchange 換匯處；foreign currency 外幣

sentences.en: Where can I exchange foreign currency?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡換外幣？

sentences.en: Do they accept US currency in Canada?
sentences.zh: 加拿大收美金嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a currency exchange booth in the terminal?
sentences.zh: 航廈裡有換匯櫃檯嗎？

sentences.en: I need to convert some currency before the trip.
sentences.zh: 出發前我得先換一些外幣。

sentences.en: Don't exchange currency at the airport. The rate is bad.
sentences.zh: 別在機場換錢，匯率很差。

sentences.en: Which currency do you want to pay in?
sentences.zh: 你想用哪種貨幣付款？

gloss_note: keep your receipt 留著收據；退換貨通常要憑收據

sentences.en: Can I have a receipt, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我收據嗎？

sentences.en: Keep your receipt in case you need to return it.
sentences.zh: 收據留著，萬一你要退貨用得到。

sentences.en: The hotel emailed me a receipt after checkout.
sentences.zh: 退房後飯店用電子郵件寄了收據給我。

sentences.en: I lost the receipt, so I can't get a refund.
sentences.zh: 我把收據弄丟了，所以沒辦法退款。

sentences.en: Would you like a paper receipt or a text?
sentences.zh: 您要紙本收據還是簡訊收據？

sentences.en: She put every receipt from the trip in an envelope.
sentences.zh: 她把旅途中的每張收據都放進信封裡。

gloss_note: 旅遊帶回的紀念小物；送人的可稱 gift

sentences.en: I bought a small souvenir for my mom.
sentences.zh: 我幫媽媽買了一個小紀念品。

sentences.en: Where is the best place to buy souvenirs?
sentences.zh: 哪裡最適合買紀念品？

sentences.en: This keychain is a cute souvenir from Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 這個鑰匙圈是夏威夷帶回來的可愛紀念品。

sentences.en: Do you sell any souvenirs with the city's name?
sentences.zh: 你們有賣印著城市名字的紀念品嗎？

sentences.en: Let's pick up a souvenir before we leave the park.
sentences.zh: 離開公園前我們去挑個紀念品吧。

sentences.en: Everyone in the office wants a souvenir from your trip.
sentences.zh: 辦公室每個人都想要你旅行帶回來的紀念品。

gloss_note: go sightseeing 去觀光；不可數名詞

sentences.en: We went sightseeing all day in New York.
sentences.zh: 我們在紐約觀光了一整天。

sentences.en: Are you doing any sightseeing this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末你有要去觀光嗎？

sentences.en: There's a sightseeing bus that stops near the hotel.
sentences.zh: 有一班觀光巴士會停在飯店附近。

sentences.en: Sightseeing makes me hungry, so let's grab lunch.
sentences.zh: 到處觀光讓我肚子好餓，我們去吃午餐吧。

sentences.en: Do you offer a sightseeing tour of the harbor?
sentences.zh: 你們有港灣觀光行程嗎？

sentences.en: It rained, so we skipped the sightseeing and napped.
sentences.zh: 下雨了，所以我們沒去觀光，改成睡午覺。

gloss_note: airport shuttle 機場接駁車；hotel shuttle 飯店接駁車

sentences.en: Does the hotel have a free airport shuttle?
sentences.zh: 飯店有免費的機場接駁車嗎？

sentences.en: The shuttle to the rental car lot leaves every ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 往租車場的接駁車每十分鐘一班。

sentences.en: I missed the shuttle, so I took a taxi.
sentences.zh: 我錯過接駁車，所以搭了計程車。

sentences.en: Wait at the curb and the shuttle will pick you up.
sentences.zh: 在路邊等，接駁車會來接你。

sentences.en: How often does the shuttle run to the parking lot?
sentences.zh: 往停車場的接駁車多久一班？

sentences.en: We took a shuttle from the airport to downtown.
sentences.zh: 我們從機場搭接駁車到市中心。

gloss_note: 飯店、航空常用；complimentary breakfast 免費早餐

sentences.en: Breakfast is complimentary for all hotel guests.
sentences.zh: 所有房客都可以免費享用早餐。

sentences.en: Is the internet complimentary, or do I pay?
sentences.zh: 網路是免費提供的，還是要另外付費？

sentences.en: They gave us complimentary drinks after the delay.
sentences.zh: 延誤之後，他們招待了我們飲料。

sentences.en: Each room comes with complimentary bottled water.
sentences.zh: 每間房都附贈瓶裝水。

sentences.en: Do you offer a complimentary shuttle to the airport?
sentences.zh: 你們有提供免費的機場接駁嗎？

sentences.en: We got a complimentary dessert for our anniversary.
sentences.zh: 我們紀念日那天，餐廳招待了一份甜點。

gloss_note: 航空艙等或房型升等；也可當名詞（a free upgrade）

sentences.en: Can I get an upgrade to business class?
sentences.zh: 我可以升等到商務艙嗎？

sentences.en: They upgraded us to a room with an ocean view.
sentences.zh: 他們把我們升等到有海景的房間。

sentences.en: I'd like to upgrade my rental car to an SUV.
sentences.zh: 我想把租的車升級成休旅車。

sentences.en: How much extra would it cost to upgrade?
sentences.zh: 升等要多加多少錢？

sentences.en: She got a free upgrade because the flight was full.
sentences.zh: 因為班機客滿，她獲得了免費升等。

sentences.en: The hotel offered us an upgrade at check-in.
sentences.zh: 辦理入住時，飯店提供我們升級房型的機會。

gloss_note: renew a passport 換發護照；入出境都要出示

sentences.en: Did you remember to bring your passport?
sentences.zh: 你有記得帶護照嗎？

sentences.en: My passport expires in March, so I need a new one.
sentences.zh: 我的護照三月到期，所以得辦新的。

sentences.en: Please hand your passport to the agent.
sentences.zh: 請把護照交給櫃檯人員。

sentences.en: I keep our passports in the hotel safe.
sentences.zh: 我把我們的護照放在飯店的保險箱裡。

sentences.en: The officer stamped my passport and waved me through.
sentences.zh: 官員在我的護照上蓋了章就放我過關。

sentences.en: Where can I get my passport photo taken?
sentences.zh: 哪裡可以拍護照用的大頭照？

gloss_note: flight delay 班機延誤；也可當動詞（延後）

sentences.en: There's a two-hour delay on our flight.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機延誤了兩個小時。

sentences.en: What's causing the delay at the gate?
sentences.zh: 登機門這邊為什麼延誤？

sentences.en: Sorry for the delay, we're still waiting for the crew.
sentences.zh: 抱歉耽擱了，我們還在等機組人員。

sentences.en: The storm caused long delays at the airport.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成機場大幅延誤。

sentences.en: Will the delay make us miss our connection?
sentences.zh: 這次延誤會害我們趕不上轉機嗎？

sentences.en: I'll text you if there's any delay.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何延誤，我會傳訊息給你。

gloss_note: baggage claim＝行李提領處；也可指保險理賠申請

sentences.en: Meet me at baggage claim after you land.
sentences.zh: 降落後到行李提領處找我。

sentences.en: Which baggage claim is for the flight from Boston?
sentences.zh: 從波士頓來的班機行李在哪個提領處？

sentences.en: Our bags aren't at the claim area yet.
sentences.zh: 我們的行李還沒送到提領區。

sentences.en: I need to file a claim for my lost suitcase.
sentences.zh: 我要為遺失的行李箱提出理賠申請。

sentences.en: How long does it take to process a claim?
sentences.zh: 處理一件理賠申請要多久？

sentences.en: Take your baggage claim ticket to the service desk.
sentences.zh: 把你的行李領取單拿到服務台。

gloss_note: bus fare 公車車資；airfare 機票費用

sentences.en: How much is the fare to the airport?
sentences.zh: 到機場的車資是多少？

sentences.en: The bus fare is two dollars each way.
sentences.zh: 公車車資單程兩美元。

sentences.en: Airlines are raising fares for the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在節日旺季調漲票價。

sentences.en: Can I pay the fare with my card?
sentences.zh: 我可以用卡付車資嗎？

sentences.en: The taxi driver told me the fare in advance.
sentences.zh: 計程車司機事先告訴我車資。

sentences.en: Kids under five ride for a reduced fare.
sentences.zh: 五歲以下的孩童搭乘有優惠票價。

gloss_note: 飯店或大樓入口的大廳；meet in the lobby 在大廳碰面

sentences.en: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine.
sentences.zh: 我們九點在飯店大廳集合。

sentences.en: Where is the lobby? I got lost.
sentences.zh: 大廳在哪裡？我迷路了。

sentences.en: There's free coffee in the lobby every morning.
sentences.zh: 大廳每天早上都有免費咖啡。

sentences.en: The lobby was full of people waiting to check in.
sentences.zh: 大廳裡擠滿了等著辦入住的人。

sentences.en: Can you wait for me in the lobby?
sentences.zh: 你可以在大廳等我嗎？

sentences.en: The shuttle picks guests up at the lobby entrance.
sentences.zh: 接駁車在大廳入口接房客。

gloss_note: checkout time 退房時間；動詞要拆成 check out

sentences.en: What time is checkout at this hotel?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店幾點退房？

sentences.en: Checkout is at eleven, so we need to pack.
sentences.zh: 十一點要退房，所以我們得收拾行李了。

sentences.en: Can we get a late checkout tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天可以延後退房嗎？

sentences.en: The checkout line at the store was really long.
sentences.zh: 那家店的結帳隊伍超長。

sentences.en: Please leave your key card at checkout.
sentences.zh: 退房時請把房卡留在櫃檯。

sentences.en: I'll meet you at the self checkout near the exit.
sentences.zh: 我在出口旁邊的自助結帳區等你。

gloss_note: 美式說法；英式說 lift

sentences.en: Where's the elevator? I have heavy bags.
sentences.zh: 電梯在哪裡？我的行李很重。

sentences.en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor.
sentences.zh: 搭電梯到五樓。

sentences.en: The elevator is out of order, so use the stairs.
sentences.zh: 電梯故障了，請走樓梯。

sentences.en: We shared the elevator with a family of four.
sentences.zh: 我們和一家四口共搭了一部電梯。

sentences.en: Could you hold the elevator for me?
sentences.zh: 可以幫我擋一下電梯門嗎？

sentences.en: The elevator to the roof deck closes at ten.
sentences.zh: 通往屋頂露臺的電梯十點停駛。

gloss_note: Welcome aboard 是歡迎登機或加入

sentences.en: Welcome aboard! Please find your seat and buckle up.
sentences.zh: 歡迎登機！請找到座位並繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: Is everyone aboard? The bus is about to leave.
sentences.zh: 大家都上車了嗎？巴士要出發了。

sentences.en: We went aboard the ferry just before sunset.
sentences.zh: 我們在日落前登上渡輪。

sentences.en: Our tour guide is already aboard the bus, so let's go.
sentences.zh: 我們的導遊已經在車上了，我們出發吧。

sentences.en: Passengers aboard the train were told to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 車上的乘客被告知保持冷靜。

sentences.en: Hurry up! Everybody else is already aboard.
sentences.zh: 快一點！其他人都已經上車了。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dominic assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: It's acceptable to...；比 good 弱

sentences.en: Is it acceptable to wear jeans to the interview?
sentences.zh: 面試穿牛仔褲可以嗎？

sentences.en: Your essay is acceptable, but it needs a stronger ending.
sentences.zh: 你的作文還可以，但結尾需要更有力。

sentences.en: Loud music after midnight is not acceptable here.
sentences.zh: 半夜過後在這裡大聲放音樂是不被允許的。

sentences.en: The price is acceptable, so I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 這個價錢可以接受，我就買了。

sentences.en: Is this temperature acceptable for everyone?
sentences.zh: 這個溫度大家都可以接受嗎？

sentences.en: The team offered an acceptable solution to the problem.
sentences.zh: 團隊提出了一個可接受的解決方案。

gloss_note: accurate to 接精確度；反義 inaccurate

sentences.en: Is this map accurate, or is it out of date?
sentences.zh: 這張地圖準確嗎，還是已經過時了？

sentences.en: The scale is not very accurate, so don't trust it.
sentences.zh: 這個體重計不太準，別太相信它。

sentences.en: She gave an accurate description of the stranger.
sentences.zh: 她對那個陌生人做了精確的描述。

sentences.en: My watch is accurate to within a few seconds.
sentences.zh: 我的手錶誤差只在幾秒之內。

sentences.en: Do you have an accurate count of the guests?
sentences.zh: 你有確切的賓客人數嗎？

sentences.en: The weather forecast was surprisingly accurate this week.
sentences.zh: 這星期的天氣預報意外地準。

gloss_note: 多指持續的悶痛；常見 headache、toothache

sentences.en: My whole body aches after that long hike yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天走了那趟長程健行，我全身都在痛。

sentences.en: My legs ache from running the whole morning.
sentences.zh: 我跑了一整個早上，腿好痠。

sentences.en: Does your back still ache when you sit for too long?
sentences.zh: 你坐太久背還會痛嗎？

sentences.en: He felt a dull ache in his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 他覺得肩膀有一陣悶痛。

sentences.en: Take a rest if your arms ache.
sentences.zh: 手臂會痠就休息一下。

sentences.en: The dentist said the ache came from a bad tooth.
sentences.zh: 牙醫說那陣痛是壞牙造成的。

gloss_note: 常見 achieve a goal / success

sentences.en: If you work hard, you can achieve your goals.
sentences.zh: 只要努力，你就能達成目標。

sentences.en: How did she achieve such great results so quickly?
sentences.zh: 她是怎麼這麼快就取得這麼好的成績？

sentences.en: I want to achieve something I can be proud of.
sentences.zh: 我想完成一件讓自己引以為傲的事。

sentences.en: The company achieved record sales last year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司去年創下銷售紀錄。

sentences.en: What do you hope to achieve in this job?
sentences.zh: 你希望在這份工作中達成什麼？

sentences.en: Nobody can achieve success without a little luck.
sentences.zh: 沒有人不靠一點運氣就能成功。

gloss_note: 可數；a sense of achievement 指成就感

sentences.en: Finishing the marathon was my greatest achievement.
sentences.zh: 跑完馬拉松是我最大的成就。

sentences.en: Graduating from college is a big achievement.
sentences.zh: 大學畢業是很大的成就。

sentences.en: She felt a real sense of achievement after the exam.
sentences.zh: 考完試後她真的很有成就感。

sentences.en: The school celebrated the students' achievements last Friday.
sentences.zh: 學校上星期五慶祝學生們的成就。

sentences.en: Is this award for academic achievement?
sentences.zh: 這個獎是頒給學業成就的嗎？

sentences.en: Landing on the moon was an amazing achievement for science.
sentences.zh: 登陸月球是科學上驚人的成就。

gloss_note: additional cost 額外費用

sentences.en: Is there an additional charge for extra cheese?
sentences.zh: 加起司要另外收費嗎？

sentences.en: Please send me additional information by email.
sentences.zh: 請用電子郵件寄給我更多資料。

sentences.en: We need two additional chairs for the guests.
sentences.zh: 我們還需要兩張椅子給客人。

sentences.en: The teacher gave us additional homework over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們週末額外的作業。

sentences.en: Do you need any additional help with that?
sentences.zh: 這件事你還需要什麼額外的幫忙嗎？

sentences.en: The airline will add an additional flight on Friday.
sentences.zh: 航空公司將在星期五加開一班航班。

gloss_note: advanced class 指進階班；也指科技先進

sentences.en: I'm taking an advanced math class this semester.
sentences.zh: 我這學期修了一門高等數學課。

sentences.en: This phone has some very advanced features.
sentences.zh: 這支手機有一些很先進的功能。

sentences.en: Is the book too advanced for beginners?
sentences.zh: 這本書對初學者來說會太難嗎？

sentences.en: After living abroad for years, her English is very advanced.
sentences.zh: 她在國外住了好幾年，英文程度很高。

sentences.en: Doctors use advanced tools to find the problem.
sentences.zh: 醫生用先進的儀器找出問題。

sentences.en: Scientists are building more advanced robots every year.
sentences.zh: 科學家每年都在打造更先進的機器人。

gloss_note: take advantage of 可指善用，也可指占便宜

sentences.en: Being tall is a big advantage in basketball.
sentences.zh: 個子高在籃球場上是很大的優勢。

sentences.en: What's the main advantage of living near school?
sentences.zh: 住在學校附近最大的好處是什麼？

sentences.en: Take advantage of the sale before it ends.
sentences.zh: 趁特價結束前把握機會。

sentences.en: Knowing two languages gave her an advantage in the interview.
sentences.zh: 會兩種語言讓她在面試中占了優勢。

sentences.en: Don't let anyone take advantage of your kindness.
sentences.zh: 別讓任何人利用你的善良。

sentences.en: The home team had the advantage of a loud crowd.
sentences.zh: 主場球隊有熱情觀眾助陣的優勢。

gloss_note: 可數也可不可數；adventure movie 指冒險片

sentences.en: We went on a great adventure in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我們在山裡展開了一場精彩的冒險。

sentences.en: Are you ready for a new adventure?
sentences.zh: 你準備好迎接新的冒險了嗎？

sentences.en: My brother loves adventure movies about pirates.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟愛看海盜的冒險電影。

sentences.en: Moving to a new city felt like an adventure.
sentences.zh: 搬到新城市感覺像一場冒險。

sentences.en: The book tells of a boy's adventure at sea.
sentences.zh: 這本書講述一個男孩在海上的歷險。

sentences.en: Our summer camp was full of fun and adventure.
sentences.zh: 我們的夏令營充滿了樂趣與冒險。

gloss_note: advertise on TV；名詞 ad

sentences.en: The store advertises its sales on the radio.
sentences.zh: 這家店在廣播上宣傳打折活動。

sentences.en: Where did you see that job advertised?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡看到那份工作的徵才廣告？

sentences.en: Many companies advertise their products during the big game.
sentences.zh: 許多公司在大賽期間為產品打廣告。

sentences.en: We should advertise our yard sale online.
sentences.zh: 我們應該在網路上宣傳我們的庭院拍賣。

sentences.en: Do restaurants still advertise in the local newspaper?
sentences.zh: 餐廳還會在地方報紙上登廣告嗎？

sentences.en: The school advertised the concert with colorful posters.
sentences.zh: 學校用色彩繽紛的海報宣傳這場音樂會。

gloss_note: advertisement 的口語縮寫

sentences.en: I skipped the ad and went straight to the video.
sentences.zh: 我跳過廣告，直接看影片。

sentences.en: Did you see that funny ad for pizza?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那支好笑的披薩廣告嗎？

sentences.en: She put an ad in the paper to sell her bike.
sentences.zh: 她在報紙上登了廣告要賣腳踏車。

sentences.en: This website is full of annoying ads.
sentences.zh: 這個網站充滿了煩人的廣告。

sentences.en: The company spent a lot of money on a new TV ad.
sentences.zh: 公司花了很多錢拍新的電視廣告。

sentences.en: I answered an ad for a part-time job.
sentences.zh: 我回應了一則兼職工作的廣告。

gloss_note: 也拼 adviser；school advisor 輔導老師

sentences.en: My advisor helped me pick my classes for next year.
sentences.zh: 我的指導老師幫我選了明年的課。

sentences.en: Have you talked to your academic advisor yet?
sentences.zh: 你跟你的學業輔導老師談過了嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a financial advisor at a bank.
sentences.zh: 她在銀行擔任財務顧問。

sentences.en: The president met with his top advisors this morning.
sentences.zh: 總統今天早上與他的重要顧問會面。

sentences.en: Our club advisor is a very kind science teacher.
sentences.zh: 我們社團的指導老師是一位很親切的自然科老師。

sentences.en: Could you be my advisor for this project?
sentences.zh: 你可以當我這個專案的指導者嗎？

gloss_note: can't afford to + 動詞

sentences.en: We can't afford a new car this year.
sentences.zh: 我們今年買不起新車。

sentences.en: Can you afford to take a week off?
sentences.zh: 你能抽得出一個星期的時間休假嗎？

sentences.en: He worked two jobs to afford college.
sentences.zh: 他打兩份工才付得起大學學費。

sentences.en: I'd love that jacket, but I can't afford it.
sentences.zh: 我很愛那件外套，但我買不起。

sentences.en: They can hardly afford the rent in this city.
sentences.zh: 他們幾乎付不起這個城市的房租。

sentences.en: We can't afford to waste any more time.
sentences.zh: 我們不能再浪費任何時間了。

gloss_note: 美式多用 afterward，英式多用 afterwards

sentences.en: Let's see a movie and eat dinner afterward.
sentences.zh: 我們先看電影，之後再吃晚餐。

sentences.en: What did you do afterward?
sentences.zh: 你之後做了什麼？

sentences.en: He took a nap afterward and felt much better.
sentences.zh: 他之後小睡了一下，覺得好多了。

sentences.en: Please wash your hands before and afterward.
sentences.zh: 請在前後都洗手。

sentences.en: We talked for hours, and soon afterward she left.
sentences.zh: 我們聊了好幾個小時，不久之後她就離開了。

sentences.en: The team celebrated afterward with pizza and soda.
sentences.zh: 球隊賽後用披薩和汽水慶祝。

gloss_note: 不可數；the agriculture industry

sentences.en: Agriculture is very important to this part of the country.
sentences.zh: 農業對這個地區非常重要。

sentences.en: My uncle studied agriculture in college.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔大學念的是農業。

sentences.en: Is agriculture still the main business here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的主要產業還是農業嗎？

sentences.en: Modern agriculture uses a lot of technology.
sentences.zh: 現代農業用了很多科技。

sentences.en: The Department of Agriculture released a new report.
sentences.zh: 農業部發布了一份新報告。

sentences.en: Rice farming is a key part of Asian agriculture.
sentences.zh: 種稻是亞洲農業的重要一環。

gloss_note: 指建築物間的窄巷；bowling alley 是保齡球道

sentences.en: The cat ran down the dark alley behind the shop.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓跑進店後面黑暗的小巷。

sentences.en: Is there a shortcut through the alley?
sentences.zh: 穿過那條小巷有捷徑嗎？

sentences.en: Their house is at the end of a quiet alley.
sentences.zh: 他們家在一條安靜小巷的盡頭。

sentences.en: The delivery truck was stuck in a narrow alley.
sentences.zh: 送貨卡車卡在一條窄巷裡。

sentences.en: Kids were playing ball in the alley after school.
sentences.zh: 孩子們放學後在巷子裡玩球。

sentences.en: Don't park in the alley, or you'll get a ticket.
sentences.zh: 別把車停在巷子裡，不然會被開罰單。

gloss_note: almond milk 是杏仁奶；美國常見健康零食

sentences.en: I always snack on almonds in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我下午總是吃杏仁當點心。

sentences.en: Do you want almond milk in your coffee?
sentences.zh: 你的咖啡要加杏仁奶嗎？

sentences.en: This cake has a light almond flavor.
sentences.zh: 這個蛋糕有淡淡的杏仁香味。

sentences.en: My sister can't eat almonds because of an allergy.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹對杏仁過敏，不能吃。

sentences.en: A handful of almonds is a healthy snack.
sentences.zh: 一把杏仁是健康的點心。

sentences.en: Almond trees bloom in early spring in California.
sentences.zh: 加州的杏仁樹在初春開花。

gloss_note: 常用被動 be amazed at / by

sentences.en: Her singing never fails to amaze me.
sentences.zh: 她的歌聲總是讓我驚嘆。

sentences.en: I was amazed by how fast he learned.
sentences.zh: 他學得這麼快，讓我很驚訝。

sentences.en: Did the magic show amaze you too?
sentences.zh: 那場魔術表演也讓你覺得很神奇嗎？

sentences.en: It amazes me that you can cook so well.
sentences.zh: 你這麼會煮菜，真讓我驚訝。

sentences.en: The little boy amazed everyone with his drawing.
sentences.zh: 小男孩的畫讓每個人都驚嘆不已。

sentences.en: The view from the top will amaze you.
sentences.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色會讓你驚嘆。

gloss_note: in amazement、to my amazement

sentences.en: We watched the fireworks in amazement.
sentences.zh: 我們驚奇地看著煙火。

sentences.en: To my amazement, I won the first prize.
sentences.zh: 讓我驚訝的是，我得了第一名。

sentences.en: She looked at the huge cake with amazement.
sentences.zh: 她驚訝地看著那個超大蛋糕。

sentences.en: The crowd stared in amazement at the magician.
sentences.zh: 群眾驚奇地盯著魔術師。

sentences.en: Why are you looking at me with such amazement?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼用這麼驚訝的眼神看我？

sentences.en: His amazement grew as he opened the box.
sentences.zh: 他打開盒子時，驚訝的感覺越來越強。

gloss_note: 派駐他國的外交代表

sentences.en: The ambassador gave a short speech at the dinner.
sentences.zh: 大使在晚宴上發表了簡短的演說。

sentences.en: My aunt works for the American embassy, but she isn't the ambassador.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在美國大使館工作，但她不是大使。

sentences.en: Who is the new ambassador to Japan?
sentences.zh: 誰是新任駐日大使？

sentences.en: The ambassador met with local students last week.
sentences.zh: 大使上星期與當地學生見了面。

sentences.en: Our school chose her as a student ambassador.
sentences.zh: 我們學校選她當學生大使。

sentences.en: Ambassadors often speak several languages.
sentences.zh: 大使通常會說好幾種語言。

gloss_note: 可數：有某個抱負；不可數：企圖心

sentences.en: Her biggest ambition is to become a doctor.
sentences.zh: 她最大的志願是成為醫生。

sentences.en: Do you have any ambition to start your own business?
sentences.zh: 你有自己創業的抱負嗎？

sentences.en: He has a lot of ambition for someone so young.
sentences.zh: 就他這麼年輕來說，他很有企圖心。

sentences.en: Her ambition drove her to work late every night.
sentences.zh: 她的雄心讓她每晚都工作到很晚。

sentences.en: My ambition is to travel to every continent.
sentences.zh: 我的心願是走遍每一個大陸。

sentences.en: The young player's ambition is to join the national team.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕球員的目標是加入國家隊。

gloss_note: 常用 announce that...；比 say 正式

sentences.en: The principal will announce the winners tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 校長明天會公布得獎者。

sentences.en: They announced that the flight was delayed.
sentences.zh: 他們宣布班機延誤了。

sentences.en: When will the company announce its new phone?
sentences.zh: 公司什麼時候會發表新手機？

sentences.en: My cousin announced her engagement at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我表姊在晚餐時宣布訂婚。

sentences.en: Did the teacher announce the test date yet?
sentences.zh: 老師已經公布考試日期了嗎？

sentences.en: The coach will announce the team list on Monday.
sentences.zh: 教練星期一會公布球隊名單。

gloss_note: make an announcement 發布公告

sentences.en: Did you hear the announcement on the loudspeaker?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到廣播裡的公告嗎？

sentences.en: The airline made an announcement about the delay.
sentences.zh: 航空公司就延誤發出了公告。

sentences.en: I have an important announcement to make.
sentences.zh: 我有一件重要的事要宣布。

sentences.en: The mayor's announcement surprised many people.
sentences.zh: 市長的宣布內容讓許多人感到意外。
