sentences.en: Check the school website for the latest announcements.
sentences.zh: 到學校網站看最新公告。

sentences.en: There was an announcement that the store would close early.
sentences.zh: 有廣播說這家店會提早打烊。

gloss_note: anxious about 擔心某事

sentences.en: I feel anxious before every big exam.
sentences.zh: 每次大考前我都會覺得焦慮。

sentences.en: Why are you so anxious about the interview?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼擔心面試？

sentences.en: She gave her parents an anxious look.
sentences.zh: 她焦慮地看了父母一眼。

sentences.en: The anxious crowd waited for news outside the hospital.
sentences.zh: 焦急的人群在醫院外等消息。

sentences.en: Dogs can get anxious during thunderstorms.
sentences.zh: 狗在打雷時可能會焦躁不安。

sentences.en: I'm anxious about how the meeting went.
sentences.zh: 我很擔心會議進行得怎麼樣。

gloss_note: 口語，用來轉換話題或表示「不管怎樣」

sentences.en: It's raining, but I'm going to the game anyhow.
sentences.zh: 雖然在下雨，但我還是要去看比賽。

sentences.en: Anyhow, let's get back to the topic.
sentences.zh: 總之，我們回到正題吧。

sentences.en: I told him not to come, but he came anyhow.
sentences.zh: 我叫他別來，他還是來了。

sentences.en: Do you want to try anyhow?
sentences.zh: 你還是想試試看嗎？

sentences.en: It was a bad idea, and it was too late anyhow.
sentences.zh: 那是個壞主意，反正也來不及了。

sentences.en: Thanks for the offer, but I'll pay anyhow.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的好意，不過我還是自己付。

gloss_note: apart from 除了；fall apart 散掉

sentences.en: The two towns are about ten miles apart.
sentences.zh: 這兩個小鎮相距大約十英里。

sentences.en: My old backpack is falling apart.
sentences.zh: 我的舊背包快要散了。

sentences.en: Can you tell the twins apart?
sentences.zh: 你分得出那對雙胞胎嗎？

sentences.en: Apart from math, I like every subject.
sentences.zh: 除了數學，每一科我都喜歡。

sentences.en: Keep your feet apart when you stretch.
sentences.zh: 伸展時雙腳要打開。

sentences.en: They lived apart for a year because of work.
sentences.zh: 他們因為工作分隔兩地住了一年。

gloss_note: appeal to sb 吸引；appeal for 呼籲

sentences.en: Superhero movies have a wide appeal among teenagers.
sentences.zh: 超級英雄電影很受青少年歡迎。

sentences.en: Does the idea of camping appeal to you?
sentences.zh: 露營這個點子吸引你嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor made an appeal for help after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，市長呼籲各界協助。

sentences.en: City life doesn't appeal to me anymore.
sentences.zh: 城市生活已經不再吸引我了。

sentences.en: Did the charity make an appeal for winter coats?
sentences.zh: 慈善機構有發出募集冬衣的呼籲嗎？

sentences.en: The cartoon's appeal comes from its funny characters.
sentences.zh: 這部卡通的魅力來自有趣的角色。

gloss_note: approve of 贊成；approve 後接計畫、申請

sentences.en: My parents don't approve of my new haircut.
sentences.zh: 我爸媽不贊成我的新髮型。

sentences.en: The city council approved the plan for a new park.
sentences.zh: 市議會批准了新公園的計畫。

sentences.en: Did your boss approve your vacation request?
sentences.zh: 你老闆批准你的休假申請了嗎？

sentences.en: Health officials approved the new medicine for children.
sentences.zh: 衛生主管機關核准了這種兒童新藥。

sentences.en: I approve of your decision to study abroad.
sentences.zh: 我贊成你出國念書的決定。

sentences.en: The school will approve the club if enough students join.
sentences.zh: 如果有足夠的學生加入，學校就會批准這個社團。

gloss_note: 廚房用品；常見 put on an apron

sentences.en: Put on an apron so you don't get sauce on your shirt.
sentences.zh: 穿上圍裙，才不會讓醬汁沾到衣服。

sentences.en: Dad wore a funny apron while grilling burgers.
sentences.zh: 爸爸烤漢堡時穿了一件有趣的圍裙。

sentences.en: Where did you hang my apron?
sentences.zh: 你把我的圍裙掛在哪裡了？

sentences.en: The baker's apron was covered in flour.
sentences.zh: 麵包師傅的圍裙沾滿了麵粉。

sentences.en: Every waiter at the café wears a black apron.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡店的每位服務生都穿黑色圍裙。

sentences.en: She took off her apron and sat down to eat.
sentences.zh: 她脫下圍裙，坐下來吃飯。

gloss_note: armed forces 軍隊；armed with 配備著

sentences.en: The movie is about an armed robbery at a museum.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是博物館發生的武裝搶案。

sentences.en: The armed forces helped after the flood.
sentences.zh: 軍隊在水災後提供了協助。

sentences.en: In the game, you play an armed guard in a castle.
sentences.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，你扮演城堡裡配有武器的守衛。

sentences.en: The guards were armed and watched the museum doors.
sentences.zh: 守衛配有武器，看守著博物館的門。

sentences.en: Were the knights in that story armed with swords?
sentences.zh: 那個故事裡的騎士配有劍嗎？

sentences.en: The history book describes how armed soldiers marched into the city.
sentences.zh: 歷史課本描述武裝士兵如何進入城市。

gloss_note: be arrested for / under arrest

sentences.en: Police made an arrest in the case yesterday.
sentences.zh: 警方昨天在這起案件中逮捕了嫌犯。

sentences.en: The man was arrested for stealing a bike.
sentences.zh: 那名男子因偷腳踏車被逮捕。

sentences.en: In the movie, the detective finally arrests the thief.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，偵探最後逮捕了小偷。

sentences.en: Why was he under arrest?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼被逮捕？

sentences.en: Do you think the officer should arrest the driver?
sentences.zh: 你覺得警察應該逮捕那名駕駛嗎？

sentences.en: "You're under arrest!" says the guard in the video game.
sentences.zh: 電玩裡的守衛說：「你被逮捕了！」

gloss_note: 不可數；常見 volcanic ash（火山灰）

sentences.en: The fire left nothing but ash behind.
sentences.zh: 那場火只留下灰燼。

sentences.en: Be careful not to spill the ash from the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 小心別把壁爐的灰弄灑了。

sentences.en: Volcanic ash covered the cars and roofs of the town.
sentences.zh: 火山灰蓋滿了小鎮的汽車和屋頂。

sentences.en: Is that gray stuff ash or just dust?
sentences.zh: 那灰灰的東西是灰燼還是只是灰塵？

sentences.en: We cleaned the ash out of the grill after dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後我們把烤爐裡的灰清掉。

sentences.en: The campfire turned to ash by morning.
sentences.zh: 營火到早上已經變成灰燼。

gloss_note: set aside 擱置；aside from 除了

sentences.en: Please put your phones aside during class.
sentences.zh: 上課請把手機放到一旁。

sentences.en: Joking aside, I think we have a real problem.
sentences.zh: 開玩笑歸開玩笑，我覺得我們真的有問題。

sentences.en: She set aside some money for the trip.
sentences.zh: 她存了一些錢準備旅行。

sentences.en: Aside from pizza, what else do you like?
sentences.zh: 除了披薩，你還喜歡什麼？

sentences.en: He stepped aside to let the nurse pass.
sentences.zh: 他往旁邊站讓護理師通過。

sentences.en: Can we set this idea aside for now?
sentences.zh: 我們可以先把這個想法擱在一邊嗎？

gloss_note: 泛指從事運動的人；student athlete 是校隊學生

sentences.en: My sister is a top athlete at her high school.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊是她高中的頂尖運動員。

sentences.en: Athletes need a lot of sleep to stay healthy.
sentences.zh: 運動員需要充足睡眠才能保持健康。

sentences.en: Which athlete do you admire most?
sentences.zh: 你最欣賞哪位運動員？

sentences.en: The young athlete trained every morning before school.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕運動員每天上學前都會訓練。

sentences.en: Many athletes from different countries joined the games.
sentences.zh: 來自不同國家的許多運動員參加了比賽。

sentences.en: You don't have to be an athlete to enjoy running.
sentences.zh: 你不必是運動員也能享受跑步。

gloss_note: a positive / bad attitude

sentences.en: She has a very positive attitude toward life.
sentences.zh: 她對人生抱持很正面的態度。

sentences.en: I don't like your attitude, young man.
sentences.zh: 年輕人，我不喜歡你的態度。

sentences.en: A good attitude can make a hard job easier.
sentences.zh: 好的心態能讓困難的工作變得容易些。

sentences.en: What is your attitude toward homework?
sentences.zh: 你對寫功課的態度是什麼？

sentences.en: His attitude changed after he joined the team.
sentences.zh: 他加入球隊後，態度改變了。

sentences.en: The coach cares more about attitude than talent.
sentences.zh: 教練重視態度勝過天分。

gloss_note: attract attention / customers

sentences.en: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers.
sentences.zh: 鮮豔的顏色會把蜜蜂吸引到花朵上。

sentences.en: What attracted you to this school?
sentences.zh: 是什麼吸引你來這所學校？

sentences.en: The sale attracted a big crowd on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 這場特賣星期六吸引了大批人潮。

sentences.en: Magnets attract small metal objects like paper clips.
sentences.zh: 磁鐵會吸引迴紋針之類的小金屬物品。

sentences.en: Her loud laugh attracts attention everywhere she goes.
sentences.zh: 她爽朗的笑聲走到哪都引人注目。

sentences.en: How can the city attract more visitors this summer?
sentences.zh: 這座城市今年夏天要怎麼吸引更多遊客？

gloss_note: 可指外表，也可指條件、提議很誘人

sentences.en: That's a very attractive offer, so I said yes.
sentences.zh: 那個條件很誘人，所以我答應了。

sentences.en: She is smart, funny, and attractive.
sentences.zh: 她聰明、風趣又迷人。

sentences.en: The new park is an attractive place to relax.
sentences.zh: 新公園是個讓人放鬆的好地方。

sentences.en: Is the apartment attractive enough for you to rent it?
sentences.zh: 這間公寓夠吸引你租嗎？

sentences.en: The low price makes this laptop very attractive.
sentences.zh: 低價讓這台筆電非常吸引人。

sentences.en: He found the idea of studying abroad attractive.
sentences.zh: 他覺得出國念書這個想法很有吸引力。

gloss_note: 集合名詞；a large audience

sentences.en: The audience clapped loudly after the song.
sentences.zh: 觀眾在歌曲結束後熱烈鼓掌。

sentences.en: Is there a big audience for tonight's show?
sentences.zh: 今晚的表演有很多觀眾嗎？

sentences.en: The speaker told a joke to win over the audience.
sentences.zh: 講者說了個笑話來贏得聽眾的心。

sentences.en: Cartoons are made for a young audience.
sentences.zh: 卡通是為年輕觀眾製作的。

sentences.en: A live audience made the game more exciting.
sentences.zh: 現場觀眾讓比賽更刺激。

sentences.en: Who is your target audience for this video?
sentences.zh: 你這支影片的目標觀眾是誰？

gloss_note: automatic door 自動門；自排車

sentences.en: Most cars in America have automatic transmissions.
sentences.zh: 美國大多數的車都是自排的。

sentences.en: The door is automatic, so just walk up to it.
sentences.zh: 這扇門是自動的，直接走過去就好。

sentences.en: Is the coffee machine automatic?
sentences.zh: 這台咖啡機是全自動的嗎？

sentences.en: Blinking is an automatic reaction of the body.
sentences.zh: 眨眼是身體的自動反應。

sentences.en: The light has an automatic timer that turns it off.
sentences.zh: 這盞燈有自動定時器會把它關掉。

sentences.en: Your bill is set up for automatic payment each month.
sentences.zh: 你的帳單每個月都設定為自動扣款。

gloss_note: 較正式，日常多說 car

sentences.en: The automobile industry is changing because of electric cars.
sentences.zh: 汽車產業因為電動車而在改變。

sentences.en: My grandfather bought his first automobile in 1970.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺在1970年買了他的第一輛汽車。

sentences.en: The automobile show opens in Detroit next week.
sentences.zh: 汽車展下週在底特律開幕。

sentences.en: Do you need an automobile insurance card for the trip?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅行你需要汽車保險卡嗎？

sentences.en: Early automobiles were slow and very noisy.
sentences.zh: 早期的汽車又慢又吵。

sentences.en: Is an automobile expensive to maintain?
sentences.zh: 養一輛汽車的花費高嗎？

gloss_note: 美國常有 Fifth Avenue 這類大街；也可指途徑

sentences.en: The parade moved slowly down Main Avenue.
sentences.zh: 遊行隊伍沿著主要大道緩緩前進。

sentences.en: Our apartment is on Maple Avenue near the park.
sentences.zh: 我們的公寓在公園附近的楓樹大道上。

sentences.en: Which avenue leads to the train station?
sentences.zh: 哪一條大道通往火車站？

sentences.en: The wide avenue was lined with trees.
sentences.zh: 寬闊的大道兩旁種滿了樹。

sentences.en: Traffic on the avenue stopped for an hour.
sentences.zh: 大道上的車流停了一個小時。

sentences.en: Let's meet at the corner of Sixth Avenue and Pine Street.
sentences.zh: 我們在第六大道和松樹街的轉角見面吧。

gloss_note: adj. be awake；v. 過去式 awoke

sentences.en: Are you still awake, or are you sleeping?
sentences.zh: 你還醒著，還是在睡了？

sentences.en: The baby stayed awake all night.
sentences.zh: 寶寶整晚都醒著。

sentences.en: I was awake until three in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我一直醒到凌晨三點。

sentences.en: Coffee keeps me awake during long meetings.
sentences.zh: 咖啡讓我在冗長的會議中保持清醒。

sentences.en: She awoke to the sound of birds outside her window.
sentences.zh: 她被窗外的鳥叫聲吵醒。

sentences.en: Is Grandpa awake yet, or should we wait?
sentences.zh: 爺爺醒了嗎，還是我們再等等？

gloss_note: 正式或文學用語；口語多用 wake up

sentences.en: A loud noise awakened the whole neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 一聲巨響吵醒了整個社區。

sentences.en: The movie awakened her interest in space.
sentences.zh: 那部電影喚起了她對太空的興趣。

sentences.en: He awakened slowly and looked around the room.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢醒來，環顧房間。

sentences.en: Did the thunder awaken you last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚的雷聲有把你吵醒嗎？

sentences.en: How do good teachers awaken curiosity in students?
sentences.zh: 好老師是怎麼喚起學生的好奇心的？

sentences.en: The story awakened old memories of her childhood.
sentences.zh: 這個故事喚起了她兒時的舊回憶。

gloss_note: win an award；award sb sth

sentences.en: She won an award for the best science project.
sentences.zh: 她憑最佳科學專題得了獎。

sentences.en: The school awarded him a scholarship.
sentences.zh: 學校頒給他一份獎學金。

sentences.en: Who will receive the award tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚誰會領獎？

sentences.en: The movie won three awards last year.
sentences.zh: 這部電影去年拿下了三座獎。

sentences.en: Our teacher awards extra points for good questions.
sentences.zh: 我們老師對好問題會加分。

sentences.en: Does the award come with any prize money?
sentences.zh: 這個獎有附獎金嗎？

gloss_note: be aware of / that

sentences.en: Are you aware that the store closes at nine?
sentences.zh: 你知道這家店九點打烊嗎？

sentences.en: I wasn't aware of the problem until yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我直到昨天才知道這個問題。

sentences.en: Drivers should be aware of kids near schools.
sentences.zh: 駕駛應該留意學校附近的孩子。

sentences.en: She became aware of someone behind her.
sentences.zh: 她察覺到身後有人。

sentences.en: Everyone should be aware of the risks of sugar.
sentences.zh: 大家都該了解糖的風險。

sentences.en: He is well aware that time is running out.
sentences.zh: 他很清楚時間不多了。

gloss_note: 口語很常用，I feel awful 表示很不舒服或很愧疚

sentences.en: The weather was awful, so we stayed home.
sentences.zh: 天氣很糟，所以我們待在家裡。

sentences.en: I feel awful about forgetting your birthday.
sentences.zh: 我忘了你的生日，覺得很抱歉。

sentences.en: This soup tastes awful. What did you put in it?
sentences.zh: 這湯味道很糟，你放了什麼？

sentences.en: Was the traffic awful this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上塞車很嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: He looked awful after the long flight.
sentences.zh: 經過長途飛行，他看起來很糟。

sentences.en: That was an awful movie. I want my money back.
sentences.zh: 那部電影爛透了，我想把錢要回來。

gloss_note: an awkward silence 尷尬的沉默

sentences.en: There was an awkward silence after his joke.
sentences.zh: 他說完笑話後，場面一陣尷尬。

sentences.en: I felt awkward at the party because I knew no one.
sentences.zh: 派對上沒有我認識的人，我覺得很不自在。

sentences.en: This box is awkward to carry up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 這個箱子扛上樓梯很不好搬。

sentences.en: Isn't it awkward to ask your boss for money?
sentences.zh: 向老闆要錢不是很尷尬嗎？

sentences.en: The new student was shy and awkward at first.
sentences.zh: 新同學一開始害羞又笨拙。

sentences.en: It's an awkward question, but I have to ask.
sentences.zh: 這個問題有點尷尬，但我必須問。

gloss_note: background music 背景音樂

sentences.en: The mountains in the background look beautiful.
sentences.zh: 背景裡的山看起來好美。

sentences.en: What is your educational background?
sentences.zh: 你的學歷背景是什麼？

sentences.en: Can you turn off the background music?
sentences.zh: 你可以把背景音樂關掉嗎？

sentences.en: Let me give you some background on the story.
sentences.zh: 讓我告訴你這件事的來龍去脈。

sentences.en: She comes from a farming background.
sentences.zh: 她出身農家。

sentences.en: The tall building stands out against the dark background.
sentences.zh: 這棟高樓在深色背景中格外顯眼。

gloss_note: 美式早餐常見，bacon and eggs；不可數

sentences.en: I'd like bacon and eggs for breakfast, please.
sentences.zh: 我早餐想點培根和蛋。

sentences.en: The kitchen smells like bacon again.
sentences.zh: 廚房又有培根的味道了。

sentences.en: Do you want extra bacon on your burger?
sentences.zh: 你的漢堡要多加培根嗎？

sentences.en: Dad cooked bacon on Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 爸爸星期天早上煎了培根。

sentences.en: I bought two packs of bacon at the store.
sentences.zh: 我在超市買了兩包培根。

sentences.en: Crispy bacon goes well with pancakes.
sentences.zh: 脆脆的培根跟鬆餅很搭。

gloss_note: 複數形，單數是 bacterium；有好有壞

sentences.en: Wash your hands to kill the bacteria.
sentences.zh: 洗手可以殺死細菌。

sentences.en: Some bacteria in yogurt are good for your stomach.
sentences.zh: 優格裡有些細菌對你的腸胃有益。

sentences.en: Heat can destroy harmful bacteria in food.
sentences.zh: 加熱可以消滅食物裡的有害細菌。

sentences.en: Are all bacteria dangerous to people?
sentences.zh: 所有細菌對人都有危險嗎？

sentences.en: The lab studied how bacteria grow in warm water.
sentences.zh: 實驗室研究細菌如何在溫水中生長。

sentences.en: Dirty sponges can hold millions of bacteria.
sentences.zh: 髒海綿可能藏有數百萬隻細菌。

gloss_note: badly hurt 重傷；want sth badly

sentences.en: He played badly in the game and felt terrible.
sentences.zh: 他比賽打得很差，心情很糟。

sentences.en: My knee was badly hurt in the fall.
sentences.zh: 我的膝蓋在那次跌倒中傷得很重。

sentences.en: I need a vacation badly.
sentences.zh: 我真的很需要放個假。

sentences.en: Was your house badly damaged in the storm?
sentences.zh: 你家在暴風雨中受到嚴重損壞了嗎？

sentences.en: She sings badly but has a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: 她唱得不好，但玩得很開心。

sentences.en: The team badly needs a new coach.
sentences.zh: 球隊迫切需要一位新教練。

gloss_note: take the bait 上鉤；v. 用餌誘捕

sentences.en: We bought fresh bait for the fishing trip.
sentences.zh: 我們為釣魚之旅買了新鮮的餌。

sentences.en: Don't take the bait. He just wants to argue.
sentences.zh: 別上鉤，他只是想吵架。

sentences.en: Dad put bait on the hook and cast the line.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在釣鉤上掛好餌，然後把釣線拋出去。

sentences.en: Is this a worm or a piece of bait?
sentences.zh: 這是蟲還是魚餌？

sentences.en: The store uses cheap prices as bait to bring in shoppers.
sentences.zh: 這家店用低價當誘餌吸引顧客。

sentences.en: They baited the trap with a piece of cheese.
sentences.zh: 他們用一塊起司當誘餌設置捕鼠器。

gloss_note: bamboo forest 竹林；竹筷

sentences.en: Pandas eat bamboo almost all day long.
sentences.zh: 貓熊幾乎整天都在吃竹子。

sentences.en: This cutting board is made of bamboo.
sentences.zh: 這塊砧板是竹子做的。

sentences.en: Have you ever walked through a bamboo forest?
sentences.zh: 你有走過竹林嗎？

sentences.en: Bamboo grows faster than most plants.
sentences.zh: 竹子比大多數植物長得快。

sentences.en: We use bamboo sticks to hold up the tomato plants.
sentences.zh: 我們用竹竿來撐住番茄植株。

sentences.en: The store sells bamboo chopsticks and baskets.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣竹筷和竹籃。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: bang the door 猛力關門

sentences.en: I heard a loud bang from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我聽到廚房傳來一聲巨響。

sentences.en: Don't bang the door when you leave.
sentences.zh: 你離開時別砰地甩門。

sentences.en: He banged his head on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 他的頭撞到了架子。

sentences.en: What was that bang outside?
sentences.zh: 外面剛剛那聲巨響是什麼？

sentences.en: The little kid banged on the table with a spoon.
sentences.zh: 小孩子拿湯匙敲打桌子。

sentences.en: The balloon popped with a bang.
sentences.zh: 氣球砰的一聲破了。

gloss_note: investment banker 投資銀行家

sentences.en: My uncle works as a banker in New York.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在紐約當銀行員。

sentences.en: The banker explained how the loan works.
sentences.zh: 銀行員解釋了貸款是怎麼運作的。

sentences.en: Is it hard to become an investment banker?
sentences.zh: 要成為投資銀行家很難嗎？

sentences.en: She met a banker at a business dinner.
sentences.zh: 她在一場商務晚宴上認識了一位銀行家。

sentences.en: Many bankers work long hours during tax season.
sentences.zh: 許多銀行員在報稅季工作時間很長。

sentences.en: The banker asked for proof of my income.
sentences.zh: 銀行員要我提供收入證明。

gloss_note: bare feet 光腳；bare walls 空蕩的牆

sentences.en: The kids ran around the beach in bare feet.
sentences.zh: 孩子們光著腳在沙灘上跑來跑去。

sentences.en: The room had bare walls and no furniture.
sentences.zh: 房間牆壁光禿禿的，沒有家具。

sentences.en: In winter, the trees are bare.
sentences.zh: 冬天時，樹都是光禿禿的。

sentences.en: Why are your arms bare in this cold weather?
sentences.zh: 天氣這麼冷，你為什麼露著手臂？

sentences.en: The bare branches shook in the cold wind.
sentences.zh: 光禿禿的樹枝在寒風中搖晃。

sentences.en: Is the floor bare, or is there a rug?
sentences.zh: 地板是空的，還是有鋪地毯？

gloss_note: 本身帶否定，不再加 not

sentences.en: I barely slept last night because of the noise.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚因為噪音幾乎沒睡。

sentences.en: We barely made it to the airport on time.
sentences.zh: 我們勉強準時趕到機場。

sentences.en: She could barely hear the teacher in the back row.
sentences.zh: 坐在後排的她幾乎聽不到老師的聲音。

sentences.en: Why can we barely see any stars from here?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我們在這裡幾乎看不到星星？

sentences.en: He was barely ten years old when he moved here.
sentences.zh: 他搬來這裡時才剛滿十歲。

sentences.en: There was barely enough food for everyone.
sentences.zh: 食物勉強夠每個人吃。

gloss_note: 農場上存放乾草、農具的大建築

sentences.en: The farmer keeps the hay in the barn.
sentences.zh: 農夫把乾草放在穀倉裡。

sentences.en: We saw a red barn on our road trip.
sentences.zh: 我們公路旅行時看到一間紅色穀倉。

sentences.en: Do the horses sleep in the barn at night?
sentences.zh: 馬晚上睡在畜棚裡嗎？

sentences.en: The old barn was turned into a wedding hall.
sentences.zh: 那間老穀倉被改建成婚禮會場。

sentences.en: The cat had kittens in the barn.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓在穀倉裡生了小貓。

sentences.en: Kids helped clean the barn during the school trip.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在校外教學時幫忙打掃穀倉。

gloss_note: oil barrel；a barrel of 一大桶

sentences.en: The farm keeps rain water in a big barrel.
sentences.zh: 農場把雨水存在一個大桶裡。

sentences.en: The farm stores its apple juice in large wooden barrels.
sentences.zh: 農場把蘋果汁存放在大木桶裡。

sentences.en: The price of a barrel of oil went up today.
sentences.zh: 今天每桶石油的價格上漲了。

sentences.en: Can you roll that barrel to the back of the truck?
sentences.zh: 你可以把那個大桶滾到卡車後面嗎？

sentences.en: Pirates in the movie hid gold inside a barrel.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的海盜把黃金藏在一個桶子裡。

sentences.en: We used an old barrel as a trash can.
sentences.zh: 我們把一個舊桶子拿來當垃圾桶。

gloss_note: 比 gulf 小；San Francisco Bay

sentences.en: We watched sailboats glide across the bay.
sentences.zh: 我們看著帆船滑過海灣。

sentences.en: The city sits right on a beautiful bay.
sentences.zh: 這座城市就位在一個美麗的海灣邊。

sentences.en: Is the water in the bay safe for swimming?
sentences.zh: 海灣的水適合游泳嗎？

sentences.en: Our hotel has a great view of the bay.
sentences.zh: 我們的旅館可以看到海灣的美景。

sentences.en: Fishing boats return to the bay before sunset.
sentences.zh: 漁船在日落前回到海灣。

sentences.en: Whales were seen in the bay this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有人在海灣看到鯨魚。

gloss_note: 串珠手環用的小珠；a bead of sweat 一滴汗珠

sentences.en: She made a bracelet with colorful glass beads.
sentences.zh: 她用彩色玻璃珠做了一條手環。

sentences.en: A bead of sweat ran down his face.
sentences.zh: 一滴汗珠從他的臉上滑落。

sentences.en: Can I borrow a needle to string these beads?
sentences.zh: 我可以借根針來串這些珠子嗎？

sentences.en: The store sells beads in every color.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣各種顏色的珠子。

sentences.en: Did one bead fall off the necklace?
sentences.zh: 項鍊上是不是掉了一顆珠子？

sentences.en: Kids sat at the craft table sorting beads by size.
sentences.zh: 孩子們坐在手工桌前依大小分類珠子。

gloss_note: a beam of light 一道光

sentences.en: A beam of light came through the window.
sentences.zh: 一道光束從窗戶照進來。

sentences.en: The flashlight's beam lit up the dark path.
sentences.zh: 手電筒的光束照亮了黑暗的小路。

sentences.en: Turn on your high beams on the dark country road.
sentences.zh: 在漆黑的鄉間道路上要開遠光燈。

sentences.en: The sun beamed down on the beach all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 太陽整個下午都照耀著海灘。

sentences.en: Does the lighthouse beam reach the ships?
sentences.zh: 燈塔的光束照得到船隻嗎？

sentences.en: A laser beam moved across the stage.
sentences.zh: 一道雷射光束掃過舞台。

gloss_note: 童話與電影常見 beast；beast 也可口語形容很強的人

sentences.en: In the story, a beast lives deep in the forest.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一隻野獸住在森林深處。

sentences.en: Beauty and the Beast is my favorite fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 《美女與野獸》是我最喜歡的童話。

sentences.en: The beast roared and the kids ran away.
sentences.zh: 野獸咆哮了一聲，孩子們跑開了。

sentences.en: Is that big dog really a gentle beast?
sentences.zh: 那隻大狗真的是溫和的大傢伙嗎？

sentences.en: Many ancient stories describe a strange beast in the sea.
sentences.zh: 許多古老故事都描述海裡有一種奇怪的野獸。

sentences.en: The video game has a giant beast as its final boss.
sentences.zh: 這款電玩有隻巨大野獸當最終頭目。

gloss_note: 昆蟲，前翅堅硬

sentences.en: A shiny beetle crawled across the leaf.
sentences.zh: 一隻閃亮的甲蟲爬過葉子。

sentences.en: My little brother keeps a pet beetle in a jar.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟把一隻寵物甲蟲養在罐子裡。

sentences.en: Beetles come in thousands of colors and shapes.
sentences.zh: 甲蟲有數千種顏色和形狀。

sentences.en: Is that bug a beetle or a cockroach?
sentences.zh: 那隻蟲是甲蟲還是蟑螂？

sentences.en: The museum has a huge collection of rare beetles.
sentences.zh: 博物館有大量稀有甲蟲的收藏。

sentences.en: Don't step on the beetle on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 別踩到人行道上的甲蟲。

gloss_note: benefit from 從中受益

sentences.en: Exercise has many benefits for your health.
sentences.zh: 運動對你的健康有許多好處。

sentences.en: Who will benefit from the new rule?
sentences.zh: 誰會從這項新規定中受益？

sentences.en: This job comes with good health benefits.
sentences.zh: 這份工作有很好的健康福利。

sentences.en: Reading every day will benefit you a lot.
sentences.zh: 每天閱讀會讓你受益良多。

sentences.en: I stayed late for the benefit of the whole team.
sentences.zh: 我為了整個團隊的利益留下來加班。

sentences.en: What's the benefit of buying in bulk?
sentences.zh: 大量購買有什麼好處？

gloss_note: strawberry、blueberry 等小型漿果的統稱

sentences.en: We picked fresh berries at the farm.
sentences.zh: 我們在農場摘了新鮮的莓果。

sentences.en: Do you want some berries on your yogurt?
sentences.zh: 你的優格要加一些莓果嗎？

sentences.en: This berry is too sour to eat plain.
sentences.zh: 這種莓果酸到不能直接吃。

sentences.en: Birds ate every berry on the bush.
sentences.zh: 鳥把灌木上的每顆莓果都吃光了。

sentences.en: The pie is filled with sweet wild berries.
sentences.zh: 這個派裡填滿了甜甜的野莓。

sentences.en: Berries are full of vitamins and fiber.
sentences.zh: 莓果富含維生素和纖維。

gloss_note: 過去式 bound；bind together

sentences.en: Use this rope to bind the boxes together.
sentences.zh: 用這條繩子把箱子綁在一起。

sentences.en: He used a ribbon to bind the old letters.
sentences.zh: 他用緞帶把舊信件綑起來。

sentences.en: Can you bind these papers into a book?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這些紙裝訂成一本書嗎？

sentences.en: Use string to bind the old newspapers into a bundle.
sentences.zh: 用繩子把舊報紙綑成一捆。

sentences.en: How do scouts bind sticks to make a raft?
sentences.zh: 童軍是怎麼把木棍綁起來做木筏的？

sentences.en: The glue binds the two pieces together firmly.
sentences.zh: 這種膠能把兩塊牢牢黏在一起。

gloss_note: 過去式 bled；常見 bleed a little

sentences.en: My finger started to bleed after the paper cut.
sentences.zh: 我的手指被紙割到後開始流血。

sentences.en: Do your gums bleed when you brush your teeth?
sentences.zh: 你刷牙時牙齦會出血嗎？

sentences.en: His nose bled for a few minutes after the ball hit it.
sentences.zh: 球打到他鼻子後，他流了幾分鐘鼻血。

sentences.en: Press a clean cloth on the cut to stop the bleeding.
sentences.zh: 用乾淨的布按住傷口止血。

sentences.en: The nurse said the cut would bleed a little.
sentences.zh: 護理師說這個傷口會流一點血。

sentences.en: Don't worry. The scratch is small and won't bleed much.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，擦傷很小，不會流很多血。

gloss_note: bloody nose 流鼻血；此處不用英式粗話義

sentences.en: He came home with a bloody nose after the game.
sentences.zh: 比賽後他流著鼻血回家。

sentences.en: Use a tissue if you have a bloody nose.
sentences.zh: 如果你流鼻血，就用面紙擦。

sentences.en: The nurse cleaned my bloody knee.
sentences.zh: 護理師幫我清理流血的膝蓋。

sentences.en: Why is your shirt bloody? Are you hurt?
sentences.zh: 你的衣服怎麼有血？你受傷了嗎？

sentences.en: The bandage was bloody, so the doctor changed it.
sentences.zh: 繃帶沾血了，所以醫生換了新的。

sentences.en: Don't touch the bloody tissue. Throw it away.
sentences.zh: 別碰那張沾血的面紙，丟掉它。

gloss_note: 可指個性大膽，也可指顏色、字體醒目；bold type 粗體

sentences.en: That was a bold move, asking the boss for a raise.
sentences.zh: 向老闆要求加薪是個大膽的舉動。

sentences.en: She wore a bold red dress to the party.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件亮眼的紅洋裝去派對。

sentences.en: Are you bold enough to try the spicy challenge?
sentences.zh: 你有膽子挑戰那個辣味嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher wrote the key words in bold letters.
sentences.zh: 老師用粗體字寫下重點單字。

sentences.en: Was it bold of him to quit his job?
sentences.zh: 他辭掉工作算大膽嗎？

sentences.en: He gave a bold answer that surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 他給了一個讓大家吃驚的大膽答案。

gloss_note: 常用複數 boots；rain boots 雨靴

sentences.en: I bought a new pair of winter boots.
sentences.zh: 我買了一雙新的冬季靴子。

sentences.en: Don't forget to wear rain boots today.
sentences.zh: 今天別忘了穿雨靴。

sentences.en: Where did you leave your muddy boots?
sentences.zh: 你把沾滿泥巴的靴子放哪了？

sentences.en: My hiking boots are great for rocky trails.
sentences.zh: 我的登山靴很適合走碎石山徑。

sentences.en: The cowboy in the movie wore old leather boots.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的牛仔穿著舊皮靴。

sentences.en: Take off your snow boots at the door.
sentences.zh: 在門口把雪靴脫掉。

gloss_note: step on the brakes；別拼成 break

sentences.en: He hit the brake when the light turned red.
sentences.zh: 紅燈亮起時，他踩了煞車。

sentences.en: My bike's brakes feel weak. Can you check them?
sentences.zh: 我腳踏車的煞車感覺不太靈，你可以檢查一下嗎？

sentences.en: Brake slowly when the road is wet.
sentences.zh: 路面濕滑時要慢慢煞車。

sentences.en: The driver slammed on the brakes to avoid a deer.
sentences.zh: 駕駛猛踩煞車避開一隻鹿。

sentences.en: Did you replace the brake pads?
sentences.zh: 你換過煞車皮了嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful. The car's parking brake is broken.
sentences.zh: 小心，這輛車的手煞車壞了。

gloss_note: brass band 銅管樂隊

sentences.en: This old door handle is made of brass.
sentences.zh: 這個舊門把是黃銅做的。

sentences.en: The school's brass band played at the game.
sentences.zh: 學校的銅管樂隊在比賽中演奏。

sentences.en: Trumpets and trombones are brass instruments.
sentences.zh: 小號和長號是銅管樂器。

sentences.en: Polish the brass lamp until it shines.
sentences.zh: 把這盞黃銅燈擦到發亮。

sentences.en: Do you play in the brass section?
sentences.zh: 你是在銅管組演奏的嗎？

sentences.en: Does the shop sell brass keys and small bells?
sentences.zh: 這家店有賣黃銅鑰匙和小鈴鐺嗎？

gloss_note: 指行動上的勇氣；award for bravery 英勇獎

sentences.en: The firefighter received an award for his bravery.
sentences.zh: 那位消防員因他的英勇而獲獎。

sentences.en: It took real bravery to speak up in class.
sentences.zh: 在課堂上發言需要真正的勇氣。

sentences.en: We admire her bravery during the storm.
sentences.zh: 我們佩服她在暴風雨中的勇敢。

sentences.en: Is bravery the same as having no fear?
sentences.zh: 勇敢就是不會害怕嗎？

sentences.en: The little boy showed great bravery at the doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 小男孩在診所表現得非常勇敢。

sentences.en: Stories of bravery help children learn courage.
sentences.zh: 勇敢的故事可以讓孩子學會勇氣。

gloss_note: chicken breast；breast pocket

sentences.en: I'll have the grilled chicken breast with rice.
sentences.zh: 我要烤雞胸肉配飯。

sentences.en: Chicken breast is low in fat and high in protein.
sentences.zh: 雞胸肉脂肪低、蛋白質高。

sentences.en: Do you want the chicken breast or the leg?
sentences.zh: 你要雞胸肉還是雞腿？

sentences.en: I put the pen in my jacket's breast pocket.
sentences.zh: 我把筆放進外套的胸前口袋。

sentences.en: Cut the chicken breast into thin slices.
sentences.zh: 把雞胸肉切成薄片。

sentences.en: Mom bought two chicken breasts for tonight's dinner.
sentences.zh: 媽媽買了兩塊雞胸肉當今晚的晚餐。

gloss_note: take a deep breath 深呼吸

sentences.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸，放輕鬆。

sentences.en: I'm out of breath after climbing the stairs.
sentences.zh: 爬完樓梯我喘不過氣來。

sentences.en: He held his breath and jumped into the pool.
sentences.zh: 他憋住氣跳進游泳池。

sentences.en: Can you smell the mint on my breath?
sentences.zh: 你聞得到我嘴裡的薄荷味嗎？

sentences.en: She stopped to catch her breath halfway up the hill.
sentences.zh: 她爬到半山腰時停下來喘口氣。

sentences.en: The doctor told me to breathe in, then hold my breath.
sentences.zh: 醫生叫我吸氣，然後憋氣。

gloss_note: a cool breeze 涼風；比 wind 輕柔
other_senses: 輕而易舉的事（It's a breeze）

sentences.en: A cool breeze came through the open window.
sentences.zh: 一陣涼風從開著的窗戶吹進來。

sentences.en: We sat on the porch and enjoyed the evening breeze.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在門廊享受傍晚的微風。

sentences.en: The sea breeze felt great after a hot day.
sentences.zh: 炎熱的一天後，海風感覺好舒服。

sentences.en: Is there a breeze today, or is it too still?
sentences.zh: 今天有風嗎，還是太悶了？

sentences.en: The test was a breeze, and I finished early.
sentences.zh: 那場考試很輕鬆，我提早寫完了。

sentences.en: A light breeze moved the curtains.
sentences.zh: 一陣輕風吹動了窗簾。

gloss_note: bride and groom 新娘和新郎；婚禮當天用

sentences.en: The bride wore a long white dress.
sentences.zh: 新娘穿著一件白色長禮服。

sentences.en: Everyone stood up when the bride walked in.
sentences.zh: 新娘走進來時，所有人都站了起來。

sentences.en: Who is the bride's best friend?
sentences.zh: 新娘最好的朋友是誰？

sentences.en: The bride and groom danced to their favorite song.
sentences.zh: 新娘和新郎隨著他們最愛的歌跳舞。

sentences.en: My cousin is the bride, so I'm helping her get ready.
sentences.zh: 我表姊是新娘，所以我在幫她準備。

sentences.en: The bride's father gave a short speech.
sentences.zh: 新娘的父親做了簡短致詞。

gloss_note: blow bubbles 吹泡泡

sentences.en: The kids blew soap bubbles in the yard.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在院子裡吹肥皂泡泡。

sentences.en: Look at the bubbles in my soda.
sentences.zh: 看我汽水裡的泡泡。

sentences.en: The soup began to bubble on the stove.
sentences.zh: 湯在爐子上開始冒泡。

sentences.en: Do you want a bubble bath tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚要泡泡澡嗎？

sentences.en: A small bubble got stuck under the phone screen protector.
sentences.zh: 手機螢幕保護貼底下卡了一個小氣泡。

sentences.en: Bubbles rose to the top of the fish tank.
sentences.zh: 氣泡升到魚缸頂端。

gloss_note: 指尚未展開的花或葉；budding 冒芽

sentences.en: The tree has small green buds in early spring.
sentences.zh: 這棵樹在初春長出小小的綠芽。

sentences.en: Look at the rose bud. It will open soon.
sentences.zh: 看這朵玫瑰花苞，它快開了。

sentences.en: Will each bud on the plant become a flower?
sentences.zh: 這株植物上的每個花苞都會長成花嗎？

sentences.en: Did the frost kill the buds on your apple tree?
sentences.zh: 霜凍有傷到你蘋果樹的芽嗎？

sentences.en: The cherry trees are budding this week.
sentences.zh: 櫻桃樹這星期正在冒出花苞。

sentences.en: A tiny bud appeared on the stem overnight.
sentences.zh: 一夜之間，莖上冒出了一個小小的花苞。

gloss_note: on a budget 預算有限

sentences.en: We're on a tight budget this month.
sentences.zh: 我們這個月預算很緊。

sentences.en: Can you make a budget for our trip?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我們的旅行編個預算嗎？

sentences.en: The school cut its budget for sports.
sentences.zh: 學校削減了運動項目的預算。

sentences.en: He budgets about fifty dollars a week for food.
sentences.zh: 他每週編列大約五十美元的伙食預算。

sentences.en: The movie went over budget by millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 這部電影超出預算好幾百萬美元。

sentences.en: Do you have a budget in mind for the gift?
sentences.zh: 你對這份禮物有預算嗎？

gloss_note: 美國常指野牛；buffalo wings 雞翅

sentences.en: A herd of buffalo crossed the road in the park.
sentences.zh: 一群野牛在公園裡穿過馬路。

sentences.en: Buffalo once roamed freely across the American plains.
sentences.zh: 野牛曾經在美國大平原上自由漫遊。

sentences.en: Water buffalo help farmers plow the rice fields.
sentences.zh: 水牛幫農夫犁稻田。

sentences.en: Is that animal a buffalo or a cow?
sentences.zh: 那隻動物是水牛還是乳牛？

sentences.en: We saw a huge buffalo near the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊看到一頭很大的野牛。

sentences.en: Hunters in the old days depended on the buffalo for food.
sentences.zh: 過去的獵人靠野牛取得食物。

gloss_note: light bulb 燈泡；flower bulb 球根

sentences.en: The light bulb in the hallway burned out.
sentences.zh: 走廊的燈泡燒壞了。

sentences.en: Do we have any spare bulbs?
sentences.zh: 我們有備用燈泡嗎？

sentences.en: Plant the tulip bulbs in the fall.
sentences.zh: 鬱金香的球根要在秋天種。

sentences.en: Switch to an energy-saving bulb to save power.
sentences.zh: 換成節能燈泡可以省電。

sentences.en: I need a brighter bulb for my desk lamp.
sentences.zh: 我的檯燈需要換一個更亮的燈泡。

sentences.en: The bulb flickered and then went dark.
sentences.zh: 燈泡閃了幾下就暗了。

gloss_note: 指公牛；bull 口語也可指胡說

sentences.en: The farmer kept one bull in the field.
sentences.zh: 農夫在田裡養了一頭公牛。

sentences.en: The bull ran to the end of the fence.
sentences.zh: 那頭公牛跑到了圍籬的盡頭。

sentences.en: Is a bull more dangerous than a cow?
sentences.zh: 公牛比母牛更危險嗎？

sentences.en: A bull and several cows stood by the barn.
sentences.zh: 一頭公牛和幾頭母牛站在穀倉旁。

sentences.en: Stay away from the bull when you visit the farm.
sentences.zh: 參觀農場時要離公牛遠一點。

sentences.en: The painting shows a huge bull in a green field.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫畫的是綠色草地上的一頭大公牛。

gloss_note: 新聞、電影、遊戲中的中性用法

sentences.en: The museum shows an old bullet from the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示著一顆南北戰爭時期的舊子彈。

sentences.en: In the game, you only have ten bullets, so use them wisely.
sentences.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，你只有十顆子彈，要聰明使用。

sentences.en: The hero in the movie dodged every bullet.
sentences.zh: 電影中的主角閃過了每一顆子彈。

sentences.en: Police found a bullet near the old building.
sentences.zh: 警方在舊大樓附近發現一顆子彈。

sentences.en: Is that a real bullet or just a movie prop?
sentences.zh: 那是真的子彈，還是只是電影道具？

sentences.en: This museum has bullets from the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有南北戰爭時期的子彈。

gloss_note: bump into 撞到／偶遇

sentences.en: I bumped my knee on the table.
sentences.zh: 我的膝蓋撞到桌子了。

sentences.en: Watch out for the bump in the road.
sentences.zh: 小心路上的顛簸處。

sentences.en: She has a bump on her forehead.
sentences.zh: 她額頭上有個腫包。

sentences.en: I bumped into the door in the dark.
sentences.zh: 我在黑暗中撞到了門。

sentences.en: Did you feel that bump when we drove over it?
sentences.zh: 我們開過去時你有感覺到那個顛簸嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful not to bump the table.
sentences.zh: 小心別撞到桌子。

gloss_note: a bunch of 一堆、一束

sentences.en: I bought a bunch of bananas at the store.
sentences.zh: 我在店裡買了一串香蕉。

sentences.en: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
sentences.zh: 他送她一束花。

sentences.en: We have a bunch of homework tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚有一大堆功課。

sentences.en: A bunch of kids were playing soccer in the park.
sentences.zh: 一群孩子在公園裡踢足球。

sentences.en: Why did you buy such a big bunch of grapes?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼買這麼大一串葡萄？

sentences.en: My friends are a fun bunch.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友們是一群很有趣的人。

gloss_note: bury sth in the ground

sentences.en: Why does the dog like to bury bones in the yard?
sentences.zh: 為什麼那隻狗喜歡在院子裡埋骨頭？

sentences.en: Pirates in the story buried their treasure on an island.
sentences.zh: 故事裡的海盜把寶藏埋在一座島上。

sentences.en: Did you bury the seeds deep enough?
sentences.zh: 你把種子埋得夠深了嗎？

sentences.en: Snow buried the cars overnight.
sentences.zh: 一夜大雪把車子都埋住了。

sentences.en: The kids buried their feet in the warm sand.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把腳埋進溫暖的沙子裡。

sentences.en: He tried to bury his face in the pillow.
sentences.zh: 他試著把臉埋進枕頭裡。

gloss_note: 常見 rose bush、bush 生長較低、枝條多

sentences.en: There is a rose bush in front of our house.
sentences.zh: 我們家前面有一叢玫瑰灌木。

sentences.en: A rabbit ran into the bushes.
sentences.zh: 一隻兔子跑進灌木叢裡。

sentences.en: Dad is trimming the bush by the fence.
sentences.zh: 爸爸正在修剪圍籬旁的灌木。

sentences.en: Did you see the little bird in that bush?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那叢灌木裡的小鳥嗎？

sentences.en: The blueberry bush is full of fruit this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的藍莓樹叢結滿了果實。

sentences.en: We hid behind a big bush during hide-and-seek.
sentences.zh: 玩捉迷藏時，我們躲在一叢大灌木後面。

gloss_note: 山林小屋；cabin crew 機組人員

sentences.en: We rented a cabin by the lake for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們租了湖邊的一間小木屋度週末。

sentences.en: Is there a fireplace in the cabin?
sentences.zh: 小木屋裡有壁爐嗎？

sentences.en: The cabin was quiet except for the sound of the wind.
sentences.zh: 木屋裡除了風聲之外一片寧靜。

sentences.en: The flight attendant checked that the cabin was ready for takeoff.
sentences.zh: 空服員檢查機艙是否已準備好起飛。

sentences.en: Grandpa built this log cabin with his own hands.
sentences.zh: 爺爺親手蓋了這間原木小屋。

sentences.en: The cabin crew passed out drinks during the flight.
sentences.zh: 機組人員在飛行途中發送飲料。

gloss_note: 美國西部常見，如 Grand Canyon（大峽谷）

sentences.en: We hiked to the bottom of the canyon.
sentences.zh: 我們健行到峽谷底部。

sentences.en: Have you ever visited the Grand Canyon?
sentences.zh: 你去過大峽谷嗎？

sentences.en: The river cut a deep canyon through the rock.
sentences.zh: 河流在岩石中切出一道深深的峽谷。

sentences.en: The view from the edge of the canyon was amazing.
sentences.zh: 從峽谷邊緣看出去的景色太美了。

sentences.en: Be careful. The canyon walls are very steep here.
sentences.zh: 小心，這裡的峽谷壁非常陡。

sentences.en: Our guide explained how the canyon was formed.
sentences.zh: 我們的導覽員解釋了峽谷是怎麼形成的。

gloss_note: be capable of + 名詞／V-ing

sentences.en: She is a capable leader and everyone trusts her.
sentences.zh: 她是個能幹的領導者，大家都信任她。

sentences.en: Are you capable of lifting this box alone?
sentences.zh: 你有辦法自己抬起這個箱子嗎？

sentences.en: This laptop is capable of running heavy games.
sentences.zh: 這台筆電可以跑很吃效能的遊戲。

sentences.en: I'm sure he's capable of finishing the job on time.
sentences.zh: 我相信他有能力準時完成工作。

sentences.en: The nurse was calm and very capable.
sentences.zh: 那位護理師冷靜又很能幹。

sentences.en: Kids are more capable than we often think.
sentences.zh: 孩子們比我們常以為的更有能力。

gloss_note: capture a moment 捕捉瞬間

sentences.en: The photo captures the beauty of the sunset.
sentences.zh: 這張照片捕捉到了夕陽的美。

sentences.en: Police captured the runaway dog near the highway.
sentences.zh: 警方在公路附近抓到了走失的狗。

sentences.en: Can you capture this moment on camera?
sentences.zh: 你可以用相機把這個瞬間拍下來嗎？

sentences.en: Her speech captured everyone's attention.
sentences.zh: 她的演講吸引了所有人的注意。

sentences.en: The army captured the city after a long fight.
sentences.zh: 軍隊經過長時間的戰事後攻占了這座城市。

sentences.en: Did the capture of the thief make the evening news?
sentences.zh: 小偷被抓的消息有上晚間新聞嗎？

gloss_note: 指長期從事的工作；career path 職涯方向

sentences.en: She wants a career in medicine.
sentences.zh: 她想從事醫學方面的職業。

sentences.en: What career are you thinking about?
sentences.zh: 你在考慮什麼職業？

sentences.en: He had a long career as a teacher.
sentences.zh: 他當了很久的老師。

sentences.en: The school holds a career day every spring.
sentences.zh: 學校每年春天都舉辦職業日。

sentences.en: A change of career can be scary but exciting.
sentences.zh: 轉換職涯可能令人害怕卻也令人興奮。

sentences.en: Did her career in music start at fifteen?
sentences.zh: 她的音樂生涯是十五歲開始的嗎？

gloss_note: 指做木製品或房屋木構的工人

sentences.en: My uncle is a carpenter who builds kitchen cabinets.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是木匠，專門做廚房櫥櫃。

sentences.en: We hired a carpenter to fix the porch.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一位木匠來修門廊。

sentences.en: Does the carpenter bring his own tools?
sentences.zh: 木匠會自己帶工具嗎？

sentences.en: The carpenter measured the wall twice.
sentences.zh: 木匠把牆量了兩次。

sentences.en: A good carpenter is always in demand.
sentences.zh: 好木匠總是供不應求。

sentences.en: Jesse studied to become a carpenter after high school.
sentences.zh: 傑西高中畢業後學習成為木匠。

gloss_note: 美式 baby carriage 是嬰兒車

sentences.en: We rode in a horse-drawn carriage around the park.
sentences.zh: 我們坐馬車繞公園一圈。

sentences.en: She pushed the baby carriage down the street.
sentences.zh: 她推著嬰兒車走在街上。

sentences.en: In the story, the princess arrived in a golden carriage.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，公主乘著金色馬車抵達。

sentences.en: Is the carriage too heavy for one horse?
sentences.zh: 這輛馬車對一匹馬來說會不會太重？

sentences.en: The museum has a carriage from the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一輛十九世紀的馬車。

sentences.en: Where did you put the baby carriage?
sentences.zh: 你把嬰兒車放在哪了？

gloss_note: 美式購物車就叫 cart；英式多說 trolley

sentences.en: Can you grab a cart while I find the milk?
sentences.zh: 你先去推台購物車好嗎？我去找牛奶。

sentences.en: The farmer loaded the cart with fresh corn.
sentences.zh: 農夫把新鮮玉米裝上推車。

sentences.en: Why is there a cart blocking the hallway?
sentences.zh: 為什麼走廊上有台推車擋著路？

sentences.en: Don't forget to return the cart after you unload.
sentences.zh: 卸完貨別忘了把推車推回去。

sentences.en: I carted all the boxes out to the garage.
sentences.zh: 我用推車把所有箱子運到車庫。

sentences.en: The hot dog cart on the corner is always busy.
sentences.zh: 轉角的熱狗攤車總是很多人。

gloss_note: 打石膏 wear a cast；cast 也指演員陣容

sentences.en: He broke his arm skiing and now wears a cast.
sentences.zh: 他滑雪時摔斷手臂，現在打著石膏。

sentences.en: The cast of the school play practiced all weekend.
sentences.zh: 學校話劇的演員陣容整個週末都在排練。

sentences.en: Did you sign his cast yet?
sentences.zh: 你簽了他的石膏沒？

sentences.en: The whole cast of the show signed my poster.
sentences.zh: 整個劇組的演員都在我的海報上簽了名。

sentences.en: Who's in the cast of that new movie?
sentences.zh: 那部新電影的演員有哪些人？

sentences.en: The doctor will remove the cast next Monday.
sentences.zh: 醫生下週一會拆掉石膏。

gloss_note: casual Friday：週五便服日

sentences.en: Jeans are fine; the dress code is pretty casual.
sentences.zh: 穿牛仔褲就行，服裝規定很隨性。

sentences.en: It was just a casual chat, nothing serious.
sentences.zh: 只是隨便聊聊，沒什麼大不了。

sentences.en: Is this restaurant casual or fancy?
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳是休閒風還是高級的？

sentences.en: I'm a casual fan; I only watch the playoffs.
sentences.zh: 我只是普通球迷，只看季後賽。

sentences.en: She wore a casual sweater to the party.
sentences.zh: 她穿了件休閒毛衣去派對。

sentences.en: Is it casual Friday, or do I need a suit?
sentences.zh: 今天是休閒日，還是我得穿西裝？

gloss_note: 集合名詞，不加 s，不說 a cattle

sentences.en: Farmers in Texas raise thousands of cattle.
sentences.zh: 德州的農民養了數千頭牛。

sentences.en: The cattle were grazing quietly in the field.
sentences.zh: 牛群在田裡安靜地吃草。

sentences.en: How many cattle does your uncle have on his ranch?
sentences.zh: 你叔叔的牧場養了幾頭牛？

sentences.en: We drove past a herd of cattle on the highway.
sentences.zh: 我們開車經過公路旁的一群牛。

sentences.en: Cattle need plenty of water in the summer heat.
sentences.zh: 夏天高溫時，牛需要大量的水。

sentences.en: Is that beef from grass-fed cattle?
sentences.zh: 那牛肉是草飼牛的嗎？

gloss_note: cave in：塌陷；屈服讓步

sentences.en: We explored a huge cave on our camping trip.
sentences.zh: 露營時我們探索了一個超大的山洞。

sentences.en: Bats sleep in the cave during the day.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠白天睡在洞穴裡。

sentences.en: Did you see the cave paintings in the museum?
sentences.zh: 你看過博物館裡的洞穴壁畫嗎？

sentences.en: Why did you cave in so easily?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼這麼輕易就讓步了？

sentences.en: The old tunnel caved in after the heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 那條老隧道在大雨後塌陷了。

sentences.en: Our basement is cool and dark like a cave.
sentences.zh: 我們的地下室又涼又暗，像山洞一樣。

gloss_note: defending champion：衛冕者

sentences.en: She was the state champion in swimming last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年是全州游泳冠軍。

sentences.en: Who's the defending champion this season?
sentences.zh: 這一季的衛冕冠軍是誰？

sentences.en: Our team finally became champions after ten years.
sentences.zh: 我們隊十年後終於成為冠軍。

sentences.en: He's a champion of free school lunches.
sentences.zh: 他是免費營養午餐的擁護者。

sentences.en: My grandpa was a chess champion in his town.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是他們鎮上的西洋棋冠軍。

sentences.en: Do you think our school can become the champion?
sentences.zh: 你覺得我們學校能拿下冠軍嗎？

gloss_note: charm 也指幸運符、手鍊上的小飾品

sentences.en: The little town has a lot of charm.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮很有魅力。

sentences.en: He used his charm to get a free dessert.
sentences.zh: 他靠著魅力換到一份免費甜點。

sentences.en: Her smile charmed everyone at the party.
sentences.zh: 她的笑容迷住了派對上的每個人。

sentences.en: She has a quiet charm that people notice right away.
sentences.zh: 她有種安靜的魅力，大家一下子就會注意到。

sentences.en: What's the charm of living in the countryside?
sentences.zh: 住在鄉下有什麼迷人之處？

sentences.en: That old bookstore has a certain charm, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 那家舊書店有種獨特的魅力，不是嗎？

gloss_note: chat with sb；線上聊天也叫 chat

sentences.en: Let's grab coffee and chat for a bit.
sentences.zh: 去喝杯咖啡聊一下吧。

sentences.en: We had a long chat about our weekend plans.
sentences.zh: 我們聊了很久週末的計畫。

sentences.en: Can I chat with you after class?
sentences.zh: 下課後我可以跟你聊聊嗎？

sentences.en: She's chatting with her friends online right now.
sentences.zh: 她現在正在線上跟朋友聊天。

sentences.en: I need a quick chat with my manager.
sentences.zh: 我得跟主管簡短談一下。

sentences.en: What were you two chatting about so happily?
sentences.zh: 你們兩個聊什麼聊得那麼開心？

gloss_note: tongue in cheek：開玩笑地

sentences.en: She gave her grandma a kiss on the cheek.
sentences.zh: 她親了外婆的臉頰一下。

sentences.en: His cheeks turned red when the teacher called his name.
sentences.zh: 老師點到他名字時，他的臉頰紅了。

sentences.en: Why is your cheek so swollen?
sentences.zh: 你的臉頰怎麼腫成這樣？

sentences.en: A tear rolled down her cheek.
sentences.zh: 一滴眼淚滑下她的臉頰。

sentences.en: The baby has such round, soft cheeks.
sentences.zh: 這寶寶的臉頰又圓又軟。

sentences.en: Did you get a sunburn on your cheeks?
sentences.zh: 你的臉頰曬傷了嗎？

gloss_note: 形容人、顏色、音樂都可以

sentences.en: The nurse was always cheerful, even on busy days.
sentences.zh: 護理師即使在忙碌的日子也總是很開朗。

sentences.en: She painted her room a cheerful yellow.
sentences.zh: 她把房間漆成明亮歡快的黃色。

sentences.en: Why are you so cheerful this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上怎麼這麼開心？

sentences.en: He gave us a cheerful wave from the porch.
sentences.zh: 他在門廊愉快地對我們揮手。

sentences.en: Who picked such a cheerful song for the store?
sentences.zh: 誰選了這麼輕快的歌放在店裡？

sentences.en: Try to stay cheerful; things will get better.
sentences.zh: 盡量保持開朗，事情會好轉的。

gloss_note: cherry blossom：櫻花

sentences.en: Cherry pie is my favorite dessert.
sentences.zh: 櫻桃派是我最愛的甜點。

sentences.en: We picked cherries at a farm last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們去年夏天在農場採櫻桃。

sentences.en: Would you like a cherry on top?
sentences.zh: 你要在上面放一顆櫻桃嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a cherry red coat in the snow.
sentences.zh: 她穿著櫻桃紅的外套走在雪中。

sentences.en: The cherry blossoms in Washington bloom every spring.
sentences.zh: 華盛頓的櫻花每年春天盛開。

sentences.en: Are these cherries sweet or sour?
sentences.zh: 這些櫻桃是甜的還是酸的？

gloss_note: toy chest 是玩具箱

sentences.en: I felt a sharp pain in my chest.
sentences.zh: 我胸口一陣刺痛。

sentences.en: Why did he cross his arms over his chest?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼雙臂交叉抱在胸前？

sentences.en: Do you have any chest pain or trouble breathing?
sentences.zh: 你有胸痛或呼吸困難嗎？

sentences.en: The baby fell asleep on her dad's chest.
sentences.zh: 寶寶睡在爸爸的胸口上。

sentences.en: Take a deep breath and puff out your chest.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸，把胸膛挺起來。

sentences.en: Her chest tightened when she heard the news.
sentences.zh: 聽到那個消息，她胸口一緊。

gloss_note: chill out：冷靜；口語 chill 指輕鬆隨和

sentences.en: A cold chill ran down my spine.
sentences.zh: 一股寒意竄過我的背脊。

sentences.en: Wanna chill at my place tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚要不要來我家放鬆一下？

sentences.en: Chill out! It's only a game.
sentences.zh: 冷靜點！只是場遊戲而已。

sentences.en: Do you usually chill at home after school?
sentences.zh: 你放學後通常都在家放鬆嗎？

sentences.en: Don't stand out in the cold; you'll catch a chill.
sentences.zh: 別站在外面吹冷風，會著涼的。

sentences.en: There's a chill in the air this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上空氣中帶著涼意。

gloss_note: 比 cool 更冷，比 cold 溫和

sentences.en: It's chilly outside, so bring a jacket.
sentences.zh: 外面涼颼颼的，帶件外套吧。

sentences.en: Isn't it a little chilly in here?
sentences.zh: 這裡是不是有點冷？

sentences.en: The lake gets chilly in the evening.
sentences.zh: 湖邊一到傍晚就會變涼。

sentences.en: She gave me a chilly look and walked away.
sentences.zh: 她冷冷地看了我一眼就走開了。

sentences.en: How chilly is it supposed to get tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚預計會冷到什麼程度？

sentences.en: October mornings in Chicago can be chilly.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥十月的早晨可能很冷。

gloss_note: 聖誕老人從 chimney 下來

sentences.en: Smoke rose slowly from the chimney.
sentences.zh: 煙從煙囪裡緩緩升起。

sentences.en: A bird built a nest in our chimney.
sentences.zh: 有隻鳥在我們家的煙囪裡築巢。

sentences.en: Does Santa really come down the chimney?
sentences.zh: 聖誕老人真的是從煙囪下來的嗎？

sentences.en: We have the chimney cleaned every fall.
sentences.zh: 我們每年秋天都請人清煙囪。

sentences.en: The old factory had a tall brick chimney.
sentences.zh: 那間舊工廠有一根高高的磚造煙囪。

sentences.en: Why is there so much smoke coming out of that chimney?
sentences.zh: 那根煙囪怎麼冒出這麼多煙？

gloss_note: 美式 chips＝洋芋片，英式叫 crisps

sentences.en: Can you pass me the bag of chips?
sentences.zh: 可以把洋芋片遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: My phone has a new chip that makes it faster.
sentences.zh: 我的手機換了新晶片，速度變快了。

sentences.en: Who finished the last chips?
sentences.zh: 誰把最後的洋芋片吃完了？

sentences.en: Dip the chip in the cheese sauce.
sentences.zh: 把洋芋片沾一下起司醬。

sentences.en: Which chips do you want, salty or spicy?
sentences.zh: 你要鹹的還是辣的洋芋片？

sentences.en: Car companies are short on chips for new models.
sentences.zh: 車廠缺少新車款要用的晶片。

gloss_note: chop up：切碎；pork chop：豬排

sentences.en: Chop the onions into small pieces.
sentences.zh: 把洋蔥切成小塊。

sentences.en: Can you chop some garlic for the sauce?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫忙剁點蒜給醬汁用嗎？

sentences.en: We had grilled pork chops for dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們晚餐吃烤豬排。

sentences.en: He chopped wood behind the cabin.
sentences.zh: 他在小木屋後面劈柴。

sentences.en: How do you chop an onion without crying?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼切洋蔥才不會流淚？

sentences.en: The lamb chops are on sale this week.
sentences.zh: 羊排這週特價。

gloss_note: 常用 a pack of cigarettes

sentences.en: Cigarette smoking is not allowed in this building.
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓禁止吸菸。

sentences.en: A pack of cigarettes costs a lot in New York.
sentences.zh: 在紐約，一包香菸要價不低。

sentences.en: Did he really quit smoking cigarettes five years ago?
sentences.zh: 他真的五年前就戒菸了嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor asked if I'd ever smoked a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 醫生問我有沒有抽過菸。

sentences.en: Please put out your cigarette before you come in.
sentences.zh: 進來之前請把菸熄掉。

sentences.en: Why do old movies show people with a cigarette?
sentences.zh: 為什麼老電影裡的人都叼著菸？

gloss_note: 美式日常多說 movie theater

sentences.en: Is there a new cinema downtown with huge screens?
sentences.zh: 市中心是不是新開了一間螢幕超大的電影院？

sentences.en: Our town has an old cinema that shows classic films.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上有間老戲院放映經典老片。

sentences.en: She studies French cinema at the university.
sentences.zh: 她在大學研究法國電影。

sentences.en: The cinema at the mall shows foreign films on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 商場裡的電影院週日放映外國片。

sentences.en: Do you remember the old cinema that became a bookstore?
sentences.zh: 你還記得那間後來變成書店的老戲院嗎？

sentences.en: Her favorite director changed modern cinema forever.
sentences.zh: 她最愛的導演徹底改變了當代電影。

gloss_note: 口語 It's a circus：亂成一團

sentences.en: Is the circus coming to our town next week?
sentences.zh: 馬戲團下週會來我們鎮上嗎？

sentences.en: My kids love the clowns at the circus.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子們好愛馬戲團的小丑。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to a circus?
sentences.zh: 你有看過馬戲團表演嗎？

sentences.en: The circus tent was bright red and yellow.
sentences.zh: 馬戲團的帳篷是鮮豔的紅黃色。

sentences.en: Mom says our house is a circus on weekday mornings.
sentences.zh: 媽媽說我們家平日早上就像個馬戲團一樣亂。

sentences.en: He walked a tightrope in the circus show.
sentences.zh: 他在馬戲團的表演中走鋼索。

gloss_note: senior citizen：年長者

sentences.en: She became a U.S. citizen last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年成為美國公民。

sentences.en: Does every citizen have the right to vote?
sentences.zh: 每位公民都有投票權嗎？

sentences.en: Are you a citizen or a permanent resident?
sentences.zh: 你是公民還是永久居民？

sentences.en: The mayor thanked the citizens for their patience.
sentences.zh: 市長感謝市民的耐心。

sentences.en: A senior citizen discount is available on Tuesdays.
sentences.zh: 週二有老年人折扣。

sentences.en: Good citizens pick up their trash in the park.
sentences.zh: 好公民會把自己的垃圾從公園裡撿走。

gloss_note: civil engineer：土木工程師；civil war：內戰

sentences.en: Isn't voting an important civil right?
sentences.zh: 投票不是很重要的公民權利嗎？

sentences.en: The couple filed a civil lawsuit against the company.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻對那間公司提起民事訴訟。

sentences.en: Students learn about the civil rights movement in history class.
sentences.zh: 學生在歷史課上學到民權運動。

sentences.en: What's the difference between civil and criminal cases?
sentences.zh: 民事案件和刑事案件有什麼差別？

sentences.en: Their history class studied the American Civil War.
sentences.zh: 他們的歷史課研究了美國南北戰爭。

sentences.en: My uncle works as a civil engineer for the city.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在市政府當土木工程師。

gloss_note: modeling clay：手工黏土

sentences.en: Can the kids make little animals out of clay?
sentences.zh: 孩子們可以用黏土做小動物嗎？

sentences.en: This pot is made of red clay.
sentences.zh: 這個盆子是紅土做的。

sentences.en: Do you have any modeling clay at home?
sentences.zh: 你家有手工黏土嗎？

sentences.en: After the rain, the clay stuck to our boots.
sentences.zh: 下過雨後，黏土黏在我們的靴子上。

sentences.en: The art teacher showed us how to shape clay.
sentences.zh: 美術老師教我們怎麼捏陶土。

sentences.en: Ancient people wrote on clay tablets.
sentences.zh: 古人把字寫在泥板上。

gloss_note: dry cleaner's＝洗衣店；vacuum cleaner＝吸塵器

sentences.en: Do we have any glass cleaner under the sink?
sentences.zh: 水槽下面有玻璃清潔劑嗎？

sentences.en: The office cleaner comes every Thursday to tidy up.
sentences.zh: 辦公室的清潔人員每週四來整理。

sentences.en: I'm taking my suit to the dry cleaner's today.
sentences.zh: 我今天要把西裝拿去乾洗店。

sentences.en: This vacuum cleaner is surprisingly quiet.
sentences.zh: 這台吸塵器出奇地安靜。

sentences.en: Which cleaner works best on kitchen grease?
sentences.zh: 哪種清潔劑對廚房油汙最有效？

sentences.en: My aunt is a hospital cleaner on the night shift.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在醫院夜班做清潔工作。

gloss_note: walk-in clinic：不用預約的診所

sentences.en: I have an appointment at the clinic at ten.
sentences.zh: 我十點在診所有預約。

sentences.en: Does the free clinic help people without insurance?
sentences.zh: 免費診所有幫助沒保險的人嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a walk-in clinic near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有不用預約的診所嗎？

sentences.en: She works at a dental clinic downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區的牙醫診所工作。

sentences.en: The student health clinic gave me an ice pack.
sentences.zh: 學生健康中心給了我一個冰敷袋。

sentences.en: The clinic opens at eight and closes at five.
sentences.zh: 這家診所八點開門、五點關門。

gloss_note: video clip：影片片段

sentences.en: Use a clip to keep the papers together.
sentences.zh: 用個夾子把這些紙夾在一起。

sentences.en: Did you see that funny clip online?
sentences.zh: 你看過網路上那段搞笑影片嗎？

sentences.en: She clipped a badge to her jacket.
sentences.zh: 她把徽章別在外套上。

sentences.en: Could you clip this note to my report?
sentences.zh: 你能把這張便條夾在我的報告上嗎？

sentences.en: The news showed a short clip of the storm.
sentences.zh: 新聞播出了一小段暴風雨的畫面。

sentences.en: Can you send me the clip from yesterday's game?
sentences.zh: 你可以把昨天比賽的片段傳給我嗎？

gloss_note: 常見 feed and clothe；不是名詞 clothes

sentences.en: Parents must feed and clothe their children.
sentences.zh: 父母必須讓孩子吃飽穿暖。

sentences.en: The charity helps clothe homeless families in winter.
sentences.zh: 這個慈善團體在冬天幫無家可歸的家庭添衣。

sentences.en: How much does it cost to clothe three kids?
sentences.zh: 給三個孩子買衣服要花多少錢？

sentences.en: She was warmly clothed in a thick wool coat.
sentences.zh: 她穿著厚厚的羊毛外套，暖呼呼的。

sentences.en: The students were neatly clothed in their school uniforms.
sentences.zh: 學生們整齊地穿著校服。

sentences.en: Can one salary feed and clothe a family today?
sentences.zh: 現在一份薪水養得起一家人嗎？

gloss_note: clown around：胡鬧；class clown：班上的開心果

sentences.en: The clown made balloon animals for the kids.
sentences.zh: 小丑為孩子們做了氣球動物。

sentences.en: Stop clowning around and finish your homework.
sentences.zh: 別再瞎玩了，快把功課寫完。

sentences.en: Why are you dressed as a clown?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼打扮成小丑？

sentences.en: Our class clown always makes everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 我們班的搞笑王總是逗得大家哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: Quit clowning around; this is serious.
sentences.zh: 別再胡鬧了，這件事很嚴肅。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a clown at a birthday party?
sentences.zh: 你在生日派對上看過小丑嗎？

gloss_note: have no clue：完全不知道（口語）

sentences.en: The police found a clue at the scene.
sentences.zh: 警方在現場找到一條線索。

sentences.en: I have no clue what he's talking about.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道他在說什麼。

sentences.en: Can you give me a clue?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我一點提示嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have any clue where my keys are?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的鑰匙在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: The last clue in the crossword puzzle was tricky.
sentences.zh: 填字遊戲的最後一條提示很難。

sentences.en: Detectives followed every clue in the old case.
sentences.zh: 偵探追查了這樁舊案的每一條線索。

gloss_note: fruit cocktail：罐頭水果雞尾酒

sentences.en: She ordered a fruity cocktail at the beach bar.
sentences.zh: 她在海灘酒吧點了一杯水果調酒。

sentences.en: Would you like a cocktail before dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐前要來杯調酒嗎？

sentences.en: The shrimp cocktail is a popular appetizer.
sentences.zh: 鮮蝦杯是很受歡迎的開胃菜。

sentences.en: We're having a cocktail party for the new neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我們要辦個雞尾酒派對歡迎新鄰居。

sentences.en: Fruit cocktail in a can is cheap and sweet.
sentences.zh: 罐頭水果雞尾酒又便宜又甜。

sentences.en: Is this cocktail strong, or mostly juice?
sentences.zh: 這杯調酒很烈，還是大多是果汁？

gloss_note: coconut water：椰子水；coconut milk：椰奶

sentences.en: We drank fresh coconut water on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海灘上喝新鮮的椰子水。

sentences.en: Do you like coconut in your cookies?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡餅乾裡加椰子嗎？

sentences.en: The coconut fell right next to the tourist.
sentences.zh: 椰子就掉在那位遊客旁邊。

sentences.en: This shampoo smells like coconut.
sentences.zh: 這瓶洗髮精聞起來像椰子。

sentences.en: Coconut milk makes the curry creamy.
sentences.zh: 椰奶讓咖哩變得濃稠滑順。

sentences.en: Can you crack open a coconut without a tool?
sentences.zh: 你能不用工具把椰子敲開嗎？

gloss_note: white-collar：白領；blue-collar：藍領

sentences.en: His shirt collar was wrinkled.
sentences.zh: 他的襯衫領子皺皺的。

sentences.en: The dog wears a red collar with a name tag.
sentences.zh: 這隻狗戴著附名牌的紅色項圈。

sentences.en: Why do you always flip up your collar?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是把領子翻起來？

sentences.en: Mom sewed a new collar onto my jacket.
sentences.zh: 媽媽幫我的外套縫上新領子。

sentences.en: White-collar jobs usually require a college degree.
sentences.zh: 白領工作通常需要大學學歷。

sentences.en: Does your cat have a collar?
sentences.zh: 你的貓有戴項圈嗎？

gloss_note: garbage collection：垃圾收運

sentences.en: My brother has a huge baseball card collection.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥有一大批棒球卡收藏。

sentences.en: The museum has a collection of old maps.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館收藏了一批古地圖。

sentences.en: Is trash collection on Monday mornings?
sentences.zh: 垃圾收運是在週一早上嗎？

sentences.en: Do you want to see my sneaker collection?
sentences.zh: 你想看我的球鞋收藏嗎？

sentences.en: The designer showed her spring collection yesterday.
sentences.zh: 設計師昨天發表了她的春季系列。

sentences.en: Her short story collection came out last month.
sentences.zh: 她的短篇小說集上個月出版了。

gloss_note: 動物或昆蟲的群體也叫 colony

sentences.en: The thirteen colonies became the first states of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 十三個殖民地成為美國最早的州。

sentences.en: A colony of ants lives under our porch.
sentences.zh: 一群螞蟻住在我們的門廊下。

sentences.en: Which country once ruled this colony?
sentences.zh: 這個殖民地以前是哪個國家統治的？

sentences.en: Scientists dream of building a colony on Mars.
sentences.zh: 科學家夢想在火星上建立殖民地。

sentences.en: The seal colony on the rocks was very noisy.
sentences.zh: 岩石上的海豹群吵得不得了。

sentences.en: Did you learn about the colonies in history class?
sentences.zh: 你在歷史課學過殖民地的事嗎？

gloss_note: column 也指報紙的專欄

sentences.en: She writes a weekly column for the local paper.
sentences.zh: 她為地方報紙寫每週專欄。

sentences.en: Tall white columns stood in front of the old bank.
sentences.zh: 老銀行前面立著高大的白色圓柱。

sentences.en: Her column runs in the paper every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 她的專欄每週日刊登在報紙上。

sentences.en: Do you read the sports column every morning?
sentences.zh: 你每天早上都看體育專欄嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has two marble columns at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 博物館入口有兩根大理石圓柱。

sentences.en: Which column in the newspaper do you read first?
sentences.zh: 你最先看報紙的哪個專欄？

gloss_note: comfort food：療癒美食

sentences.en: This old blanket is a great comfort to me.
sentences.zh: 這條舊毯子對我來說是很大的慰藉。

sentences.en: I love the comfort of my own bed.
sentences.zh: 我愛自己床鋪的舒適。

sentences.en: How can I comfort my friend after the bad news?
sentences.zh: 聽到壞消息後，我該怎麼安慰朋友？

sentences.en: The nurse spoke softly to comfort the child.
sentences.zh: 護理師輕聲細語地安撫孩子。

sentences.en: Comfort food like mac and cheese always helps.
sentences.zh: 像起司通心粉這種療癒美食總是有用。

sentences.en: Are these shoes built for comfort or style?
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋是為了舒適還是為了造型？

gloss_note: 句中停頓用 comma，句尾用 period

sentences.en: Put a comma after the first word.
sentences.zh: 在第一個字後面加個逗號。

sentences.en: You forgot a comma in this sentence.
sentences.zh: 你這個句子漏了一個逗號。

sentences.en: Where does the comma go in this list?
sentences.zh: 這份清單裡的逗號該放在哪裡？

sentences.en: Our English teacher is picky about commas.
sentences.zh: 我們英文老師對逗號很挑剔。

sentences.en: Use a comma to separate items in a series.
sentences.zh: 用逗號來分隔並列的項目。

sentences.en: Does this sentence need a comma?
sentences.zh: 這個句子需要逗號嗎？

gloss_note: 美式動詞多用單數；英式單複數皆可

sentences.en: The school committee meets every first Monday.
sentences.zh: 學校委員會每個月第一個週一開會。

sentences.en: She was chosen to lead the planning committee.
sentences.zh: 她被選為籌備委員會的召集人。

sentences.en: Which committee are you on this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年加入哪個委員會？

sentences.en: The committee voted to approve the new rule.
sentences.zh: 委員會投票通過了新規定。

sentences.en: Which committee will decide who gets the scholarship?
sentences.zh: 哪個委員會會決定誰拿到獎學金？

sentences.en: Our class formed a committee for the dance.
sentences.zh: 我們班為舞會成立了籌備小組。

gloss_note: communicate with sb；名詞是 communication

sentences.en: Dogs communicate with body language.
sentences.zh: 狗用肢體語言溝通。

sentences.en: We communicate mostly by text these days.
sentences.zh: 這些日子我們大多用簡訊聯絡。

sentences.en: It's hard to communicate when the Wi-Fi is down.
sentences.zh: 網路斷線時很難聯絡。

sentences.en: How do you communicate with your team?
sentences.zh: 你都怎麼跟團隊溝通？

sentences.en: Good doctors communicate clearly with their patients.
sentences.zh: 好醫生會跟病人清楚溝通。

sentences.en: Did you communicate the new schedule to everyone?
sentences.zh: 你有把新時間表通知大家嗎？

gloss_note: in comparison with/to：與…相比

sentences.en: Is there any comparison between these two phones?
sentences.zh: 這兩支手機有得比嗎？

sentences.en: Make a price comparison before you buy.
sentences.zh: 買之前先比價。

sentences.en: In comparison, the new model is much lighter.
sentences.zh: 相較之下，新款輕多了。

sentences.en: This chart shows a comparison of last year's sales.
sentences.zh: 這張圖表比較了去年的銷售狀況。

sentences.en: Is it fair to make a comparison with her sister?
sentences.zh: 拿她跟她姊姊比，公平嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher asked for a comparison of the two stories.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們寫這兩篇故事的比較。

gloss_note: compete with/against sb；compete in 比賽

sentences.en: Our school will compete in the state finals.
sentences.zh: 我們學校將參加全州決賽。

sentences.en: Small shops can't compete with big chains on price.
sentences.zh: 小店在價格上拼不過大型連鎖店。

sentences.en: How many teams are competing this year?
sentences.zh: 今年有多少隊參賽？

sentences.en: She loves to compete, even in board games.
sentences.zh: 她愛競爭，連玩桌遊也一樣。

sentences.en: Do you want to compete in the talent show?
sentences.zh: 你想參加才藝表演比賽嗎？

sentences.en: Two companies compete for the same customers.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司在爭取同一批客人。

gloss_note: file a complaint：提出投訴

sentences.en: I'd like to file a complaint about the noise.
sentences.zh: 我想就噪音問題提出投訴。

sentences.en: Customers have made several complaints this week.
sentences.zh: 這星期有好幾位顧客投訴。

sentences.en: What's your biggest complaint about the food?
sentences.zh: 你對這裡的食物最大的不滿是什麼？

sentences.en: Her only complaint was the long wait.
sentences.zh: 她唯一的抱怨就是等太久。

sentences.en: The store replied to my complaint within a day.
sentences.zh: 商店一天之內就回覆了我的投訴。

sentences.en: Did anyone make a complaint about the heat?
sentences.zh: 有人抱怨過天氣太熱嗎？

gloss_note: in concert：合作、一起

sentences.en: Did you get tickets to the concert on Friday?
sentences.zh: 你拿到週五演唱會的票了嗎？

sentences.en: The school band is giving a concert tonight.
sentences.zh: 學校樂隊今晚有場音樂會。

sentences.en: Have you ever been to an outdoor concert?
sentences.zh: 你去過戶外演唱會嗎？

sentences.en: The concert starts at eight, so don't be late.
sentences.zh: 音樂會八點開始，別遲到。

sentences.en: Her first concert was a rock show at age ten.
sentences.zh: 她十歲時看的第一場演唱會是搖滾秀。

sentences.en: We watched the concert live online.
sentences.zh: 我們在網路上看了演唱會直播。

gloss_note: jump to conclusions：妄下定論

sentences.en: In conclusion, exercise is good for your health.
sentences.zh: 總之，運動有益健康。

sentences.en: What conclusion did you draw from the data?
sentences.zh: 你從這些資料得出了什麼結論？

sentences.en: Don't jump to conclusions before you hear the whole story.
sentences.zh: 聽完整件事之前，別急著下結論。

sentences.en: Did the movie have a surprising conclusion?
sentences.zh: 這部電影有出人意料的結局嗎？

sentences.en: The long speech finally came to its conclusion.
sentences.zh: 冗長的演講終於結束了。

sentences.en: I came to the conclusion that he was right.
sentences.zh: 我得到的結論是他是對的。

gloss_note: traffic cone：交通錐；pine cone：松果

sentences.en: Can I have a vanilla ice cream cone, please?
sentences.zh: 我可以來一個香草冰淇淋甜筒嗎？

sentences.en: Workers put orange cones around the hole.
sentences.zh: 工人在坑洞四周擺上橘色三角錐。

sentences.en: Who dropped their ice cream cone on the sidewalk?
sentences.zh: 誰把冰淇淋甜筒掉在人行道上了？

sentences.en: A cone has one flat circle and a point on top.
sentences.zh: 圓錐有一個平面的圓形底和一個頂點。

sentences.en: Drivers must go around the traffic cone.
sentences.zh: 駕駛必須繞過交通錐。

sentences.en: The pine cone fell from the tree.
sentences.zh: 松果從樹上掉了下來。

gloss_note: connect to：連上；connect with sb：與人投緣

sentences.en: How do I connect my phone to the Wi-Fi?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼把手機連上 Wi-Fi？

sentences.en: This bridge connects the island to the mainland.
sentences.zh: 這座橋把小島和本土連了起來。

sentences.en: We connected right away at the party.
sentences.zh: 我們在派對上一見如故。

sentences.en: Can you connect the printer to my laptop?
sentences.zh: 你可以把印表機接到我的筆電上嗎？

sentences.en: The two roads connect near the school.
sentences.zh: 這兩條路在學校附近交會。

sentences.en: I couldn't connect to the Internet all day.
sentences.zh: 我一整天都連不上網路。

gloss_note: conscious of：意識到；health-conscious：注重健康

sentences.en: She is very conscious of her health.
sentences.zh: 她非常注意自己的健康。

sentences.en: The patient was conscious after the surgery.
sentences.zh: 病人手術後恢復了意識。

sentences.en: Are you conscious of how loud you are?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到自己有多大聲嗎？

sentences.en: Are you conscious of the time?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到時間嗎？

sentences.en: I was barely conscious when the alarm rang.
sentences.zh: 鬧鐘響的時候我幾乎還沒清醒。

sentences.en: Many teens are conscious of their image online.
sentences.zh: 許多青少年很在意自己的網路形象。

gloss_note: 常修飾 amount、time、effort

sentences.en: The project took a considerable amount of time.
sentences.zh: 這個專案花了相當多的時間。

sentences.en: She earns a considerable income from her blog.
sentences.zh: 她靠部落格賺了不少收入。

sentences.en: Is there considerable interest in the new game?
sentences.zh: 大家對這款新遊戲很有興趣嗎？

sentences.en: Is the damage from the storm considerable?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成的損失嚴重嗎？

sentences.en: The company spent a considerable sum on ads.
sentences.zh: 公司花了一大筆錢打廣告。

sentences.en: The price dropped by a considerable amount.
sentences.zh: 價格大幅下降。

gloss_note: constant 不是「體貼」，是「一直不變」

sentences.en: Is the baby's constant crying keeping you awake?
sentences.zh: 寶寶一直哭，你睡不著嗎？

sentences.en: He drives at a constant speed on the highway.
sentences.zh: 他在高速公路上以固定的速度行駛。

sentences.en: Why is the noise so constant today?
sentences.zh: 今天的噪音怎麼一直不停？

sentences.en: A constant stream of customers came in at noon.
sentences.zh: 中午客人源源不絕地湧進來。

sentences.en: In this equation, the number 5 is a constant.
sentences.zh: 在這個方程式裡，5 是一個常數。

sentences.en: Her constant support helped me through college.
sentences.zh: 她一路上不間斷的支持，幫我撐過了大學。

gloss_note: seven continents：七大洲

sentences.en: Africa is the second largest continent.
sentences.zh: 非洲是第二大洲。

sentences.en: Which continent has the most people?
sentences.zh: 哪一個洲的人口最多？

sentences.en: Antarctica is the coldest continent on Earth.
sentences.zh: 南極洲是地球上最冷的大陸。

sentences.en: We hope to visit every continent someday.
sentences.zh: 我們希望有一天能走遍每個大洲。

sentences.en: The two continents were once joined together.
sentences.zh: 這兩塊大陸以前是連在一起的。

sentences.en: How many continents have you traveled to?
sentences.zh: 你去過幾個大洲？

gloss_zh: 遊戲手把；控制器；管制員
gloss_note: air traffic controller：空中交通管制員

sentences.en: Can I borrow your controller for the game?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的手把來玩遊戲嗎？

sentences.en: My controller ran out of battery.
sentences.zh: 我的手把沒電了。

sentences.en: The air traffic controller guided the plane in.
sentences.zh: 空中交通管制員引導飛機降落。

sentences.en: Press the red button on the controller.
sentences.zh: 按手把上的紅色按鈕。

sentences.en: Hold the controller with both hands.
sentences.zh: 用雙手握住遊戲手把。

sentences.en: Which controller do you prefer for racing games?
sentences.zh: 玩賽車遊戲你比較喜歡哪種手把？

gloss_note: 常見 rice cooker、slow cooker、pressure cooker

sentences.en: Put the rice in the rice cooker.
sentences.zh: 把米放進電鍋裡。

sentences.en: Dad uses a pressure cooker for stew.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用壓力鍋燉東西。

sentences.en: Do you have a slow cooker I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有慢燉鍋可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: The rice cooker clicked off after twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 電鍋煮了二十分鐘就跳起來了。

sentences.en: A slow cooker is perfect for busy weeknights.
sentences.zh: 慢燉鍋很適合忙碌的平日晚上。

sentences.en: Is this rice cooker big enough for six people?
sentences.zh: 這個電鍋夠六個人吃嗎？

gloss_note: 比 expensive 書面，也指代價慘重

sentences.en: Fixing the old car would be too costly.
sentences.zh: 修那台舊車太花錢了。

sentences.en: That was a costly mistake for the company.
sentences.zh: 那對公司來說是個代價高昂的錯誤。

sentences.en: Is a hospital visit costly without insurance?
sentences.zh: 沒有保險的話，看病很貴嗎？

sentences.en: Would a trip to Europe be too costly for us?
sentences.zh: 去歐洲旅行對我們來說會不會太貴？

sentences.en: He made a costly error in the final minutes.
sentences.zh: 他在最後幾分鐘犯了一個代價慘重的失誤。

sentences.en: Repairs on old houses can be very costly.
sentences.zh: 老房子的維修可能很花錢。

gloss_note: 反義 uncountable：不可數的

sentences.en: Water is not a countable noun.
sentences.zh: 水不是可數名詞。

sentences.en: Is this word countable or uncountable?
sentences.zh: 這個字是可數還是不可數的？

sentences.en: Chairs are countable, but furniture is not.
sentences.zh: 椅子是可數的，但家具不可數。

sentences.en: A countable noun can have a plural form.
sentences.zh: 可數名詞可以有複數形。

sentences.en: Which of these nouns are countable?
sentences.zh: 這些名詞裡哪些是可數的？

sentences.en: Learners often mix up countable and uncountable nouns.
sentences.zh: 學習者常搞混可數與不可數名詞。

gloss_note: 美國州下面的行政區，類似台灣的縣

sentences.en: I live in Orange County, California.
sentences.zh: 我住在加州的橘郡。

sentences.en: Does the county fair have rides and fried food?
sentences.zh: 郡的園遊會有遊樂設施和炸物嗎？

sentences.en: Which county are you from?
sentences.zh: 你是哪個郡的人？

sentences.en: The county built a new library last year.
sentences.zh: 郡政府去年蓋了一間新圖書館。

sentences.en: Our county has the lowest crime rate in the state.
sentences.zh: 我們郡的犯罪率是全州最低的。

sentences.en: The county sheriff spoke at the town meeting.
sentences.zh: 郡警長在鎮民大會上發言。

gloss_note: the cradle of…：…的發源地

sentences.en: The baby slept quietly in the cradle.
sentences.zh: 寶寶安靜地睡在搖籃裡。

sentences.en: The baby's cradle is next to our bed.
sentences.zh: 寶寶的搖籃就放在我們床邊。

sentences.en: Greece is called the cradle of democracy.
sentences.zh: 希臘被稱為民主的發源地。

sentences.en: Did your parents rock you in a cradle?
sentences.zh: 你爸媽以前有用搖籃哄你睡嗎？

sentences.en: Is this old cradle still safe for a newborn?
sentences.zh: 這個舊搖籃對新生兒還安全嗎？

sentences.en: The valley is the cradle of the wine industry.
sentences.zh: 這個山谷是葡萄酒產業的發源地。

gloss_note: crane 也當動詞：伸長脖子看

sentences.en: A tall crane is building the new tower.
sentences.zh: 一台高大的起重機正在蓋新大樓。

sentences.en: The red-crowned crane is a symbol of long life.
sentences.zh: 丹頂鶴象徵長壽。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a crane standing in shallow water?
sentences.zh: 你有看過鶴站在淺水裡嗎？

sentences.en: Did you see the crane lifting that huge box?
sentences.zh: 你有看到起重機吊起那個大箱子嗎？

sentences.en: A white crane flew over the rice field.
sentences.zh: 一隻白鶴飛越稻田。

sentences.en: Origami cranes are a sign of good luck.
sentences.zh: 摺紙鶴代表好運。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: crash into：撞上；電腦當機也用 crash

sentences.en: I heard a loud crash in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我聽到廚房傳來一聲巨響。

sentences.en: My computer crashed right before I saved.
sentences.zh: 我的電腦剛好在我存檔前當機了。

sentences.en: Was anyone hurt in the car crash?
sentences.zh: 那場車禍有人受傷嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, or you'll crash into that wall!
sentences.zh: 小心，不然你會撞上那面牆！

sentences.en: Why does this app keep crashing on my phone?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這個應用程式在我的手機上一直當機？

sentences.en: The waves crash against the rocks every night.
sentences.zh: 海浪每天晚上都拍打著岩石。

gloss_note: at a crawl：極慢地

sentences.en: Did the baby start to crawl last week?
sentences.zh: 寶寶上星期開始會爬了嗎？

sentences.en: Traffic crawled along the bridge this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上橋上的車流龜速前進。

sentences.en: A spider crawled up the wall.
sentences.zh: 一隻蜘蛛爬上了牆。

sentences.en: Why is the line moving at a crawl?
sentences.zh: 隊伍怎麼動得像蝸牛爬一樣慢？

sentences.en: We had to crawl under the fence.
sentences.zh: 我們得從圍籬下面爬過去。

sentences.en: Ants crawl all over the picnic table.
sentences.zh: 螞蟻爬滿了整張野餐桌。

gloss_note: creative writing：創意寫作

sentences.en: Is she a creative kid who loves to draw?
sentences.zh: 她是個愛畫畫的創意小孩嗎？

sentences.en: We need a creative solution to this problem.
sentences.zh: 我們需要有創意的辦法來解決這個問題。

sentences.en: Are you creative with cooking?
sentences.zh: 你做菜有創意嗎？

sentences.en: He works in a creative job at an ad agency.
sentences.zh: 他在廣告公司做創意工作。

sentences.en: Wow, what a creative costume you made!
sentences.zh: 哇，你做的服裝好有創意！

sentences.en: Writing helps me stay creative.
sentences.zh: 寫作幫我保持創造力。

gloss_note: content creator：內容創作者

sentences.en: The creator of this game is only nineteen.
sentences.zh: 這款遊戲的作者才十九歲。

sentences.en: Many content creators post videos every day.
sentences.zh: 很多內容創作者每天都發影片。

sentences.en: Who is the creator of this cartoon?
sentences.zh: 這部卡通是誰創作的？

sentences.en: She is a creator who shares recipes online.
sentences.zh: 她是在網路上分享食譜的創作者。

sentences.en: The creator answered questions in the comments.
sentences.zh: 創作者在留言區回答了問題。

sentences.en: Do you know the creator of that song?
sentences.zh: 你知道那首歌的創作者是誰嗎？

gloss_note: a creature of habit：習慣固定的人

sentences.en: What kind of creature makes that sound at night?
sentences.zh: 夜裡發出那種聲音的是什麼生物？

sentences.en: Whales are the largest creatures in the sea.
sentences.zh: 鯨魚是海裡最大的生物。

sentences.en: The movie is about a strange creature from space.
sentences.zh: 這部電影在講一種來自太空的奇怪生物。

sentences.en: Every living creature needs water.
sentences.zh: 所有生物都需要水。

sentences.en: He's a creature of habit and eats the same lunch.
sentences.zh: 他是個習慣固定的人，天天吃一樣的午餐。

sentences.en: Did you see that tiny creature on the leaf?
sentences.zh: 你有看到葉子上那隻小生物嗎？

gloss_note: 整組人員用 crew，如 flight crew

sentences.en: Did the flight crew say when we'll land?
sentences.zh: 機組人員有說我們幾點降落嗎？

sentences.en: A film crew was shooting on our street.
sentences.zh: 一組拍片人員正在我們街上拍攝。

sentences.en: The rowing crew trains before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 划船隊在日出前訓練。

sentences.en: How many crew members work on the ship?
sentences.zh: 這艘船上有多少船員？

sentences.en: The road crew worked all night to fix the street.
sentences.zh: 道路維修人員整晚都在修馬路。

sentences.en: The camp crew set up all the tents before dark.
sentences.zh: 營地工作人員在天黑前搭好了所有帳篷。

gloss_note: cricket 也是英式板球，美國較少人玩

sentences.en: A cricket was chirping outside my window.
sentences.zh: 一隻蟋蟀在我的窗外鳴叫。

sentences.en: Do you hear the crickets at night?
sentences.zh: 你晚上聽得到蟋蟀叫嗎？

sentences.en: The cricket jumped onto my shoe.
sentences.zh: 蟋蟀跳到了我的鞋子上。

sentences.en: Crickets chirp faster when it's warm.
sentences.zh: 天氣暖和時，蟋蟀叫得比較快。

sentences.en: In the story, a cricket gives advice to a puppet.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一隻蟋蟀給木偶出主意。

sentences.en: Why are there so many crickets in the garage?
sentences.zh: 車庫裡怎麼有這麼多蟋蟀？

gloss_note: criminal record：前科；civil 則是民事

sentences.en: The detective in the movie chased a clever criminal.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的偵探追捕一名狡猾的罪犯。

sentences.en: The news said the criminal was arrested yesterday.
sentences.zh: 新聞說那名罪犯昨天被逮捕了。

sentences.en: Who plays the criminal in that crime movie?
sentences.zh: 那部犯罪片裡是誰演罪犯？

sentences.en: Is this a criminal case or a civil one?
sentences.zh: 這是刑事案件還是民事案件？

sentences.en: The criminal record check takes about a week.
sentences.zh: 查前科紀錄大約要一個星期。

sentences.en: Wasting that much food is almost criminal.
sentences.zh: 浪費那麼多食物簡直不可原諒。

gloss_note: 比 crunchy 偏薄、乾、酥

sentences.en: I like my fries extra crispy.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡薯條炸得特別酥脆。

sentences.en: The fried chicken was golden and crispy.
sentences.zh: 炸雞金黃又酥脆。

sentences.en: Is the bacon crispy enough for you?
sentences.zh: 培根夠脆了嗎？

sentences.en: Nothing beats a crispy taco shell.
sentences.zh: 沒有什麼比酥脆的塔可餅殼更棒了。

sentences.en: The crispy skin on the roast chicken was perfect.
sentences.zh: 烤雞的脆皮好完美。

sentences.en: How do you keep leftover pizza crust crispy?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼讓剩的披薩餅皮保持酥脆？

gloss_note: cash crop：經濟作物

sentences.en: Corn is the main crop in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 玉米是愛荷華州的主要農作物。

sentences.en: A late frost destroyed half of the crop.
sentences.zh: 一場晚霜毀了一半的收成。

sentences.en: What crops do farmers grow around here?
sentences.zh: 這附近的農民都種些什麼作物？

sentences.en: The farmers harvest their crops in October.
sentences.zh: 農民在十月收割他們的作物。

sentences.en: Heavy rain can ruin a whole season's crop.
sentences.zh: 大雨可能毀掉整季的收成。

sentences.en: Why did the farmers rotate their crops?
sentences.zh: 農民為什麼要輪作？

gloss_note: dental crown 是牙冠

sentences.en: The queen wore a golden crown.
sentences.zh: 女王戴著一頂金色王冠。

sentences.en: The kids made paper crowns for the party.
sentences.zh: 孩子們為派對做了紙王冠。

sentences.en: Which team won the crown last year?
sentences.zh: 去年是哪一隊拿到冠軍頭銜？

sentences.en: He was crowned champion at the end of the match.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束時，他被加冕為冠軍。

sentences.en: The dentist put a crown on my tooth.
sentences.zh: 牙醫幫我的牙齒裝了牙冠。

sentences.en: Is that a real crown in the museum?
sentences.zh: 博物館裡那頂是真的王冠嗎？

gloss_note: 美式廚房多說 cabinet

sentences.en: The plates are in the cupboard above the sink.
sentences.zh: 盤子在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

sentences.en: Our cupboard is empty; let's go shopping.
sentences.zh: 我們的櫥櫃空了，去買東西吧。

sentences.en: Where do you keep your cereal, in the cupboard?
sentences.zh: 你的麥片放哪裡，放櫥櫃嗎？

sentences.en: She hid the cookies in the top cupboard.
sentences.zh: 她把餅乾藏在最上層的櫥櫃裡。

sentences.en: Can you reach the cups in the cupboard?
sentences.zh: 你搆得到櫥櫃裡的杯子嗎？

sentences.en: We put a small cupboard in the garage for tools.
sentences.zh: 我們在車庫放了一個小櫥櫃收工具。

gloss_note: dairy-free：不含乳製品

sentences.en: I can't eat dairy because of my allergy.
sentences.zh: 我對乳製品過敏，不能吃。

sentences.en: Milk, cheese, and yogurt are dairy products.
sentences.zh: 牛奶、起司和優格都是乳製品。

sentences.en: Is this ice cream dairy-free?
sentences.zh: 這個冰淇淋不含乳製品嗎？

sentences.en: My uncle runs a dairy farm in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在威斯康辛州經營乳牛場。

sentences.en: The dairy aisle is next to the eggs.
sentences.zh: 乳製品區就在雞蛋旁邊。

sentences.en: Do you drink dairy milk or plant milk?
sentences.zh: 你喝牛奶還是植物奶？

gloss_note: 名詞為主；動詞指築壩攔住

sentences.en: The dam provides water for the whole city.
sentences.zh: 這座水壩為整座城市供水。
