sentences.en: Workers built a dam across the river.
sentences.zh: 工人在河上蓋了一座水壩。

sentences.en: Is the dam safe after all this rain?
sentences.zh: 下了這麼多雨，水壩安全嗎？

sentences.en: Beavers dam the stream with sticks and mud.
sentences.zh: 河狸用樹枝和泥巴把小溪堵住。

sentences.en: We hiked up to see the big dam.
sentences.zh: 我們健行上去看那座大水壩。

sentences.en: Have you ever visited a dam?
sentences.zh: 你參觀過水壩嗎？

gloss_note: dare to do；truth or dare：真心話大冒險

sentences.en: I dare you to jump into the lake!
sentences.zh: 我賭你不敢跳進湖裡！

sentences.en: How dare you read my diary?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼敢偷看我的日記？

sentences.en: She didn't dare to tell her mom the truth.
sentences.zh: 她不敢告訴媽媽實話。

sentences.en: Nobody dared to ask the teacher.
sentences.zh: 沒有人敢去問老師。

sentences.en: Do you dare to try the spicy noodles?
sentences.zh: 你敢吃這碗辣麵嗎？

sentences.en: Don't you dare touch my game!
sentences.zh: 你敢碰我的遊戲試試看！

gloss_note: 稱呼用語，對陌生人較少用

sentences.en: Thanks for the help, darling.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙，親愛的。

sentences.en: Their darling baby girl smiled at everyone.
sentences.zh: 他們可愛的寶貝女兒對每個人微笑。

sentences.en: Are you coming to dinner, darling?
sentences.zh: 你要來吃晚餐了嗎，親愛的？

sentences.en: What a darling little puppy!
sentences.zh: 好可愛的小狗！

sentences.en: She's the darling of the fashion world.
sentences.zh: 她是時尚圈的寵兒。

sentences.en: Are you feeling okay, darling?
sentences.zh: 你還好嗎，親愛的？

gloss_note: the 100-meter dash：百米短跑

sentences.en: She made a dash for the bus.
sentences.zh: 她衝去追公車。

sentences.en: Sorry, I have to dash to class. I'm running late.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我得趕快衝去上課，我快遲到了。

sentences.en: Who won the 100-meter dash at the meet?
sentences.zh: 誰贏得了運動會的一百公尺短跑？

sentences.en: We dashed through the rain to the car.
sentences.zh: 我們冒著雨衝向車子。

sentences.en: Why did you dash out of the room?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼衝出房間？

sentences.en: A dog dashed past us down the street.
sentences.zh: 一隻狗從我們身旁衝過街道。

gloss_note: 常見 search a database、customer database

sentences.en: The school keeps student records in a database.
sentences.zh: 學校把學生紀錄存在資料庫裡。

sentences.en: Can you search the database for that name?
sentences.zh: 你能在資料庫裡查那個名字嗎？

sentences.en: Our database went down last night.
sentences.zh: 我們的資料庫昨晚掛掉了。

sentences.en: She is learning how to build a database.
sentences.zh: 她正在學怎麼建立資料庫。

sentences.en: The library has an online database of old photos.
sentences.zh: 圖書館有個老照片的線上資料庫。

sentences.en: Is the customer database up to date?
sentences.zh: 客戶資料庫是最新的嗎？

gloss_note: car dealer：汽車經銷商

sentences.en: My uncle is a car dealer in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在俄亥俄州當汽車經銷商。

sentences.en: The dealer offered us a good price on the truck.
sentences.zh: 經銷商給了我們卡車一個好價錢。

sentences.en: Which dealer did you buy your bike from?
sentences.zh: 你的腳踏車是跟哪家經銷商買的？

sentences.en: Does she work as an art dealer downtown?
sentences.zh: 她在市區當藝術品商人嗎？

sentences.en: The card dealer shuffled the deck quickly.
sentences.zh: 發牌員很快地洗了牌。

sentences.en: The dealer called to say the car is ready.
sentences.zh: 經銷商打電話來說車子好了。

gloss_note: for a decade；in the past decade

sentences.en: The town has changed a lot in the past decade.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮在過去十年變了很多。

sentences.en: Which decade do you think had the best music?
sentences.zh: 你覺得哪個年代的音樂最棒？

sentences.en: Has she lived here for almost a decade?
sentences.zh: 她住在這裡快十年了嗎？

sentences.en: Two decades ago, there were no smartphones.
sentences.zh: 二十年前還沒有智慧型手機。

sentences.en: It took a decade to finish the bridge.
sentences.zh: 這座橋花了十年才完工。

sentences.en: Prices have doubled in just one decade.
sentences.zh: 物價在短短十年內漲了一倍。

gloss_note: 美式 deck 常指後院木造露台

sentences.en: We had dinner on the deck last night.
sentences.zh: 我們昨晚在露台上吃晚餐。

sentences.en: The passengers walked along the ship's deck.
sentences.zh: 乘客沿著船的甲板散步。

sentences.en: Is Dad building a new wooden deck?
sentences.zh: 爸爸是不是在蓋新的木頭露台？

sentences.en: Do you want to sit out on the deck?
sentences.zh: 你想到外面露台坐坐嗎？

sentences.en: The captain called everyone to the deck.
sentences.zh: 船長叫大家都到甲板上來。

sentences.en: Our deck has a great view of the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們的露台可以看到很棒的湖景。

gloss_note: good deed：善行

sentences.en: The firefighter was praised for his brave deed.
sentences.zh: 消防員因為勇敢的行為受到表揚。

sentences.en: Why not do a good deed every day?
sentences.zh: 何不每天做一件好事？

sentences.en: Her kind deeds touched the whole town.
sentences.zh: 她的善行感動了整個小鎮。

sentences.en: Deeds speak louder than words.
sentences.zh: 行動勝於言語。

sentences.en: Have you done a good deed today?
sentences.zh: 你今天做好事了嗎？

sentences.en: The old stories tell of heroic deeds.
sentences.zh: 那些古老的故事講述著英勇的事蹟。

gloss_note: deepen your understanding：加深理解

sentences.en: The lake deepens quickly after the first few steps.
sentences.zh: 走了幾步之後，湖水很快就變深了。

sentences.en: The mystery deepened when another clue appeared.
sentences.zh: 又出現一條線索後，謎團變得更深了。

sentences.en: Did their friendship deepen over the years?
sentences.zh: 他們的友誼這些年有變深嗎？

sentences.en: Will the crisis deepen next year?
sentences.zh: 這場危機明年會惡化嗎？

sentences.en: Reading helps deepen your understanding of the world.
sentences.zh: 閱讀能加深你對世界的了解。

sentences.en: The sky deepened to purple as the sun set.
sentences.zh: 日落時，天空轉成深紫色。

gloss_note: by definition：依定義；high definition：高畫質

sentences.en: Look up the definition of this word.
sentences.zh: 查一下這個字的定義。

sentences.en: What's your definition of a good friend?
sentences.zh: 你對好朋友的定義是什麼？

sentences.en: The dictionary gives two definitions for this verb.
sentences.zh: 字典給了這個動詞兩種定義。

sentences.en: By definition, a triangle has three sides.
sentences.zh: 依定義，三角形有三條邊。

sentences.en: This TV has high definition and looks amazing.
sentences.zh: 這台電視是高畫質，看起來好棒。

sentences.en: Can you explain the definition in simpler words?
sentences.zh: 你可以用更簡單的話解釋這個定義嗎？

gloss_note: 名詞 democracy，形容詞 democratic

sentences.en: The United States is a democracy.
sentences.zh: 美國是個民主國家。

sentences.en: Democracy means people choose their leaders.
sentences.zh: 民主代表人民選出自己的領導者。

sentences.en: Students learn about democracy in civics class.
sentences.zh: 學生在公民課學習民主制度。

sentences.en: Is our class run like a democracy?
sentences.zh: 我們班是用民主方式運作的嗎？

sentences.en: Ancient Athens is famous for its early democracy.
sentences.zh: 古雅典以早期的民主制度聞名。

sentences.en: How does democracy work in a small town?
sentences.zh: 民主制度在小鎮裡是怎麼運作的？

gloss_note: 名詞 democracy；副詞 democratically

sentences.en: Our school council makes democratic decisions.
sentences.zh: 學校學生會用民主的方式做決定。

sentences.en: Is the process democratic and fair?
sentences.zh: 這個過程民主又公平嗎？

sentences.en: The club held a democratic vote on the new name.
sentences.zh: 社團針對新名稱舉行了民主投票。

sentences.en: Many democratic countries hold elections every few years.
sentences.zh: 許多民主國家每隔幾年舉行選舉。

sentences.en: She prefers a democratic style of leading the team.
sentences.zh: 她偏好用民主的風格帶領團隊。

sentences.en: How democratic is your family when picking dinner?
sentences.zh: 你們家挑晚餐時有多民主？

gloss_note: security deposit：房屋押金

sentences.en: We paid a deposit to reserve the room.
sentences.zh: 我們付了訂金來預訂房間。

sentences.en: I need to deposit this check at the bank.
sentences.zh: 我得去銀行存這張支票。

sentences.en: How much is the security deposit for the apartment?
sentences.zh: 這間公寓的押金是多少？

sentences.en: Do you get your deposit back when you move out?
sentences.zh: 搬走的時候押金會退還嗎？

sentences.en: She made a deposit of two hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 她存了兩百美元進去。

sentences.en: Please deposit the money into my savings account.
sentences.zh: 請把錢存進我的儲蓄帳戶。

gloss_note: 也可當形容詞，指名牌的 designer bag

sentences.en: My sister wants to be a fashion designer.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹想當服裝設計師。

sentences.en: The designer of this app is very talented.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式的設計師很有才華。

sentences.en: Who is the designer of that jacket?
sentences.zh: 那件外套是誰設計的？

sentences.en: A web designer is building our new site.
sentences.zh: 一位網頁設計師正在做我們的新網站。

sentences.en: She wore a designer bag to the party.
sentences.zh: 她揹著名牌包去派對。

sentences.en: Did the designer choose these colors?
sentences.zh: 這些顏色是設計師選的嗎？

gloss_note: 常見 highly desirable、desirable location

sentences.en: A quiet neighborhood is a desirable place to live.
sentences.zh: 安靜的社區是理想的居住地。

sentences.en: This job has many desirable benefits.
sentences.zh: 這份工作有很多吸引人的福利。

sentences.en: Is it desirable to work from home?
sentences.zh: 在家工作值得嚮往嗎？

sentences.en: A college degree is desirable for this position.
sentences.zh: 這個職位最好有大學學歷。

sentences.en: Houses near the beach are highly desirable.
sentences.zh: 海邊的房子非常搶手。

sentences.en: What makes a city desirable to young families?
sentences.zh: 什麼讓一座城市對年輕家庭有吸引力？

gloss_note: 名詞 destruction；被毀用 be destroyed

sentences.en: Did the storm destroy the old barn?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨有摧毀那座舊穀倉嗎？

sentences.en: Don't destroy the sandcastle yet!
sentences.zh: 先別弄壞沙堡！

sentences.en: Fires can destroy thousands of acres of forest.
sentences.zh: 大火可能燒毀數千英畝的森林。

sentences.en: Why would anyone destroy such a beautiful painting?
sentences.zh: 怎麼會有人想毀掉這麼美的畫？

sentences.en: The company shredded documents to destroy the data.
sentences.zh: 公司把文件絞碎來銷毀資料。

sentences.en: Too much sugar can destroy your teeth.
sentences.zh: 吃太多糖會毀掉你的牙齒。

gloss_note: determine + 疑問詞子句；形容詞 determined：堅決的

sentences.en: The test will determine your final grade.
sentences.zh: 這次考試將決定你的期末成績。

sentences.en: Scientists are trying to determine the cause.
sentences.zh: 科學家正努力查明原因。

sentences.en: How do you determine the right price?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼決定合適的價格？

sentences.en: We need to determine who will go first.
sentences.zh: 我們得決定誰先上場。

sentences.en: Experts determined that the bridge was safe.
sentences.zh: 專家判定這座橋是安全的。

sentences.en: Can you determine the age of this old tree?
sentences.zh: 你能判斷出這棵老樹的年齡嗎？

gloss_note: 口語 little devil：小搗蛋

sentences.en: He dressed as a devil for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 他萬聖節扮成了小惡魔。

sentences.en: You little devil, you ate all the cookies!
sentences.zh: 你這個小搗蛋，把餅乾全吃光了！

sentences.en: My little brother is a real devil at bedtime.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟一到睡覺時間就變成小搗蛋。

sentences.en: Why do people say the devil is in the details?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家說魔鬼藏在細節裡？

sentences.en: The story is about a devil who makes a deal.
sentences.zh: 這個故事講的是一個跟人做交易的魔鬼。

sentences.en: Who's the little devil that drew on the wall?
sentences.zh: 是哪個小搗蛋在牆上亂畫？

gloss_note: dim the lights：把燈調暗

sentences.en: The room was dim, with just one candle.
sentences.zh: 房間很昏暗，只有一根蠟燭。

sentences.en: Can you dim the lights a little?
sentences.zh: 你可以把燈調暗一點嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant has dim lighting.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的燈光很昏暗。

sentences.en: I have a dim memory of that trip.
sentences.zh: 我對那趟旅行只有模糊的記憶。

sentences.en: The stars dimmed as the sun came up.
sentences.zh: 太陽升起時，星星漸漸暗了下去。

sentences.en: Why is the screen so dim today?
sentences.zh: 今天螢幕怎麼這麼暗？

gloss_note: a dime a dozen：多得不稀奇

sentences.en: How many cents is a dime worth?
sentences.zh: 一角硬幣值幾美分？

sentences.en: Do you have a dime for the machine?
sentences.zh: 你有一角硬幣可以投販賣機嗎？

sentences.en: I found a dime under the couch.
sentences.zh: 我在沙發底下找到一枚十美分硬幣。

sentences.en: A dime is smaller than a penny.
sentences.zh: 一角硬幣比一分錢硬幣還小。

sentences.en: Gum used to cost a dime a piece.
sentences.zh: 口香糖以前一片只要一角。

sentences.en: Good singers are a dime a dozen here.
sentences.zh: 這裡好歌手多得是，不稀奇。

gloss_note: 較正式；dine out：外出用餐

sentences.en: We dined at a nice Italian restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我們在一家不錯的義式餐廳用餐。

sentences.en: Would you like to dine with us tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想跟我們一起用餐嗎？

sentences.en: They dine out every Friday.
sentences.zh: 他們每個星期五都外出用餐。

sentences.en: Guests will dine in the garden.
sentences.zh: 賓客將在花園裡用餐。

sentences.en: Where do you usually dine on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末通常在哪裡用餐？

sentences.en: The hotel lets you dine by the pool.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店讓你能在泳池邊用餐。

gloss_note: dip in：沾；dip 也指小幅下降

sentences.en: Dip the chip in the salsa.
sentences.zh: 把洋芋片沾一點莎莎醬。

sentences.en: Do you want some dip with your veggies?
sentences.zh: 你的蔬菜要配點沾醬嗎？

sentences.en: She dipped her toes in the cold water.
sentences.zh: 她把腳趾浸進冰涼的水裡。

sentences.en: I love to dip fries in ketchup.
sentences.zh: 我愛拿薯條沾番茄醬。

sentences.en: Spinach dip is a party favorite.
sentences.zh: 菠菜沾醬是派對上的熱門選擇。

sentences.en: Would you dip the brush in the paint?
sentences.zh: 你可以把刷子沾一下顏料嗎？

gloss_note: dirt road：泥土路

sentences.en: The kids were covered in dirt after playing.
sentences.zh: 孩子們玩完後全身都是泥土。

sentences.en: Wipe the dirt off your shoes before coming in.
sentences.zh: 進來之前先把鞋上的泥擦掉。

sentences.en: Is there dirt on my face?
sentences.zh: 我臉上有髒東西嗎？

sentences.en: We drove on a dirt road to the farm.
sentences.zh: 我們開在泥土路上前往農場。

sentences.en: He planted the seeds in rich, dark dirt.
sentences.zh: 他把種子種在肥沃的黑土裡。

sentences.en: Where did all this dirt come from?
sentences.zh: 這些髒東西是哪裡來的？

gloss_note: at a discount：打折賣

sentences.en: Students get a ten percent discount here.
sentences.zh: 學生在這裡可享九折優惠。

sentences.en: Can you give me a discount on this jacket?
sentences.zh: 這件外套可以算我便宜一點嗎？

sentences.en: The store discounts old items every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 這家店每週日都會把舊商品打折。

sentences.en: I got a big discount with my coupon.
sentences.zh: 我用優惠券拿到很大的折扣。

sentences.en: Is there a senior discount on Tuesdays?
sentences.zh: 週二有老人折扣嗎？

sentences.en: Everything in the shop is at a discount today.
sentences.zh: 店裡今天所有東西都打折。

gloss_note: hard disk＝硬碟；光碟美式多拼 disc

sentences.en: Save the file to the hard disk.
sentences.zh: 把檔案存到硬碟裡。

sentences.en: My laptop's hard disk is almost full.
sentences.zh: 我筆電的硬碟快滿了。

sentences.en: Is there enough free space on the disk?
sentences.zh: 磁碟還有足夠的空間嗎？

sentences.en: She backed up her photos on an external disk.
sentences.zh: 她把照片備份在外接硬碟上。

sentences.en: The old computer used floppy disks.
sentences.zh: 那台舊電腦用的是軟碟。

sentences.en: Is the disk almost full?
sentences.zh: 這個磁碟快滿了嗎？

gloss_note: 語氣比 hate 輕；dislike + V-ing

sentences.en: I dislike waking up early on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡週末早起。

sentences.en: Do you dislike spicy food?
sentences.zh: 你不喜歡吃辣嗎？

sentences.en: She has a strong dislike of loud noise.
sentences.zh: 她非常討厭吵鬧的聲音。

sentences.en: Why does he dislike his new teacher?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼不喜歡新老師？

sentences.en: Likes and dislikes are different for everyone.
sentences.zh: 每個人的喜好與厭惡都不一樣。

sentences.en: I developed a dislike for fish after getting sick.
sentences.zh: 我吃壞肚子後就變得討厭魚了。

gloss_note: v. 口語指甩掉、丟下不管

sentences.en: The car slid off the road and into a ditch.
sentences.zh: 車子滑出馬路，掉進水溝裡。

sentences.en: I ditched my old phone after the screen cracked.
sentences.zh: 螢幕裂了之後，我就把舊手機扔了。

sentences.en: Don't ditch me at the party, okay?
sentences.zh: 派對上別把我丟下不管，好嗎？

sentences.en: Workers dug a deep ditch along the farm field.
sentences.zh: 工人沿著農田挖了一條深溝。

sentences.en: He ditched his old friends after he got famous.
sentences.zh: 他紅了以後就把老朋友甩了。

sentences.en: Did you ditch your umbrella again?
sentences.zh: 你是不是又把雨傘隨手丟下不管了？

gloss_note: dive into 也可指一頭栽進、投入

sentences.en: She learned to dive when she was ten years old.
sentences.zh: 她十歲就學會潛水了。

sentences.en: Did you see him dive off the high board?
sentences.zh: 你有看到他從高台跳水嗎？

sentences.en: Let's dive into the pool before dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚餐前我們跳進泳池吧。

sentences.en: The divers went on a deep dive to explore the old ship.
sentences.zh: 潛水員深潛去探索那艘舊船。

sentences.en: A seagull made a quick dive for the fish.
sentences.zh: 一隻海鷗俯衝下去抓魚。

sentences.en: How long can you hold your breath on a dive?
sentences.zh: 潛水時你能憋氣多久？

sentences.en: The ferry docks at six every morning.
sentences.zh: 渡輪每天早上六點靠岸。

sentences.en: We sat at the end of the dock and watched the sunset.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在碼頭盡頭看夕陽。

sentences.en: Which dock does our boat leave from?
sentences.zh: 我們的船從哪個碼頭出發？

sentences.en: Fishermen unloaded their catch on the dock.
sentences.zh: 漁夫在碼頭卸下漁獲。

sentences.en: The cruise ship is scheduled to dock tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 郵輪預定明天早上靠岸。

sentences.en: Can we walk down to the dock after lunch?
sentences.zh: 午餐後我們可以走去碼頭嗎？

gloss_note: 常用 a dose of medicine

sentences.en: Take one dose of this medicine every six hours.
sentences.zh: 這種藥每六小時吃一劑。

sentences.en: Did the doctor change your dose?
sentences.zh: 醫生有改你的劑量嗎？

sentences.en: Too large a dose can make you feel sick.
sentences.zh: 劑量太大會讓你不舒服。

sentences.en: The nurse checked the dose before giving the shot.
sentences.zh: 護士打針前先核對了劑量。

sentences.en: I forgot to take my morning dose.
sentences.zh: 我忘了吃早上那一劑。

sentences.en: Is it safe to double the dose?
sentences.zh: 把劑量加倍安全嗎？

gloss_note: doubtful that/whether；語氣比 unlikely 保留

sentences.en: I'm doubtful that he'll show up on time.
sentences.zh: 我懷疑他會準時出現。

sentences.en: It's doubtful whether the store is open today.
sentences.zh: 這家店今天有沒有開還很難說。

sentences.en: Are you doubtful about the new plan?
sentences.zh: 你對新計畫有疑慮嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me a doubtful look.
sentences.zh: 她給了我一個懷疑的眼神。

sentences.en: Do the team's chances of winning still look doubtful?
sentences.zh: 球隊獲勝的機會看起來還是不大嗎？

sentences.en: It's doubtful that the bridge will open on time.
sentences.zh: 橋能不能如期通車還很難說。

gloss_note: drag and drop 是拖放；也指硬拉人去

sentences.en: Don't drag that heavy bag across the floor.
sentences.zh: 別把那個重袋子在地板上拖。

sentences.en: Can you help me drag the couch to the wall?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我把沙發拖到牆邊嗎？

sentences.en: Why do you always drag me to the mall?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是拉我去逛購物中心？

sentences.en: The kids dragged their sleds up the hill.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把雪橇拖上山坡。

sentences.en: He dragged himself out of bed at six.
sentences.zh: 他六點勉強拖著身子下床。

sentences.en: Use your mouse to drag the file into the folder.
sentences.zh: 用滑鼠把檔案拖進資料夾。

sentences.en: A dragonfly landed on the tip of the fishing rod.
sentences.zh: 一隻蜻蜓停在釣竿尖上。

sentences.en: Look at that blue dragonfly over the pond!
sentences.zh: 看池塘上那隻藍色蜻蜓！

sentences.en: Do dragonflies really live near water?
sentences.zh: 蜻蜓真的都住在水邊嗎？

sentences.en: Have you ever caught a dragonfly with your hands?
sentences.zh: 你有徒手抓過蜻蜓嗎？

sentences.en: My daughter drew a red dragonfly in art class.
sentences.zh: 我女兒在美術課畫了一隻紅蜻蜓。

sentences.en: The dragonfly flew away before I could take a photo.
sentences.zh: 我還沒拍到照，蜻蜓就飛走了。

gloss_note: drain 也可比喻耗盡精力或資源

sentences.en: Please drain the pasta in the sink.
sentences.zh: 請把義大利麵的水瀝乾。

sentences.en: Why does this bathtub drain so slowly?
sentences.zh: 這個浴缸為什麼排水這麼慢？

sentences.en: Something is blocking the drain in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 有東西堵住廚房的排水孔。

sentences.en: Did you drain the oil from the engine?
sentences.zh: 你把引擎的機油放掉了嗎？

sentences.en: Long meetings drain my energy.
sentences.zh: 開長會會耗盡我的精力。

sentences.en: Heavy rain filled the street drains in minutes.
sentences.zh: 大雨幾分鐘就灌滿了街上的排水溝。

sentences.en: Did you see the dramatic change in the weather?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到天氣的劇烈變化嗎？

sentences.en: Why are you being so dramatic?
sentences.zh: 你幹嘛這麼誇張？

sentences.en: The movie ends with a dramatic chase scene.
sentences.zh: 電影以戲劇性的追逐場面收尾。

sentences.en: Prices showed a dramatic increase this year.
sentences.zh: 今年物價大幅上漲。

sentences.en: She made a dramatic entrance in a red dress.
sentences.zh: 她穿著紅洋裝戲劇性地登場。

sentences.en: The soccer team's dramatic win surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 足球隊戲劇性的勝利讓大家都很驚訝。

gloss_note: a drip 指一滴液體或滴水聲

sentences.en: Why does the faucet drip all night long?
sentences.zh: 為什麼水龍頭整晚都在滴水？

sentences.en: Can you hear that drip in the bathroom?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到浴室的滴水聲嗎？

sentences.en: Sweat dripped down his face as he ran up the hill.
sentences.zh: 他跑上山坡時，汗水順著臉頰滴下來。

sentences.en: Be careful not to drip paint on the floor.
sentences.zh: 小心別把油漆滴在地板上。

sentences.en: Rain dripped from the roof into a bucket.
sentences.zh: 雨水從屋頂滴進水桶裡。

sentences.en: Mom put a bowl under the drip from the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在天花板滴水的地方放了一個碗。

gloss_note: drown out 是把聲音蓋過去

sentences.en: Always swim with a buddy so you won't drown.
sentences.zh: 游泳要找伴，這樣才不會溺水。

sentences.en: The loud music drowned out our conversation.
sentences.zh: 大聲的音樂蓋過了我們的對話。

sentences.en: Isn't that much dressing going to drown your salad?
sentences.zh: 淋那麼多醬汁，沙拉不會被淹掉嗎？

sentences.en: Did the flood drown all the crops in the field?
sentences.zh: 洪水把田裡的作物全淹死了嗎？

sentences.en: The lifeguard watches the pool so no one drowns.
sentences.zh: 救生員盯著泳池，避免有人溺水。

sentences.en: I'm drowning in homework this week.
sentences.zh: 這星期我的作業多到快滅頂了。

gloss_note: dump 比 throw away 隨便；也指甩掉某人

sentences.en: Don't dump your trash in the park.
sentences.zh: 別把垃圾亂丟在公園裡。

sentences.en: She dumped the leftover soup down the sink.
sentences.zh: 她把剩下的湯倒進水槽。

sentences.en: Where can I dump this old couch?
sentences.zh: 我可以把這張舊沙發丟在哪裡？

sentences.en: Did he dump a whole bag of ice into the cooler?
sentences.zh: 他是不是把一整袋冰塊倒進了冰桶？

sentences.en: The city fined the company for dumping waste in the river.
sentences.zh: 市政府因該公司把廢料倒進河裡而罰款。

sentences.en: We drove to the dump to throw away the broken TV.
sentences.zh: 我們開車去垃圾場丟掉壞掉的電視。

gloss_note: dust 當動詞是擦掉灰塵

sentences.en: There is a thick layer of dust on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 架子上積了一層厚厚的灰塵。

sentences.en: I need to dust the living room this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我得把客廳的灰塵擦一擦。

sentences.en: Can you dust the TV for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把電視擦一擦嗎？

sentences.en: Why is there so much dust on the dirt road?
sentences.zh: 這條土路上為什麼有這麼多灰塵？

sentences.en: Dust makes me sneeze all the time.
sentences.zh: 灰塵老是害我打噴嚏。

sentences.en: Mom dusted the piano before the guests arrived.
sentences.zh: 客人到之前，媽媽把鋼琴撣乾淨了。

gloss_note: eager to + 動詞；eager for + 名詞

sentences.en: The kids are eager to open their presents.
sentences.zh: 孩子們迫不及待要拆禮物。

sentences.en: She's eager to learn how to drive.
sentences.zh: 她很想學開車。

sentences.en: Are you eager to start your new job?
sentences.zh: 你迫不及待要開始新工作了嗎？

sentences.en: The eager fans waited in line all night.
sentences.zh: 熱情的粉絲排了一整夜的隊。

sentences.en: He was eager for a chance to prove himself.
sentences.zh: 他渴望有機會證明自己。

sentences.en: Why are you so eager to leave?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼急著要走？

gloss_note: 也可指附和別人的話

sentences.en: Shout in the cave and you'll hear an echo.
sentences.zh: 在山洞裡大喊，你就會聽到回音。

sentences.en: Our voices echoed in the empty hallway.
sentences.zh: 我們的聲音在空蕩的走廊裡迴盪。

sentences.en: Do you hear the echo of my voice?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到我聲音的回音嗎？

sentences.en: The sound of the bell echoed across the valley.
sentences.zh: 鐘聲在山谷間迴響。

sentences.en: Why is there an echo when I talk on the phone?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我講電話時會有回音？

sentences.en: Her words echo in my mind every day.
sentences.zh: 她的話每天都在我腦海裡迴響。

gloss_note: edit 影片、照片、文章都能用

sentences.en: I need to edit this video before I post it.
sentences.zh: 我要先剪輯這支影片再發出去。

sentences.en: Can you edit my essay for spelling mistakes?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我修改作文裡的拼字錯誤嗎？

sentences.en: She edits the school newspaper every month.
sentences.zh: 她每個月編輯校刊。

sentences.en: Click here to edit your profile.
sentences.zh: 點這裡編輯你的個人檔案。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to edit our own writing.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們自己修改文章。

sentences.en: Who edited this photo? It looks great!
sentences.zh: 這張照片是誰修的？看起來好棒！

gloss_note: 也指編輯軟體，如 photo editor

sentences.en: My aunt works as an editor at a publishing company.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨在出版社當編輯。

sentences.en: The editor cut two pages from the story.
sentences.zh: 編輯從那篇故事裡刪掉了兩頁。

sentences.en: Who is the editor of the school newspaper?
sentences.zh: 誰是校刊的主編？

sentences.en: Who sent the article to the editor?
sentences.zh: 是誰把這篇文章寄給編輯的？

sentences.en: I use a free photo editor on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我手機上用的是免費的修圖軟體。

sentences.en: A good editor catches mistakes the writer missed.
sentences.zh: 好的編輯會抓出作者漏掉的錯誤。

gloss_note: 常用被動 be educated at/in

sentences.en: Parents should educate their children about money.
sentences.zh: 父母應該教導孩子金錢觀念。

sentences.en: She was educated at a small public school.
sentences.zh: 她在一所小型公立學校受教育。

sentences.en: How can we educate people about recycling?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓大家了解回收的重要？

sentences.en: The museum aims to educate young visitors about space.
sentences.zh: 博物館的目標是讓年輕參觀者認識太空。

sentences.en: Who educated you about money when you were young?
sentences.zh: 你小時候是誰教你理財觀念的？

sentences.en: The new program will educate students about online safety.
sentences.zh: 新課程會教學生網路安全。

sentences.en: This game is fun and educational.
sentences.zh: 這個遊戲既好玩又有教育意義。

sentences.en: We watched an educational video about whales.
sentences.zh: 我們看了一支關於鯨魚的教育影片。

sentences.en: Is this website educational or just for fun?
sentences.zh: 這個網站是有教育意義，還是只是好玩？

sentences.en: The trip to the science museum was very educational.
sentences.zh: 去科學博物館的那趟旅行很有收穫。

sentences.en: The school offers many educational programs for adults.
sentences.zh: 這所學校為成人開設許多教育課程。

sentences.en: Do you have any educational toys for a four-year-old?
sentences.zh: 你們有適合四歲小孩的益智玩具嗎？

gloss_note: efficient 是做事不浪費時間或資源

sentences.en: She is a very efficient worker.
sentences.zh: 她是個非常有效率的員工。

sentences.en: This new heater is more efficient than the old one.
sentences.zh: 這台新暖氣比舊的更省能源。

sentences.en: What's the most efficient way to get downtown?
sentences.zh: 去市區最有效率的方式是什麼？

sentences.en: An efficient system saves everyone time.
sentences.zh: 有效率的系統能幫大家省時間。

sentences.en: Is your new car fuel efficient?
sentences.zh: 你的新車省油嗎？

sentences.en: The efficient staff served us in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 效率很高的店員五分鐘內就幫我們上了餐。

gloss_note: elbow 當動詞是用手肘推擠

sentences.en: I hit my elbow on the door.
sentences.zh: 我的手肘撞到門了。

sentences.en: Don't put your elbows on the table.
sentences.zh: 別把手肘放在桌上。

sentences.en: Did you hurt your elbow playing tennis?
sentences.zh: 你打網球時手肘受傷了嗎？

sentences.en: Did she really elbow her way through the crowd?
sentences.zh: 她真的是用手肘擠開人群往前走的嗎？

sentences.en: My elbow is sore from lifting boxes all day.
sentences.zh: 我整天搬箱子，手肘好痠。

sentences.en: He rested his elbow on the car window.
sentences.zh: 他把手肘靠在車窗上。

gloss_note: 比 old 禮貌，指老年人

sentences.en: An elderly man helped me find the library.
sentences.zh: 一位年長的先生幫我找到圖書館。

sentences.en: Please give your seat to an elderly passenger.
sentences.zh: 請把座位讓給年長的乘客。

sentences.en: Does your elderly neighbor live alone?
sentences.zh: 你家年長的鄰居是一個人住嗎？

sentences.en: Are there any discounts for elderly customers?
sentences.zh: 年長的顧客有任何折扣嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse takes care of elderly patients at the clinic.
sentences.zh: 護士在診所照顧年長的病人。

sentences.en: Many elderly people in our town live alone.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上有許多老人獨居。

sentences.en: The election will be held on a Tuesday in early November.
sentences.zh: 選舉將在十一月初的一個星期二舉行。

sentences.en: Who do you think will win the election?
sentences.zh: 你覺得誰會贏得選舉？

sentences.en: Our class held an election for class president.
sentences.zh: 我們班舉行了班長選舉。

sentences.en: Few people voted in the last election.
sentences.zh: 上次選舉沒什麼人去投票。

sentences.en: The mayor won the election by a small margin.
sentences.zh: 市長以些微差距贏得選舉。

sentences.en: Have you registered to vote in the election?
sentences.zh: 你登記要參加這次選舉投票了嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數；停電常說 the power went out

sentences.en: The electricity went out during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨時停電了。

sentences.en: How much electricity does this fridge use?
sentences.zh: 這台冰箱用多少電？

sentences.en: Our house gets electricity from solar panels.
sentences.zh: 我們家的電來自太陽能板。

sentences.en: Don't touch that wire; it carries electricity.
sentences.zh: 別碰那條線，它有電。

sentences.en: We saved electricity by turning off the lights.
sentences.zh: 我們靠關燈來省電。

sentences.en: When did the town first get electricity?
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮是什麼時候開始有電的？

gloss_note: electric 指用電驅動，electronic 指電子零件

sentences.en: Please turn off all electronic devices during takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛時請關閉所有電子裝置。

sentences.en: Can I use electronic devices during the test?
sentences.zh: 考試時可以用電子產品嗎？

sentences.en: Do you prefer electronic books or paper ones?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡電子書還是紙本書？

sentences.en: The store sells electronic equipment like radios and cameras.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣收音機、相機之類的電子設備。

sentences.en: Electronic music is popular with teenagers.
sentences.zh: 電子音樂很受青少年歡迎。

sentences.en: Can I pay my bill by electronic transfer?
sentences.zh: 我可以用電子轉帳付帳單嗎？

sentences.en: Oxygen is an important element for life.
sentences.zh: 氧是生命的重要元素。

sentences.en: What is the key element of a good story?
sentences.zh: 一個好故事的關鍵要素是什麼？

sentences.en: Is trust an element of every friendship?
sentences.zh: 信任是每段友情的要素嗎？

sentences.en: Gold is a chemical element, not a compound.
sentences.zh: 黃金是化學元素，不是化合物。

sentences.en: There's an element of truth in what he said.
sentences.zh: 他說的話有幾分道理。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to name three elements.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們說出三種元素。

gloss_note: in an emergency；急診室是 emergency room

sentences.en: You should call 911 in an emergency.
sentences.zh: 遇到緊急情況你應該打 911。

sentences.en: The hospital's emergency room is open all night.
sentences.zh: 醫院的急診室整夜開放。

sentences.en: Is it an emergency, or can it wait?
sentences.zh: 這是緊急狀況，還是可以等？

sentences.en: Do you keep a flashlight in the car for emergencies?
sentences.zh: 你車上有放手電筒以備不時之需嗎？

sentences.en: The governor declared a state of emergency after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，州長宣布進入緊急狀態。

sentences.en: There was a family emergency, so I left early.
sentences.zh: 家裡有急事，所以我提早離開了。

sentences.en: She got emotional when she said goodbye.
sentences.zh: 道別時她情緒激動了起來。

sentences.en: Are you feeling emotional today?
sentences.zh: 你今天情緒比較敏感嗎？

sentences.en: The movie's ending was very emotional.
sentences.zh: 電影的結局非常感人。

sentences.en: Is your dad an emotional person?
sentences.zh: 你爸爸是個感情外露的人嗎？

sentences.en: Teenagers often go through emotional ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 青少年常會經歷情緒起伏。

sentences.en: He needs emotional support from his friends.
sentences.zh: 他需要朋友的情感支持。

sentences.en: The emperor lived in a huge palace.
sentences.zh: 皇帝住在一座巨大的宮殿裡。

sentences.en: Who was the first emperor of China?
sentences.zh: 中國的第一位皇帝是誰？

sentences.en: We learned about a Roman emperor in history class.
sentences.zh: 我們在歷史課學到一位羅馬皇帝。

sentences.en: The emperor ruled the land for forty years.
sentences.zh: 皇帝統治這片土地四十年。

sentences.en: In the game, you play as a young emperor.
sentences.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，你扮演一位年輕的皇帝。

sentences.en: Did the emperor really wear that heavy crown every day?
sentences.zh: 皇帝真的每天都戴那頂沉重的皇冠嗎？

gloss_note: enable A to + 動詞

sentences.en: This tool enables us to finish the job faster.
sentences.zh: 這個工具讓我們能更快完成工作。

sentences.en: The new ramp enables wheelchairs to enter the building.
sentences.zh: 新的坡道讓輪椅可以進入大樓。

sentences.en: Does this setting enable the camera?
sentences.zh: 這個設定能啟用相機嗎？

sentences.en: A scholarship enabled her to attend college.
sentences.zh: 一筆獎學金讓她得以上大學。

sentences.en: How can we enable everyone to join the game?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓每個人都能加入遊戲？

sentences.en: Please enable notifications so you don't miss messages.
sentences.zh: 請開啟通知，這樣你才不會漏看訊息。

gloss_note: engage in 是從事；engage someone 是吸引住

sentences.en: She likes to engage in friendly debates.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡進行友善的辯論。

sentences.en: Good teachers know how to engage their students.
sentences.zh: 好老師懂得怎麼讓學生投入。

sentences.en: The story engaged my attention from the first page.
sentences.zh: 這個故事從第一頁就抓住了我的注意力。

sentences.en: Do you often engage in sports after school?
sentences.zh: 你放學後常從事運動嗎？

sentences.en: The company engages in online sales.
sentences.zh: 這家公司從事網路銷售。

sentences.en: How can we engage more people in the project?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓更多人投入這個專案？

gloss_note: prior engagement 是先前就約好的事

sentences.en: They announced their engagement last week.
sentences.zh: 他們上星期宣布訂婚。

sentences.en: Have you seen her engagement ring yet?
sentences.zh: 你看過她的訂婚戒指了嗎？

sentences.en: I can't come; I have a prior engagement.
sentences.zh: 我不能去，我先有約了。

sentences.en: Did you hear about Tom's engagement?
sentences.zh: 你聽說湯姆訂婚的事了嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor has several engagements this week.
sentences.zh: 市長這個星期有好幾個行程。

sentences.en: Congratulations on your engagement, you two!
sentences.zh: 恭喜你們兩個訂婚！

gloss_note: 形容事情令人享受，不形容人

sentences.en: It was an enjoyable dinner with old friends.
sentences.zh: 和老朋友吃了一頓愉快的晚餐。

sentences.en: Was the trip enjoyable for the kids?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅行孩子們玩得開心嗎？

sentences.en: Cooking together can be really enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 一起做菜真的可以很愉快。

sentences.en: The concert was more enjoyable than I expected.
sentences.zh: 演唱會比我預期的還要好看。

sentences.en: I found the book quite enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 我覺得這本書相當有趣。

sentences.en: What's the most enjoyable part of your job?
sentences.zh: 你工作中最愉快的部分是什麼？

gloss_note: entry fee 是入場費；no entry 是禁止進入

sentences.en: The entry to the museum is on the left.
sentences.zh: 博物館的入口在左邊。

sentences.en: Is entry allowed without a ticket?
sentences.zh: 沒有票可以入場嗎？

sentences.en: Is entry free for kids?
sentences.zh: 小孩入場免費嗎？

sentences.en: She won first prize with her entry in the art contest.
sentences.zh: 她的參賽作品在美術比賽中得了第一名。

sentences.en: Each student submitted an entry to the science fair.
sentences.zh: 每個學生都交了一件作品參加科展。

sentences.en: Entry to the stadium opens at noon.
sentences.zh: 球場從中午開始入場。

sentences.en: Can you erase the board for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我擦黑板嗎？

sentences.en: I accidentally erased all my photos.
sentences.zh: 我不小心把照片全刪光了。

sentences.en: Just erase the wrong answer and try again.
sentences.zh: 把錯的答案擦掉再試一次。

sentences.en: Time can't erase the memory of that summer.
sentences.zh: 時間抹不掉那個夏天的記憶。

sentences.en: Please erase my name from the list.
sentences.zh: 請把我的名字從名單上刪掉。

sentences.en: How do I erase everything on this old phone?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼清除這支舊手機上的所有資料？

gloss_note: 較正式，常見 academic excellence

sentences.en: The school is known for academic excellence.
sentences.zh: 這所學校以學業卓越聞名。

sentences.en: She received an award for excellence in teaching.
sentences.zh: 她因教學卓越獲獎。

sentences.en: Does excellence take years of hard work?
sentences.zh: 要做到卓越，是不是得花上很多年努力？

sentences.en: Our school has a long history of excellence in music.
sentences.zh: 我們學校在音樂方面一直表現卓越。

sentences.en: The coach expects excellence from every player.
sentences.zh: 教練要求每位球員都要出類拔萃。

sentences.en: Is he famous for his excellence in math?
sentences.zh: 他是不是以數學能力出眾而聞名？

gloss_note: exchange rate 是匯率；in exchange for 是作為交換

sentences.en: Can I exchange this shirt for a bigger size?
sentences.zh: 我可以把這件襯衫換成大一點的嗎？

sentences.en: We exchanged phone numbers at the party.
sentences.zh: 我們在派對上交換了電話號碼。

sentences.en: What's the exchange rate for dollars today?
sentences.zh: 今天美元的匯率是多少？

sentences.en: In exchange for the ride, I bought him lunch.
sentences.zh: 為了答謝載我一程，我請他吃午餐。

sentences.en: She is an exchange student from Spain.
sentences.zh: 她是來自西班牙的交換學生。

sentences.en: Do you exchange gifts on Christmas?
sentences.zh: 你們聖誕節會交換禮物嗎？

gloss_note: 美式也常說 exhibit

sentences.en: We went to an art exhibition on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我們星期六去看了一場藝術展。

sentences.en: The exhibition opens next Friday at the city museum.
sentences.zh: 展覽下星期五在市立博物館開幕。

sentences.en: Is the exhibition free for students?
sentences.zh: 這個展覽學生免費嗎？

sentences.en: Her photos will be shown in a big exhibition.
sentences.zh: 她的照片將在一場大型展覽中展出。

sentences.en: The science exhibition was crowded with kids.
sentences.zh: 科學展覽擠滿了小朋友。

sentences.en: How long will the exhibition last?
sentences.zh: 這個展覽會持續多久？

gloss_note: 常用複數 expectations

sentences.en: The movie didn't meet my expectations.
sentences.zh: 這部電影不如我的期待。

sentences.en: My parents have high expectations for me.
sentences.zh: 爸媽對我的期望很高。

sentences.en: Against all expectations, our team won the game.
sentences.zh: 出乎所有人意料，我們隊贏了比賽。

sentences.en: What are your expectations for this job?
sentences.zh: 你對這份工作有什麼期待？

sentences.en: Isn't that expectation a little too high?
sentences.zh: 這個期望是不是訂得太高了一點？

sentences.en: Sales fell short of the company's expectations.
sentences.zh: 銷售額沒達到公司的預期。

gloss_note: experiment with 是試著用新方法

sentences.en: We did an experiment in science class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在自然課做了一個實驗。

sentences.en: Scientists experimented with different kinds of soil.
sentences.zh: 科學家用各種不同的土壤做實驗。

sentences.en: Do you want to experiment with a new recipe tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚想試做新食譜嗎？

sentences.en: The experiment failed, so we tried again.
sentences.zh: 實驗失敗了，所以我們重做了一次。

sentences.en: It's just an experiment, so don't worry about mistakes.
sentences.zh: 這只是個實驗，別擔心犯錯。

sentences.en: How long did the experiment take?
sentences.zh: 這個實驗花了多久？

gloss_note: 也可比喻情緒或人群突然爆發

sentences.en: The balloon exploded with a loud pop.
sentences.zh: 氣球砰的一聲爆了。

sentences.en: Fireworks exploded over the lake.
sentences.zh: 煙火在湖面上空炸開。

sentences.en: Did you hear something explode?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到什麼東西爆炸嗎？

sentences.en: Will soda cans explode if I leave them in a hot car?
sentences.zh: 把汽水罐留在熱車裡，它們會爆開嗎？

sentences.en: The crowd exploded with joy when the team scored.
sentences.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾歡聲雷動。

sentences.en: A tire exploded on the highway, but nobody was hurt.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上有個輪胎爆了，但沒人受傷。

sentences.en: Let's explore the old town this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們今天下午去逛逛這座老城吧。

sentences.en: Kids love to explore the woods behind the house.
sentences.zh: 孩子們喜歡探索房子後面的樹林。

sentences.en: Have you ever explored the caves near the beach?
sentences.zh: 你有探索過海灘附近的洞穴嗎？

sentences.en: Do scientists plan to explore the deep ocean?
sentences.zh: 科學家打算探索深海嗎？

sentences.en: We need to explore other options before we decide.
sentences.zh: 我們做決定前得先考慮其他選項。

sentences.en: She explored the city on her bike.
sentences.zh: 她騎腳踏車探索這座城市。

gloss_note: 反義詞是 import；電腦可指匯出檔案

sentences.en: Japan exports cars all over the world.
sentences.zh: 日本把汽車出口到世界各地。

sentences.en: Rice is the country's main export.
sentences.zh: 稻米是這個國家的主要出口品。

sentences.en: What does your country export?
sentences.zh: 你的國家出口什麼？

sentences.en: Coffee exports rose sharply last year.
sentences.zh: 去年咖啡出口量大幅上升。

sentences.en: Can you export this file to another format?
sentences.zh: 你能把這個檔案匯出成別的格式嗎？

sentences.en: The company plans to export its toys to Canada next year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司計畫明年把玩具外銷到加拿大。

gloss_zh: 表情豐富的；有表現力的

sentences.en: She has very expressive eyes.
sentences.zh: 她有一雙很有表情的眼睛。

sentences.en: The dancer's expressive movements moved the audience.
sentences.zh: 舞者富有表現力的動作感動了觀眾。

sentences.en: Is your dog always this expressive?
sentences.zh: 你的狗總是這麼表情豐富嗎？

sentences.en: Is music an expressive way to share feelings?
sentences.zh: 音樂是不是一種分享感受的表達方式？

sentences.en: His voice is calm but expressive.
sentences.zh: 他的聲音平穩卻很有感情。

sentences.en: The painter's expressive style uses bold colors.
sentences.zh: 這位畫家富有表現力的風格用了大膽的色彩。

gloss_note: go to extremes 是走極端

sentences.en: The desert has extreme heat in summer.
sentences.zh: 沙漠夏天酷熱無比。

sentences.en: Extreme weather caused many flight delays.
sentences.zh: 極端天氣造成許多班機延誤。

sentences.en: Is it safe to try such an extreme sport?
sentences.zh: 嘗試這麼極限的運動安全嗎？

sentences.en: He takes everything to the extreme.
sentences.zh: 他凡事都做得太極端。

sentences.en: Do you think it's extreme to wake up at four?
sentences.zh: 你覺得凌晨四點起床算極端嗎？

sentences.en: Don't go to extremes with your diet.
sentences.zh: 飲食別走極端。

sentences.en: My jeans have faded after many washes.
sentences.zh: 我的牛仔褲洗了很多次，已經褪色了。

sentences.en: The music slowly faded away.
sentences.zh: 音樂慢慢漸弱消失。

sentences.en: Will this ink fade in the sun?
sentences.zh: 這種墨水會被太陽曬到褪色嗎？

sentences.en: Her smile faded when she heard the news.
sentences.zh: 她聽到消息時，笑容漸漸消失。

sentences.en: The pain should fade in a few days.
sentences.zh: 這種疼痛幾天內應該會慢慢消退。

sentences.en: Do old memories ever really fade?
sentences.zh: 舊的記憶真的會淡去嗎？

gloss_note: faint 當動詞是昏倒，當形容詞是微弱模糊

sentences.en: I felt dizzy and almost fainted in the heat.
sentences.zh: 我在大熱天頭暈，差點昏倒。

sentences.en: Did he faint in the hot gym?
sentences.zh: 他在悶熱的體育館裡昏倒了嗎？

sentences.en: I heard a faint noise from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我聽到廚房傳來微弱的聲音。

sentences.en: There was a faint smell of coffee in the hall.
sentences.zh: 走廊裡有一絲淡淡的咖啡香。

sentences.en: The light grew faint as the sun went down.
sentences.zh: 太陽下山後，光線變得微弱。

sentences.en: Have you ever fainted from standing too long?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有因為站太久而昏倒過？

gloss_note: 程度比 very 弱，比 a little 強

sentences.en: The test was fairly easy.
sentences.zh: 考試相當簡單。

sentences.en: I know her fairly well.
sentences.zh: 我跟她算滿熟的。

sentences.en: Is the new teacher fairly strict?
sentences.zh: 新來的老師相當嚴格嗎？

sentences.en: Is it fairly cold outside today?
sentences.zh: 今天外面滿冷的嗎？

sentences.en: The bus is fairly crowded in the morning.
sentences.zh: 早上公車滿擠的。

sentences.en: We were fairly sure he would come.
sentences.zh: 我們滿確定他會來。

gloss_note: fairy tale 是童話故事

sentences.en: The little girl dressed up as a fairy.
sentences.zh: 小女孩打扮成小仙子。

sentences.en: Do you believe in fairies?
sentences.zh: 你相信有精靈嗎？

sentences.en: Did Mom read you a fairy tale every night?
sentences.zh: 你媽媽以前每晚都唸童話故事給你聽嗎？

sentences.en: The fairy waved her wand and the pumpkin became a carriage.
sentences.zh: 仙女揮動魔杖，南瓜變成了馬車。

sentences.en: My niece wants a fairy costume for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我姪女萬聖節想要一套仙女裝。

sentences.en: In the story, a good fairy helps the poor boy.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一位善良的仙女幫助了那個窮男孩。

gloss_note: have faith in 是對某人有信心

sentences.en: I have faith in you; you can do it.
sentences.zh: 我對你有信心，你做得到。

sentences.en: She lost faith in the old system.
sentences.zh: 她對舊制度失去了信心。

sentences.en: Do you have faith in your team?
sentences.zh: 你對你的團隊有信心嗎？

sentences.en: Have a little faith in me, okay?
sentences.zh: 對我有點信心嘛，好嗎？

sentences.en: The coach put his faith in the young players.
sentences.zh: 教練把信任放在年輕球員身上。

sentences.en: Customers lost faith in the bank after the news.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導後，客戶對這家銀行失去了信心。

gloss_note: fake news 是假新聞；也指假裝

sentences.en: Is this bag real or fake?
sentences.zh: 這個包包是真的還是假的？

sentences.en: He used a fake name online.
sentences.zh: 他在網路上用假名。

sentences.en: She faked a cough to get out of class.
sentences.zh: 她假裝咳嗽想逃課。

sentences.en: Be careful of fake news on social media.
sentences.zh: 小心社群媒體上的假新聞。

sentences.en: The snow in the movie was fake.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的雪是假的。

sentences.en: That diamond is a fake, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 那顆鑽石是假的，對吧？

gloss_note: be familiar with 對…熟悉

sentences.en: Your face looks really familiar to me.
sentences.zh: 你的臉我看起來真的好眼熟。

sentences.en: Are you familiar with this software?
sentences.zh: 你熟悉這套軟體嗎？

sentences.en: The song sounded familiar, but I couldn't remember the name.
sentences.zh: 這首歌聽起來很熟，但我想不起歌名。

sentences.en: Aren't you familiar with this part of town?
sentences.zh: 你對這個區域不熟嗎？

sentences.en: It's good to see a familiar face.
sentences.zh: 看到熟悉的面孔真好。

sentences.en: The smell of fresh bread was warm and familiar.
sentences.zh: 新鮮麵包的味道溫暖又熟悉。

gloss_note: be fearful of / that；比 afraid 稍正式

sentences.en: She was fearful of speaking in public.
sentences.zh: 她害怕在公開場合說話。

sentences.en: Are you fearful about the exam results?
sentences.zh: 你擔心考試成績嗎？

sentences.en: The fearful child hid behind his mother.
sentences.zh: 膽怯的孩子躲在媽媽背後。

sentences.en: He was fearful that he would miss the flight.
sentences.zh: 他擔心自己會趕不上班機。

sentences.en: Many people are fearful of flying.
sentences.zh: 許多人害怕搭飛機。

sentences.en: Why are you so fearful of the dark?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼怕黑？

sentences.en: I found a white feather on the grass.
sentences.zh: 我在草地上撿到一根白色羽毛。

sentences.en: The pillow is filled with soft feathers.
sentences.zh: 這個枕頭裡面填滿柔軟的羽毛。

sentences.en: Do ducks lose their feathers in the summer?
sentences.zh: 鴨子夏天會掉羽毛嗎？

sentences.en: She wore a hat with a long blue feather.
sentences.zh: 她戴了一頂插著藍色長羽毛的帽子。

sentences.en: The bird's bright feathers shone in the sun.
sentences.zh: 那隻鳥鮮豔的羽毛在陽光下閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: Can you tell what bird this feather came from?
sentences.zh: 你看得出這根羽毛是哪種鳥的嗎？

sentences.en: He trains every day to become a better fighter.
sentences.zh: 他每天訓練，想成為更厲害的格鬥選手。

sentences.en: My grandma is a real fighter; she never gives up.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶是個真正的鬥士，從不放棄。

sentences.en: Which fighter do you pick in this video game?
sentences.zh: 這款電玩裡你選哪個格鬥角色？

sentences.en: The young fighter won the match in the third round.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的選手在第三回合贏得比賽。

sentences.en: Every fighter in the ring wears gloves and a mouthguard.
sentences.zh: 擂台上的每位選手都戴著手套和護牙套。

sentences.en: Is he a good fighter, or just a big talker?
sentences.zh: 他真的很會打，還是只是嘴上說說？

gloss_note: 常用複數 fireworks

sentences.en: We watched the fireworks on the Fourth of July.
sentences.zh: 我們在七月四日看煙火。

sentences.en: The kids love sparklers and fireworks.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很喜歡仙女棒和煙火。

sentences.en: Did you hear the fireworks last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有聽到煙火聲嗎？

sentences.en: The fireworks show begins at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 煙火秀九點開始。

sentences.en: One firework didn't go off.
sentences.zh: 有一支煙火沒有炸開。

sentences.en: Are fireworks allowed in this park?
sentences.zh: 這座公園可以放煙火嗎？

gloss_note: fist bump 是碰拳

sentences.en: He made a fist and knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 他握緊拳頭敲門。

sentences.en: She raised her fist in the air to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 她高舉拳頭慶祝。

sentences.en: Can you open your fist and show me what's inside?
sentences.zh: 你可以張開拳頭讓我看看裡面是什麼嗎？

sentences.en: The baby held the toy in his tiny fist.
sentences.zh: 嬰兒用他小小的拳頭抓著玩具。

sentences.en: Do you want to do a fist bump?
sentences.zh: 你要碰拳嗎？

sentences.en: Dad pounded his fist on the table and laughed.
sentences.zh: 爸爸笑著用拳頭捶桌子。

gloss_note: in flames 是著火；open flame 是明火

sentences.en: The candle flame moved in the wind.
sentences.zh: 蠟燭的火焰隨風搖動。

sentences.en: Turn the flame down so the soup doesn't burn.
sentences.zh: 把火轉小，湯才不會燒焦。

sentences.en: Will dry wood burst into flames quickly?
sentences.zh: 乾柴會很快燒起來嗎？

sentences.en: Can you see the flame from here?
sentences.zh: 你從這裡看得到火苗嗎？

sentences.en: Firefighters put out the flames in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 消防員十分鐘內就撲滅了火焰。

sentences.en: Never touch an open flame with your hands.
sentences.zh: 千萬別用手去碰明火。

sentences.en: A flash of lightning lit up the sky.
sentences.zh: 一道閃電照亮了天空。

sentences.en: Don't use the flash in the museum.
sentences.zh: 別在博物館裡使用閃光燈。

sentences.en: The lights flashed red and blue.
sentences.zh: 燈閃著紅藍的光。

sentences.en: Did an idea suddenly flash through your mind?
sentences.zh: 你腦海裡是不是突然閃過一個點子？

sentences.en: Did you see that flash?
sentences.zh: 你有看到剛剛那道閃光嗎？

sentences.en: The warning light flashes when the battery is low.
sentences.zh: 電量不足時，警示燈會閃爍。

gloss_note: 美式拼 flavor，英式拼 flavour

sentences.en: What flavor of ice cream do you want?
sentences.zh: 你要什麼口味的冰淇淋？

sentences.en: This soup needs more flavor.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯需要更多味道。

sentences.en: The candy comes in six different flavors.
sentences.zh: 這種糖果有六種不同的口味。

sentences.en: She added lemon to flavor the tea.
sentences.zh: 她加了檸檬來給茶調味。

sentences.en: Do you like the strawberry flavor?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡草莓口味嗎？

sentences.en: The spices gave the dish a rich flavor.
sentences.zh: 香料讓這道菜的味道更濃郁。

gloss_note: flesh and blood 指血肉之軀；親人

sentences.en: The flesh of this peach is soft and sweet.
sentences.zh: 這顆桃子的果肉又軟又甜。

sentences.en: Scoop out the flesh of the avocado with a spoon.
sentences.zh: 用湯匙把酪梨的果肉挖出來。

sentences.en: Is the flesh of this fish white or pink?
sentences.zh: 這種魚的肉是白色還是粉紅色？

sentences.en: Ghosts aren't flesh and blood like us.
sentences.zh: 鬼不像我們是血肉之軀。

sentences.en: Is the flesh of this melon orange or green?
sentences.zh: 這種瓜的果肉是橘色還是綠色？

sentences.en: Her son is her own flesh and blood.
sentences.zh: 他兒子是她的親骨肉。

gloss_note: 也指遊行的花車

sentences.en: Wood floats on top of the water.
sentences.zh: 木頭會浮在水面上。

sentences.en: Can you float on your back?
sentences.zh: 你會仰漂嗎？

sentences.en: A leaf floated down the stream.
sentences.zh: 一片葉子順著小溪漂下去。

sentences.en: The balloon floated up into the sky.
sentences.zh: 氣球飄上了天空。

sentences.en: Why does the ship float but the coin sink?
sentences.zh: 為什麼船會浮，而硬幣會沉？

sentences.en: The boat floats in the middle of the lake.
sentences.zh: 小船漂在湖中央。

gloss_note: flock to 是成群湧向某處

sentences.en: A flock of birds flew over the lake.
sentences.zh: 一群鳥飛過湖面。

sentences.en: The farmer watched over his flock of sheep.
sentences.zh: 農夫看顧著他的羊群。

sentences.en: How big is that flock of geese?
sentences.zh: 那群鵝有多大？

sentences.en: Tourists flock to the beach every summer.
sentences.zh: 遊客每年夏天都湧向海灘。

sentences.en: A flock of seagulls followed the fishing boat.
sentences.zh: 一群海鷗跟著漁船。

sentences.en: Did you see the flock heading south?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那群鳥往南飛嗎？

sentences.en: The heavy rain caused a flood in the town.
sentences.zh: 大雨讓鎮上發生了水災。

sentences.en: Many roads were flooded after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，許多道路都淹水了。

sentences.en: Is our street likely to flood?
sentences.zh: 我們這條街容易淹水嗎？

sentences.en: Flood water covered the farm fields.
sentences.zh: 洪水淹沒了農田。

sentences.en: Did the flood damage your house?
sentences.zh: 洪水有損壞你家嗎？

sentences.en: The basement floods every spring.
sentences.zh: 地下室每年春天都會淹水。

sentences.en: Please fold the towels and put them away.
sentences.zh: 請把毛巾摺好收起來。

sentences.en: Can you fold this paper into a plane?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這張紙摺成紙飛機嗎？

sentences.en: She folded her arms and looked at me.
sentences.zh: 她雙臂交叉看著我。

sentences.en: Should I fold the letter in half before mailing it?
sentences.zh: 寄信前我要先把信對摺嗎？

sentences.en: I fold my clothes after they come out of the dryer.
sentences.zh: 衣服從烘乾機拿出來後，我就把它們摺好。

sentences.en: Press along the fold to make it flat.
sentences.zh: 沿著摺痕壓平。

sentences.en: She has over a thousand followers on social media.
sentences.zh: 她在社群媒體上有一千多名追蹤者。

sentences.en: The singer thanked her loyal followers.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手感謝她忠實的粉絲。

sentences.en: Are you a leader or a follower?
sentences.zh: 你是領導者還是跟隨者？

sentences.en: How many followers does your account have?
sentences.zh: 你的帳號有多少追蹤者？

sentences.en: He gained new followers after the video went viral.
sentences.zh: 影片爆紅後，他多了不少新的追蹤者。

sentences.en: Followers of the team wore red to the game.
sentences.zh: 球隊的支持者穿紅色去看比賽。

gloss_note: be fond of 喜歡；fond memories 美好的回憶

sentences.en: I'm very fond of my little cousin.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡我的小表弟。

sentences.en: Are you fond of spicy food?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡吃辣的食物嗎？

sentences.en: She has fond memories of her childhood home.
sentences.zh: 她對童年的家有美好的回憶。

sentences.en: Is your dog fond of chewing shoes too?
sentences.zh: 你的狗也很愛咬鞋子嗎？

sentences.en: He's not very fond of the cold.
sentences.zh: 他不太喜歡冷天氣。

sentences.en: They gave their teacher a fond goodbye.
sentences.zh: 他們深情地向老師道別。

gloss_note: make a fortune 是賺大錢；good fortune 是好運

sentences.en: He made a fortune selling used cars.
sentences.zh: 他靠賣二手車賺了一大筆錢。

sentences.en: Did it cost a fortune to fix the roof?
sentences.zh: 修屋頂是不是花了一大筆錢？

sentences.en: Do you believe in good fortune?
sentences.zh: 你相信有好運嗎？

sentences.en: She had the good fortune to meet a great teacher.
sentences.zh: 她很幸運遇到了一位好老師。

sentences.en: Her grandfather built a fortune in the shipping business.
sentences.zh: 她祖父靠航運事業累積了一大筆財富。

sentences.en: I wish you fortune and happiness in the new year.
sentences.zh: 祝你新的一年財運亨通、幸福快樂。

gloss_note: water fountain 是飲水機

sentences.en: Kids splashed in the fountain on a hot day.
sentences.zh: 大熱天裡，孩子們在噴泉裡玩水。

sentences.en: We threw coins into the fountain and made a wish.
sentences.zh: 我們把硬幣丟進噴泉裡許願。

sentences.en: Where is the water fountain?
sentences.zh: 飲水機在哪裡？

sentences.en: The park has a beautiful fountain in the center.
sentences.zh: 公園中央有一座漂亮的噴泉。

sentences.en: Do you want to meet by the fountain at noon?
sentences.zh: 你中午要不要在噴泉旁碰面？

sentences.en: The fountain lights up at night.
sentences.zh: 噴泉到了晚上會亮起燈。

gloss_note: freezing 常指冷得要命

sentences.en: The lake freezes every winter.
sentences.zh: 這座湖每年冬天都會結冰。

sentences.en: You can freeze the soup for later.
sentences.zh: 你可以把湯冷凍起來以後再吃。

sentences.en: It's going to freeze tonight, so cover the plants.
sentences.zh: 今晚會結冰，把植物蓋起來。

sentences.en: At what temperature does water freeze?
sentences.zh: 水在幾度會結冰？

sentences.en: Are your fingers freezing out there?
sentences.zh: 你的手指在外面凍僵了嗎？

sentences.en: A hard freeze is expected this weekend.
sentences.zh: 本週末預計會有嚴重霜凍。

gloss_note: 動詞 frequent 重音在後，是常去某地

sentences.en: She makes frequent trips to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 她常常去洛杉磯。

sentences.en: How frequent are the buses on this route?
sentences.zh: 這條路線的公車多久一班？

sentences.en: He's a frequent visitor at our shop.
sentences.zh: 他是我們店的常客。

sentences.en: We frequent this café on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我們週末常去這家咖啡店。

sentences.en: Frequent hand washing helps stop colds.
sentences.zh: 勤洗手有助於預防感冒。

sentences.en: Do you take frequent breaks when you study?
sentences.zh: 你讀書時會常常休息嗎？

gloss_note: in fright 嚇得…；stage fright 是怯場；美式少說 give a fright

sentences.en: A loud noise woke the baby, and she cried in fright.
sentences.zh: 巨大的聲響吵醒了寶寶，她嚇得哭了起來。

sentences.en: She screamed in fright when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 燈熄掉時，她嚇得尖叫。

sentences.en: Were you frozen with fright?
sentences.zh: 你是不是嚇呆了？

sentences.en: Was your dog shaking with fright during the thunder?
sentences.zh: 打雷時你的狗是不是嚇得發抖？

sentences.en: The kids ran off in fright when the dog barked.
sentences.zh: 狗一叫，孩子們嚇得跑開了。

sentences.en: Stage fright made his hands shake.
sentences.zh: 上台的緊張讓他的手發抖。

gloss_note: fuel 泛指燃料；一般人加油常說 gas

sentences.en: The truck was low on fuel, so we stopped at the next station.
sentences.zh: 卡車燃料快沒了，所以我們在下一個加油站停下來。

sentences.en: The plane is almost out of fuel.
sentences.zh: 飛機的燃料快用完了。

sentences.en: Why did fuel prices go up again this month?
sentences.zh: 這個月燃料價格為什麼又漲了？

sentences.en: Do electric cars use less fuel?
sentences.zh: 電動車用的燃料比較少嗎？

sentences.en: Dry wood is the best fuel for a campfire.
sentences.zh: 乾木頭是營火最好的燃料。

sentences.en: A good breakfast fuels your body for the day.
sentences.zh: 好的早餐為你一整天的身體提供能量。

gloss_note: raise funds 是募款

sentences.en: The school raised funds for a new library.
sentences.zh: 學校為新圖書館募款。

sentences.en: Our class started a fund to help a classmate.
sentences.zh: 我們班發起了一個基金來幫助一位同學。

sentences.en: Who will fund this research?
sentences.zh: 誰會資助這項研究？

sentences.en: I put some money into a retirement fund.
sentences.zh: 我把一些錢放進退休基金。

sentences.en: The project ran out of funds last month.
sentences.zh: 這個專案上個月經費用完了。

sentences.en: Do we have enough funds to buy new uniforms?
sentences.zh: 我們有足夠的經費買新制服嗎？

sentences.en: My cat's fur is soft and gray.
sentences.zh: 我的貓毛又軟又灰。

sentences.en: Dog fur is all over the couch.
sentences.zh: 沙發上到處都是狗毛。

sentences.en: Does this coat have real fur?
sentences.zh: 這件外套是真的毛皮嗎？

sentences.en: Does the rabbit's white fur blend into the snow?
sentences.zh: 兔子的白毛會融入雪地裡嗎？

sentences.en: Brush the dog's fur every few days.
sentences.zh: 每隔幾天就幫狗梳一次毛。

sentences.en: She wore a hat made of fake fur.
sentences.zh: 她戴了一頂人造毛皮做的帽子。

gloss_note: 美制約 3.8 公升，買牛奶、汽油常用

sentences.en: I bought a gallon of milk at the store.
sentences.zh: 我在店裡買了一加侖的牛奶。

sentences.en: How many miles per gallon does your car get?
sentences.zh: 你的車一加侖可以跑幾英里？

sentences.en: A gallon of gas costs about four dollars here.
sentences.zh: 這裡一加侖汽油大約四塊錢。

sentences.en: We need two gallons of paint for the room.
sentences.zh: 這個房間我們需要兩加侖的油漆。

sentences.en: The tank holds fifteen gallons.
sentences.zh: 這個油箱可以裝十五加侖。

sentences.en: Is a gallon bigger than a liter?
sentences.zh: 一加侖比一公升大嗎？

gloss_note: a gamble 常指有風險的決定

sentences.en: Many people gamble when they visit Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 許多人到拉斯維加斯會去賭博。

sentences.en: Starting a business is a big gamble.
sentences.zh: 創業是一場大冒險。

sentences.en: Would you gamble with your health?
sentences.zh: 你會拿自己的健康去冒險嗎？

sentences.en: The coach took a gamble and put in a new player.
sentences.zh: 教練冒險派上一名新球員。

sentences.en: Is it a good gamble to move to a new city?
sentences.zh: 搬到新城市是個值得的賭注嗎？

sentences.en: He never gambles because he knows the odds are bad.
sentences.zh: 他從不賭博，因為他知道勝算很低。

gloss_note: 口語可稱一夥朋友為 the gang

sentences.en: The whole gang is coming to the party tonight.
sentences.zh: 大夥今晚都會來參加派對。

sentences.en: Hey, gang, let's get started!
sentences.zh: 嘿，各位，我們開始吧！

sentences.en: Police broke up a gang that stole bikes.
sentences.zh: 警方破獲了一個偷腳踏車的幫派。

sentences.en: Are you coming with the gang to the movies?
sentences.zh: 你要跟大家一起去看電影嗎？

sentences.en: Is that gang of kids playing soccer in the street again?
sentences.zh: 那群孩子又在街上踢足球了嗎？

sentences.en: Some teens join a gang to feel like they belong.
sentences.zh: 有些青少年加入幫派是想找歸屬感。

gloss_note: mind the gap 為英國用語（美式 watch the gap）；gap year 是空檔年

sentences.en: There is a small gap under the door.
sentences.zh: 門底下有一道小縫。

sentences.en: Watch the gap between the train and the platform.
sentences.zh: 小心月台與列車之間的空隙。

sentences.en: Is the gap between rich and poor growing?
sentences.zh: 貧富差距是不是正在擴大？

sentences.en: Is there a big age gap between you two?
sentences.zh: 你們兩個年紀差很多嗎？

sentences.en: I took a gap year before college.
sentences.zh: 上大學前，我休了一年空檔年。

sentences.en: He closed the gap and tied the game.
sentences.zh: 他拉近差距，追平了比數。

gloss_note: 美式口語直接說 gas

sentences.en: Gasoline prices went up again this week.
sentences.zh: 這星期汽油價格又漲了。

sentences.en: Do not smoke anywhere near the gasoline.
sentences.zh: 別在汽油附近抽菸。

sentences.en: How many gallons of gasoline does your truck hold?
sentences.zh: 你的卡車油箱可以裝幾加侖的汽油？

sentences.en: The station sells three grades of gasoline.
sentences.zh: 這間加油站賣三種等級的汽油。

sentences.en: Does this hybrid car use less gasoline?
sentences.zh: 這台油電混合車比較省汽油嗎？

sentences.en: Gasoline is stored in a metal tank underground.
sentences.zh: 汽油被存放在地下的金屬槽裡。

gloss_note: at first glance 是乍看之下

sentences.en: She glanced at her watch and stood up.
sentences.zh: 她瞥了一眼手錶便站起來。

sentences.en: Take a quick glance at this photo.
sentences.zh: 快看一下這張照片。

sentences.en: Have you even glanced at the menu?
sentences.zh: 你到底有沒有看一下菜單？

sentences.en: Can you tell the answer at first glance?
sentences.zh: 你乍看之下就能說出答案嗎？

sentences.en: He glanced over his shoulder before crossing the street.
sentences.zh: 過馬路前，他回頭瞥了一眼。

sentences.en: I only had time for a glance at the news.
sentences.zh: 我只有時間匆匆看一眼新聞。

sentences.en: Global warming is a big problem.
sentences.zh: 全球暖化是個大問題。

sentences.en: The company has a global network of stores.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在全球都有分店。

sentences.en: Is this a global brand?
sentences.zh: 這是個全球性的品牌嗎？

sentences.en: Does the internet connect people on a global scale?
sentences.zh: 網路是不是把全世界的人連在一起？

sentences.en: Our class is learning about global trade.
sentences.zh: 我們班正在學全球貿易。

sentences.en: A global event like the Olympics gets worldwide attention.
sentences.zh: 像奧運這樣的全球盛事會受到世界關注。

gloss_note: 較正式，帶有文學色彩

sentences.en: The team fought for the glory of the school.
sentences.zh: 球隊為了學校的榮耀而奮戰。

sentences.en: She won glory by finishing the marathon.
sentences.zh: 她跑完馬拉松，贏得了榮耀。

sentences.en: What is glory without hard work?
sentences.zh: 沒有努力，哪來榮耀？

sentences.en: The old castle was once in its full glory.
sentences.zh: 這座古堡曾經風光一時。

sentences.en: The players enjoyed their moment of glory.
sentences.zh: 球員們享受著他們的光榮時刻。

sentences.en: Do you dream of fame and glory?
sentences.zh: 你夢想著成名和榮耀嗎？

sentences.en: The moon cast a soft glow over the lake.
sentences.zh: 月亮在湖面灑下柔和的光。

sentences.en: The stars glow brightly in the desert.
sentences.zh: 沙漠裡的星星閃耀著明亮的光。

sentences.en: Do these shoes glow in the dark?
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋在黑暗中會發光嗎？

sentences.en: Her face glowed with happiness.
sentences.zh: 她的臉上洋溢著幸福的光彩。

sentences.en: We sat by the warm glow of the fire.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在溫暖的火光旁。

sentences.en: Why is your phone screen glowing?
sentences.zh: 你的手機螢幕為什麼在發光？

gloss_note: gossip 也指愛說閒話的人

sentences.en: Don't believe the gossip you hear at school.
sentences.zh: 別相信你在學校聽到的閒話。

sentences.en: They gossip about everyone in the office.
sentences.zh: 他們在辦公室裡什麼人都拿來閒聊八卦。

sentences.en: Did you hear the latest gossip?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到最新的八卦嗎？

sentences.en: Do you like to gossip behind people's backs?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡在背後說人閒話嗎？

sentences.en: She is such a gossip!
sentences.zh: 她真愛說人閒話！

sentences.en: The magazine is full of celebrity gossip.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌滿是名人八卦。

gloss_note: 美國每州都有 governor

sentences.en: The governor gave a speech on TV.
sentences.zh: 州長在電視上發表了演說。

sentences.en: Who is the governor of your state?
sentences.zh: 你們州的州長是誰？

sentences.en: The governor signed the new law yesterday.
sentences.zh: 州長昨天簽署了新法案。

sentences.en: Our class visited the governor's office.
sentences.zh: 我們班參觀了州長辦公室。

sentences.en: The governor announced a plan to repair roads.
sentences.zh: 州長宣布了一項修路計畫。

sentences.en: Would you like to meet the governor?
sentences.zh: 你想見見州長嗎？

gloss_note: graduate from + 學校

sentences.en: She will graduate from high school in June.
sentences.zh: 她六月就要從高中畢業了。

sentences.en: My brother is a college graduate.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥是大學畢業生。

sentences.en: When exactly do you graduate this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年到底什麼時候畢業？

sentences.en: Graduates wore black gowns at the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 畢業生在典禮上穿著黑色學士袍。

sentences.en: He graduated from college with honors.
sentences.zh: 他以優異成績從大學畢業。

sentences.en: What do you want to do after you graduate?
sentences.zh: 你畢業後想做什麼？

gloss_note: grasp 也可指理解、掌握

sentences.en: She grasped the rope with both hands.
sentences.zh: 她用雙手抓緊繩子。

sentences.en: I can't grasp this math problem.
sentences.zh: 我搞不懂這題數學。

sentences.en: Do you grasp what the teacher said?
sentences.zh: 你聽懂老師說的話了嗎？

sentences.en: Can the baby grasp your finger tightly?
sentences.zh: 寶寶能緊緊抓住你的手指嗎？

sentences.en: The toy is just out of his grasp.
sentences.zh: 那個玩具就在他搆不到的地方。

sentences.en: He has a good grasp of English grammar.
sentences.zh: 他對英文文法掌握得很好。

sentences.en: A grasshopper jumped onto my shoe.
sentences.zh: 一隻蚱蜢跳到我的鞋子上。

sentences.en: Grasshoppers can jump far with their strong back legs.
sentences.zh: 蚱蜢能靠強壯的後腳跳得很遠。

sentences.en: Have you ever held a grasshopper?
sentences.zh: 你有拿過蚱蜢嗎？

sentences.en: The green grasshopper hid in the tall grass.
sentences.zh: 那隻綠色的蚱蜢躲在高高的草叢裡。

sentences.en: My little brother is afraid of grasshoppers.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟怕蚱蜢。

sentences.en: Why do grasshoppers jump so high?
sentences.zh: 蚱蜢為什麼跳得那麼高？

sentences.en: We had a picnic on a grassy hill.
sentences.zh: 我們在一座長滿草的小山丘上野餐。

sentences.en: The grassy field behind school is perfect for soccer.
sentences.zh: 學校後面那片草地很適合踢足球。

sentences.en: Is there a grassy spot near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有草地嗎？

sentences.en: Does the path run through a grassy valley?
sentences.zh: 那條小路是穿過一座綠草如茵的山谷嗎？

sentences.en: Deer rested on the grassy bank of the river.
sentences.zh: 鹿在長滿草的河岸邊休息。

sentences.en: Let's sit on that grassy area over there.
sentences.zh: 我們去坐在那邊那塊草地上吧。

gloss_note: greenhouse effect 是溫室效應

sentences.en: Tomatoes grow well in the greenhouse.
sentences.zh: 番茄在溫室裡長得很好。

sentences.en: The greenhouse stays warm even in winter.
sentences.zh: 溫室即使在冬天也很溫暖。

sentences.en: Dad built a small greenhouse in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在後院蓋了一間小溫室。

sentences.en: Can I visit the greenhouse at the botanical garden?
sentences.zh: 我可以參觀植物園的溫室嗎？

sentences.en: Flowers bloom early in a greenhouse.
sentences.zh: 花在溫室裡開得比較早。

sentences.en: Why is it so hot in the greenhouse?
sentences.zh: 溫室裡為什麼這麼熱？

sentences.en: He had a big grin on his face.
sentences.zh: 他臉上掛著大大的笑容。

sentences.en: She grinned when she saw the cake.
sentences.zh: 她看到蛋糕就咧嘴笑了。

sentences.en: Why are you grinning like that?
sentences.zh: 你幹嘛笑成那樣？

sentences.en: Why did the kids grin at each other?
sentences.zh: 孩子們為什麼彼此咧嘴對笑？

sentences.en: With a wide grin, he held up the trophy.
sentences.zh: 他咧嘴大笑，高舉獎盃。

sentences.en: Stop grinning and tell me the news!
sentences.zh: 別傻笑了，快告訴我消息！

gloss_note: 常用複數 groceries 指買回家的食品

sentences.en: I need to buy groceries after work.
sentences.zh: 我下班後要去買菜和日用品。

sentences.en: The grocery store closes at ten.
sentences.zh: 那家超市十點打烊。

sentences.en: Can you carry the grocery bags inside?
sentences.zh: 你可以把雜貨袋提進屋裡嗎？

sentences.en: Do you do your grocery shopping on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你都是週末去採買日用品嗎？

sentences.en: We keep a grocery list on the fridge.
sentences.zh: 我們把採買清單貼在冰箱上。

sentences.en: Grocery prices keep going up.
sentences.zh: 日用食品的價格一直在漲。

audio.artist:
Speaker: Flame, not lame
Recorder: Flame, not lame

gloss_note: 不可數；guidance counselor 是輔導老師

sentences.en: The students need guidance from their teacher.
sentences.zh: 學生需要老師的指導。

sentences.en: She gave me good guidance on choosing a college.
sentences.zh: 她在我選大學時給了我很好的建議。

sentences.en: Where can I get guidance about careers?
sentences.zh: 我可以去哪裡得到職涯方面的輔導？

sentences.en: Under her guidance, the team improved fast.
sentences.zh: 在她的指導下，球隊進步很快。

sentences.en: Parents should offer guidance, not orders.
sentences.zh: 父母應該提供引導，而不是下命令。

sentences.en: Do you need any guidance with this form?
sentences.zh: 填這張表格需要任何協助嗎？

gloss_note: gum 也指牙齦；完整名稱是 chewing gum

sentences.en: Can I have a piece of gum?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一片口香糖嗎？

sentences.en: Don't chew gum in class.
sentences.zh: 上課不要嚼口香糖。

sentences.en: I stepped on gum on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 我在人行道上踩到了口香糖。

sentences.en: Do you have any mint gum?
sentences.zh: 你有薄荷口香糖嗎？

sentences.en: He blew a big bubble with his gum.
sentences.zh: 他用口香糖吹出一個大泡泡。

sentences.en: The coach chews gum during every game.
sentences.zh: 教練每場比賽都會嚼口香糖。

gloss_note: 美式也常說 hairstylist

sentences.en: My hairdresser cut my hair short.
sentences.zh: 我的美髮師把我的頭髮剪短了。

sentences.en: Do you have an appointment with the hairdresser?
sentences.zh: 你有跟美髮師預約嗎？

sentences.en: She works as a hairdresser downtown.
sentences.zh: 她在市區當美髮師。

sentences.en: I'll ask my hairdresser about a new style.
sentences.zh: 我要問問我的美髮師有什麼新髮型。

sentences.en: The hairdresser washed and dried my hair.
sentences.zh: 美髮師幫我洗頭並吹乾。

sentences.en: How often do you visit the hairdresser?
sentences.zh: 你多久去一次美髮院？

gloss_note: 美式常說 hallway，英式多說 corridor

sentences.en: Please don't run in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 請不要在走廊上奔跑。

sentences.en: The hallway was full of students between classes.
sentences.zh: 下課時走廊上擠滿了學生。

sentences.en: Is the bathroom down the hallway?
sentences.zh: 廁所在走廊那頭嗎？

sentences.en: Does your apartment have a long hallway?
sentences.zh: 你住的公寓有一條很長的走廊嗎？

sentences.en: She left her shoes in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 她把鞋子留在走廊上。

sentences.en: We met in the hallway after class.
sentences.zh: 下課後我們在走廊碰面。

gloss_note: a handful of + 名詞

sentences.en: She grabbed a handful of popcorn from the bowl.
sentences.zh: 她從碗裡抓了一把爆米花。

sentences.en: Only a handful of students passed the test.
sentences.zh: 只有少數幾個學生通過了考試。

sentences.en: Can I have a handful of those grapes?
sentences.zh: 我可以拿一把那些葡萄嗎？

sentences.en: Just a handful of people showed up to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 只有寥寥幾個人來開會。

sentences.en: Do you have a handful of coins for the meter?
sentences.zh: 你有一把零錢可以投停車計時器嗎？

sentences.en: A handful of fans waited outside the theater in the rain.
sentences.zh: 有一小群粉絲在雨中等在戲院外面。

gloss_note: come in handy 派上用場；keep ... handy 放在手邊

sentences.en: This little knife is really handy for camping.
sentences.zh: 這把小刀露營時真的很好用。

sentences.en: Keep a flashlight handy in case the power goes out.
sentences.zh: 把手電筒放在手邊，以防停電。

sentences.en: Do you think this old umbrella will come in handy today?
sentences.zh: 你覺得這把舊雨傘今天會派上用場嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a handy place to park near the school?
sentences.zh: 學校附近有方便停車的地方嗎？

sentences.en: A phone charger is handy when you travel.
sentences.zh: 旅行時有個手機充電器很方便。

sentences.en: The new app is super handy for ordering lunch.
sentences.zh: 這個新的應用程式訂午餐超方便。

gloss_note: harbor a grudge 懷恨；英式拼 harbour

sentences.en: The boats came back to the harbor before the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，船都回到港口了。

sentences.en: We watched the sunset over the harbor.
sentences.zh: 我們看著夕陽落在港口上方。

sentences.en: Is the harbor open to tourists on weekends?
sentences.zh: 這個港口週末開放給遊客嗎？

sentences.en: Many ships were waiting in the harbor for the fog to clear.
sentences.zh: 許多船隻在港內等霧散去。

sentences.en: Why would you harbor a grudge against your best friend?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼會對最好的朋友懷恨在心？

sentences.en: She harbors no hard feelings about what happened.
sentences.zh: 她對發生的事沒有任何芥蒂。

gloss_note: do harm 造成傷害；There's no harm in ...

sentences.en: Don't worry, the dog won't do you any harm.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，這隻狗不會傷害你的。

sentences.en: Eating too much sugar can harm your teeth.
sentences.zh: 吃太多糖會傷害牙齒。

sentences.en: What harm could one little question do?
sentences.zh: 問一個小問題能有什麼壞處？

sentences.en: There's no harm in asking for a discount.
sentences.zh: 問問看能不能打折也無妨。

sentences.en: The new rules are meant to protect children from harm.
sentences.zh: 新規定是為了保護孩子不受傷害。

sentences.en: Did the storm cause any harm to your garden?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨有傷到你的花園嗎？

gloss_note: be harmful to + 名詞

sentences.en: Too much screen time can be harmful to your eyes.
sentences.zh: 看螢幕太久可能對眼睛有害。

sentences.en: Is this cleaning product harmful to pets?
sentences.zh: 這個清潔劑對寵物有害嗎？

sentences.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.
sentences.zh: 吸菸有害健康。

sentences.en: Some chemicals in the river are harmful to fish.
sentences.zh: 河裡有些化學物質對魚有害。

sentences.en: Are energy drinks harmful to teenagers?
sentences.zh: 能量飲料對青少年有害嗎？

sentences.en: Experts warn that harmful rumors spread quickly online.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，有害的謠言在網路上傳得很快。

gloss_note: harvest season 收穫季

sentences.en: Farmers are busy with the corn harvest this month.
sentences.zh: 農夫這個月忙著收玉米。

sentences.en: We harvested apples from the old tree last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們上週末從老樹上採了蘋果。

sentences.en: When do you harvest the rice in your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你家鄉什麼時候收割稻米？

sentences.en: The cold weather ruined this year's harvest.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的天氣毀了今年的收成。

sentences.en: Grandpa grows tomatoes and harvests them in August.
sentences.zh: 爺爺種番茄，八月採收。

sentences.en: How was the harvest this year?
sentences.zh: 今年收成如何？

gloss_note: 常見 hasty decision；Haste makes waste.

sentences.en: Don't make a hasty decision about your major.
sentences.zh: 選主修時不要草率做決定。

sentences.en: I'm sorry; what I said yesterday was hasty.
sentences.zh: 對不起，我昨天說的話太衝動了。

sentences.en: Was it a hasty choice, or did you think about it?
sentences.zh: 那是倉促的決定，還是你想過了？

sentences.en: The team made a hasty exit when the alarm rang.
sentences.zh: 警報響起時，隊員們匆忙離開。

sentences.en: Shouldn't we check the facts first instead of being hasty?
sentences.zh: 我們不是應該先查證事實，而不是草率下結論嗎？

sentences.en: Don't give hasty answers on a test, or you'll lose points.
sentences.zh: 考試時不要草率作答，不然會被扣分。

gloss_note: hatch out 孵出；常見 eggs hatch

sentences.en: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
sentences.zh: 這些蛋大約三週後會孵化。

sentences.en: When did the baby chicks hatch?
sentences.zh: 小雞是什麼時候孵出來的？

sentences.en: A tiny turtle hatched on the beach last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚海灘上孵出了一隻小海龜。

sentences.en: How long does it take for a duck egg to hatch?
sentences.zh: 鴨蛋要多久才會孵化？

sentences.en: The chicks hatched just before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 小雞在日出前不久孵出來了。

sentences.en: Mom says don't count your chickens before they hatch.
sentences.zh: 媽媽說，雞蛋還沒孵出來，別先數有幾隻小雞，意思是別高興得太早。

gloss_note: hateful comments 惡毒的留言

sentences.en: That was a hateful thing to say to your sister.
sentences.zh: 對你妹妹說那種話太惡毒了。

sentences.en: Why did he write such hateful comments online?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼要在網路上寫那麼惡毒的留言？

sentences.en: The villain in the movie is a cruel and hateful man.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的反派是個殘忍又可恨的人。

sentences.en: Hateful messages have no place in our school.
sentences.zh: 惡意訊息在我們學校沒有容身之地。

sentences.en: Don't be so hateful; she was only trying to help.
sentences.zh: 別那麼刻薄，她只是想幫忙。

sentences.en: Do you think that was a hateful joke?
sentences.zh: 你覺得那是個惡毒的玩笑嗎？

gloss_note: hay fever 花粉熱（過敏）

sentences.en: The farmer loaded hay onto the truck.
sentences.zh: 農夫把乾草裝上卡車。

sentences.en: The horses are eating hay in the barn.
sentences.zh: 馬在穀倉裡吃乾草。

sentences.en: Can we jump into that pile of hay?
sentences.zh: 我們可以跳進那堆乾草裡嗎？

sentences.en: Where do you keep the hay for the cows?
sentences.zh: 你們把牛的乾草放在哪裡？

sentences.en: Dry hay can catch fire easily in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天乾草很容易起火。

sentences.en: We sat on bales of hay at the fall festival.
sentences.zh: 我們在秋季慶典坐在乾草捆上。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortybot assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: news headline 新聞標題；make headlines 上頭條

sentences.en: The headline says the bridge will reopen on Monday.
sentences.zh: 標題寫著橋梁週一會重新開放。

sentences.en: Did you see the headline on the front page this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上看到頭版的標題了嗎？

sentences.en: I only read the headlines on my phone before work.
sentences.zh: 上班前我只用手機看新聞標題。

sentences.en: What was the top headline on the news last night?
sentences.zh: 昨晚新聞的頭條是什麼？

sentences.en: That headline is misleading; the story says something else.
sentences.zh: 那個標題誤導人，內文講的是別的事。

sentences.en: A funny headline caught my eye in the newspaper.
sentences.zh: 報紙上一個好笑的標題吸引了我的目光。

gloss_note: 形式為複數但常當單數用

sentences.en: The company's headquarters is in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的總部在西雅圖。

sentences.en: Where is the headquarters of your company?
sentences.zh: 你們公司的總部在哪裡？

sentences.en: She got a call from headquarters this morning.
sentences.zh: 她今天早上接到總部的電話。

sentences.en: The company's downtown headquarters is closed for the holiday.
sentences.zh: 公司位於市中心的總部因假日休息。

sentences.en: Do you work at the main headquarters or at a branch?
sentences.zh: 你在總部上班，還是在分公司？

sentences.en: The company moved its headquarters to Texas last year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司去年把總部搬到德州。

gloss_note: heal up 痊癒；Time heals all wounds.

sentences.en: It took six weeks for my broken arm to heal.
sentences.zh: 我骨折的手臂花了六週才痊癒。

sentences.en: Grandma always says time heals all wounds.
sentences.zh: 奶奶常說時間會治癒一切傷痛。

sentences.en: How long will it take for the cut to heal?
sentences.zh: 這個傷口要多久才會癒合？

sentences.en: A good night's sleep helps your body heal.
sentences.zh: 睡得好有助於身體復原。

sentences.en: Has your knee healed yet?
sentences.zh: 你的膝蓋好了嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor said the burn would heal in a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 醫生說燙傷幾週內就會好。

gloss_note: a heap of / heaps of 大量（口語）

sentences.en: There's a heap of dirty clothes on your floor.
sentences.zh: 你地板上有一堆髒衣服。

sentences.en: He heaped mashed potatoes onto my plate.
sentences.zh: 他在我的盤子上堆了滿滿的馬鈴薯泥。

sentences.en: Why is there a heap of boxes in the hallway?
sentences.zh: 為什麼走廊上有一堆箱子？

sentences.en: We raked the leaves into a big heap.
sentences.zh: 我們把落葉耙成一大堆。

sentences.en: Don't heap all the blame on him.
sentences.zh: 別把所有責任都推到他身上。

sentences.en: Who left this heap of mail at our door?
sentences.zh: 是誰把這一大堆信放在我們門口？

gloss_note: 高跟鞋常用複數 heels

sentences.en: I have a blister on my left heel.
sentences.zh: 我的左腳跟起水泡了。

sentences.en: These high heels really hurt my feet.
sentences.zh: 這雙高跟鞋讓我的腳好痛。

sentences.en: Can you fix the heel of this shoe?
sentences.zh: 你可以修這隻鞋的鞋跟嗎？

sentences.en: She turned on her heel and walked out of the room.
sentences.zh: 她猛然轉身走出房間。

sentences.en: Do these boots have a thick heel?
sentences.zh: 這雙靴子的鞋跟很粗嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse checked the sore on his heel.
sentences.zh: 護理師檢查了他腳跟的傷口。

gloss_note: wear a helmet 戴安全帽

sentences.en: Always wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 騎腳踏車時一定要戴安全帽。

sentences.en: Where did you put your helmet?
sentences.zh: 你把安全帽放哪了？

sentences.en: The football player's helmet cracked during the game.
sentences.zh: 那名美式足球球員的頭盔在比賽中裂了。

sentences.en: Do I need a helmet for this ride?
sentences.zh: 這趟我需要戴安全帽嗎？

sentences.en: The construction workers all wore yellow helmets.
sentences.zh: 工地的工人都戴著黃色安全帽。

sentences.en: My helmet protected me when I fell off my scooter.
sentences.zh: 我從滑板車上摔下來時，安全帽保護了我。

gloss_note: Don't hesitate to + 動詞（儘管開口）

sentences.en: Don't hesitate to call me if you need help.
sentences.zh: 需要幫忙儘管打給我。

sentences.en: She hesitated before answering the question.
sentences.zh: 她回答問題前遲疑了一下。

sentences.en: Why do you hesitate every time I ask you to sing?
sentences.zh: 為什麼每次我請你唱歌你都猶豫？

sentences.en: If you hesitate, you might lose the chance.
sentences.zh: 你要是猶豫，可能就錯失機會了。

sentences.en: Did he hesitate when you asked him to join?
sentences.zh: 你邀他加入時，他有猶豫嗎？

sentences.en: Customers hesitate to buy when prices keep changing.
sentences.zh: 價格一直變動時，顧客會猶豫不敢買。

gloss_note: drop a hint 暗示；give a hint 給提示

sentences.en: Can you give me a hint about the answer?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我一點答案的提示嗎？

sentences.en: She hinted that she might quit her job.
sentences.zh: 她暗示自己可能會辭職。

sentences.en: Dad dropped a hint about my birthday present.
sentences.zh: 爸爸暗示了一下我的生日禮物是什麼。

sentences.en: The teacher gave a hint before the quiz started.
sentences.zh: 小考開始前老師給了一個提示。

sentences.en: Was that a hint that I should leave?
sentences.zh: 那是在暗示我該走了嗎？

sentences.en: He hinted that we should leave early.
sentences.zh: 他暗示我們該早點離開。

sentences.en: My uncle is a historian at a local college.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是當地一所大學的歷史學家。

sentences.en: The historian wrote a book about the old railroad.
sentences.zh: 那位歷史學家寫了一本關於老鐵路的書。

sentences.en: Do you want to be a historian when you grow up?
sentences.zh: 你長大後想當歷史學家嗎？

sentences.en: Historians still argue about how the old city fell.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論那座古城是怎麼衰亡的。

sentences.en: What does the historian say about that old bridge?
sentences.zh: 那位歷史學家怎麼說那座老橋？

sentences.en: A famous historian spoke at our school today.
sentences.zh: 一位知名的歷史學家今天來我們學校演講。

gloss_note: 常見複合字：cup holder、ticket holder

sentences.en: Please put your cup in the cup holder.
sentences.zh: 請把你的杯子放進杯架。

sentences.en: Are you a ticket holder for tonight's game?
sentences.zh: 你有今晚比賽的票嗎？

sentences.en: Each card holder gets a ten percent discount.
sentences.zh: 每位持卡人可享九折優惠。

sentences.en: Passport holders can use the fast line.
sentences.zh: 持護照的人可以走快速通道。

sentences.en: Where did you put the toothbrush holder?
sentences.zh: 你把牙刷架放哪了？

sentences.en: She is the record holder in the 100-meter race.
sentences.zh: 她是一百公尺賽跑的紀錄保持人。

gloss_note: sound hollow 聽起來空洞

sentences.en: The old tree trunk is hollow inside.
sentences.zh: 這棵老樹的樹幹裡面是空的。

sentences.en: Chocolate bunnies are usually hollow.
sentences.zh: 巧克力兔通常是空心的。

sentences.en: Is this wall hollow? It sounds odd when I knock.
sentences.zh: 這面牆是空心的嗎？我敲起來聲音怪怪的。

sentences.en: A squirrel lives in that hollow log.
sentences.zh: 有隻松鼠住在那根中空的木頭裡。

sentences.en: His promise sounded hollow after what happened.
sentences.zh: 發生那些事之後，他的承諾聽起來很空洞。

sentences.en: Are these metal pipes hollow or solid?
sentences.zh: 這些金屬管是空心的還是實心的？

gloss_note: 口語驚嘆 Holy cow! 天啊！

sentences.en: The temple is a holy place for many people.
sentences.zh: 這座廟對許多人來說是神聖的地方。

sentences.en: Holy cow, that is the biggest pizza I've ever seen!
sentences.zh: 天啊，這是我看過最大的披薩！

sentences.en: Why is this mountain holy to the local people?
sentences.zh: 為什麼這座山對當地人來說是聖山？

sentences.en: Visitors travel to the holy site from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 遊客從世界各地前來這處聖地。

sentences.en: Is that river a holy place for the villagers?
sentences.zh: 那條河是村民心中的聖地嗎？

sentences.en: Many cultures have a holy day for rest.
sentences.zh: 許多文化都有一個神聖的休息日。

sentences.en: I'm going back to my hometown for the holidays.
sentences.zh: 假期我要回家鄉。

sentences.en: Where is your hometown, by the way?
sentences.zh: 對了，你的家鄉在哪裡？

sentences.en: My hometown is small, but everyone knows each other.
sentences.zh: 我家鄉很小，但大家都互相認識。

sentences.en: Do you miss your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你想念家鄉嗎？

sentences.en: The singer became famous and returned to her hometown as a star.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手成名後，以明星之姿回到家鄉。

sentences.en: The team's hometown crowd cheered loudly all night.
sentences.zh: 球隊的家鄉球迷整晚大聲歡呼。

gloss_note: It's an honor to ...；英式拼 honour

sentences.en: It's an honor to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很榮幸見到你。

sentences.en: The school will honor the winning team on Friday.
sentences.zh: 學校週五會表揚獲勝的球隊。

sentences.en: Would you do me the honor of joining us?
sentences.zh: 你願意賞光和我們一起嗎？

sentences.en: She graduated with honors from a state university.
sentences.zh: 她以優異成績從州立大學畢業。

sentences.en: We honor veterans every November.
sentences.zh: 每年十一月我們都會向退伍軍人致敬。

sentences.en: Is it a great honor to win this prize?
sentences.zh: 得到這個獎是很大的榮譽嗎？

gloss_note: be hopeful about/that ...

sentences.en: I'm hopeful that we'll win the game.
sentences.zh: 我希望我們能贏這場比賽。

sentences.en: Are you hopeful about the job interview?
sentences.zh: 你對這場面試有信心嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor sounded hopeful about her recovery.
sentences.zh: 醫生對她的復原感到樂觀。
