sentences.en: Do things look hopeful after the meeting?
sentences.zh: 開完會後，情況看起來樂觀嗎？

sentences.en: She stayed hopeful even after the long delay.
sentences.zh: 即使延遲了這麼久，她仍抱著希望。

sentences.en: I'm hopeful that it will stop raining soon.
sentences.zh: 我希望雨很快就會停。

gloss_note: honk the horn 按喇叭

sentences.en: The driver honked the horn at the slow truck.
sentences.zh: 司機對那輛慢吞吞的卡車按了喇叭。

sentences.en: Please don't honk your horn at night.
sentences.zh: 請不要在晚上按喇叭。

sentences.en: A rhino has a big horn on its nose.
sentences.zh: 犀牛的鼻子上有一隻大角。

sentences.en: Can you play the French horn?
sentences.zh: 你會吹法國號嗎？

sentences.en: Did you hear that horn outside?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到外面那聲喇叭嗎？

sentences.en: The goat has two curved horns.
sentences.zh: 那隻山羊有兩隻彎曲的角。

gloss_note: horror movie 恐怖片；in horror 驚恐地

sentences.en: We watched a horror movie on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 我們週五晚上看了一部恐怖片。

sentences.en: She screamed in horror when she saw the spider.
sentences.zh: 她看到蜘蛛時驚恐地尖叫。

sentences.en: Do you like horror stories?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡恐怖故事嗎？

sentences.en: To my horror, I realized I'd lost my wallet.
sentences.zh: 我驚恐地發現自己弄丟了皮夾。

sentences.en: Why did he look at us in horror?
sentences.zh: 他為什麼驚恐地看著我們？

sentences.en: The crowd watched in horror as the ride suddenly stopped.
sentences.zh: 遊樂設施突然停住時，群眾驚恐地看著。

gloss_note: hourly wage 時薪；hourly rate 每小時費用

sentences.en: The bus runs hourly on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末公車每小時一班。

sentences.en: Does the shuttle leave hourly?
sentences.zh: 接駁車每小時發一班嗎？

sentences.en: I get paid an hourly wage.
sentences.zh: 我領的是時薪。

sentences.en: What's the hourly rate for this job?
sentences.zh: 這份工作的時薪是多少？

sentences.en: The radio gives hourly weather updates.
sentences.zh: 電台每小時都有天氣更新。

sentences.en: The nurse checks his temperature hourly.
sentences.zh: 護理師每小時量一次他的體溫。

gloss_note: 美式：飯店房務員或家事幫傭

sentences.en: The housekeeper cleans our house every Thursday.
sentences.zh: 幫傭每週四來打掃我們家。

sentences.en: The hotel housekeeper left fresh towels in the room.
sentences.zh: 飯店房務員在房裡放了乾淨的毛巾。

sentences.en: Can you ask the housekeeper to bring extra pillows?
sentences.zh: 你可以請房務員多送幾個枕頭來嗎？

sentences.en: Our housekeeper is very kind and hardworking.
sentences.zh: 我們的管家人很好又勤奮。

sentences.en: Does the hotel have a housekeeper on duty at night?
sentences.zh: 飯店晚上有房務員值班嗎？

sentences.en: She worked as a housekeeper in a big hotel for ten years.
sentences.zh: 她在一家大飯店當了十年的房務員。

gloss_note: hum a tune 哼曲子

sentences.en: She hums while she cooks dinner.
sentences.zh: 她煮晚餐時會哼歌。

sentences.en: Why are you humming that song again?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼又在哼那首歌？

sentences.en: Dad hummed along to the radio in the car.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在車上跟著收音機哼歌。

sentences.en: Stop humming; I'm trying to study.
sentences.zh: 別哼了，我在念書。

sentences.en: Can you hum the tune for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以哼那段旋律給我聽嗎？

sentences.en: The baby hummed quietly before falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 寶寶睡著前輕輕地哼著。

sentences.en: The hikers slept in a small wooden hut.
sentences.zh: 登山客睡在一間木造小屋裡。

sentences.en: There's an old hut by the lake.
sentences.zh: 湖邊有一間舊小屋。

sentences.en: Who built this hut in the middle of the forest?
sentences.zh: 誰在森林中間蓋了這間小屋？

sentences.en: We stayed in a beach hut during our trip.
sentences.zh: 我們旅行時住在海灘小屋。

sentences.en: Is that hut still used by the farmers?
sentences.zh: 那間小屋農夫還在用嗎？

sentences.en: Smoke rose from the chimney of the hut.
sentences.zh: 小屋的煙囪冒出煙來。

gloss_note: icy road 結冰的路；icy stare 冰冷的眼神

sentences.en: Be careful; the road is icy this morning.
sentences.zh: 小心，今天早上路面結冰。

sentences.en: An icy wind blew across the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 一陣冰冷的風吹過停車場。

sentences.en: Are the sidewalks icy near your house?
sentences.zh: 你家附近的人行道有結冰嗎？

sentences.en: She gave me an icy stare.
sentences.zh: 她冷冷地瞪了我一眼。

sentences.en: The lake was icy, so nobody went swimming.
sentences.zh: 湖面結冰，所以沒人去游泳。

sentences.en: Can you drive safely on icy roads?
sentences.zh: 你能在結冰的路上安全開車嗎？

gloss_note: use your imagination 發揮想像力

sentences.en: Kids have a great imagination.
sentences.zh: 小孩的想像力很豐富。

sentences.en: Use your imagination and draw anything you like.
sentences.zh: 發揮想像力，畫你喜歡的任何東西。

sentences.en: Is it real, or is it just your imagination?
sentences.zh: 那是真的，還是你自己想像出來的？

sentences.en: The story sparked my imagination.
sentences.zh: 這個故事激發了我的想像力。

sentences.en: Does reading help build a child's imagination?
sentences.zh: 閱讀有助於培養孩子的想像力嗎？

sentences.en: It's all in your imagination; nobody is following you.
sentences.zh: 那都是你想像的，沒有人在跟蹤你。

gloss_note: immediate family 直系親屬

sentences.en: The patient needs immediate care.
sentences.zh: 這位病人需要立即的照護。

sentences.en: Please give me an immediate answer.
sentences.zh: 請立刻給我答覆。

sentences.en: Is there an immediate need for more staff?
sentences.zh: 現在有立刻增加人手的需要嗎？

sentences.en: Only my immediate family came to the party.
sentences.zh: 只有我的直系親屬來參加派對。

sentences.en: The new rule had an immediate effect on traffic.
sentences.zh: 新規定馬上對交通產生了影響。

sentences.en: What are your immediate plans after graduation?
sentences.zh: 你畢業後近期有什麼計畫？

gloss_note: 反義 export 出口；名詞重音在前

sentences.en: The U.S. imports a lot of coffee.
sentences.zh: 美國進口大量咖啡。

sentences.en: Where do you import these fruits from?
sentences.zh: 你們這些水果是從哪裡進口的？

sentences.en: Imports from overseas have become more expensive.
sentences.zh: 來自海外的進口品變貴了。

sentences.en: We import most of our furniture from abroad.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分的家具都是從國外進口的。

sentences.en: Does this shop sell imports from Italy?
sentences.zh: 這家店有賣義大利進口的商品嗎？

sentences.en: This car is an import from Germany.
sentences.zh: 這輛車是從德國進口的。

gloss_note: be impressed by/with ...

sentences.en: Her singing really impressed the judges.
sentences.zh: 她的歌聲讓評審印象深刻。

sentences.en: I tried to impress my new boss.
sentences.zh: 我努力想給新老闆留下好印象。

sentences.en: How did he impress you so much?
sentences.zh: 他是怎麼讓你這麼佩服的？

sentences.en: Don't try to impress people; just be yourself.
sentences.zh: 別刻意想讓別人佩服你，做自己就好。

sentences.en: Did the movie impress you?
sentences.zh: 這部電影讓你印象深刻嗎？

sentences.en: Their quick reply impressed the customers.
sentences.zh: 他們迅速的回覆讓顧客印象深刻。

gloss_note: 反義 outdoor 戶外的

sentences.en: We played an indoor game because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，我們玩了室內遊戲。

sentences.en: Is there an indoor pool near here?
sentences.zh: 這附近有室內游泳池嗎？

sentences.en: Indoor plants need less sunlight.
sentences.zh: 室內植物需要的陽光比較少。

sentences.en: He joined the indoor soccer team at school.
sentences.zh: 他加入了學校的室內足球隊。

sentences.en: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor sports?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡室內還是戶外運動？

sentences.en: The mall has a big indoor playground.
sentences.zh: 那間購物中心有個很大的室內遊樂場。

gloss_note: go indoors 進屋；stay indoors 待在室內

sentences.en: Stay indoors until the storm passes.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過去前待在室內。

sentences.en: Let's go indoors; it's getting cold.
sentences.zh: 我們進屋吧，天氣越來越冷了。

sentences.en: Why are you sitting indoors on such a nice day?
sentences.zh: 天氣這麼好，你怎麼待在室內？

sentences.en: Can we eat indoors, please?
sentences.zh: 我們可以在室內吃嗎？

sentences.en: The kids played indoors all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 孩子們整個下午都在室內玩。

sentences.en: Smoking is not allowed indoors.
sentences.zh: 室內禁止吸菸。

gloss_note: industrial area 工業區

sentences.en: This city has a large industrial area.
sentences.zh: 這座城市有一大片工業區。

sentences.en: Industrial waste must be cleaned before it enters the river.
sentences.zh: 工業廢棄物必須先處理，才能排入河裡。

sentences.en: Is your factory using industrial robots?
sentences.zh: 你們工廠有在用工業機器人嗎？

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution changed how people worked.
sentences.zh: 工業革命改變了人們工作的方式。

sentences.en: Where is the industrial park in your town?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上的工業園區在哪裡？

sentences.en: They bought an industrial mixer for the bakery.
sentences.zh: 他們為麵包店買了一台工業用攪拌機。

gloss_note: inferior to + 名詞（不用 than）

sentences.en: This copy is inferior to the original.
sentences.zh: 這個複製品比不上原件。

sentences.en: Don't let anyone make you feel inferior.
sentences.zh: 別讓任何人讓你覺得自己不如人。

sentences.en: Is this brand inferior to the other one?
sentences.zh: 這個牌子比另一個差嗎？

sentences.en: Cheap, inferior materials won't last long.
sentences.zh: 便宜的劣質材料用不久。

sentences.en: Why do you think your work is inferior?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼覺得你的作品比較差？

sentences.en: He felt inferior next to his older brother.
sentences.zh: 站在哥哥旁邊，他覺得自己不如人。

gloss_note: inform sb of/about sth；keep sb informed

sentences.en: Please inform me if the schedule changes.
sentences.zh: 行程有變動請通知我。

sentences.en: The school informed parents about the new rule.
sentences.zh: 學校把新規定通知了家長。

sentences.en: Who informed you about the meeting?
sentences.zh: 是誰通知你開會的？

sentences.en: I'm sorry to inform you that your flight was canceled.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉通知您，您的班機取消了。

sentences.en: Have you informed your boss yet?
sentences.zh: 你已經告知你老闆了嗎？

sentences.en: Keep me informed about the situation.
sentences.zh: 有狀況隨時讓我知道。

gloss_note: knee injury 膝傷；suffer an injury 受傷

sentences.en: He missed the game because of a knee injury.
sentences.zh: 他因為膝蓋受傷而缺席比賽。

sentences.en: Did anyone suffer a serious injury in the crash?
sentences.zh: 這起車禍有人受重傷嗎？

sentences.en: The injury healed faster than the doctor expected.
sentences.zh: 傷勢比醫生預期的好得更快。

sentences.en: How did you get that injury on your arm?
sentences.zh: 你手臂上的傷是怎麼來的？

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injury.
sentences.zh: 戴安全帽可以預防頭部受傷。

sentences.en: Fortunately, there were no injuries in the fire.
sentences.zh: 幸好這場火災沒有人受傷。

gloss_note: innocent of + 罪名；反義 guilty

sentences.en: The jury found him innocent of all charges.
sentences.zh: 陪審團認定他所有罪名都不成立。

sentences.en: I'm innocent; I never touched your phone!
sentences.zh: 我是無辜的，我根本沒碰過你的手機！

sentences.en: Is she really innocent, or is she lying?
sentences.zh: 她真的是清白的，還是在說謊？

sentences.en: Innocent people shouldn't have to pay for this.
sentences.zh: 無辜的人不該為此付出代價。

sentences.en: The little kid asked an innocent question.
sentences.zh: 那個小孩問了一個天真的問題。

sentences.en: Do you believe he's innocent?
sentences.zh: 你相信他是清白的嗎？

sentences.en: The officer inspected our bags at the gate.
sentences.zh: 工作人員在登機門檢查了我們的包包。

sentences.en: Please inspect the car before you buy it.
sentences.zh: 買車之前請先檢查車況。

sentences.en: Who inspects the restaurants in this city?
sentences.zh: 這座城市的餐廳是誰在檢查的？

sentences.en: The landlord inspected the apartment before we moved out.
sentences.zh: 我們搬走前，房東檢查了這間公寓。

sentences.en: Can I inspect the package first?
sentences.zh: 我可以先檢查一下包裹嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher inspected each desk before the test.
sentences.zh: 老師在考試前檢查了每張桌子。

gloss_note: health inspector 衛生檢查員

sentences.en: The health inspector visited the restaurant today.
sentences.zh: 衛生檢查員今天到餐廳視察。

sentences.en: An inspector checked the elevator last week.
sentences.zh: 上週有檢查員來檢查電梯。

sentences.en: Is the building inspector coming tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 建築檢查員明天會來嗎？

sentences.en: The fire inspector asked everyone a few questions.
sentences.zh: 消防檢查員問了每個人幾個問題。

sentences.en: When will the inspector arrive?
sentences.zh: 檢查員什麼時候會到？

sentences.en: The inspector found a problem with the brakes.
sentences.zh: 檢查員發現煞車有問題。

sentences.en: Who was the inventor of the telephone?
sentences.zh: 電話的發明者是誰？

sentences.en: My grandfather was an inventor.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺是個發明家。

sentences.en: The young inventor won first prize at the science fair.
sentences.zh: 那位年輕發明家在科展拿到第一名。

sentences.en: Do you want to be an inventor someday?
sentences.zh: 你將來想當發明家嗎？

sentences.en: Every inventor makes mistakes along the way.
sentences.zh: 每個發明家一路上都會犯錯。

sentences.en: The inventor showed us his new robot.
sentences.zh: 發明家向我們展示他的新機器人。

gloss_note: investigate a case 調查案件

sentences.en: The police are investigating the missing bike.
sentences.zh: 警方正在調查那輛失竊的腳踏車。

sentences.en: We should investigate why the website keeps crashing.
sentences.zh: 我們應該查查網站為什麼一直當機。

sentences.en: Who is investigating the accident?
sentences.zh: 是誰在調查這起意外？

sentences.en: Scientists investigated the cause of the fire.
sentences.zh: 科學家調查了火災的起因。

sentences.en: Can you investigate this noise in the basement?
sentences.zh: 你可以去查查地下室這個聲音嗎？

sentences.en: Reporters investigate stories before they publish them.
sentences.zh: 記者在刊出報導前會先查證。

gloss_note: 作形容詞指淡黃白色

sentences.en: The old piano keys were made of ivory.
sentences.zh: 那架老鋼琴的琴鍵是象牙做的。

sentences.en: Selling ivory is illegal in many countries.
sentences.zh: 在許多國家販售象牙是違法的。

sentences.en: Do you like the ivory color for the walls?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡牆壁用象牙白嗎？

sentences.en: She wore an ivory dress to the wedding.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件象牙白的洋裝去婚禮。

sentences.en: Is that statue made of real ivory?
sentences.zh: 那座雕像是真象牙做的嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has a small ivory carving from the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一件十九世紀的小型象牙雕刻。

gloss_note: go to jail 入獄；in jail 在獄中

sentences.en: The man was sent to jail for three months.
sentences.zh: 那名男子被判入獄三個月。

sentences.en: In this board game, you go to jail if you roll doubles.
sentences.zh: 玩這款桌遊時，擲出雙數就要進監獄。

sentences.en: Is the old jail now a museum?
sentences.zh: 那座舊監獄現在是博物館嗎？

sentences.en: The judge jailed him for fraud.
sentences.zh: 法官判他詐欺罪入獄。

sentences.en: How long was he in jail?
sentences.zh: 他被關了多久？

sentences.en: The town jail was built in 1890.
sentences.zh: 這座鎮上的監獄是一八九○年蓋的。

gloss_note: a jar of honey 一罐蜂蜜

sentences.en: Put the cookies in a glass jar.
sentences.zh: 把餅乾放進玻璃罐裡。

sentences.en: Can you open this jar for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我打開這個罐子嗎？

sentences.en: There's a jar of honey in the cupboard.
sentences.zh: 櫥櫃裡有一罐蜂蜜。

sentences.en: Mom keeps coins in a big jar.
sentences.zh: 媽媽把零錢放在一個大罐子裡。

sentences.en: Do we have an empty jar for the leftovers?
sentences.zh: 我們有空罐子裝剩菜嗎？

sentences.en: The jar slipped out of my hand and broke.
sentences.zh: 那個罐子從我手上滑落摔破了。

gloss_note: one's jaw dropped 嚇得下巴掉下來

sentences.en: My jaw hurts after the dentist visit.
sentences.zh: 看完牙醫後我的下巴好痛。

sentences.en: His jaw dropped when he saw the price.
sentences.zh: 他看到價格時嚇得下巴都掉了。

sentences.en: Does your jaw ache when you chew?
sentences.zh: 你咀嚼時下巴會痛嗎？

sentences.en: A crocodile's jaws are incredibly strong.
sentences.zh: 鱷魚的下顎力量大得驚人。

sentences.en: She clenched her jaw and kept quiet.
sentences.zh: 她咬緊牙關，一句話也沒說。

sentences.en: Did you hit your jaw on the door?
sentences.zh: 你的下巴撞到門了嗎？

gloss_note: 美式 jelly 通常指果醬

sentences.en: I'll make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich.
sentences.zh: 我來做個花生醬果醬三明治。

sentences.en: Do you want grape jelly or strawberry jam?
sentences.zh: 你要葡萄果醬還是草莓醬？

sentences.en: The kids love jelly on their toast.
sentences.zh: 孩子們喜歡在吐司上抹果醬。

sentences.en: Mom packed jelly sandwiches for our picnic.
sentences.zh: 媽媽幫我們準備了果醬三明治去野餐。

sentences.en: Is there any jelly left in the jar?
sentences.zh: 罐子裡還有果醬嗎？

sentences.en: This jelly is too sweet for me.
sentences.zh: 這個果醬對我來說太甜了。

gloss_note: private jet 私人飛機；jet engine 噴射引擎

sentences.en: A private jet landed at the small airport.
sentences.zh: 一架私人飛機降落在小機場。

sentences.en: The jet flew low over our house.
sentences.zh: 那架噴射機低空飛過我們家。

sentences.en: Have you ever flown on a jet?
sentences.zh: 你搭過噴射客機嗎？

sentences.en: The jet took off right on time.
sentences.zh: 那架飛機準時起飛。

sentences.en: How fast can a jet fly?
sentences.zh: 噴射機可以飛多快？

sentences.en: Two jets flew over the stadium before the game.
sentences.zh: 賽前有兩架噴射機飛過球場上空。

sentences.en: The queen's crown was covered with jewels.
sentences.zh: 女王的皇冠鑲滿了寶石。

sentences.en: She found a red jewel in the old box.
sentences.zh: 她在舊盒子裡發現了一顆紅寶石。

sentences.en: Is that jewel real or fake?
sentences.zh: 那顆寶石是真的還是假的？

sentences.en: The museum has a rare blue jewel on display.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一顆罕見的藍寶石。

sentences.en: Where did you get such a beautiful jewel?
sentences.zh: 你從哪裡弄到這麼漂亮的寶石？

sentences.en: The thieves in the movie stole a famous jewel.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的小偷偷走了一顆名貴的寶石。

gloss_note: 不可數；a piece of jewelry 一件首飾

sentences.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small box.
sentences.zh: 她把首飾收在一個小盒子裡。

sentences.en: Do you wear any jewelry to work?
sentences.zh: 你上班會戴首飾嗎？

sentences.en: The store sells handmade jewelry.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣手工首飾。

sentences.en: I bought some silver jewelry as a gift.
sentences.zh: 我買了一些銀飾當禮物。

sentences.en: Where can I find cheap jewelry?
sentences.zh: 哪裡可以買到便宜的首飾？

sentences.en: Her grandmother gave her a piece of jewelry.
sentences.zh: 她的奶奶送她一件首飾。

gloss_note: Have a safe journey! 一路平安

sentences.en: The journey from Los Angeles to San Francisco takes about six hours.
sentences.zh: 從洛杉磯到舊金山的車程大約六小時。

sentences.en: I hope you have a safe journey!
sentences.zh: 祝你一路平安！

sentences.en: How long was your journey home?
sentences.zh: 你回家的路程多久？

sentences.en: The journey was long, but the view was great.
sentences.zh: 旅程很長，但風景很棒。

sentences.en: Was the journey worth it?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅程值得嗎？

sentences.en: Their journey across the country took a month.
sentences.zh: 他們橫越全國的旅程花了一個月。

sentences.en: The joyful crowd sang and danced in the street.
sentences.zh: 歡樂的人群在街上唱歌跳舞。

sentences.en: She gave a joyful laugh.
sentences.zh: 她發出一陣開心的笑聲。

sentences.en: Why is everyone so joyful today?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家今天都這麼開心？

sentences.en: We had a joyful holiday with our family.
sentences.zh: 我們和家人度過了歡樂的假期。

sentences.en: Is it a joyful or a sad story?
sentences.zh: 這是個歡樂的故事還是悲傷的故事？

sentences.en: The joyful news spread quickly through the town.
sentences.zh: 這個喜訊很快傳遍全鎮。

sentences.en: These peaches are so sweet and juicy.
sentences.zh: 這些桃子又甜又多汁。

sentences.en: Do you want a juicy burger for dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐你要不要吃個多汁的漢堡？

sentences.en: The steak was tender and juicy.
sentences.zh: 那塊牛排又嫩又多汁。

sentences.en: Is this watermelon juicy enough for you?
sentences.zh: 這顆西瓜夠不夠多汁？

sentences.en: I love a juicy piece of fruit on a hot day.
sentences.zh: 大熱天我最愛吃多汁的水果。

sentences.en: A juicy slice of watermelon is perfect after practice.
sentences.zh: 練習完來片多汁的西瓜最棒了。

gloss_note: concrete jungle 鋼筋水泥叢林

sentences.en: Monkeys live deep in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 猴子住在叢林深處。

sentences.en: The explorers walked through the thick jungle for days.
sentences.zh: 探險隊在濃密的叢林裡走了好幾天。

sentences.en: Would you survive in the jungle?
sentences.zh: 你能在叢林裡生存嗎？

sentences.en: We watched a TV show about jungle animals.
sentences.zh: 我們看了一個關於叢林動物的電視節目。

sentences.en: Is the jungle hot and wet all year?
sentences.zh: 叢林一年到頭都又熱又濕嗎？

sentences.en: Living downtown feels like living in a concrete jungle.
sentences.zh: 住在市中心像住在鋼筋水泥叢林裡。

gloss_note: junk food 垃圾食物；junk mail 垃圾郵件

sentences.en: Mom told me to throw away all the junk in the garage.
sentences.zh: 媽媽叫我把車庫裡的破爛都丟掉。

sentences.en: Eating junk food every day isn't healthy.
sentences.zh: 每天吃垃圾食物不健康。

sentences.en: Is this box just full of junk?
sentences.zh: 這個箱子裡裝的全是破爛嗎？

sentences.en: My desk is covered with junk.
sentences.zh: 我的桌上堆滿了雜物。

sentences.en: Why do we keep so much junk?
sentences.zh: 我們為什麼要留這麼多破爛？

sentences.en: I get a lot of junk mail every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都收到很多垃圾郵件。

gloss_note: computer keyboard 電腦鍵盤；也指電子琴

sentences.en: My laptop keyboard stopped working.
sentences.zh: 我筆電的鍵盤壞了。

sentences.en: Can you play the keyboard?
sentences.zh: 你會彈電子琴嗎？

sentences.en: I spilled juice on my keyboard this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上把果汁灑在鍵盤上了。

sentences.en: Is this a wireless keyboard?
sentences.zh: 這是無線鍵盤嗎？

sentences.en: She typed fast on the keyboard.
sentences.zh: 她在鍵盤上打字很快。

sentences.en: This mechanical keyboard makes a loud clicking sound.
sentences.zh: 這個機械式鍵盤會發出很大的喀噠聲。

sentences.en: The kidneys clean waste from our blood.
sentences.zh: 腎臟會清除血液中的廢物。

sentences.en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
sentences.zh: 喝足夠的水對腎臟有益。

sentences.en: How many kidneys does a person have?
sentences.zh: 一個人有幾個腎臟？

sentences.en: He donated a kidney to his brother.
sentences.zh: 他捐了一顆腎給他的哥哥。

sentences.en: Do you know what the kidney does?
sentences.zh: 你知道腎臟的功能是什麼嗎？

sentences.en: We studied the kidney in biology class.
sentences.zh: 我們在生物課學了腎臟。

gloss_note: first aid kit 急救包；tool kit 工具箱

sentences.en: Keep a first aid kit in the car.
sentences.zh: 車上要放一個急救包。

sentences.en: Do we have a repair kit for the bike?
sentences.zh: 我們有腳踏車的修理工具組嗎？

sentences.en: The model airplane kit comes with glue.
sentences.zh: 這個飛機模型套件附有膠水。

sentences.en: She packed a small sewing kit for the trip.
sentences.zh: 她為旅行帶了一個小縫紉包。

sentences.en: Where did you put the tool kit?
sentences.zh: 你把工具箱放哪了？

sentences.en: The science kit includes everything for the experiment.
sentences.zh: 這個科學實驗組包含做實驗需要的一切。

gloss_note: 西洋棋的「馬」也叫 knight

sentences.en: The knight rode a white horse into the castle.
sentences.zh: 騎士騎著白馬進了城堡。

sentences.en: In chess, the knight moves in an L shape.
sentences.zh: 下西洋棋時，馬走的是 L 形。

sentences.en: Do you want to play a knight in the school play?
sentences.zh: 你想在學校的戲劇裡演騎士嗎？

sentences.en: The old castle has a statue of a knight.
sentences.zh: 那座古堡有一尊騎士雕像。

sentences.en: Was he a real knight or just a legend?
sentences.zh: 他是真的騎士，還是只是傳說？

sentences.en: Knights wore heavy armor in the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 中世紀的騎士穿著厚重的盔甲。

gloss_note: knit a sweater 織毛衣

sentences.en: Grandma knits a scarf every winter.
sentences.zh: 奶奶每年冬天都會織一條圍巾。

sentences.en: Can you knit a sweater for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我織一件毛衣嗎？

sentences.en: She knitted these socks by hand.
sentences.zh: 這些襪子是她手工織的。

sentences.en: I'm learning to knit during my lunch break.
sentences.zh: 我利用午休時間學織毛線。

sentences.en: Did you knit this hat yourself?
sentences.zh: 這頂帽子是你自己織的嗎？

sentences.en: The warm knit sweater was a birthday gift.
sentences.zh: 這件暖暖的針織毛衣是生日禮物。

gloss_note: tie a knot 打結；untie 解開

sentences.en: Can you tie a knot in this rope?
sentences.zh: 你可以在這條繩子上打個結嗎？

sentences.en: I can't untie this knot.
sentences.zh: 我解不開這個結。

sentences.en: Who taught you how to tie that knot?
sentences.zh: 是誰教你打那種結的？

sentences.en: There's a knot in my shoelace.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋帶打結了。

sentences.en: Did you knot the balloon tightly?
sentences.zh: 你有把氣球綁緊嗎？

sentences.en: She knotted her scarf around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她把圍巾在脖子上打了個結。

gloss_note: read the label 看標示

sentences.en: Read the label before you take the medicine.
sentences.zh: 吃藥前先看標籤。

sentences.en: The label says it was made in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 標籤上寫著這是台灣製造的。

sentences.en: Can you label the boxes for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我在箱子上貼標籤嗎？

sentences.en: Don't label people before you know them.
sentences.zh: 在認識別人之前，不要給人貼標籤。

sentences.en: Where is the price label?
sentences.zh: 價格標籤在哪裡？

sentences.en: Each jar has a label with the date.
sentences.zh: 每個罐子上都有標明日期的標籤。

gloss_note: lace up 繫緊鞋帶

sentences.en: Her wedding dress was made of white lace.
sentences.zh: 她的婚紗是白色蕾絲做的。

sentences.en: Tie your laces before you run.
sentences.zh: 跑步前先把鞋帶綁好。

sentences.en: Do these shoes come with extra laces?
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋有附備用鞋帶嗎？

sentences.en: Lace up your boots; it's cold outside.
sentences.zh: 把靴子繫好，外面很冷。

sentences.en: Mom put a lace curtain in the window.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在窗戶掛了蕾絲窗簾。

sentences.en: Why did the lace on my sneaker break?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我球鞋的鞋帶斷了？

gloss_note: career ladder 職場晉升階梯

sentences.en: Hold the ladder while I climb up.
sentences.zh: 我爬上去的時候幫我扶著梯子。

sentences.en: Do you have a ladder I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有梯子可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: The painter set up a tall ladder against the wall.
sentences.zh: 油漆工把一座高梯子靠在牆上。

sentences.en: Be careful on that ladder.
sentences.zh: 在那座梯子上要小心。

sentences.en: Is the ladder tall enough to reach the roof?
sentences.zh: 這座梯子夠高，搆得到屋頂嗎？

sentences.en: Climbing the career ladder takes time.
sentences.zh: 在職場上晉升需要時間。

gloss_note: 多用於現在完成式、否定句或疑問句

sentences.en: I've been really tired lately.
sentences.zh: 我最近真的很累。

sentences.en: Have you seen Jake lately?
sentences.zh: 你最近有看到傑克嗎？

sentences.en: It hasn't rained much lately.
sentences.zh: 最近沒怎麼下雨。

sentences.en: What have you been up to lately?
sentences.zh: 你最近在忙什麼？

sentences.en: She's been busy with work lately.
sentences.zh: 她最近忙著工作。

sentences.en: Prices at the supermarket have been going up lately.
sentences.zh: 超市的物價最近一直在漲。

gloss_note: burst into laughter 爆笑；不可數

sentences.en: Laughter filled the whole room.
sentences.zh: 笑聲充滿了整個房間。

sentences.en: We heard laughter coming from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們聽到廚房傳來笑聲。

sentences.en: Do you remember the sound of her laughter?
sentences.zh: 你還記得她的笑聲嗎？

sentences.en: My mom says laughter is the best medicine.
sentences.zh: 我媽說笑是最好的良藥。

sentences.en: Why was there so much laughter in class today?
sentences.zh: 為什麼今天班上有這麼多笑聲？

sentences.en: He burst into laughter when he saw my hat.
sentences.zh: 他一看到我的帽子就爆笑出來。

gloss_note: mow the lawn 割草

sentences.en: I have to mow the lawn this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我得割草。

sentences.en: The kids were playing on the front lawn.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在前院的草坪上玩。

sentences.en: Please keep off the lawn.
sentences.zh: 請勿踐踏草坪。

sentences.en: Can you water the lawn for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我澆草坪嗎？

sentences.en: Is the lawn still wet from the rain?
sentences.zh: 草坪還因為下雨濕著嗎？

sentences.en: The lawn looks so green after the rain.
sentences.zh: 下過雨後，草坪看起來好綠。

gloss_note: a gas leak 瓦斯外洩

sentences.en: There's a leak in the kitchen ceiling.
sentences.zh: 廚房天花板有個漏水的地方。

sentences.en: The roof leaks whenever it rains hard.
sentences.zh: 一下大雨屋頂就會漏水。

sentences.en: Is the faucet leaking again?
sentences.zh: 水龍頭又在漏水了嗎？

sentences.en: We found a small leak under the sink.
sentences.zh: 我們在水槽下發現一個小漏水處。

sentences.en: Where is the leak coming from?
sentences.zh: 是哪裡在漏水？

sentences.en: My pen leaked ink all over my bag.
sentences.zh: 我的筆漏墨水，弄得整個包包都是。

gloss_note: 過去式 leaped／leapt；leap year 閏年

sentences.en: The cat leaped onto the table.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓跳上了桌子。

sentences.en: Look before you leap, as the saying goes.
sentences.zh: 俗話說，三思而後行。

sentences.en: How far can a frog leap?
sentences.zh: 青蛙能跳多遠？

sentences.en: The company took a big leap forward this year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司今年大躍進。

sentences.en: Will you take a leap of faith with me?
sentences.zh: 你願意跟我一起放手一搏嗎？

sentences.en: In a leap year, February has 29 days.
sentences.zh: 閏年的二月有二十九天。

gloss_note: genuine leather 真皮

sentences.en: My jacket is made of real leather.
sentences.zh: 我的外套是真皮做的。

sentences.en: Do you like leather shoes or sneakers?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡皮鞋還是球鞋？

sentences.en: The leather seats in the car are soft.
sentences.zh: 車子的皮革座椅很柔軟。

sentences.en: She bought a leather bag at the market.
sentences.zh: 她在市場買了一個皮包。

sentences.en: Is this wallet genuine leather?
sentences.zh: 這個皮夾是真皮的嗎？

sentences.en: Leather gets better with age.
sentences.zh: 皮革越用越有味道。

gloss_note: leisure time 休閒時間；at one's leisure 悠閒地

sentences.en: What do you do in your leisure time?
sentences.zh: 你空閒時都做些什麼？

sentences.en: I read books for leisure.
sentences.zh: 我看書是為了休閒。

sentences.en: Take it at your leisure; there's no rush.
sentences.zh: 慢慢來，不急。

sentences.en: The town has many leisure activities for families.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮有許多適合家庭的休閒活動。

sentences.en: Do you get much leisure time at your new job?
sentences.zh: 你新工作有很多閒暇時間嗎？

sentences.en: Leisure time is important for good health.
sentences.zh: 休閒時間對健康很重要。

gloss_note: 美式 lemonade 加糖，味道偏甜

sentences.en: We sold lemonade on the street last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我們在街邊賣檸檬汁。

sentences.en: Can I have a glass of lemonade?
sentences.zh: 我可以喝杯檸檬汁嗎？

sentences.en: This lemonade is too sour.
sentences.zh: 這杯檸檬汁太酸了。

sentences.en: She poured cold lemonade for the guests.
sentences.zh: 她為客人倒了冰檸檬汁。

sentences.en: Do you want ice in your lemonade?
sentences.zh: 你的檸檬汁要加冰嗎？

sentences.en: Fresh lemonade is perfect on a hot day.
sentences.zh: 大熱天來杯鮮榨檸檬汁最棒了。

sentences.en: A leopard climbed up the tree.
sentences.zh: 有隻豹爬上了樹。

sentences.en: Leopards can run very fast.
sentences.zh: 豹跑得非常快。

sentences.en: What's the difference between a leopard and a cheetah?
sentences.zh: 豹和獵豹有什麼不同？

sentences.en: We saw a leopard at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻豹。

sentences.en: Is that dress a leopard print?
sentences.zh: 那件洋裝是豹紋的嗎？

sentences.en: The leopard's spots help it hide in the grass.
sentences.zh: 豹的斑點能幫助牠藏身在草叢裡。

gloss_note: 比 freedom 正式；at liberty 可自由行動

sentences.en: The Statue of Liberty welcomes visitors from around the world.
sentences.zh: 自由女神像迎接來自世界各地的遊客。

sentences.en: People should have the liberty to choose their own jobs.
sentences.zh: 人們應該有選擇自己工作的自由。

sentences.en: Are you at liberty to talk right now?
sentences.zh: 你現在方便講話嗎？

sentences.en: Liberty means more than just doing what you want.
sentences.zh: 自由不只是想做什麼就做什麼。

sentences.en: Why is liberty so important to people?
sentences.zh: 為什麼自由對人們這麼重要？

sentences.en: Citizens fought for their liberty in that war.
sentences.zh: 人民在那場戰爭中為自由而戰。

gloss_note: once-in-a-lifetime 一生一次的

sentences.en: A trip to Japan is the chance of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 去日本旅行是千載難逢的機會。

sentences.en: She spent a lifetime helping others.
sentences.zh: 她一生都在幫助別人。

sentences.en: How long is a dog's lifetime?
sentences.zh: 狗的壽命有多長？

sentences.en: This is a once-in-a-lifetime offer.
sentences.zh: 這是個一生難得的優惠。

sentences.en: Will this battery last a lifetime?
sentences.zh: 這顆電池能用一輩子嗎？

sentences.en: In his lifetime, he saw many changes in the city.
sentences.zh: 他一生中見證了這座城市許多的變化。

sentences.en: The lighthouse guides ships at night.
sentences.zh: 燈塔在夜裡為船隻指引方向。

sentences.en: We climbed to the top of the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 我們爬到了燈塔頂端。

sentences.en: Is the lighthouse open to visitors?
sentences.zh: 這座燈塔開放參觀嗎？

sentences.en: A tall white lighthouse stands on the cliff.
sentences.zh: 一座白色的高燈塔矗立在懸崖上。

sentences.en: How old is that lighthouse?
sentences.zh: 那座燈塔有多老了？

sentences.en: The lighthouse keeper lived alone on the island.
sentences.zh: 守燈塔的人獨自住在島上。

gloss_note: water lily 睡蓮

sentences.en: She carried a bouquet of white lilies.
sentences.zh: 她捧著一束白百合。

sentences.en: Lilies smell wonderful in the evening.
sentences.zh: 百合在傍晚聞起來很香。

sentences.en: What color is this lily?
sentences.zh: 這朵百合是什麼顏色？

sentences.en: A water lily floated on the pond.
sentences.zh: 池塘上漂著一朵睡蓮。

sentences.en: Are lilies dangerous for cats?
sentences.zh: 百合對貓有危險嗎？

sentences.en: My grandmother grows lilies in her garden.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶在花園裡種百合。

gloss_note: go out on a limb 冒險表態
other_senses: 冒險表態（go out on a limb）

sentences.en: Regular exercise keeps your limbs strong.
sentences.zh: 規律運動能讓四肢保持強健。

sentences.en: A bird sat on a high limb of the oak tree.
sentences.zh: 一隻鳥停在橡樹的高處樹枝上。

sentences.en: Why climb out on that thin limb?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼要爬到那根細樹枝上？

sentences.en: Swimming works all four limbs.
sentences.zh: 游泳會運動到四肢。

sentences.en: A large limb fell from the tree during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨中，樹上掉下一根大樹枝。

sentences.en: Is the cat stuck on that limb?
sentences.zh: 那隻貓是不是卡在那根樹枝上了？

gloss_note: Don't litter! 禁止亂丟垃圾

sentences.en: Please don't litter in the park.
sentences.zh: 請不要在公園亂丟垃圾。

sentences.en: There's litter all over the beach.
sentences.zh: 整片海灘上到處都是垃圾。

sentences.en: Who left this litter on the sidewalk?
sentences.zh: 是誰把這些垃圾丟在人行道上？

sentences.en: You can get a fine for littering in this city.
sentences.zh: 在這座城市亂丟垃圾可能會被罰款。

sentences.en: Do you pick up litter on your walk?
sentences.zh: 你散步時會順手撿垃圾嗎？

sentences.en: Volunteers collected bags of litter from the river bank.
sentences.zh: 志工從河岸撿了好幾袋垃圾。

sentences.en: The lively kids ran around the yard.
sentences.zh: 活潑的孩子們在院子裡跑來跑去。

sentences.en: This is a lively neighborhood with lots of cafes.
sentences.zh: 這是個有很多咖啡館的熱鬧街區。

sentences.en: Is the party always this lively?
sentences.zh: 這個派對都這麼熱鬧嗎？

sentences.en: She told a lively story at dinner.
sentences.zh: 她在晚餐時講了一個生動的故事。

sentences.en: We had a lively discussion in class today.
sentences.zh: 我們今天在課堂上有一場熱烈的討論。

sentences.en: Do you want lively music or something calm?
sentences.zh: 你想聽輕快的音樂還是平靜的？

gloss_note: log in／log out 登入／登出；也可當動詞「記錄」

sentences.en: We sat on a log by the campfire.
sentences.zh: 我們坐在營火旁的一根原木上。

sentences.en: Please log in with your email and password.
sentences.zh: 請用你的電子郵件和密碼登入。

sentences.en: I can't log in to my account.
sentences.zh: 我登不進我的帳號。

sentences.en: Why won't it let me log in?
sentences.zh: 為什麼它不讓我登入？

sentences.en: Dad cut a big log into small pieces for the fire.
sentences.zh: 爸爸把一根大原木劈成小塊當柴燒。

sentences.en: Did you log out of your account?
sentences.zh: 你有登出帳號嗎？

sentences.en: The little girl licked a red lollipop.
sentences.zh: 小女孩舔著紅色棒棒糖。

sentences.en: The dentist gave me a lollipop after my checkup.
sentences.zh: 牙醫在檢查後給了我一支棒棒糖。

sentences.en: Do you want a lollipop?
sentences.zh: 你要棒棒糖嗎？

sentences.en: I found a sticky lollipop under the couch.
sentences.zh: 我在沙發底下發現一支黏黏的棒棒糖。

sentences.en: What flavor is your lollipop?
sentences.zh: 你的棒棒糖是什麼口味？

sentences.en: Kids lined up for free lollipops at the parade.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在遊行活動排隊領免費棒棒糖。

gloss_note: loose change 零錢；反義 tight

sentences.en: This screw on the chair is loose.
sentences.zh: 這張椅子上的螺絲鬆了。

sentences.en: I like wearing loose clothes at home.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡在家穿寬鬆的衣服。

sentences.en: My tooth feels loose; should I see the dentist?
sentences.zh: 我的牙齒有點鬆動，要看牙醫嗎？

sentences.en: The dog got loose and ran down the street.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗掙脫了，跑到街上去。

sentences.en: Are these pants too loose?
sentences.zh: 這條褲子會太寬嗎？

sentences.en: A loose button fell off my coat.
sentences.zh: 我大衣上一顆鬆掉的鈕扣掉了。

gloss_note: 英國貴族頭銜；the Lord 另指宗教中的主

sentences.en: The lord of the castle held a big feast.
sentences.zh: 城堡的領主舉辦了一場盛宴。

sentences.en: In the story, a cruel lord ruled the village.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一位殘酷的領主統治著村莊。

sentences.en: Was he a lord or a farmer?
sentences.zh: 他是貴族還是農夫？

sentences.en: Every lord in the kingdom attended the royal wedding.
sentences.zh: 王國裡的每位貴族都出席了王室婚禮。

sentences.en: Who was the lord of this old castle?
sentences.zh: 這座古堡以前的領主是誰？

sentences.en: In England, a lord is a man of high rank.
sentences.zh: 在英國，貴族是指地位很高的男士。

gloss_note: 常見 dog lover、music lover；也指戀人

sentences.en: My sister is a real dog lover.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊是個十足的愛狗人。

sentences.en: Are you a book lover or a movie lover?
sentences.zh: 你是愛看書的人，還是愛看電影的人？

sentences.en: This café is a paradise for coffee lovers.
sentences.zh: 這間咖啡館是咖啡愛好者的天堂。

sentences.en: Music lovers will enjoy the free concert in the park.
sentences.zh: 音樂愛好者會喜歡公園的免費演唱會。

sentences.en: He is a nature lover who hikes every weekend.
sentences.zh: 他熱愛大自然，每個週末都去健行。

sentences.en: Are you a pizza lover like me?
sentences.zh: 你也跟我一樣愛吃披薩嗎？

sentences.en: Smoking badly damages your lungs.
sentences.zh: 吸菸會嚴重傷害你的肺。

sentences.en: Take a deep breath and fill your lungs with air.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸，讓空氣充滿你的肺。

sentences.en: How big are our lungs?
sentences.zh: 我們的肺有多大？

sentences.en: The doctor listened to my lungs.
sentences.zh: 醫生聽了我的肺部。

sentences.en: Does swimming make your lungs stronger?
sentences.zh: 游泳會讓肺更強壯嗎？

sentences.en: Air pollution can harm young lungs.
sentences.zh: 空氣汙染會傷害幼小的肺。

sentences.en: The movie is full of magical creatures.
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡有好多有魔法的生物。

sentences.en: It was a magical night under the stars.
sentences.zh: 那是個在星空下的神奇夜晚。

sentences.en: Do you believe in magical powers?
sentences.zh: 你相信魔法的力量嗎？

sentences.en: The kids loved the magical show.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很喜歡那場魔法秀。

sentences.en: Is there a magical way to fall asleep fast?
sentences.zh: 有什麼神奇的方法能很快入睡嗎？

sentences.en: Her magical voice made everyone stop and listen.
sentences.zh: 她充滿魔力的歌聲讓大家都停下來聆聽。

gloss_note: fridge magnet 冰箱磁鐵

sentences.en: A magnet can pick up small pins.
sentences.zh: 磁鐵可以吸起小別針。

sentences.en: There's a magnet on our fridge.
sentences.zh: 我們的冰箱上有一個磁鐵。

sentences.en: Does this magnet stick to plastic?
sentences.zh: 這個磁鐵會吸在塑膠上嗎？

sentences.en: The kids played with a magnet in science class.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在自然課玩磁鐵。

sentences.en: Where did you buy this fridge magnet?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡買到這個冰箱磁鐵的？

sentences.en: The strong magnet pulled the nail across the table.
sentences.zh: 強力磁鐵把釘子吸過了桌面。

gloss_note: 美式：hotel maid 飯店房務員

sentences.en: The hotel maid cleaned our room in the morning.
sentences.zh: 飯店房務員早上打掃了我們的房間。

sentences.en: In the old story, the maid carried tea to the queen.
sentences.zh: 在古老的故事裡，女僕端茶給王后。

sentences.en: Did the maid change the sheets?
sentences.zh: 房務員有換床單嗎？

sentences.en: A maid used to work in this big house.
sentences.zh: 這棟大房子以前有個女傭。

sentences.en: Can you call the maid for extra towels?
sentences.zh: 你可以請房務員多送幾條毛巾嗎？

sentences.en: The maid in the play wore a white apron.
sentences.zh: 劇中的女僕穿著白色圍裙。

gloss_note: the majority of + 複數名詞；反義 minority

sentences.en: The majority of students walk to school.
sentences.zh: 大多數學生走路上學。

sentences.en: The majority voted to have a picnic.
sentences.zh: 大多數人投票決定去野餐。

sentences.en: Does the majority of the class agree with you?
sentences.zh: 班上大多數人同意你嗎？

sentences.en: A large majority of customers prefer the new menu.
sentences.zh: 大多數顧客比較喜歡新菜單。

sentences.en: Are girls in the majority in your class?
sentences.zh: 你們班上女生佔多數嗎？

sentences.en: In the majority of cases, the bus is on time.
sentences.zh: 大多數情況下，公車都準時。

gloss_note: 不加冠詞；也說 humankind（較中性）

sentences.en: Fire changed the course of mankind.
sentences.zh: 火改變了人類的發展方向。

sentences.en: The moon landing was a big step for mankind.
sentences.zh: 登月是人類的一大步。

sentences.en: What does the future hold for mankind?
sentences.zh: 人類的未來會怎麼樣？

sentences.en: Scientists want to improve life for all mankind.
sentences.zh: 科學家希望改善全人類的生活。

sentences.en: Is mankind ready for robots in every home?
sentences.zh: 人類準備好讓每個家庭都有機器人了嗎？

sentences.en: Mankind has built great cities over thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 人類在數千年間建造了偉大的城市。

gloss_note: 彈珠通常用複數 marbles

sentences.en: The kitchen counter is made of white marble.
sentences.zh: 廚房檯面是白色大理石做的。

sentences.en: The kids played marbles in the yard.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩彈珠。

sentences.en: Do you have any marbles left in your bag?
sentences.zh: 你包包裡還有彈珠嗎？

sentences.en: The museum floor is cool, smooth marble.
sentences.zh: 博物館的地板是冰涼光滑的大理石。

sentences.en: A marble rolled under the couch.
sentences.zh: 一顆彈珠滾到沙發底下了。

sentences.en: Is this statue made of marble?
sentences.zh: 這座雕像是大理石做的嗎？

gloss_note: mathematical skills；名詞 math

sentences.en: Her mathematical skills are way above average.
sentences.zh: 她的數學能力遠高於平均。

sentences.en: Is that a mathematical formula or just a guess?
sentences.zh: 那是數學公式，還是你亂猜的？

sentences.en: He solved the mathematical puzzle in under two minutes.
sentences.zh: 他不到兩分鐘就解開了那道數學謎題。

sentences.en: The scientist built a mathematical model of the storm.
sentences.zh: 那位科學家建立了風暴的數學模型。

sentences.en: Do you think chess is more mathematical than creative?
sentences.zh: 你覺得西洋棋比較需要數理頭腦，還是創意？

sentences.en: My dad has a very mathematical way of thinking.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸的思考方式很有數理邏輯。

gloss_note: 美國市長多為民選；稱呼 Mayor + 姓

sentences.en: The mayor will speak at the city park tonight.
sentences.zh: 市長今晚會在市立公園發表談話。

sentences.en: Who is the mayor of your town?
sentences.zh: 你們鎮上的市長是誰？

sentences.en: Our mayor cut the ribbon at the new library.
sentences.zh: 市長為新圖書館剪綵。

sentences.en: My uncle ran for mayor last year but lost.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔去年競選市長，但落選了。

sentences.en: Did you see the mayor on TV this morning?
sentences.zh: 你今天早上有看到電視上的市長嗎？

sentences.en: The mayors of three cities met to discuss traffic.
sentences.zh: 三個城市的市長開會討論交通問題。

gloss_note: 多指有野花、青草的開闊草地

sentences.en: We had a picnic in a green meadow.
sentences.zh: 我們在一片綠油油的草地上野餐。

sentences.en: Wildflowers covered the whole meadow in spring.
sentences.zh: 春天時野花開滿了整片草地。

sentences.en: The cows were eating grass in the meadow.
sentences.zh: 牛群在草地上吃草。

sentences.en: Do you want to walk through the meadow with me?
sentences.zh: 你要不要跟我一起穿過那片草地散步？

sentences.en: Is there a meadow near your grandparents' house?
sentences.zh: 你爺爺奶奶家附近有草地嗎？

sentences.en: The children ran across the meadow, chasing butterflies.
sentences.zh: 孩子們穿過草地，追著蝴蝶跑。

gloss_note: meaningful look 指意味深長的眼神

sentences.en: She gave me a meaningful look across the room.
sentences.zh: 她隔著房間給了我一個意味深長的眼神。

sentences.en: I want a job that feels meaningful.
sentences.zh: 我想要一份有意義的工作。

sentences.en: Was the trip meaningful to you?
sentences.zh: 這趟旅行對你來說有意義嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for such a meaningful gift.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你送這麼有意義的禮物。

sentences.en: How can we make this class more meaningful for students?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼讓這堂課對學生更有意義？

sentences.en: The two leaders had a meaningful conversation about trade.
sentences.zh: 兩位領袖就貿易問題進行了一場有實質意義的對話。

gloss_note: 常放句首加逗號，連接兩件同時發生的事

sentences.en: Cook the pasta. Meanwhile, I'll make the sauce.
sentences.zh: 你煮義大利麵，同時我來做醬汁。

sentences.en: I was stuck in traffic. Meanwhile, the movie started.
sentences.zh: 我塞在車陣裡，這時電影已經開演了。

sentences.en: I'll wash the dishes. Meanwhile, could you take out the trash?
sentences.zh: 我來洗碗，同時你可以去倒垃圾嗎？

sentences.en: The team lost again. Meanwhile, their rivals won easily.
sentences.zh: 球隊又輸了，同一時間，對手輕鬆獲勝。

sentences.en: Mom is at work. Meanwhile, Dad is picking up the kids.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在上班，同時爸爸去接孩子。

sentences.en: The rain will stop soon. Meanwhile, can we wait inside?
sentences.zh: 雨很快就會停，在那之前我們可以先在裡面等嗎？

gloss_note: gold/silver/bronze medal

sentences.en: She won a gold medal in swimming.
sentences.zh: 她在游泳比賽中拿下金牌。

sentences.en: Did your brother get a medal at the track meet?
sentences.zh: 你哥哥在田徑賽拿到獎牌了嗎？

sentences.en: The soldier received a medal for his courage.
sentences.zh: 那位士兵因為勇氣獲頒勳章。

sentences.en: He hung his silver medal on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他把銀牌掛在牆上。

sentences.en: How many medals did the team bring home?
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍帶回了幾面獎牌？

sentences.en: Winning a medal at the Olympics is every athlete's dream.
sentences.zh: 在奧運拿到獎牌是每位運動員的夢想。

gloss_note: 泛指瓜類水果；西瓜是 watermelon

sentences.en: This melon is so sweet and juicy.
sentences.zh: 這顆甜瓜又甜又多汁。

sentences.en: Can you cut the melon for dessert?
sentences.zh: 你可以把甜瓜切一切當甜點嗎？

sentences.en: How do you pick a ripe melon?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼挑熟的甜瓜？

sentences.en: I bought a big melon at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我在農夫市集買了一顆大甜瓜。

sentences.en: She ordered fresh melon with her breakfast.
sentences.zh: 她早餐點了新鮮的甜瓜。

sentences.en: Melon slices are perfect on a hot summer day.
sentences.zh: 炎熱的夏日裡，來幾片甜瓜最棒了。

gloss_note: ice/snow/butter melts

sentences.en: The ice cream will melt if you leave it out.
sentences.zh: 冰淇淋放在外面會融化。

sentences.en: Snow starts to melt in March around here.
sentences.zh: 這附近三月雪就開始融化。

sentences.en: Why does chocolate melt so fast in my pocket?
sentences.zh: 為什麼巧克力在我口袋裡融得這麼快？

sentences.en: Melt the butter in a small pan.
sentences.zh: 把奶油放在小鍋裡融化。

sentences.en: Why did the snowman melt so fast?
sentences.zh: 雪人為什麼融化得這麼快？

sentences.en: Will the glaciers melt faster because of warming?
sentences.zh: 冰河會因為暖化而融化得更快嗎？

gloss_note: 多用於衣物、小物件的修補

sentences.en: Can you mend this hole in my sock?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我補這隻襪子的破洞嗎？

sentences.en: Grandma used to mend our clothes by hand.
sentences.zh: 奶奶以前都用手縫補我們的衣服。

sentences.en: He tried to mend the broken fence with some nails.
sentences.zh: 他試著用幾根釘子修補壞掉的籬笆。

sentences.en: Is it cheaper to mend shoes than to buy new ones?
sentences.zh: 補鞋比買新鞋便宜嗎？

sentences.en: She mended the torn page with tape.
sentences.zh: 她用膠帶把撕破的那頁黏好。

sentences.en: Do you know how to mend a torn jacket?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼縫補破掉的外套嗎？

gloss_note: mental health 心理健康

sentences.en: Sleep is important for your mental health.
sentences.zh: 睡眠對你的心理健康很重要。

sentences.en: I made a mental note to call him back.
sentences.zh: 我在心裡記下要回他電話。

sentences.en: Do you ever do mental math at the store?
sentences.zh: 你在商店會心算嗎？

sentences.en: She took a day off for her mental well-being.
sentences.zh: 她請了一天假來調適心理狀態。

sentences.en: Chess is more of a mental game than a physical one.
sentences.zh: 西洋棋比較是腦力遊戲，而不是體力運動。

sentences.en: Is stress hurting your mental focus at work?
sentences.zh: 壓力有影響你工作時的專注力嗎？

gloss_note: 幾乎只用於 Merry Christmas；他處偏文學、古風

sentences.en: We wish you a merry Christmas and a happy new year.
sentences.zh: 祝你聖誕快樂、新年快樂。

sentences.en: Everyone was merry at the Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 聖誕派對上，每個人都很歡樂。

sentences.en: Why does the whole house feel so merry on Christmas morning?
sentences.zh: 為什麼聖誕節早上整個家都這麼歡樂？

sentences.en: The merry sound of children's laughter filled the house.
sentences.zh: 孩子們歡樂的笑聲充滿了整個屋子。

sentences.en: Did you have a merry Christmas with your family?
sentences.zh: 你和家人過了個快樂的聖誕節嗎？

sentences.en: They sang merry songs around the fire.
sentences.zh: 他們圍著營火唱著歡樂的歌。

gloss_note: 口語常簡稱 mic

sentences.en: Can you hear me? Is the microphone on?
sentences.zh: 你聽得到我嗎？麥克風有開嗎？

sentences.en: The singer dropped the microphone on stage.
sentences.zh: 歌手把麥克風掉在舞台上。

sentences.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
sentences.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，大家才聽得到。

sentences.en: I need a better microphone for my online classes.
sentences.zh: 我上線上課需要一支更好的麥克風。

sentences.en: Who has the microphone now?
sentences.zh: 現在麥克風在誰手上？

sentences.en: The reporter held a microphone near the mayor.
sentences.zh: 記者把麥克風舉到市長面前。

gloss_note: 多用於文學、故事或形容大自然

sentences.en: The mighty river flows through three states.
sentences.zh: 那條雄偉的大河流經三個州。

sentences.en: He was a mighty king in the old story.
sentences.zh: 他是故事裡一位強大的國王。

sentences.en: Is anything mightier than the sea?
sentences.zh: 有什麼比大海更強大嗎？

sentences.en: The mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
sentences.zh: 那棵雄偉的橡樹矗立在田野中央。

sentences.en: Our team faced a mighty opponent in the final.
sentences.zh: 我們隊在決賽遇上了強大的對手。

sentences.en: What makes the lion so mighty?
sentences.zh: 是什麼讓獅子這麼強大？

gloss_note: It's a miracle that... 真是奇蹟

sentences.en: It's a miracle that nobody got hurt.
sentences.zh: 沒有人受傷，真是奇蹟。

sentences.en: Do you really believe in miracles?
sentences.zh: 你真的相信有奇蹟嗎？

sentences.en: The new medicine worked like a miracle.
sentences.zh: 這種新藥的效果像奇蹟一樣。

sentences.en: She passed the exam, and that was a small miracle.
sentences.zh: 她通過了考試，那可說是個小奇蹟。

sentences.en: It would take a miracle to finish this by Friday.
sentences.zh: 要在週五前完成這個，得靠奇蹟才行。

sentences.en: Was it a miracle or just good luck?
sentences.zh: 那是奇蹟，還是只是運氣好？

gloss_note: 指長期的不幸或難受；常搭配 in misery

sentences.en: The long wait in the rain was pure misery.
sentences.zh: 在雨中久等真是痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: He lived in misery after losing his job.
sentences.zh: 他失業後過著痛苦的日子。

sentences.en: Why do you keep putting yourself through such misery?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼老是讓自己受這種罪？

sentences.en: The good news ended our misery at last.
sentences.zh: 這個好消息終於結束了我們的煎熬。

sentences.en: Do you remember the misery of last winter's flu?
sentences.zh: 你還記得去年冬天得流感的痛苦嗎？

sentences.en: Cold, wet, and hungry, the campers sat in misery.
sentences.zh: 又冷、又濕、又餓，露營的人苦不堪言地坐著。

gloss_note: 軍事用語；也泛指被投射出去的東西

sentences.en: The museum displays an old missile from the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示著一枚冷戰時期的舊飛彈。

sentences.en: In the video game, you shoot a missile at the tank.
sentences.zh: 在這款電玩裡，你要對坦克發射飛彈。

sentences.en: The news said the country tested a new missile.
sentences.zh: 新聞說那個國家試射了一枚新型飛彈。

sentences.en: How fast can a missile travel?
sentences.zh: 飛彈能飛多快？

sentences.en: The movie ends when the hero stops the missile.
sentences.zh: 電影的結尾是主角阻止了那枚飛彈。

sentences.en: Did you see the missile launch in that old documentary?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那部舊紀錄片裡的飛彈發射畫面嗎？

gloss_note: mission statement 宗旨

sentences.en: Our mission is to help kids learn English.
sentences.zh: 我們的使命是幫助孩子學好英文。

sentences.en: The astronauts finished their mission safely.
sentences.zh: 太空人安全完成了他們的任務。

sentences.en: Is this mission too difficult for a beginner?
sentences.zh: 這個任務對新手來說太難了嗎？

sentences.en: Her mission was to find the lost dog.
sentences.zh: 她的任務是找到走失的狗。

sentences.en: Does the company have a clear mission statement?
sentences.zh: 這間公司有明確的宗旨聲明嗎？

sentences.en: Mission accomplished! We finally finished the report.
sentences.zh: 任務完成！我們終於把報告寫完了。

gloss_note: n. 比 fog 淡；玻璃起霧美式多說 fog up

sentences.en: A thin mist covered the lake this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上一層薄霧籠罩著湖面。

sentences.en: The mountains disappeared into the mist.
sentences.zh: 群山消失在薄霧中。

sentences.en: Can you see anything through this mist?
sentences.zh: 這種霧，你看得到東西嗎？

sentences.en: Mist rose from the warm pond after the rain.
sentences.zh: 雨後，溫暖的池塘升起一層水霧。

sentences.en: The mirror misted up after my hot shower.
sentences.zh: 洗完熱水澡，鏡子起霧了。

sentences.en: Why does mist form over the river at dawn?
sentences.zh: 為什麼黎明時河面上會形成薄霧？

gloss_note: 常帶吵鬧、失控的意味

sentences.en: A mob of fans waited outside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 一大群粉絲在飯店外等候。

sentences.en: A mob of shoppers rushed into the store at six.
sentences.zh: 一大群顧客在六點衝進了商店。

sentences.en: Why is there such a mob at the entrance?
sentences.zh: 入口怎麼聚了這麼一大群人？

sentences.en: Fans mobbed the singer as she left the building.
sentences.zh: 歌手離開大樓時，粉絲蜂擁圍住她。

sentences.en: The angry mob gathered in front of city hall.
sentences.zh: 憤怒的群眾聚集在市政廳前面。

sentences.en: Did you see the mob at the sale yesterday?
sentences.zh: 你昨天有看到特賣會上那一大群人嗎？

gloss_note: mobile app；手機美式說 cell phone

sentences.en: I use a mobile app to order lunch.
sentences.zh: 我用行動應用程式點午餐。

sentences.en: Is Grandpa still mobile at ninety?
sentences.zh: 爺爺九十歲了還行動自如嗎？

sentences.en: We live in a mobile home near the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們住在湖邊的活動房屋裡。

sentences.en: Is the library website mobile friendly?
sentences.zh: 圖書館的網站適合用手機瀏覽嗎？

sentences.en: This mobile stage can be moved to any part of the park.
sentences.zh: 這個可移動的舞台可以搬到公園裡任何地方。

sentences.en: I'm not very mobile with this sore knee.
sentences.zh: 我膝蓋痛，行動不太方便。

gloss_note: 蛋糕、土壤、空氣、眼睛都可用，語氣中性偏好

sentences.en: This chocolate cake is so moist and soft.
sentences.zh: 這個巧克力蛋糕又濕潤又鬆軟。

sentences.en: Keep the soil moist, but don't overwater it.
sentences.zh: 保持土壤濕潤，但不要澆太多水。

sentences.en: Her eyes grew moist as she read the letter.
sentences.zh: 她讀信的時候，眼眶濕潤了。

sentences.en: Is the towel still moist or completely dry?
sentences.zh: 這條毛巾還是濕的，還是全乾了？

sentences.en: The air felt warm and moist after the rain.
sentences.zh: 雨後的空氣又溫暖又潮濕。

sentences.en: Why is my turkey never moist enough?
sentences.zh: 為什麼我烤的火雞肉總是不夠多汁？

gloss_note: skin/soil moisture；不可數名詞

sentences.en: Plants need moisture to grow.
sentences.zh: 植物需要水分才能生長。

sentences.en: This cream keeps moisture in your skin.
sentences.zh: 這款乳霜能幫皮膚鎖住水分。

sentences.en: Where is all this moisture coming from?
sentences.zh: 這些濕氣是從哪裡來的？

sentences.en: Put the bread in a bag to keep the moisture in.
sentences.zh: 把麵包放進袋子裡，才能保住水分。

sentences.en: Does your skin lose moisture in the winter?
sentences.zh: 你的皮膚冬天會流失水分嗎？

sentences.en: The desert air has almost no moisture.
sentences.zh: 沙漠的空氣幾乎沒有水氣。

gloss_note: 佛教與基督教的出家人皆可稱 monk

sentences.en: The monk lives in a quiet mountain temple.
sentences.zh: 那位僧人住在安靜的山間寺廟。

sentences.en: We visited an old temple and met a monk.
sentences.zh: 我們參觀了一座古寺，還遇見了一位僧人。

sentences.en: Did the monk really stay silent for a whole year?
sentences.zh: 那位僧人真的整整一年都沒說話嗎？

sentences.en: The monks wake up before the sun rises.
sentences.zh: 僧侶們在太陽升起前就起床了。

sentences.en: In the movie, a young monk learns kung fu.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，一位年輕的僧人學習功夫。

sentences.en: Do you think he'll become a monk someday?
sentences.zh: 你覺得他有一天會出家當僧侶嗎？

gloss_note: monthly fee/bill；adv. 放句尾

sentences.en: What's your monthly rent for that apartment?
sentences.zh: 那間公寓你每個月的房租是多少？

sentences.en: I pay my phone bill monthly.
sentences.zh: 我每個月繳手機費。

sentences.en: The club holds monthly meetings on Tuesday nights.
sentences.zh: 這個社團每月在週二晚上開一次會。

sentences.en: Is the magazine published monthly or weekly?
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌是月刊還是週刊？

sentences.en: Our monthly budget is pretty tight right now.
sentences.zh: 我們的每月預算現在很吃緊。

sentences.en: She gets a monthly check from her grandfather.
sentences.zh: 她每個月都會收到爺爺寄來的一張支票。

gloss_note: the moral of the story 寓意

sentences.en: It's a moral issue, not just a legal one.
sentences.zh: 這是道德問題，不只是法律問題。

sentences.en: What's the moral of this story?
sentences.zh: 這個故事的寓意是什麼？

sentences.en: He is a person with strong moral values.
sentences.zh: 他是個有很強道德觀念的人。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to explain the moral of the fable.
sentences.zh: 老師要我們說明這則寓言的寓意。

sentences.en: Do you think it's moral to lie to protect someone?
sentences.zh: 你覺得為了保護別人而說謊，合乎道德嗎？

sentences.en: The coach gave the team some moral support.
sentences.zh: 教練給了球隊一些精神上的支持。

gloss_note: 修飾名詞或動詞，意思近 mainly

sentences.en: I mostly eat lunch at my desk.
sentences.zh: 我午餐大多在座位上吃。

sentences.en: The class is mostly girls this year.
sentences.zh: 今年班上大多是女生。

sentences.en: Is your house mostly made of wood?
sentences.zh: 你家的房子大部分是木造的嗎？

sentences.en: It's mostly sunny today, with a few clouds.
sentences.zh: 今天大多是晴天，只有幾朵雲。

sentences.en: What do you mostly do on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末大多在做什麼？

sentences.en: The audience was mostly young people.
sentences.zh: 觀眾大多是年輕人。

gloss_note: 美國的 motel 是公路旁的平價旅館

sentences.en: We stayed at a cheap motel off the highway.
sentences.zh: 我們住在高速公路旁一間便宜的汽車旅館。

sentences.en: Is there a motel near the next exit?
sentences.zh: 下一個出口附近有汽車旅館嗎？

sentences.en: The motel room had two beds and a small TV.
sentences.zh: 那間汽車旅館的房間有兩張床和一台小電視。

sentences.en: Many old motels line the highway outside town.
sentences.zh: 許多老舊的汽車旅館沿著城外的公路林立。

sentences.en: How much is a night at the motel?
sentences.zh: 住那間汽車旅館一晚多少錢？

sentences.en: Our family checked into a motel after the long drive.
sentences.zh: 長途開車後，我們全家入住了一間汽車旅館。

gloss_note: butterfly 是蝴蝶；衣蛾會蛀衣服

sentences.en: A moth kept flying around the lamp.
sentences.zh: 一隻飛蛾一直繞著燈飛。

sentences.en: Moths are attracted to light at night.
sentences.zh: 飛蛾夜裡會被光線吸引。

sentences.en: Is that a butterfly or a moth?
sentences.zh: 那是蝴蝶還是飛蛾？

sentences.en: Moths ate holes in Grandpa's wool coat.
sentences.zh: 蛾把爺爺的羊毛外套蛀出了洞。

sentences.en: Why do moths fly toward the porch light?
sentences.zh: 為什麼飛蛾會飛向門廊的燈？

sentences.en: I found a moth inside the closet.
sentences.zh: 我在衣櫃裡發現一隻蛾。

gloss_note: 電動馬達；汽車引擎美式稱 engine

sentences.en: The motor in this fan is making a strange noise.
sentences.zh: 這台電風扇的馬達發出怪聲。

sentences.en: Does the boat have a motor?
sentences.zh: 這艘船有裝馬達嗎？

sentences.en: He turned off the motor of the boat and jumped onto the dock.
sentences.zh: 他關掉船的馬達，跳上碼頭。

sentences.en: The toy car runs on a small electric motor.
sentences.zh: 這輛玩具車靠一顆小型電動馬達運轉。

sentences.en: My dad fixed the motor of our old washing machine.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸修好了我們舊洗衣機的馬達。

sentences.en: Can you hear the motor humming?
sentences.zh: 你聽得到馬達嗡嗡響嗎？

gloss_note: multiply A by B；也可指迅速增加

sentences.en: Multiply six by seven and tell me the answer.
sentences.zh: 把六乘以七，然後告訴我答案。

sentences.en: The number of visitors multiplied after the festival.
sentences.zh: 慶典過後，遊客人數成倍增加。

sentences.en: What do you get if you multiply twelve by three?
sentences.zh: 十二乘以三等於多少？

sentences.en: My problems seem to multiply every week.
sentences.zh: 我的問題似乎每週都在增加。

sentences.en: Can you multiply large numbers in your head?
sentences.zh: 你能心算大數字的乘法嗎？

sentences.en: Her worries multiplied as the exam got closer.
sentences.zh: 隨著考試越來越近，她的煩惱越來越多。

gloss_note: 多出現在新聞、小說、電影；v. 指蓄意殺人

sentences.en: In the mystery novel, the detective solves a murder.
sentences.zh: 推理小說裡，偵探破解了一樁謀殺案。

sentences.en: The news reported a murder trial in the city.
sentences.zh: 新聞報導了市內一場謀殺案的審判。

sentences.en: Who was accused of the murder in that movie?
sentences.zh: 那部電影裡，誰被指控犯下謀殺案？

sentences.en: We're playing a murder mystery game tonight.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚要玩謀殺懸疑推理遊戲。

sentences.en: Do you like watching murder documentaries?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡看謀殺案紀錄片嗎？

sentences.en: In the old play, a king murdered his rival.
sentences.zh: 在那齣老戲劇裡，一位國王殺害了他的對手。

gloss_note: pull a muscle 拉傷肌肉

sentences.en: I pulled a muscle in my leg during practice.
sentences.zh: 我練習時拉傷了腿部的肌肉。

sentences.en: How long does it take to build muscle?
sentences.zh: 練出肌肉要花多久時間？

sentences.en: Her arm muscles are really strong from tennis.
sentences.zh: 她打網球，手臂肌肉很結實。

sentences.en: Walking every day is good for your muscles.
sentences.zh: 每天走路對肌肉有好處。

sentences.en: My back muscle hurts after moving boxes all day.
sentences.zh: 搬了一整天箱子，我背部的肌肉好痛。

sentences.en: Is it true that fat turns into muscle?
sentences.zh: 脂肪真的會變成肌肉嗎？

gloss_note: v. 指像蘑菇一樣迅速擴大（正式）

sentences.en: I'd like extra mushrooms on my pizza, please.
sentences.zh: 我的披薩請多加一點蘑菇。

sentences.en: Don't pick wild mushrooms unless you're sure.
sentences.zh: 除非你很確定，否則不要採野生的菇。

sentences.en: Mushrooms grow fast in damp, dark places.
sentences.zh: 蘑菇在潮濕陰暗的地方長得很快。

sentences.en: Is this mushroom soup vegetarian?
sentences.zh: 這道蘑菇湯是素食嗎？

sentences.en: After the factory opened, the town's population began to mushroom.
sentences.zh: 工廠開張後，鎮上的人口開始快速成長。

sentences.en: Can you slice the mushrooms for the salad?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫沙拉把蘑菇切片嗎？

gloss_note: remain a mystery 仍是個謎；也指推理小說

sentences.en: Who stole my lunch? It's a mystery.
sentences.zh: 誰偷了我的午餐？真是個謎。

sentences.en: She loves reading mystery novels before bed.
sentences.zh: 她睡前喜歡讀推理小說。

sentences.en: Why the plane went missing remains a mystery.
sentences.zh: 那架飛機為何失蹤，至今仍是個謎。

sentences.en: Is the mystery of the pyramids solved yet?
sentences.zh: 金字塔之謎解開了嗎？

sentences.en: How the cat got on the roof is a mystery to me.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓怎麼上屋頂的，我完全想不透。

sentences.en: We watched a mystery movie with a surprise ending.
sentences.zh: 我們看了一部結局出人意料的懸疑電影。

gloss_note: naked eye 肉眼；也可形容無遮蔽的東西

sentences.en: You can see Venus with the naked eye.
sentences.zh: 用肉眼就能看到金星。

sentences.en: Naked branches shook in the cold wind.
sentences.zh: 光禿禿的樹枝在寒風中搖晃。

sentences.en: The trees look naked in winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天的樹看起來光禿禿的。

sentences.en: Is the bulb naked or covered by a shade?
sentences.zh: 那顆燈泡是裸露的，還是有燈罩？

sentences.en: Bacteria are too small to see with the naked eye.
sentences.zh: 細菌小到用肉眼看不見。

sentences.en: Why is the statue in the park naked?
sentences.zh: 公園裡的雕像為什麼沒穿衣服？

gloss_note: take a nap 小睡；power nap

sentences.en: I took a short nap after lunch.
sentences.zh: 我午餐後小睡了一下。

sentences.en: Do you want to nap before we go out?
sentences.zh: 出門前你想先小睡一下嗎？

sentences.en: The baby is taking a nap upstairs.
sentences.zh: 寶寶正在樓上午睡。

sentences.en: A quick nap can help you focus in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 小睡一下能幫你下午集中精神。

sentences.en: He was napping on the couch when I got home.
sentences.zh: 我回到家時，他正在沙發上打盹。

sentences.en: How long should a power nap be?
sentences.zh: 補充精神的小睡該睡多久？

gloss_note: native speaker 母語人士

sentences.en: Is English your native language?
sentences.zh: 英語是你的母語嗎？

sentences.en: She's a native of Texas.
sentences.zh: 她是德州本地人。

sentences.en: Are kangaroos native to Australia?
sentences.zh: 袋鼠是原產於澳洲嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to talk with a native speaker.
sentences.zh: 我想跟母語人士聊聊。

sentences.en: Many native plants grow in this park.
sentences.zh: 這座公園裡長著許多原生植物。

sentences.en: The museum shows how native peoples lived here long ago.
sentences.zh: 博物館展示了很久以前原住民如何在這裡生活。

gloss_note: navy blue 海軍藍，簡稱 navy

sentences.en: My brother joined the navy last year.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥去年加入了海軍。

sentences.en: The navy ship arrived at the port this morning.
sentences.zh: 海軍艦艇今天早上抵達了港口。

sentences.en: Do you like my navy sweater?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡我這件深藍色的毛衣嗎？

sentences.en: Her grandfather served in the navy during the war.
sentences.zh: 她的爺爺在戰爭期間於海軍服役。

sentences.en: Which is bigger, the army or the navy?
sentences.zh: 陸軍和海軍哪個比較大？

sentences.en: He wore a navy suit to the interview.
sentences.zh: 他穿著深藍色西裝去面試。

gloss_note: 美式口語 neat 也表示「很酷、很棒」

sentences.en: Her room is always neat and clean.
sentences.zh: 她的房間總是整齊又乾淨。

sentences.en: That's a neat trick! How did you do it?
sentences.zh: 這招好酷！你是怎麼做到的？

sentences.en: Please keep your desk neat.
sentences.zh: 請保持你的書桌整潔。

sentences.en: He always has such neat handwriting.
sentences.zh: 他的字跡總是很工整。

sentences.en: Isn't this a neat idea for a science project?
sentences.zh: 這不是個很棒的科展點子嗎？

sentences.en: The books were stacked in neat piles.
sentences.zh: 書被疊成整整齊齊的幾疊。

gloss_note: of necessity 迫於需要；可數／不可數皆可

sentences.en: Water is a basic necessity of life.
sentences.zh: 水是生活的基本必需品。

sentences.en: Is a car a necessity where you live?
sentences.zh: 在你住的地方，車子是必需品嗎？

sentences.en: Out of necessity, we sold our second car.
sentences.zh: 迫於需要，我們賣掉了第二輛車。

sentences.en: Is a phone a necessity for most teenagers now?
sentences.zh: 對現在大多數青少年來說，手機是必需品嗎？

sentences.en: Sleep is not a luxury; it's a necessity.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不是奢侈品，而是必需品。

sentences.en: The store sells daily necessities at low prices.
sentences.zh: 這間店以低價販售日常必需品。

gloss_note: 口語常簡稱 tie；wear/tie a necktie

sentences.en: Dad wears a necktie to work every day.
sentences.zh: 爸爸每天上班都打領帶。

sentences.en: Can you help me tie my necktie?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我打領帶嗎？

sentences.en: He spilled soup on his new necktie.
sentences.zh: 他把湯灑在新領帶上了。

sentences.en: Do I have to wear a necktie to the interview?
sentences.zh: 面試一定要打領帶嗎？

sentences.en: She gave her husband a blue necktie for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 她送給先生一條藍色領帶當生日禮物。

sentences.en: Neckties are not required at our school.
sentences.zh: 我們學校不要求打領帶。

gloss_note: 美式拼法；英式為 neighbourhood

sentences.en: It's a quiet neighborhood with a lot of trees.
sentences.zh: 這是個安靜、綠樹很多的社區。

sentences.en: Do you like living in this neighborhood?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡住在這一帶嗎？

sentences.en: Kids play outside in our neighborhood every evening.
sentences.zh: 我們社區的孩子每天傍晚都在外面玩。

sentences.en: The neighborhood grocery store closes at nine.
sentences.zh: 社區附近的雜貨店九點打烊。

sentences.en: I grew up in a small neighborhood in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我在俄亥俄州的一個小社區長大。

sentences.en: Is this neighborhood safe at night?
sentences.zh: 這一帶晚上安全嗎？

gloss_note: give someone a nickname

sentences.en: Everyone calls her Tiny, but it's just a nickname.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫她「小不點」，不過那只是個綽號。

sentences.en: What's the story behind your nickname?
sentences.zh: 你這個綽號背後有什麼故事？

sentences.en: My friends gave me a funny nickname in middle school.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友在國中時幫我取了個好笑的綽號。

sentences.en: They nicknamed the small puppy Bean.
sentences.zh: 他們給那隻小狗取了個外號叫「豆豆」。

sentences.en: Do you have a nickname at home?
sentences.zh: 你在家裡有小名嗎？

sentences.en: The team's nickname is the Eagles.
sentences.zh: 這支球隊的別名是老鷹隊。

gloss_note: novel 是小說；novelist 專指寫長篇小說的人

sentences.en: She wants to become a novelist someday.
sentences.zh: 她希望有一天成為小說家。

sentences.en: That novelist wrote ten books in twenty years.
sentences.zh: 那位小說家二十年寫了十本書。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite novelist?
sentences.zh: 你最喜歡哪位小說家？

sentences.en: The famous novelist will visit our school next week.
sentences.zh: 那位知名小說家下週會來我們學校。

sentences.en: Is the novelist working on a new story?
sentences.zh: 那位小說家正在寫新作品嗎？

sentences.en: Many novelists write early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 許多小說家習慣在清晨寫作。

gloss_note: 天主教等修道院的女性修行者

sentences.en: The nun teaches music at the girls' school.
sentences.zh: 那位修女在女子學校教音樂。

sentences.en: Have you seen the movie about a singing nun?
sentences.zh: 你看過那部關於唱歌修女的電影嗎？

sentences.en: My aunt became a nun when she was twenty.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨二十歲時成為修女。

sentences.en: The nuns run a small hospital in the town.
sentences.zh: 修女們在鎮上經營一間小醫院。

sentences.en: A nun walked quietly through the garden.
sentences.zh: 一位修女靜靜地走過花園。

sentences.en: Why did she decide to become a nun?
sentences.zh: 她為什麼決定成為修女？

gloss_note: oak tree 橡樹；果實是 acorn

sentences.en: Do you see the huge oak tree in our backyard?
sentences.zh: 你看到我們後院那棵巨大的橡樹了嗎？

sentences.en: The table is made of solid oak.
sentences.zh: 這張桌子是用實心橡木做的。

sentences.en: Squirrels hide acorns under the oak.
sentences.zh: 松鼠把橡實藏在橡樹下。

sentences.en: Is that floor oak or pine?
sentences.zh: 那個地板是橡木還是松木？

sentences.en: We carved our names into the old oak.
sentences.zh: 我們把名字刻在那棵老橡樹上。

sentences.en: Oak furniture lasts for many years.
sentences.zh: 橡木家具可以用很多年。

gloss_note: observe + 人／事／that 子句

sentences.en: Scientists observe the stars with large telescopes.
sentences.zh: 科學家用大型望遠鏡觀測星星。

sentences.en: Did you observe any changes in the plant this week?
sentences.zh: 你這週有觀察到這株植物有什麼變化嗎？

sentences.en: Sit quietly and observe how the birds behave.
sentences.zh: 靜靜坐著，觀察鳥類的行為。

sentences.en: How long did the nurse observe the patient?
sentences.zh: 護士觀察了病人多久？

sentences.en: I observed that she was very nervous.
sentences.zh: 我注意到她非常緊張。

sentences.en: Children learn by observing adults.
sentences.zh: 孩子透過觀察大人來學習。

gloss_note: special occasion 特殊場合

sentences.en: Does Dad only wear a suit on special occasions?
sentences.zh: 爸爸只有在特殊場合才穿西裝嗎？

sentences.en: We've met on several occasions at school events.
sentences.zh: 我們在學校活動上見過好幾次面。

sentences.en: I'd love to visit, but maybe on another occasion.
sentences.zh: 我很想去拜訪，不過也許改天找別的機會。

sentences.en: The wedding was a joyful occasion for both families.
sentences.zh: 婚禮對兩家人來說都是喜悅的場合。

sentences.en: What's the occasion? You look so happy!
sentences.zh: 有什麼喜事嗎？你看起來好開心！

sentences.en: She wore a red dress for the occasion.
sentences.zh: 她為了這個場合穿了一件紅色洋裝。

gloss_note: odd job 零工；odd number 奇數

sentences.en: It's odd that he didn't answer my call.
sentences.zh: 他沒接我的電話，真奇怪。

sentences.en: Don't you think it's odd that the door was open?
sentences.zh: 你不覺得門開著很奇怪嗎？

sentences.en: Does she really have an odd habit of talking to plants?
sentences.zh: 她真的有對植物說話的怪習慣嗎？

sentences.en: That's an odd name for a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 對餐廳來說，這是個怪名字。

sentences.en: The soup tastes a little odd to me.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯我吃起來有點怪。

sentences.en: What an odd coincidence to meet you here!
sentences.zh: 在這裡遇到你，真是奇怪的巧合！

gloss_note: ongoing project/problem

sentences.en: The ongoing road work is slowing everyone down.
sentences.zh: 持續進行的道路施工讓大家都變慢了。

sentences.en: Are the talks still ongoing?
sentences.zh: 會談還在進行中嗎？

sentences.en: There's an ongoing problem with the school's Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 學校的無線網路一直有問題。

sentences.en: The police have an ongoing investigation into the case.
sentences.zh: 警方對這起案件仍在調查中。

sentences.en: Is the sale ongoing, or did it end yesterday?
sentences.zh: 特賣還在進行嗎？還是昨天就結束了？

sentences.en: Learning a language is an ongoing process.
sentences.zh: 學語言是個持續不斷的過程。

gloss_note: opportunity to + V；比 chance 正式

sentences.en: This is a great opportunity to learn something new.
sentences.zh: 這是學習新東西的絕佳機會。

sentences.en: Don't miss the opportunity to meet the author.
sentences.zh: 別錯過見到作者的機會。

sentences.en: Will you get the opportunity to travel this summer?
sentences.zh: 你今年夏天會有機會去旅行嗎？

sentences.en: The company offers equal job opportunities to everyone.
sentences.zh: 這間公司提供每個人平等的工作機會。

sentences.en: I'm grateful for the opportunity to work with you.
sentences.zh: 我很感謝有機會跟你共事。

sentences.en: When will the next opportunity come up?
sentences.zh: 下一個機會什麼時候會出現？

gloss_note: 介系詞用法美式多說 across from

sentences.en: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
sentences.zh: 銀行在街道的對面。

sentences.en: He said the opposite of what he really meant.
sentences.zh: 他說的和真正的意思正好相反。

sentences.en: Is the post office on the opposite corner from the library?
sentences.zh: 郵局在圖書館的對角嗎？

sentences.en: Hot is the opposite of cold.
sentences.zh: 熱是冷的相反。

sentences.en: We went in opposite directions after the meeting.
sentences.zh: 開完會後，我們往相反的方向走了。

sentences.en: Do you and your sister have opposite tastes in music?
sentences.zh: 你和你姐姐的音樂品味完全相反嗎？

gloss_note: be optimistic about/that...

sentences.en: I'm optimistic about the game tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我對明天的比賽很樂觀。

sentences.en: Why are you so optimistic about the test?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對這次考試這麼樂觀？

sentences.en: She is an optimistic person who always smiles.
sentences.zh: 她是個樂觀的人，總是帶著笑容。

sentences.en: Doctors are optimistic that he will recover soon.
sentences.zh: 醫生樂觀地認為他很快就會康復。

sentences.en: Are you optimistic about finding a job this year?
sentences.zh: 你對今年找到工作樂觀嗎？

sentences.en: It's hard to stay optimistic in such bad weather.
sentences.zh: 天氣這麼糟，很難保持樂觀。

gloss_note: oral test 口試；oral health 口腔健康

sentences.en: Do we have an oral test in English class tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天英文課有口試嗎？

sentences.en: Do you prefer an oral report or a written one?
sentences.zh: 你比較喜歡口頭報告還是書面報告？

sentences.en: Brush twice a day for good oral health.
sentences.zh: 每天刷兩次牙，口腔才會健康。

sentences.en: The agreement was only oral, not in writing.
sentences.zh: 這個協議只是口頭的，沒有白紙黑字。

sentences.en: Folk stories were passed on through oral tradition.
sentences.zh: 民間故事是靠口耳相傳的傳統流傳下來的。

sentences.en: Her oral English is much better than her writing.
sentences.zh: 她的英語口說比寫作好多了。

gloss_note: organic food/farm；也指有機物的

sentences.en: I buy organic vegetables at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 我在農夫市集買有機蔬菜。

sentences.en: Is this milk organic or regular?
sentences.zh: 這瓶牛奶是有機的還是一般的？

sentences.en: Organic food usually costs more than regular food.
sentences.zh: 有機食品通常比一般食品貴。

sentences.en: My uncle runs an organic farm outside town.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在城外經營一座有機農場。

sentences.en: Do you use organic soap on your baby's skin?
sentences.zh: 你用有機肥皂幫寶寶洗澡嗎？

sentences.en: Dead leaves are organic matter that helps the soil.
sentences.zh: 落葉是有助於土壤的有機物質。

gloss_note: 英式拼法 organise

sentences.en: Let's organize a surprise party for Mom.
sentences.zh: 我們來幫媽媽籌辦一場驚喜派對吧。

sentences.en: I need to organize my desk before the exam.
sentences.zh: 考試前我得先整理書桌。

sentences.en: Who organized the school trip last year?
sentences.zh: 去年的校外旅行是誰籌辦的？

sentences.en: Can you help me organize these files by date?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我把這些檔案按日期整理嗎？

sentences.en: The club organizes a beach cleanup every summer.
sentences.zh: 這個社團每年夏天都會舉辦淨灘活動。

sentences.en: She organized her ideas before she started writing.
sentences.zh: 她先把想法整理好，才開始動筆寫。

gloss_note: the original 指原作

sentences.en: Do you still have the original receipt?
sentences.zh: 你還留著原始收據嗎？

sentences.en: Isn't that a very original idea for a story?
sentences.zh: 那不是個很有創意的故事點子嗎？

sentences.en: The original building was destroyed in a fire.
sentences.zh: 原本的建築毀於一場大火。

sentences.en: I like the original better than the remake.
sentences.zh: 我覺得原作比重拍版好看。

sentences.en: Our teacher wants original work, not copied text.
sentences.zh: 老師要的是原創作品，不是抄來的文字。

sentences.en: My original plan was to stay home all weekend.
sentences.zh: 我原本的計畫是整個週末都待在家。

gloss_note: 只放名詞前；反義詞 indoor；副詞用 outdoors

sentences.en: We love outdoor activities like hiking and camping.
sentences.zh: 我們喜歡健行、露營這類戶外活動。

sentences.en: Is there an outdoor pool at the hotel?
sentences.zh: 這間飯店有室外游泳池嗎？

sentences.en: The outdoor concert starts at seven.
sentences.zh: 戶外演唱會七點開始。

sentences.en: Are outdoor tables available at the café tonight?
sentences.zh: 咖啡店今晚有戶外座位嗎？

sentences.en: She works as an outdoor guide in the national park.
sentences.zh: 她在國家公園擔任戶外嚮導。

sentences.en: Our school has a big outdoor basketball court.
sentences.zh: 我們學校有個大型室外籃球場。

gloss_note: the outdoors 指大自然（名詞）

sentences.en: Let's eat outdoors since the weather is nice.
sentences.zh: 天氣這麼好，我們到戶外吃吧。

sentences.en: Kids should spend more time outdoors.
sentences.zh: 孩子應該多花點時間待在戶外。

sentences.en: Do you want to play outdoors or inside?
sentences.zh: 你想在外面玩，還是在屋裡玩？

sentences.en: We slept outdoors under the stars last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我們睡在戶外的星空下。

sentences.en: It's too cold to work outdoors today.
sentences.zh: 今天太冷，沒辦法在戶外工作。

sentences.en: Is it okay to take the dog outdoors now?
sentences.zh: 現在可以帶狗到外面去嗎？

gloss_note: write an outline 列大綱；v. 概述

sentences.en: Write an outline before you start your essay.
sentences.zh: 開始寫作文之前，先列大綱。

sentences.en: Can you outline the plan in two minutes?
sentences.zh: 你能用兩分鐘概述一下這個計畫嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher gave us an outline of the lesson.
sentences.zh: 老師給了我們這堂課的大綱。

sentences.en: I could see the outline of a house in the fog.
sentences.zh: 我在霧中看得見一棟房子的輪廓。

sentences.en: She outlined her ideas on the whiteboard.
sentences.zh: 她把想法簡要寫在白板上。

sentences.en: Does your report have a clear outline?
sentences.zh: 你的報告有清楚的大綱嗎？

gloss_note: night owl 指夜貓子（愛熬夜的人）

sentences.en: An owl hooted outside my window last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚窗外有隻貓頭鷹在叫。

sentences.en: Owls hunt mostly at night.
sentences.zh: 貓頭鷹大多在夜間獵食。

sentences.en: Have you ever seen a real owl in the wild?
sentences.zh: 你有在野外看過真正的貓頭鷹嗎？

sentences.en: Why can an owl turn its head so far?
sentences.zh: 為什麼貓頭鷹的頭可以轉那麼遠？

sentences.en: My little sister has an owl backpack.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹有個貓頭鷹圖案的背包。

sentences.en: She's such a night owl; she stays up until three.
sentences.zh: 她是個夜貓子，會熬夜到三點。

gloss_note: home ownership 自有住宅

sentences.en: Who has legal ownership of this old house?
sentences.zh: 這棟老房子的法定所有權人是誰？

sentences.en: You need proof of ownership to sell the car.
sentences.zh: 賣車需要有所有權證明。

sentences.en: The company changed ownership last year.
sentences.zh: 那間公司去年換了老闆。

sentences.en: The two brothers share ownership of the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 兩兄弟共同擁有這間餐廳。

sentences.en: Is home ownership expensive in big cities?
sentences.zh: 在大城市，擁有自己的房子很貴嗎？

sentences.en: Ownership of the land was never clear.
sentences.zh: 那塊土地的所有權一直不明確。

gloss_note: note pad 便條本；v. 用軟料填塞

sentences.en: I wrote his number on a note pad.
sentences.zh: 我把他的號碼寫在便條本上。

sentences.en: Put a pad under your knees when you work.
sentences.zh: 工作時，在膝蓋下面墊個墊子。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your pad and pen?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的便條本和筆嗎？

sentences.en: The goalie wears pads on both legs.
sentences.zh: 守門員兩條腿上都戴著護墊。

sentences.en: He padded the box with old newspaper.
sentences.zh: 他用舊報紙墊在箱子裡。

sentences.en: Do you have a mouse pad I can use?
sentences.zh: 你有滑鼠墊可以借我用嗎？

gloss_note: 非常口語；pen pal 筆友

sentences.en: Hey pal, can you give me a hand?
sentences.zh: 嘿，老兄，能幫我一下嗎？

sentences.en: He's my old pal from elementary school.
sentences.zh: 他是我小學時的老朋友。

sentences.en: Are you and Jake pals?
sentences.zh: 你和傑克是朋友嗎？

sentences.en: My pen pal in Canada writes me every month.
sentences.zh: 我在加拿大的筆友每個月都寫信給我。

sentences.en: We've been pals since we were six.
sentences.zh: 我們從六歲就是好朋友了。

sentences.en: Thanks, pal. I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 謝啦，朋友，我真的很感激。

gloss_note: royal palace 皇宮；比 castle 更偏宮廷

sentences.en: The king lived in a huge palace by the sea.
sentences.zh: 國王住在海邊一座巨大的宮殿裡。

sentences.en: We toured the palace and saw the royal gardens.
sentences.zh: 我們參觀了宮殿，還看了皇家花園。

sentences.en: Is the palace open to visitors on Sundays?
sentences.zh: 宮殿星期天開放參觀嗎？

sentences.en: The palace has over a hundred rooms.
sentences.zh: 這座宮殿有一百多個房間。

sentences.en: Did you take any photos inside the palace?
sentences.zh: 你有在宮殿裡拍照嗎？

sentences.en: Guards stand outside the palace gates all day.
sentences.zh: 衛兵整天站在宮殿大門外。

gloss_note: palm 指手心；palm tree 棕櫚樹

sentences.en: Is the coin in the palm of your hand?
sentences.zh: 硬幣在你的手心嗎？

sentences.en: My palms get sweaty when I'm nervous.
sentences.zh: 我一緊張手心就冒汗。

sentences.en: Tall palms lined the beach road.
sentences.zh: 高大的棕櫚樹排列在海邊的路上。

sentences.en: Can you really read my palm?
sentences.zh: 你真的會看我的手相嗎？

sentences.en: We rested under a palm tree at the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海灘的棕櫚樹下休息。

sentences.en: She wiped her wet palms on her jeans.
sentences.zh: 她把濕濕的手心擦在牛仔褲上。

gloss_note: 美式早餐常見，常淋 maple syrup

sentences.en: Dad makes pancakes every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 爸爸每個星期天早上都做鬆餅。

sentences.en: Can I have pancakes with maple syrup?
sentences.zh: 我可以點配楓糖漿的鬆餅嗎？

sentences.en: The pancake was thick, soft, and warm.
sentences.zh: 這片鬆餅厚厚軟軟的，還熱熱的。

sentences.en: How many pancakes can you eat?
sentences.zh: 你能吃幾片鬆餅？

sentences.en: She flipped the pancake without breaking it.
sentences.zh: 她翻面時沒有把鬆餅弄破。

sentences.en: We had blueberry pancakes for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我們早餐吃了藍莓鬆餅。

gloss_note: Don't panic! 別慌；過去式 panicked

sentences.en: Don't panic! We still have time.
sentences.zh: 別慌！我們還有時間。

sentences.en: A panic broke out when the fire alarm rang.
sentences.zh: 火災警報響起時，現場陷入一片恐慌。

sentences.en: Why are you in such a panic?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼這麼慌張？

sentences.en: I panicked when I couldn't find my keys.
sentences.zh: 我找不到鑰匙時慌了手腳。

sentences.en: Panic spread quickly through the crowd.
sentences.zh: 恐慌在人群中迅速蔓延。

sentences.en: Do you panic when you speak in front of people?
sentences.zh: 你在眾人面前說話會慌張嗎？

gloss_note: holiday parade 節慶遊行

sentences.en: We watched the parade from the roof.
sentences.zh: 我們在屋頂上看遊行。

sentences.en: The holiday parade starts at ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 假日遊行十點開始。

sentences.en: Are you marching in the school parade?
sentences.zh: 你要參加學校的遊行嗎？

sentences.en: Thousands of fans lined the street for the victory parade.
sentences.zh: 成千上萬的球迷擠在街邊看勝利遊行。

sentences.en: Children in costumes paraded through the town.
sentences.zh: 穿著戲服的孩子們在鎮上遊行。

sentences.en: Where can I get a good view of the parade?
sentences.zh: 在哪裡可以有最好的視野看遊行？

gloss_note: a paradise for + 人；常形容理想之地

sentences.en: This beach is paradise on a sunny day.
sentences.zh: 晴天的這片海灘簡直是天堂。

sentences.en: Hawaii is a paradise for surfers.
sentences.zh: 夏威夷是衝浪者的天堂。

sentences.en: Is this island really a tropical paradise?
sentences.zh: 這座島真的是熱帶天堂嗎？

sentences.en: For book lovers, this store is paradise.
sentences.zh: 對愛書人來說，這間書店就是天堂。

sentences.en: They found paradise in a small mountain village.
sentences.zh: 他們在一個山中小村裡找到了世外桃源。

sentences.en: What does your idea of paradise look like?
sentences.zh: 你心目中的天堂是什麼樣子？

gloss_note: 美式較常說 package；parcel post 郵政包裹

sentences.en: A parcel arrived for you this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有你的包裹送到。

sentences.en: I need to send this parcel to my aunt.
sentences.zh: 我得把這個包裹寄給我阿姨。

sentences.en: Did the parcel come with a tracking number?
sentences.zh: 這個包裹有附追蹤號碼嗎？

sentences.en: I went to the post office to pick up a parcel.
sentences.zh: 我去郵局領包裹。

sentences.en: How much does it cost to mail a parcel to Taiwan?
sentences.zh: 寄包裹到台灣要多少錢？

sentences.en: She wrapped the parcel in brown paper.
sentences.zh: 她用牛皮紙把包裹包起來。

gloss_note: reading passage 閱讀短文

sentences.en: Read the passage and answer the questions.
sentences.zh: 讀這段文章，然後回答問題。

sentences.en: There's a narrow passage behind the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 廚房後面有條狹窄的通道。

sentences.en: Which passage in the book is your favorite?
sentences.zh: 書裡你最喜歡哪一段？

sentences.en: Please keep the passage clear in case of fire.
sentences.zh: 為了防火，請保持通道暢通。

sentences.en: Is there a secret passage in this old castle?
sentences.zh: 這座舊城堡裡有祕密通道嗎？

sentences.en: I highlighted the key passage in yellow.
sentences.zh: 我把重點段落用黃色螢光筆標了出來。

gloss_note: have a passion for...

sentences.en: Cooking is my biggest passion.
sentences.zh: 烹飪是我最大的熱情所在。

sentences.en: She plays the violin with great passion.
sentences.zh: 她拉小提琴時充滿熱情。

sentences.en: Do you have a passion for music?
sentences.zh: 你對音樂有熱情嗎？

sentences.en: He lost his passion for the job after five years.
sentences.zh: 工作五年後，他對這份工作失去了熱情。

sentences.en: Find a job that fits your passion.
sentences.zh: 找一份符合你熱情的工作。

sentences.en: What is your passion outside of school?
sentences.zh: 除了學校課業，你熱愛什麼？

gloss_note: pat someone on the back

sentences.en: She patted the dog on the head.
sentences.zh: 她輕拍了那隻狗的頭。

sentences.en: Dad gave me a pat on the back.
sentences.zh: 爸爸輕拍我的背稱讚我。

sentences.en: Can I pat your cat for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以摸一下你的貓嗎？

sentences.en: The teacher patted him on the shoulder and smiled.
sentences.zh: 老師輕拍他的肩膀，微微一笑。

sentences.en: Should I pat the dough gently to make it flat?
sentences.zh: 我要輕輕拍麵團讓它變平嗎？

sentences.en: He gave the baby a gentle pat to calm her.
sentences.zh: 他輕輕拍了拍嬰兒，讓她安靜下來。

gloss_note: lose/run out of patience

sentences.en: Teaching little kids takes a lot of patience.
sentences.zh: 教小孩需要很多耐心。

sentences.en: Do you ever lose your patience with this slow computer?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有對這台慢吞吞的電腦失去過耐心？

sentences.en: Thank you for your patience.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您的耐心等候。

sentences.en: Do you have the patience to wait in this line?
sentences.zh: 你有耐心排這條隊嗎？

sentences.en: Patience is the key to learning a new language.
sentences.zh: 耐心是學會新語言的關鍵。

sentences.en: She lost her patience and started yelling.
sentences.zh: 她失去耐心，開始大吼。

gloss_note: pave the way for 為…鋪路

sentences.en: They will pave the road next month.
sentences.zh: 他們下個月要鋪設這條路。

sentences.en: The workers paved the parking lot last week.
sentences.zh: 工人上週鋪好了停車場。

sentences.en: Is the path to the beach paved?
sentences.zh: 去海灘的小路有鋪過嗎？

sentences.en: Good grades can pave the way to a good college.
sentences.zh: 好成績能為進入好大學鋪路。

sentences.en: Our street was paved last summer.
sentences.zh: 我們這條街去年夏天鋪了新路面。
