sentences.en: Why do they pave over the grass here?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼把這裡的草地鋪成路面？

gloss_note: 美式指路面；人行道美式說 sidewalk

sentences.en: The pavement was hot enough to cook an egg.
sentences.zh: 路面燙到可以煎蛋。

sentences.en: Is the pavement still slippery from the rain?
sentences.zh: 路面被雨淋過後還很滑嗎？

sentences.en: Kids drew pictures on the pavement with chalk.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用粉筆在路面上畫畫。

sentences.en: The bike hit the pavement hard.
sentences.zh: 腳踏車重重撞上了路面。

sentences.en: Can you see the cracks in the pavement?
sentences.zh: 你看得到路面上的裂縫嗎？

sentences.en: Workers are repairing the pavement on Main Street.
sentences.zh: 工人正在修補大街的路面。

gloss_note: peas 通常用複數；green peas 青豆仁

sentences.en: I don't like peas in my fried rice.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡炒飯裡有豌豆。

sentences.en: Peas grow in green pods.
sentences.zh: 豌豆長在綠色的豆莢裡。

sentences.en: Can you pass me the peas, please?
sentences.zh: 可以把豌豆遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: The soup has carrots, corn, and peas.
sentences.zh: 這碗湯裡有紅蘿蔔、玉米和豌豆。

sentences.en: My little brother hides his peas under the rice.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟把他的豌豆藏在飯底下。

sentences.en: Do you grow pea plants in your garden?
sentences.zh: 你花園裡有種豌豆嗎？

gloss_note: peanut butter 花生醬；花生過敏很常見

sentences.en: Are you allergic to peanuts?
sentences.zh: 你對花生過敏嗎？

sentences.en: I love peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 我愛吃花生果醬三明治。

sentences.en: He ate a handful of peanuts at the game.
sentences.zh: 他在比賽現場吃了一把花生。

sentences.en: This cookie contains peanut oil.
sentences.zh: 這片餅乾含有花生油。

sentences.en: Peanuts are really beans, not nuts.
sentences.zh: 花生其實是豆類，不是堅果。

sentences.en: Can I get a bag of roasted peanuts?
sentences.zh: 我可以買一包烤花生嗎？

gloss_note: pearl necklace 珍珠項鍊

sentences.en: She wore a pearl necklace to the dinner.
sentences.zh: 她戴著珍珠項鍊去赴晚宴。

sentences.en: Pearls form slowly inside oysters in the sea.
sentences.zh: 珍珠在海裡的牡蠣體內慢慢形成。

sentences.en: Is that pearl real or fake?
sentences.zh: 那顆珍珠是真的還是假的？

sentences.en: My grandmother gave me her pearl earrings.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶把她的珍珠耳環送給了我。

sentences.en: Do you want pearls in your milk tea?
sentences.zh: 你的奶茶要加珍珠嗎？

sentences.en: Divers searched the bay for a rare pearl.
sentences.zh: 潛水員在海灣裡尋找一顆稀有的珍珠。

gloss_note: peel an orange；banana peel

sentences.en: Can you peel the potatoes for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫忙削晚餐要用的馬鈴薯皮嗎？

sentences.en: Don't throw the banana peel on the floor.
sentences.zh: 別把香蕉皮丟在地上。

sentences.en: My nose is peeling after the sunburn.
sentences.zh: 曬傷後，我的鼻子在脫皮。

sentences.en: Peel the orange and share it with your sister.
sentences.zh: 把橘子剝開，跟你妹妹分著吃。

sentences.en: The paint on the wall is starting to peel.
sentences.zh: 牆上的油漆開始剝落了。

sentences.en: How do you peel garlic so fast?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼能剝蒜頭剝得這麼快？

gloss_note: penguin 不會飛，但很會游泳

sentences.en: The penguin slid across the ice on its belly.
sentences.zh: 企鵝用肚子在冰面上滑行。

sentences.en: Penguins live in cold places like Antarctica.
sentences.zh: 企鵝住在南極洲這類寒冷的地方。

sentences.en: Which is cuter, a penguin or a panda?
sentences.zh: 企鵝和貓熊，哪個比較可愛？

sentences.en: We saw a baby penguin at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻小企鵝。

sentences.en: Why can't a penguin fly like other birds?
sentences.zh: 為什麼企鵝不能像其他鳥一樣飛？

sentences.en: My son loves his stuffed penguin.
sentences.zh: 我兒子很愛他的企鵝填充玩偶。

gloss_note: 美國一分硬幣；100 pennies = 1 dollar

sentences.en: I found a penny on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 我在人行道上撿到一枚一分錢硬幣。

sentences.en: A penny saved is a penny earned.
sentences.zh: 省下一分錢，就等於賺到一分錢。

sentences.en: Do you have a penny I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有一分錢硬幣可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: One hundred pennies make a dollar.
sentences.zh: 一百個一分錢硬幣等於一美元。

sentences.en: He spent every last penny on that guitar.
sentences.zh: 他把最後一分錢都花在那把吉他上了。

sentences.en: Is a penny still worth anything today?
sentences.zh: 一分錢在今天還有價值嗎？

gloss_note: perform a task/operation 執行；表演

sentences.en: She will perform a piano piece at the concert.
sentences.zh: 她將在音樂會上演奏一首鋼琴曲。

sentences.en: Doctors perform many operations every day.
sentences.zh: 醫生每天都會進行許多手術。

sentences.en: Who will perform the safety check on this machine?
sentences.zh: 誰會對這台機器執行安全檢查？

sentences.en: Our band will perform at the school fair.
sentences.zh: 我們的樂團將在校慶園遊會上表演。

sentences.en: Which song will you perform at the talent show?
sentences.zh: 你要在才藝表演上表演哪首歌？

sentences.en: The actors performed in front of a full theater.
sentences.zh: 演員們在座無虛席的劇院裡演出。

gloss_note: a good performance

sentences.en: Her performance in the play was amazing.
sentences.zh: 她在這齣戲裡的表演太精彩了。

sentences.en: What time does the evening performance start?
sentences.zh: 晚場演出幾點開始？

sentences.en: My grades reflect my performance this semester.
sentences.zh: 我的成績反映出我這學期的表現。

sentences.en: The team's performance has improved a lot.
sentences.zh: 球隊的表現進步了很多。

sentences.en: Did you enjoy the performance last night?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡昨晚的演出嗎？

sentences.en: The band's final performance made the crowd cheer.
sentences.zh: 樂團的最後一場演出讓觀眾歡呼。

gloss_note: ask for/give permission；不可數名詞

sentences.en: You need permission to use this room.
sentences.zh: 使用這間教室需要經過許可。

sentences.en: Did your mom give you permission to go?
sentences.zh: 你媽媽答應讓你去了嗎？

sentences.en: May I have your permission to leave early?
sentences.zh: 我可以得到您的允許提早離開嗎？

sentences.en: He took the car without permission.
sentences.zh: 他未經允許就把車開走了。

sentences.en: Ask for permission before you borrow my things.
sentences.zh: 借我的東西之前，要先徵求同意。

sentences.en: The photographer asked for permission to take our picture.
sentences.zh: 攝影師徵求我們同意拍照。

gloss_note: v. 重音在後，n. 重音在前

sentences.en: Smoking is not permitted in the building.
sentences.zh: 這棟大樓內不准吸菸。

sentences.en: Do you have a permit to park here?
sentences.zh: 你有在這裡停車的許可證嗎？

sentences.en: The school doesn't permit phones during class.
sentences.zh: 學校不准學生上課時使用手機。

sentences.en: If time permits, we'll visit the museum.
sentences.zh: 如果時間允許，我們會去參觀博物館。

sentences.en: My dad is applying for a building permit.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸正在申請建築許可證。

sentences.en: Will the weather permit a picnic this weekend?
sentences.zh: 這個週末的天氣允許我們去野餐嗎？

gloss_note: persuade 人 to + 動詞

sentences.en: I tried to persuade him to come with us.
sentences.zh: 我試著說服他跟我們一起來。

sentences.en: Can you persuade Mom to let me go?
sentences.zh: 你能說服媽媽讓我去嗎？

sentences.en: She persuaded me to try the spicy noodles.
sentences.zh: 她說服我試試那碗辣麵。

sentences.en: We were persuaded by the low price.
sentences.zh: 我們被低廉的價格說服了。

sentences.en: It's hard to persuade teenagers to wake up early.
sentences.zh: 要說服青少年早起很難。

sentences.en: How did the salesperson persuade you to buy it?
sentences.zh: 業務員是怎麼說服你買下它的？

gloss_note: wedding/news photographer

sentences.en: The photographer took our family picture.
sentences.zh: 攝影師幫我們拍了全家福。

sentences.en: My cousin works as a wedding photographer.
sentences.zh: 我表哥是婚禮攝影師。

sentences.en: Is the photographer free this Saturday?
sentences.zh: 攝影師這個星期六有空嗎？

sentences.en: A photographer waited outside the stadium all night.
sentences.zh: 一位攝影師在體育場外等了一整晚。

sentences.en: Do you want to be a photographer someday?
sentences.zh: 你將來想當攝影師嗎？

sentences.en: The photographers rushed to the red carpet.
sentences.zh: 攝影師們衝向了紅毯。

gloss_note: take a pill 吃藥

sentences.en: Take one pill after each meal.
sentences.zh: 每餐飯後吃一顆藥丸。

sentences.en: I forgot to take my allergy pill this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上忘了吃過敏藥。

sentences.en: Is it hard for you to swallow a pill?
sentences.zh: 你吞藥丸會覺得困難嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor gave me pills for the pain.
sentences.zh: 醫生開了止痛藥給我。

sentences.en: Vitamin pills don't replace healthy food.
sentences.zh: 維他命錠不能取代健康的食物。

sentences.en: How many pills should I take each day?
sentences.zh: 我每天應該吃幾顆藥？

gloss_note: pilot program 試辦計畫

sentences.en: The pilot said we'll land in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 機長說我們十分鐘後降落。

sentences.en: My uncle is an airline pilot.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是航空公司的飛行員。

sentences.en: Do you want to be a pilot?
sentences.zh: 你想當飛行員嗎？

sentences.en: The school will pilot a new reading program.
sentences.zh: 學校將試辦一項新的閱讀計畫。

sentences.en: Who piloted the plane during the storm?
sentences.zh: 暴風雨時是誰駕駛那架飛機的？

sentences.en: They ran a pilot test before the big launch.
sentences.zh: 他們在大規模推出前先做了試行測試。

gloss_note: pine tree 松樹；pine needle 松針

sentences.en: The cabin is surrounded by tall pine trees.
sentences.zh: 小木屋被高大的松樹環繞著。

sentences.en: I love the smell of pine in the winter.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡冬天松樹的氣味。

sentences.en: Is this table made of pine or oak?
sentences.zh: 這張桌子是松木還是橡木做的？

sentences.en: Pine needles covered the ground.
sentences.zh: 松針鋪滿了地面。

sentences.en: Should we cut a small pine for Christmas?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要砍一棵小松樹當聖誕樹？

sentences.en: Pine forests cover much of the northern mountains.
sentences.zh: 松林覆蓋了北部山區的大部分地方。

gloss_note: 美制約 473 毫升；1 quart = 2 pints

sentences.en: I'd like a pint of milk, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一品脫牛奶。

sentences.en: A pint is half of a quart.
sentences.zh: 一品脫是一夸脫的一半。

sentences.en: She bought a pint of ice cream for dessert.
sentences.zh: 她買了一品脫的冰淇淋當甜點。

sentences.en: How many pints are in a gallon?
sentences.zh: 一加侖有幾品脫？

sentences.en: Add a pint of water to the soup.
sentences.zh: 在湯裡加一品脫的水。

sentences.en: Do you sell fresh strawberries by the pint?
sentences.zh: 你們的新鮮草莓是論品脫賣的嗎？

gloss_note: cherry/olive pit 果核；也指深坑

sentences.en: Why did they dig such a deep pit here?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他們在這裡挖這麼深的坑？

sentences.en: Remove the pit before you eat the cherry.
sentences.zh: 吃櫻桃之前，先把果核去掉。

sentences.en: Is there a large pit in the middle of an avocado?
sentences.zh: 酪梨中間有一顆大籽嗎？

sentences.en: Workers dug a deep pit behind the building.
sentences.zh: 工人在大樓後面挖了一個深坑。

sentences.en: I almost broke a tooth on an olive pit.
sentences.zh: 我差點被橄欖核崩到牙齒。

sentences.en: The car got stuck in a muddy pit.
sentences.zh: 那輛車卡在一個泥坑裡。

gloss_note: pitch a ball 投球；high pitch 高音

sentences.en: He threw a fast pitch right over the plate.
sentences.zh: 他投了一顆直直越過本壘板的快速球。

sentences.en: She can pitch a fastball over ninety miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 她能投出時速超過九十英里的速球。

sentences.en: This song's pitch is too high for me.
sentences.zh: 這首歌的音太高了，我唱不上去。

sentences.en: Can you tell the difference in pitch between these notes?
sentences.zh: 你分得出這幾個音的音高差別嗎？

sentences.en: Who will pitch in tomorrow's game?
sentences.zh: 明天的比賽誰要投球？

sentences.en: A high pitch made everyone cover their ears.
sentences.zh: 一聲尖銳的高音讓大家都摀住了耳朵。

gloss_note: What a pity! 真可惜

sentences.en: It's a pity that you can't come.
sentences.zh: 你不能來真可惜。

sentences.en: What a pity! The store just closed.
sentences.zh: 太可惜了！那家店剛剛關門。

sentences.en: Why would I want your pity?
sentences.zh: 我為什麼要你的同情？

sentences.en: She felt pity for the lost puppy.
sentences.zh: 她很同情那隻走失的小狗。

sentences.en: Isn't it a pity to throw away good food?
sentences.zh: 把好好的食物丟掉，不是很可惜嗎？

sentences.en: I pity anyone who has to work this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我很同情這個週末還得上班的人。

gloss_note: plastic bag/bottle；不可數，指材質

sentences.en: Please stop using so much plastic.
sentences.zh: 請不要再用那麼多塑膠了。

sentences.en: Plastic takes hundreds of years to break down.
sentences.zh: 塑膠要好幾百年才會分解。

sentences.en: Is this cup made of plastic or glass?
sentences.zh: 這個杯子是塑膠還是玻璃做的？

sentences.en: He gave me a plastic toy car.
sentences.zh: 他給了我一輛塑膠玩具車。

sentences.en: We should recycle plastic bottles.
sentences.zh: 我們應該回收塑膠瓶。

sentences.en: Do you have a plastic bag I can use?
sentences.zh: 你有塑膠袋可以借我用嗎？

gloss_note: 可形容人、動物或語氣

sentences.en: Our puppy is so playful that he never sits still.
sentences.zh: 我們的小狗太愛玩了，一刻都靜不下來。

sentences.en: Is she always this playful, or is she just in a good mood?
sentences.zh: 她一直都這麼愛玩嗎，還是今天心情特別好？

sentences.en: He gave me a playful push and ran away laughing.
sentences.zh: 他開玩笑地推了我一下，然後笑著跑掉了。

sentences.en: The teacher's playful tone made the grammar lesson less boring.
sentences.zh: 老師輕鬆逗趣的語氣讓文法課沒那麼無聊。

sentences.en: Don't take it personally; he was just being playful.
sentences.zh: 別放在心上，他只是在鬧著玩。

sentences.en: Why is your cat so playful in the morning?
sentences.zh: 你的貓為什麼早上那麼愛玩？

gloss_note: plug in 插上電源；plug into 插入

sentences.en: Can you pull the plug out before you clean the lamp?
sentences.zh: 你清燈之前可以先把插頭拔掉嗎？

sentences.en: I forgot to plug in my phone last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚忘了把手機插上充電。

sentences.en: Where can I plug this laptop in?
sentences.zh: 我可以在哪裡插這台筆電？

sentences.en: The plug doesn't fit this wall outlet.
sentences.zh: 這個插頭插不進這個牆上的插座。

sentences.en: Just plug the cable into the back of the TV.
sentences.zh: 把線插進電視後面就好了。

sentences.en: You need a power strip because this plug won't reach the wall outlet.
sentences.zh: 你需要一條延長線，因為這個插頭搆不到牆上的插座。

gloss_note: 如 North Pole、flagpole、telephone pole

sentences.en: The bird sat on top of a tall pole.
sentences.zh: 那隻鳥停在一根高高的竿子頂端。

sentences.en: Penguins don't live at the North Pole.
sentences.zh: 企鵝不住在北極。

sentences.en: A car hit a telephone pole near our school.
sentences.zh: 一輛車撞上了我們學校附近的電線桿。

sentences.en: Do you have a fishing pole I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有釣竿可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: They put up the tent using two long poles.
sentences.zh: 他們用兩根長桿子把帳篷搭起來。

sentences.en: How tall is the pole that holds our school flag?
sentences.zh: 升學校旗幟的那根竿子有多高？

gloss_note: 通常放在名詞前，如 political party

sentences.en: Our social studies class is about the political system.
sentences.zh: 我們的社會課在講政治制度。

sentences.en: I don't like to argue about political topics at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡在晚餐時爭論政治話題。

sentences.en: Is that a political party or a sports club?
sentences.zh: 那是政黨還是運動社團？

sentences.en: The mayor made a political speech downtown yesterday.
sentences.zh: 市長昨天在市區發表了一場政治演說。

sentences.en: My uncle always watches political news after work.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔下班後總是看政治新聞。

sentences.en: Why do you think young people don't join political groups?
sentences.zh: 你覺得為什麼年輕人不參加政治團體？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: 口語中有時帶批評意味

sentences.en: My dad says every politician promises too much.
sentences.zh: 我爸說每個政治人物都承諾得太多。

sentences.en: Would you ever want to be a politician?
sentences.zh: 你想過當政治人物嗎？

sentences.en: The politician shook hands with people outside the market.
sentences.zh: 那位政治人物在市場外跟民眾握手。

sentences.en: A good politician listens to the people in the town.
sentences.zh: 好的政治人物會聆聽鎮上居民的聲音。

sentences.en: Several politicians visited our school for the festival.
sentences.zh: 有幾位政治人物來我們學校參加園遊會。

sentences.en: Which politician is giving the speech tonight?
sentences.zh: 今晚是哪位政治人物要演講？

gloss_note: 視為單數；talk politics 談政治

sentences.en: I try not to talk about politics at work.
sentences.zh: 我盡量不在公司談政治。

sentences.en: Do you follow politics, or is it too stressful?
sentences.zh: 你有在關心政治嗎，還是覺得壓力太大？

sentences.en: She studied politics in college and works at City Hall now.
sentences.zh: 她大學念政治，現在在市政府工作。

sentences.en: Politics is a hot topic among the seniors this year.
sentences.zh: 今年高三生很常討論政治。

sentences.en: Local politics affects the price of parking in this town.
sentences.zh: 地方政治會影響這個鎮上的停車費。

sentences.en: Why does everyone get so loud when they talk politics?
sentences.zh: 為什麼一談到政治，大家就變得這麼大聲？

gloss_note: 常見 opinion poll；v. 指做民調

sentences.en: A new poll shows most people like the plan.
sentences.zh: 一項新民調顯示多數人喜歡這個計畫。

sentences.en: Did you see the poll about school lunch?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那個關於學校午餐的民調嗎？

sentences.en: The class took a quick poll to pick a movie.
sentences.zh: 全班快速投票選了一部電影。

sentences.en: They polled five hundred voters over the phone.
sentences.zh: 他們用電話訪問了五百位選民。

sentences.en: According to the latest poll, the two teams are tied.
sentences.zh: 根據最新民調，兩隊不相上下。

sentences.en: Who won the poll to pick our class movie?
sentences.zh: 選班級電影的投票誰贏了？

gloss_note: 不可數；常指精緻的白瓷

sentences.en: This porcelain cup was my grandmother's.
sentences.zh: 這個瓷杯是我奶奶的。

sentences.en: Be careful, porcelain breaks easily.
sentences.zh: 小心，瓷器很容易破。

sentences.en: The museum has a room full of old Chinese porcelain.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一整間展示古代中國瓷器。

sentences.en: Is this vase real porcelain or just plastic?
sentences.zh: 這個花瓶是真的瓷器，還是塑膠的？

sentences.en: She keeps her best porcelain plates for special dinners.
sentences.zh: 她把最好的瓷盤留到特別的晚餐才用。

sentences.en: How much is this porcelain bowl?
sentences.zh: 這個瓷碗多少錢？

gloss_note: a portion of 一部分；v. 指分配

sentences.en: The portions at this restaurant are huge.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的份量好大。

sentences.en: Can I have a small portion of rice, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一小份飯嗎？

sentences.en: A large portion of my pay goes to rent.
sentences.zh: 我薪水有一大部分拿去付房租。

sentences.en: Only a small portion of the students passed the test.
sentences.zh: 只有一小部分學生通過了考試。

sentences.en: Mom portioned out the cake so everyone got a piece.
sentences.zh: 媽媽把蛋糕分好，讓每個人都有一塊。

sentences.en: Did you finish your portion of the group project?
sentences.zh: 你完成小組報告中你負責的部分了嗎？

gloss_note: 也可指人物的描寫；portrait mode 人像模式

sentences.en: There is a portrait of my grandfather in the hall.
sentences.zh: 走廊上掛著我爺爺的肖像。

sentences.en: She paints portraits of people in the park.
sentences.zh: 她在公園替人畫肖像。

sentences.en: Can you use portrait mode to take a picture of me?
sentences.zh: 你可以用人像模式幫我拍張照嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has a famous portrait of a young woman.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一幅著名的年輕女子肖像。

sentences.en: The book paints a warm portrait of small-town life.
sentences.zh: 這本書描繪了小鎮生活溫暖的一面。

sentences.en: Who painted this portrait of the old man?
sentences.zh: 這幅老先生的肖像是誰畫的？

gloss_note: 宣傳或裝飾用的大張紙；movie poster

sentences.en: I hung a poster of my favorite band on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我在牆上貼了一張我最愛的樂團的海報。

sentences.en: Did you see the poster for the school play?
sentences.zh: 你有看到學校話劇的海報嗎？

sentences.en: They put up posters all over town for the concert.
sentences.zh: 他們在鎮上到處貼演唱會的海報。

sentences.en: Our group made a poster about recycling for science class.
sentences.zh: 我們這組為自然課做了一張關於回收的海報。

sentences.en: Where can I buy a cheap movie poster?
sentences.zh: 哪裡可以買到便宜的電影海報？

sentences.en: The lost dog poster was taped to every pole on the street.
sentences.zh: 尋狗海報被貼在街上的每根電線桿上。

gloss_note: 後面接名詞或 -ing；postpone until/to

sentences.en: We had to postpone the picnic because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，我們只好把野餐延期。

sentences.en: Can we postpone our meeting until Friday?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把會議延到星期五嗎？

sentences.en: The team decided to postpone the game for a week.
sentences.zh: 球隊決定把比賽延後一週。

sentences.en: Don't postpone your homework until the last minute.
sentences.zh: 不要把功課拖到最後一刻才寫。

sentences.en: She postponed her trip when she got sick.
sentences.zh: 她生病時把旅行延期了。

sentences.en: Why did they postpone the field trip?
sentences.zh: 他們為什麼把校外教學延期？

gloss_note: a postponement of ... 某事的延期

sentences.en: The postponement of the concert upset a lot of fans.
sentences.zh: 演唱會延期讓許多粉絲很失望。

sentences.en: Did you hear about the postponement of the exam?
sentences.zh: 你聽說考試延期的事了嗎？

sentences.en: We received an email announcing the postponement.
sentences.zh: 我們收到一封宣布延期的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Bad weather caused the postponement of the game.
sentences.zh: 壞天氣導致比賽延期。

sentences.en: A short postponement won't change our plan much.
sentences.zh: 短暫的延期不會讓我們的計畫改變太多。

sentences.en: Who decided on the postponement of the school trip?
sentences.zh: 是誰決定把校外教學延期的？

gloss_note: 不可數；pottery class 陶藝課

sentences.en: My mom took a pottery class on Saturday mornings.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽週六早上去上陶藝課。

sentences.en: This pottery was made by hand in a small village.
sentences.zh: 這件陶器是在一個小村莊手工做的。

sentences.en: Do you want to try making pottery with me?
sentences.zh: 你想跟我一起試試做陶嗎？

sentences.en: The museum has pottery that is over two thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 博物館有超過兩千年歷史的陶器。

sentences.en: She sells her pottery at the weekend market.
sentences.zh: 她在週末市集賣她做的陶器。

sentences.en: Where did you learn to make pottery?
sentences.zh: 你在哪裡學會做陶器的？

gloss_note: pour 倒液體；It's pouring. 下大雨

sentences.en: Can you pour me a glass of water?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我倒杯水嗎？

sentences.en: It started to pour right when we left school.
sentences.zh: 我們剛離開學校就下起傾盆大雨。

sentences.en: She poured milk into her cereal and sat down.
sentences.zh: 她把牛奶倒進麥片裡就坐下了。

sentences.en: Don't pour hot water into a glass cup.
sentences.zh: 不要把熱水倒進玻璃杯裡。

sentences.en: Rain was pouring down, so the game was canceled.
sentences.zh: 雨一直傾盆而下，所以比賽取消了。

sentences.en: Should I pour the soup into the big bowl?
sentences.zh: 我要把湯倒進大碗裡嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數；live in poverty 生活貧困

sentences.en: Many families in the area live in poverty.
sentences.zh: 這個地區有許多家庭生活貧困。

sentences.en: Our class collected food to help fight poverty.
sentences.zh: 我們班募集食物來協助對抗貧窮。

sentences.en: He grew up in poverty but worked hard to go to college.
sentences.zh: 他在貧困中長大，卻努力考上了大學。

sentences.en: What causes poverty in a rich country?
sentences.zh: 在富裕的國家，貧窮是怎麼造成的？

sentences.en: The charity gives free meals to people living in poverty.
sentences.zh: 這個慈善團體提供免費餐點給生活貧困的人。

sentences.en: How can schools help kids who live in poverty?
sentences.zh: 學校要怎麼幫助生活貧困的孩子？

gloss_note: a practical person 務實的人

sentences.en: This bag is not pretty, but it's very practical.
sentences.zh: 這個包包不好看，但很實用。

sentences.en: Do you have any practical advice for a new student?
sentences.zh: 你對新生有什麼實用的建議嗎？

sentences.en: Let's be practical and take the bus instead of a taxi.
sentences.zh: 我們務實一點，搭公車不要搭計程車。

sentences.en: My mom is a practical person who hates wasting money.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽是個務實的人，最討厭浪費錢。

sentences.en: The class gives us practical skills like cooking and sewing.
sentences.zh: 這門課教我們烹飪和縫紉這類實用技能。

sentences.en: Is it practical to drive downtown at five o'clock?
sentences.zh: 五點開車去市區實際可行嗎？

gloss_note: in preparation for 為了準備；常用複數 preparations

sentences.en: Preparation for the test took me all weekend.
sentences.zh: 準備這次考試花了我整個週末。

sentences.en: How is the preparation for the party going?
sentences.zh: 派對的籌備進行得怎麼樣？

sentences.en: We made a lot of preparations for the camping trip.
sentences.zh: 我們為露營旅行做了很多準備。

sentences.en: Good preparation can make a job interview much easier.
sentences.zh: 充分的準備能讓面試輕鬆許多。

sentences.en: She bought extra water in preparation for the storm.
sentences.zh: 她為了因應風暴多買了一些水。

sentences.en: Did you finish the preparation for tomorrow's speech?
sentences.zh: 你把明天演講的準備做完了嗎？

gloss_note: in sb's presence 在某人面前；presence of ...

sentences.en: Your presence at the meeting is required.
sentences.zh: 你必須出席這場會議。

sentences.en: Did you notice the presence of a camera in the hall?
sentences.zh: 你有注意到走廊上有攝影機嗎？

sentences.en: Mom's presence made the room feel calm.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在場，讓整個房間感覺很平靜。

sentences.en: Please don't use your phone in the presence of guests.
sentences.zh: 有客人在場時請不要用手機。

sentences.en: The police presence on the street made people feel safer.
sentences.zh: 街上有警察駐守讓大家覺得比較安全。

sentences.en: Is your presence at the party really necessary?
sentences.zh: 你真的有必要出席那場派對嗎？

gloss_note: pretend to + 動詞；pretend (that) + 句子

sentences.en: The kids pretend to be pirates every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 孩子們每天下午都假裝自己是海盜。

sentences.en: Stop pretending you didn't hear me.
sentences.zh: 別再假裝你沒聽到我說話。

sentences.en: He pretended to be asleep so he wouldn't have to help.
sentences.zh: 他假裝睡著，這樣就不用幫忙了。

sentences.en: Why do you always pretend everything is fine?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼總是假裝一切都很好？

sentences.en: Let's pretend we're on a desert island.
sentences.zh: 我們來假裝自己在一座荒島上。

sentences.en: Do you ever pretend to be busy to avoid chores?
sentences.zh: 你有沒有假裝很忙來躲家事？

gloss_note: prevent sb from + -ing；prevention 為名詞

sentences.en: Washing your hands helps prevent the flu.
sentences.zh: 勤洗手有助於預防流感。

sentences.en: Nothing can prevent me from going to the concert.
sentences.zh: 沒有什麼能阻止我去演唱會。

sentences.en: How can we prevent water from leaking into the basement?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼防止水滲進地下室？

sentences.en: A fence was built to prevent children from running into the road.
sentences.zh: 他們蓋了圍欄，防止小孩跑到馬路上。

sentences.en: The new rule is meant to prevent cheating on tests.
sentences.zh: 這條新規定是為了防止考試作弊。

sentences.en: What can we do to prevent food from going bad?
sentences.zh: 我們可以怎麼防止食物壞掉？

gloss_note: previous to 在...之前（正式）

sentences.en: My previous teacher gave us much less homework.
sentences.zh: 我之前的老師給的功課少多了。

sentences.en: Did you have any previous experience with this software?
sentences.zh: 你之前有用過這套軟體的經驗嗎？

sentences.en: Please read the previous page before we start.
sentences.zh: 開始之前請先讀完前一頁。

sentences.en: Where did you work in your previous job?
sentences.zh: 你上一份工作在哪裡做？

sentences.en: The previous owner left a lot of old furniture here.
sentences.zh: 前一任屋主在這裡留下很多舊家具。

sentences.en: On the previous night, the storm knocked out the power.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，暴風雨造成停電。

gloss_note: It is probable that ...；比 possible 機率更高

sentences.en: It's probable that it will rain tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天很可能會下雨。

sentences.en: How probable is it that she will win the contest?
sentences.zh: 她有多大機率贏得比賽？

sentences.en: The probable cause of the fire was an old heater.
sentences.zh: 這場火災很可能的原因是一台舊暖氣機。

sentences.en: A late flight is a probable result of this storm.
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨很可能造成班機誤點。

sentences.en: That's the most probable reason he missed the bus.
sentences.zh: 那是他沒趕上公車最可能的原因。

sentences.en: How probable is it that the bus will be late again?
sentences.zh: 公車又誤點的機率有多大？

gloss_note: n. 為過程、步驟；v. 為處理、加工

sentences.en: Learning a language is a slow process.
sentences.zh: 學語言是個緩慢的過程。

sentences.en: The process of applying for a license takes weeks.
sentences.zh: 申請執照的程序要花好幾週。

sentences.en: Can you explain the process step by step?
sentences.zh: 你可以一步一步說明這個流程嗎？

sentences.en: The factory processes thousands of tomatoes every day.
sentences.zh: 這家工廠每天處理好幾千顆番茄。

sentences.en: It will take a few days to process your order.
sentences.zh: 處理你的訂單需要幾天的時間。

sentences.en: What is the next step in the process?
sentences.zh: 這個流程的下一步是什麼？

gloss_note: 常指電影、音樂製作人或農產品生產者

sentences.en: The movie producer visited our school last week.
sentences.zh: 那位電影製作人上週來了我們學校。

sentences.en: My cousin wants to be a music producer.
sentences.zh: 我表哥想當音樂製作人。

sentences.en: Brazil is a large producer of coffee.
sentences.zh: 巴西是咖啡的生產大國。

sentences.en: Who is the producer of this show?
sentences.zh: 這個節目的製作人是誰？

sentences.en: Local producers sell fresh eggs at the farmers market.
sentences.zh: 當地生產者在農夫市集賣新鮮雞蛋。

sentences.en: Is he the producer of that cooking show?
sentences.zh: 他是那個料理節目的製作人嗎？

gloss_note: by-product 副產品；product of ... 某事的結果

sentences.en: This store sells a lot of healthy products.
sentences.zh: 這家店賣很多健康的產品。

sentences.en: What is the best-selling product in your shop?
sentences.zh: 你們店裡最暢銷的產品是什麼？

sentences.en: The company just launched a new product.
sentences.zh: 那間公司剛推出一項新產品。

sentences.en: Her good grades are a product of hard work.
sentences.zh: 她的好成績是努力的成果。

sentences.en: Please check the product label for the ingredients.
sentences.zh: 請看產品標籤上的成分。

sentences.en: Does this product come with a warranty?
sentences.zh: 這項產品有附保固嗎？

gloss_note: make a profit 賺錢；profit from 從...獲益

sentences.en: The shop made a small profit last month.
sentences.zh: 那家店上個月賺了一點小利潤。

sentences.en: Did your lemonade stand make any profit?
sentences.zh: 你的檸檬水攤有賺到錢嗎？

sentences.en: The club sells cookies to raise money, not to make a profit.
sentences.zh: 社團賣餅乾是為了募款，不是為了賺錢。

sentences.en: Some people profit from other people's mistakes.
sentences.zh: 有些人靠別人的錯誤獲利。

sentences.en: Our profit was about twenty dollars after we paid for the supplies.
sentences.zh: 付完材料費後，我們賺了大約二十美元。

sentences.en: How much profit did the bake sale make?
sentences.zh: 園遊會的烘焙義賣賺了多少？

gloss_note: 常見 promote a product / be promoted

sentences.en: The company promotes its new phone on TV.
sentences.zh: 那間公司在電視上宣傳它的新手機。

sentences.en: Eating well can promote good health.
sentences.zh: 吃得健康有助於促進身體健康。

sentences.en: She was promoted to manager last week.
sentences.zh: 她上週被升為經理。

sentences.en: The club wants to promote the school play online.
sentences.zh: 社團想在網路上宣傳學校的話劇。

sentences.en: How can we promote reading among teenagers?
sentences.zh: 我們要怎麼在青少年之間推廣閱讀？

sentences.en: Did you get promoted, or are you just working harder?
sentences.zh: 你是升職了，還是只是比較努力？

gloss_note: proof of ... 某事的證明；不可數

sentences.en: Do you have proof that you paid the bill?
sentences.zh: 你有證據證明你付過帳單了嗎？

sentences.en: Please show proof of age before you buy the ticket.
sentences.zh: 購票前請出示年齡證明。

sentences.en: His smile was proof that he enjoyed the trip.
sentences.zh: 他的笑容證明他很喜歡這趟旅行。

sentences.en: The police found no proof that he was there.
sentences.zh: 警方找不到他曾在現場的證據。

sentences.en: I need proof of address to open a bank account.
sentences.zh: 我需要住址證明才能開銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: Do you have any proof for what you said?
sentences.zh: 你說的話有任何證據嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數時指財產；private property 私人土地

sentences.en: Please stay off private property.
sentences.zh: 請勿進入私人土地。

sentences.en: My uncle owns a lot of property near the beach.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在海邊擁有很多房地產。

sentences.en: Whose property is this old truck?
sentences.zh: 這輛舊卡車是誰的財產？

sentences.en: Stealing someone's property is against the law.
sentences.zh: 偷別人的財物是違法的。

sentences.en: The school's property includes a big sports field.
sentences.zh: 學校的用地包括一座大運動場。

sentences.en: Is this garden part of your property?
sentences.zh: 這個花園是你家土地的一部分嗎？

gloss_note: protection from/against ...；sun protection 防曬

sentences.en: Wear a hat for protection from the sun.
sentences.zh: 戴頂帽子來防曬。

sentences.en: This case gives your phone good protection.
sentences.zh: 這個手機殼能把手機保護得很好。

sentences.en: The law offers protection to young workers.
sentences.zh: 法律保護年輕的勞工。

sentences.en: Do these gloves provide enough protection against the cold?
sentences.zh: 這雙手套足夠防寒嗎？

sentences.en: Animals in the park are under strict protection.
sentences.zh: 公園裡的動物受到嚴格保護。

sentences.en: Does your helmet give you enough protection when you ride a scooter?
sentences.zh: 你騎機車時，安全帽的保護夠嗎？

gloss_note: 美式較常說 bar；pub 多指英式或愛爾蘭風格

sentences.en: They met at an Irish pub downtown after work.
sentences.zh: 他們下班後在市區一家愛爾蘭酒吧碰面。

sentences.en: The pub on the corner serves great fish and chips.
sentences.zh: 轉角那家酒吧的炸魚薯條很好吃。

sentences.en: Do you want to watch the game at the pub?
sentences.zh: 你想去酒吧看球賽嗎？

sentences.en: My dad's friend owns a small pub in London.
sentences.zh: 我爸的朋友在倫敦開了一家小酒吧。

sentences.en: In England, many towns have a pub near the church.
sentences.zh: 在英國，許多城鎮的教堂旁邊都有一間酒吧。

sentences.en: Is this pub open for lunch, or only at night?
sentences.zh: 這家酒吧中午有營業，還是只有晚上？

gloss_note: v. 指用拳頭打或用打孔機打洞；n. 為一拳

sentences.en: The boxer threw a quick punch at the bag.
sentences.zh: 拳擊手朝沙包快速揮了一拳。

sentences.en: Don't punch the wall; you'll hurt your hand.
sentences.zh: 別打牆壁，你會弄傷手。

sentences.en: Do you have a hole punch I can borrow?
sentences.zh: 你有打孔機可以借我嗎？

sentences.en: The conductor punched my ticket and smiled.
sentences.zh: 車掌在我的票上打了孔，並對我微笑。

sentences.en: In the movie, the hero punches a hole in the door.
sentences.zh: 電影裡，主角一拳在門上打出一個洞。

sentences.en: Why did the actor punch the wall in that scene?
sentences.zh: 那一幕裡，演員為什麼要打牆？

gloss_note: puppet show 木偶戲；hand puppet 手偶

sentences.en: The kids loved the puppet show at the library.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很喜歡圖書館的木偶戲。

sentences.en: My little sister plays with a cat puppet every day.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹每天都玩一隻貓咪手偶。

sentences.en: Can you make the puppet talk with a funny voice?
sentences.zh: 你可以用搞笑的聲音讓這個手偶說話嗎？

sentences.en: He built a puppet out of socks for the class project.
sentences.zh: 他用襪子做了一個手偶當班級作業。

sentences.en: The artist moves the puppet with thin strings.
sentences.zh: 藝術家用細線操控木偶。

sentences.en: Can you make a puppet out of paper?
sentences.zh: 你可以用紙做一個手偶嗎？

gloss_note: pure gold 純金；pure luck 純屬運氣

sentences.en: This ring is made of pure gold.
sentences.zh: 這枚戒指是純金做的。

sentences.en: The lake water is so pure that you can drink it.
sentences.zh: 這座湖的水很純淨，可以直接喝。

sentences.en: Is this orange juice 100 percent pure?
sentences.zh: 這瓶柳橙汁是百分之百純的嗎？

sentences.en: Winning the game was pure luck.
sentences.zh: 贏得比賽純粹是運氣。

sentences.en: She laughed with pure joy when she saw the snow.
sentences.zh: 她看到雪時開心地大笑。

sentences.en: Is this honey pure, or does it have sugar in it?
sentences.zh: 這罐蜂蜜是純的，還是有加糖？

gloss_note: v. 引述別人的話；n. 引文或報價

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to quote the poem in our essays.
sentences.zh: 老師要求我們在作文裡引用那首詩。

sentences.en: Can you quote me a price for painting the room?
sentences.zh: 你可以給我粉刷這個房間的報價嗎？

sentences.en: The reporter quoted the mayor in the story.
sentences.zh: 記者在報導裡引述了市長的話。

sentences.en: I love that quote about never giving up.
sentences.zh: 我很喜歡那句關於永不放棄的名言。

sentences.en: Please quote the author's words exactly and list the source.
sentences.zh: 請逐字引述作者的原話，並列出出處。

sentences.en: Can I quote you on that in my school paper?
sentences.zh: 我可以在校刊裡引用你這句話嗎？

gloss_note: racial equality 種族平等；racial group 族群

sentences.en: The class talked about racial equality in history.
sentences.zh: 這堂課在談歷史上的種族平等。

sentences.en: The school wants every racial group to feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 學校希望每個族群的人都感到受歡迎。

sentences.en: Is this law about racial fairness at work?
sentences.zh: 這條法律是關於職場上的種族公平嗎？

sentences.en: Racial differences should never be a reason for bullying.
sentences.zh: 種族差異絕不該成為霸凌的理由。

sentences.en: Our town has a very mixed racial makeup.
sentences.zh: 我們鎮上的種族組成非常多元。

sentences.en: How can schools teach students to respect all racial groups?
sentences.zh: 學校要怎麼教導學生尊重所有種族？

gloss_note: a piece of rag；in rags 衣衫襤褸

sentences.en: Grab a rag and wipe the table, please.
sentences.zh: 請拿一塊抹布把桌子擦乾淨。

sentences.en: Dad cleans the car with an old rag.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用一塊舊抹布擦車子。

sentences.en: Where do you keep the rags for cleaning?
sentences.zh: 你把清潔用的抹布放在哪裡？

sentences.en: I used a wet rag to clean the spilled juice.
sentences.zh: 我用一塊濕抹布擦掉打翻的果汁。

sentences.en: The old shirt became a rag after a few years.
sentences.zh: 那件舊襯衫過了幾年就變成了抹布。

sentences.en: Do you have a clean rag for the windows?
sentences.zh: 你有乾淨的抹布可以擦窗戶嗎？

gloss_note: rank first/second；high rank 高階級

sentences.en: Our school ranks first in the state in math.
sentences.zh: 我們學校數學在全州排名第一。

sentences.en: What rank did your team get in the contest?
sentences.zh: 你們隊在比賽中排第幾名？

sentences.en: The magazine ranks the best colleges every year.
sentences.zh: 這份雜誌每年都會替最佳大學排名。

sentences.en: Our team is ranked third in the league this year.
sentences.zh: 我們隊今年在聯盟排名第三。

sentences.en: Her rank in the class dropped after she got sick.
sentences.zh: 她生病後，班上的名次往下掉了。

sentences.en: How would you rank these five movies from best to worst?
sentences.zh: 你會怎麼把這五部電影從最好到最差排名？

gloss_note: raw fish 生魚片；raw material 原料

sentences.en: Do you like to eat raw fish?
sentences.zh: 你喜歡吃生魚嗎？

sentences.en: Don't eat raw eggs; they can make you sick.
sentences.zh: 不要吃生蛋，可能會讓你生病。

sentences.en: I like carrots raw, but my brother likes them cooked.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡生吃紅蘿蔔，但我弟弟喜歡吃熟的。

sentences.en: The factory buys raw materials from other countries.
sentences.zh: 這家工廠從其他國家購買原料。

sentences.en: This salad has raw vegetables and a little cheese.
sentences.zh: 這份沙拉有生的蔬菜和一點起司。

sentences.en: Is this fish raw or cooked?
sentences.zh: 這條魚是生的還是熟的？

gloss_note: ray of light/sunshine；X-ray X光

sentences.en: A ray of sunlight came through the window.
sentences.zh: 一道陽光從窗戶照了進來。

sentences.en: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from the sun's rays.
sentences.zh: 擦防曬乳來保護皮膚不被陽光的光線傷害。

sentences.en: Do you see that ray of light behind the clouds?
sentences.zh: 你有看到雲後面那道光線嗎？

sentences.en: Look at the ray of light coming through the curtain.
sentences.zh: 看窗簾透進來的那道光線。

sentences.en: The first rays of the morning sun lit up the lake.
sentences.zh: 清晨的第一道陽光照亮了湖面。

sentences.en: Can you see the ray of light on the wall?
sentences.zh: 你有看到牆上那道光線嗎？

gloss_note: electric razor 電動刮鬍刀；razor blade 刀片

sentences.en: My dad uses an electric razor every morning.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸每天早上用電動刮鬍刀。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your razor for a minute?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的刮鬍刀用一下嗎？

sentences.en: Be careful, that razor is very sharp.
sentences.zh: 小心，那把刮鬍刀很鋒利。

sentences.en: I need to buy a new razor at the drugstore.
sentences.zh: 我得去藥妝店買一支新的刮鬍刀。

sentences.en: The razor blade is too dull, so it hurts my face.
sentences.zh: 這個刀片太鈍了，刮起來臉會痛。

sentences.en: Where did you put my razor?
sentences.zh: 你把我的刮鬍刀放到哪裡去了？

gloss_note: react to ...；react badly 反應不佳

sentences.en: How did your parents react to the news?
sentences.zh: 你爸媽聽到這個消息有什麼反應？

sentences.en: She didn't react at all when I told her the joke.
sentences.zh: 我講笑話給她聽，她一點反應也沒有。

sentences.en: Some people react badly to certain foods.
sentences.zh: 有些人吃了某些食物會有不良反應。

sentences.en: Players must react fast to a ball coming at them.
sentences.zh: 球員必須對飛過來的球快速反應。

sentences.en: Iron can react with air and water and turn into rust.
sentences.zh: 鐵可以和空氣與水起反應，變成鐵鏽。

sentences.en: How do you think she will react to the surprise?
sentences.zh: 你覺得她對這個驚喜會有什麼反應？

gloss_note: reaction to ...；allergic reaction 過敏反應

sentences.en: What was your reaction when you saw the test score?
sentences.zh: 你看到考試成績時有什麼反應？

sentences.en: His reaction to the surprise party was priceless.
sentences.zh: 他對驚喜派對的反應真是太好笑了。

sentences.en: She had an allergic reaction to the peanuts.
sentences.zh: 她對花生有過敏反應。

sentences.en: The film got a strong reaction from the audience.
sentences.zh: 這部電影得到觀眾很大的迴響。

sentences.en: Good drivers have quick reactions on the road.
sentences.zh: 好的駕駛在路上反應很快。

sentences.en: What was the audience's reaction to the ending?
sentences.zh: 觀眾對結局的反應如何？

gloss_note: reasonable price 公道的價格

sentences.en: The price of this jacket is quite reasonable.
sentences.zh: 這件外套的價格相當公道。

sentences.en: Is it reasonable to ask for a day off?
sentences.zh: 請一天假是合理的要求嗎？

sentences.en: My parents are reasonable people, so I can talk to them.
sentences.zh: 我父母是講理的人，所以我可以跟他們談。

sentences.en: That sounds like a reasonable plan to me.
sentences.zh: 我覺得那聽起來是個合理的計畫。

sentences.en: We found a hotel with a reasonable rate near the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們在海邊附近找到一家價格合理的旅館。

sentences.en: Don't you think that's a reasonable request?
sentences.zh: 你不覺得這是個合理的要求嗎？

gloss_note: telephone receiver 電話聽筒；radio receiver

sentences.en: He picked up the receiver and dialed the number.
sentences.zh: 他拿起話筒撥了號碼。

sentences.en: Our old radio receiver still works well.
sentences.zh: 我們那台舊收音機的接收器還能用。

sentences.en: Please put the receiver back when you finish.
sentences.zh: 講完請把話筒掛回去。

sentences.en: The TV needs a new receiver to get a clear signal.
sentences.zh: 這台電視需要新的接收器才能收到清楚的訊號。

sentences.en: Where did you leave the receiver for the cordless phone?
sentences.zh: 你把無線電話的話筒放到哪裡去了？

sentences.en: Is the receiver on the table, or did you hang it up?
sentences.zh: 話筒在桌上，還是你已經掛好了？

gloss_note: recognize sb by ...；also recognize 承認

sentences.en: I almost didn't recognize you with short hair.
sentences.zh: 你剪短頭髮，我差點認不出你。

sentences.en: Do you recognize this song?
sentences.zh: 你認得這首歌嗎？

sentences.en: She recognized her old teacher at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 她在雜貨店認出了她的老師。

sentences.en: My phone can recognize my face to unlock itself.
sentences.zh: 我的手機能辨識我的臉來解鎖。

sentences.en: She recognized the man from an old photo.
sentences.zh: 她從一張舊照片認出了那個男人。

sentences.en: Would you recognize him if you saw him again?
sentences.zh: 如果再看到他，你認得出來嗎？

gloss_note: voice recorder 錄音筆

sentences.en: I use a voice recorder to save the teacher's lecture.
sentences.zh: 我用錄音筆錄下老師的課。

sentences.en: Can I turn on the recorder during the interview?
sentences.zh: 訪談的時候我可以開錄音機嗎？

sentences.en: Grandpa still has an old tape recorder in the closet.
sentences.zh: 爺爺的衣櫃裡還有一台舊的錄音機。

sentences.en: The reporter held a small recorder near the mayor.
sentences.zh: 記者把一支小錄音機拿到市長旁邊。

sentences.en: Where is the recorder I used for the project?
sentences.zh: 我做專題用的錄音機在哪裡？

sentences.en: The recorder picked up every word of the speech.
sentences.zh: 錄音機把演講的每個字都錄下來了。

gloss_note: reduce A to B；reduce the risk of ...

sentences.en: We need to reduce the amount of plastic we use.
sentences.zh: 我們需要減少使用塑膠的量。

sentences.en: How can I reduce my stress before the test?
sentences.zh: 考前我要怎麼降低壓力？

sentences.en: The store reduced the price of winter coats by half.
sentences.zh: 商店把冬季外套的價格砍了一半。

sentences.en: Exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
sentences.zh: 運動可以降低心臟病的風險。

sentences.en: The city wants to reduce traffic downtown.
sentences.zh: 這座城市想減少市區的車流。

sentences.en: Can we reduce the cost by buying in bulk?
sentences.zh: 我們可以靠大量購買來降低成本嗎？

gloss_note: regional manager 區域經理

sentences.en: Our team won the regional contest last weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們隊上週末贏得了區域比賽。

sentences.en: Each regional office has its own manager.
sentences.zh: 每個區域辦公室都有自己的經理。

sentences.en: This restaurant serves regional dishes from the South.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳供應南方的地方料理。

sentences.en: Is there a regional bus to the airport?
sentences.zh: 有開往機場的區域公車嗎？

sentences.en: The regional weather report says rain is coming.
sentences.zh: 地區天氣預報說快要下雨了。

sentences.en: What is the regional food of your hometown?
sentences.zh: 你家鄉的地方料理是什麼？

gloss_note: v. 釋放、發布；n. 新發行（如 new release）

sentences.en: The band will release a new album next month.
sentences.zh: 這個樂團下個月要發行新專輯。

sentences.en: Did they release the bird back into the wild?
sentences.zh: 他們把那隻鳥放回野外了嗎？

sentences.en: Please don't release the button until the light turns green.
sentences.zh: 燈號變綠之前請不要放開按鈕。

sentences.en: The movie's release date was moved to June.
sentences.zh: 這部電影的上映日期改到了六月。

sentences.en: The company released a statement about the problem.
sentences.zh: 公司發布了一份關於這個問題的聲明。

sentences.en: Is the new phone's release in the fall or spring?
sentences.zh: 新手機是秋天還是春天發售？

gloss_note: reliable source 可靠的消息來源

sentences.en: My old truck is not pretty, but it's reliable.
sentences.zh: 我的舊卡車不好看，但很可靠。

sentences.en: Is this website a reliable source of news?
sentences.zh: 這個網站是可靠的新聞來源嗎？

sentences.en: Our neighbor is a reliable babysitter.
sentences.zh: 我們的鄰居是個可靠的保母。

sentences.en: Can I get a reliable internet connection here?
sentences.zh: 我在這裡能連上穩定的網路嗎？

sentences.en: She is the most reliable person on our team.
sentences.zh: 她是我們團隊裡最可靠的人。

sentences.en: You need a reliable car to drive to work every day.
sentences.zh: 你每天開車上班需要一輛可靠的車。

gloss_note: What a relief! 真是鬆了一口氣；pain relief 止痛

sentences.en: It was a relief to finish the final exam.
sentences.zh: 期末考考完真是讓人鬆了口氣。

sentences.en: What a relief! I found my keys.
sentences.zh: 真是鬆了一口氣！我找到鑰匙了。

sentences.en: She sighed with relief when the test was over.
sentences.zh: 考試結束時，她如釋重負地嘆了口氣。

sentences.en: Do you take anything for pain relief?
sentences.zh: 你有吃什麼東西來止痛嗎？

sentences.en: Cold water gave him some relief from the heat.
sentences.zh: 冷水讓他覺得沒那麼熱了。

sentences.en: Did you feel any relief after taking the medicine?
sentences.zh: 吃了藥之後有比較舒服嗎？

gloss_note: religious holiday 宗教節日

sentences.en: Christmas is both a religious and a family holiday.
sentences.zh: 聖誕節既是宗教節日，也是家人團聚的節日。

sentences.en: My grandmother is very religious and goes to church every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶很虔誠，每週日都去教堂。

sentences.en: Our class visited a religious building to learn about art.
sentences.zh: 我們班參觀了一座宗教建築，認識其中的藝術。

sentences.en: Are you taking the religious studies class next year?
sentences.zh: 你明年要修宗教學的課嗎？

sentences.en: Many religious festivals include music and special food.
sentences.zh: 許多宗教節慶都有音樂和特別的食物。

sentences.en: Is that building a religious center or a museum?
sentences.zh: 那棟建築是宗教場所還是博物館？

gloss_note: rely on/upon sb/sth；on 不能省

sentences.en: You can rely on me; I'll be there at six.
sentences.zh: 你可以信賴我，我六點會到。

sentences.en: Many people rely on their phones for directions.
sentences.zh: 很多人靠手機來看路線。

sentences.en: Can I rely on you to water my plants this week?
sentences.zh: 這週我可以靠你幫我澆花嗎？

sentences.en: The small town relies on tourists for most of its income.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮的大部分收入都仰賴觀光客。

sentences.en: Don't rely only on the weather report when you go hiking.
sentences.zh: 去健行時別只依賴天氣預報。

sentences.en: Who do you rely on when you need help?
sentences.zh: 你需要幫忙的時候會靠誰？

gloss_note: remain + 形容詞；remain in/at 留在某處

sentences.en: Please remain seated until the plane stops.
sentences.zh: 飛機完全停下之前，請繼續坐好。

sentences.en: Only two cookies remain in the jar.
sentences.zh: 罐子裡只剩下兩片餅乾。

sentences.en: The weather will remain cold through the weekend.
sentences.zh: 天氣到週末都會一直很冷。

sentences.en: Do you want to remain friends after we graduate?
sentences.zh: 我們畢業後還要繼續當朋友嗎？

sentences.en: He remained calm even when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 即使燈熄了，他還是很冷靜。

sentences.en: The question remains: who will pay for the repairs?
sentences.zh: 問題依然存在：誰要付修理費？

gloss_note: remote village 偏遠村莊；remote control 遙控器

sentences.en: They live in a remote village in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 他們住在山裡一個偏遠的村子。

sentences.en: The cabin is in a remote area with no cell signal.
sentences.zh: 那間小木屋位在沒有手機訊號的偏遠地區。

sentences.en: We stayed in a remote cabin with no internet.
sentences.zh: 我們住在一間沒有網路的偏遠小木屋。

sentences.en: Can you only reach that remote island by boat?
sentences.zh: 那座偏遠的小島只能搭船去嗎？

sentences.en: I can't find the remote control for the TV.
sentences.zh: 我找不到電視的遙控器。

sentences.en: Is the cabin really that remote?
sentences.zh: 那間小木屋真的那麼偏遠嗎？

gloss_note: replace A with B；replace 的受詞是被換掉的東西

sentences.en: I need to replace the batteries in this remote.
sentences.zh: 我得換掉這個遙控器的電池。

sentences.en: Who will replace Mr. Lee as our coach?
sentences.zh: 誰會接替李老師當我們的教練？

sentences.en: Robots may replace people in some factory jobs.
sentences.zh: 機器人可能會取代某些工廠的工作。

sentences.en: Can you replace this shirt with a larger size?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這件襯衫換成大一點的尺寸嗎？

sentences.en: She replaced the broken window last weekend.
sentences.zh: 她上週末換了破掉的窗戶。

sentences.en: Nothing can replace a good night's sleep.
sentences.zh: 沒有什麼能取代一夜好眠。

gloss_note: replacement for ...；常與 find a replacement 連用

sentences.en: I'm looking for a replacement for my broken charger.
sentences.zh: 我在找一個可以取代壞掉充電器的替代品。

sentences.en: The team found a replacement for the injured player.
sentences.zh: 球隊找到了一位來代替受傷球員的人。

sentences.en: Do you offer free replacement if the item is damaged?
sentences.zh: 商品如果有損壞，你們提供免費換貨嗎？

sentences.en: She trained her replacement before she left the job.
sentences.zh: 她離職前訓練了接替她的人。

sentences.en: A replacement for the old bridge will open next year.
sentences.zh: 舊橋的新替代橋明年會開通。

sentences.en: Who will be the replacement for the coach?
sentences.zh: 誰會接替教練的位置？

gloss_note: represent sb 作為代表；represent 表示、象徵

sentences.en: He will represent our school in the speech contest.
sentences.zh: 他將代表我們學校參加演講比賽。

sentences.en: What does the red color represent on this flag?
sentences.zh: 這面旗子上的紅色代表什麼？

sentences.en: A lawyer represents you in court.
sentences.zh: 律師在法庭上代表你。

sentences.en: Each star on the poster represents one team member.
sentences.zh: 海報上的每顆星代表一位團隊成員。

sentences.en: Who will represent the class at the student meeting?
sentences.zh: 誰要代表班上去參加學生大會？

sentences.en: The painting is meant to represent peace.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫的用意是象徵和平。

gloss_note: n. 代表、業務員；adj. 具代表性

sentences.en: A sales representative called me about the new phone plan.
sentences.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來介紹新的手機方案。

sentences.en: Each class elects a representative for the student council.
sentences.zh: 每個班級都會選一位代表進學生會。

sentences.en: Can I talk to a customer service representative?
sentences.zh: 我可以跟客服人員談嗎？

sentences.en: This painting is representative of the artist's early work.
sentences.zh: 這幅畫是這位藝術家早期作品的代表。

sentences.en: The company sent a representative to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 公司派了一位代表去開會。

sentences.en: Is this small group representative of the whole school?
sentences.zh: 這個小團體能代表整個學校嗎？

gloss_note: 如 the Republic of ...；國家名稱常用

sentences.en: The Czech Republic is a country in Europe.
sentences.zh: 捷克共和國是歐洲的一個國家。

sentences.en: Rome was a republic before it became an empire.
sentences.zh: 羅馬在成為帝國之前是共和國。

sentences.en: Is France a republic or a kingdom?
sentences.zh: 法國是共和國還是王國？

sentences.en: Our teacher explained how a republic works.
sentences.zh: 老師解釋了共和國是怎麼運作的。

sentences.en: The new republic wrote its own laws.
sentences.zh: 這個新共和國制訂了自己的法律。

sentences.en: What is the difference between a republic and a kingdom?
sentences.zh: 共和國和王國有什麼不同？

gloss_note: at sb's request 應某人要求；request sth

sentences.en: Can I make a request for a vegetarian meal?
sentences.zh: 我可以要求一份素食餐嗎？

sentences.en: She made a request to change seats.
sentences.zh: 她要求換座位。

sentences.en: The library accepted my request for the book.
sentences.zh: 圖書館接受了我借那本書的申請。

sentences.en: I requested a day off for my brother's wedding.
sentences.zh: 我為了我哥的婚禮申請了一天休假。

sentences.en: The DJ played the song at my request.
sentences.zh: DJ 應我的要求播放了那首歌。

sentences.en: Do you have a song request for the road trip?
sentences.zh: 你有想在公路旅行聽的歌嗎？

gloss_note: resist + 名詞/-ing；can't resist 忍不住

sentences.en: I can't resist fresh cookies.
sentences.zh: 我抵擋不了剛出爐的餅乾。

sentences.en: Try to resist the urge to check your phone during class.
sentences.zh: 上課時盡量忍住想看手機的衝動。

sentences.en: The town resisted the plan to close the library.
sentences.zh: 鎮上居民反對關閉圖書館的計畫。

sentences.en: How do you resist buying things you don't need?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼忍住不去買不需要的東西？

sentences.en: This coat helps you resist the cold wind.
sentences.zh: 這件外套能幫你抵擋寒風。

sentences.en: Can you resist eating dessert after dinner?
sentences.zh: 你晚餐後可以忍住不吃甜點嗎？

gloss_note: 常用複數 resources；natural resources 天然資源

sentences.en: Water is an important natural resource.
sentences.zh: 水是重要的天然資源。

sentences.en: The library has plenty of online resources for students.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為學生提供許多線上資源。

sentences.en: Our company doesn't have enough resources for this project.
sentences.zh: 我們公司沒有足夠的資源做這個專案。

sentences.en: Where can I find resources for learning English?
sentences.zh: 我可以去哪裡找學英文的資源？

sentences.en: Time is a resource we can't get back.
sentences.zh: 時間是我們追不回來的資源。

sentences.en: What resource can I use for my science project?
sentences.zh: 我做自然專題可以用什麼資源？

gloss_note: in response to ... 回應某事

sentences.en: I'm still waiting for a response to my email.
sentences.zh: 我還在等我那封電子郵件的回覆。

sentences.en: What was his response when you asked him?
sentences.zh: 你問他的時候，他怎麼回應？

sentences.en: In response to the storm, the school closed early.
sentences.zh: 為了因應暴風雨，學校提早放學。

sentences.en: The company's quick response saved the project.
sentences.zh: 公司迅速的回應挽救了這個專案。

sentences.en: We got a great response from the audience.
sentences.zh: 我們得到觀眾很好的回應。

sentences.en: What was the response to your idea?
sentences.zh: 大家對你的點子有什麼回應？

gloss_note: take responsibility for ... 為...負責

sentences.en: It's your responsibility to feed the dog.
sentences.zh: 餵狗是你的責任。

sentences.en: Who takes responsibility for this mistake?
sentences.zh: 這個錯誤由誰負責？

sentences.en: Having a pet is a big responsibility.
sentences.zh: 養寵物是很大的責任。

sentences.en: She felt a heavy responsibility as the team captain.
sentences.zh: 身為隊長，她覺得責任重大。

sentences.en: The mayor accepted responsibility for the delay.
sentences.zh: 市長承認這次延誤是他的責任。

sentences.en: Whose responsibility is it to lock the door?
sentences.zh: 鎖門是誰的責任？

gloss_note: restrict sb to ...；restrict sth 限制某事物

sentences.en: The school restricts phone use during class.
sentences.zh: 學校在上課時限制使用手機。

sentences.en: My doctor told me to restrict my salt intake.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生叫我限制鹽的攝取量。

sentences.en: The park restricts parking to two hours.
sentences.zh: 這座公園把停車限制在兩小時內。

sentences.en: Why do they restrict access to this room?
sentences.zh: 為什麼他們限制進入這個房間？

sentences.en: Heavy snow restricted our view of the road.
sentences.zh: 大雪限制了我們看路的視線。

sentences.en: Should schools restrict video games on campus?
sentences.zh: 學校應該限制在校園玩電玩嗎？

gloss_note: reveal a secret 說出秘密

sentences.en: The teacher will reveal the test results on Monday.
sentences.zh: 老師星期一會公布考試結果。

sentences.en: Please don't reveal the secret to anyone.
sentences.zh: 請不要把這個秘密告訴任何人。

sentences.en: The photo revealed a hidden door behind the shelf.
sentences.zh: 那張照片顯示書架後面有一道隱藏的門。

sentences.en: When will the company reveal its new phone?
sentences.zh: 公司什麼時候會發表它的新手機？

sentences.en: Do you want to reveal who your favorite singer is?
sentences.zh: 你願意說出你最喜歡的歌手是誰嗎？

sentences.en: The test revealed a small problem with his eyes.
sentences.zh: 檢查發現他的眼睛有個小問題。

gloss_note: tie a ribbon 打蝴蝶結；blue ribbon 一等獎

sentences.en: She tied a red ribbon around the gift.
sentences.zh: 她在禮物上綁了一條紅色緞帶。

sentences.en: Can I have a ribbon for my hair?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一條綁頭髮的緞帶嗎？

sentences.en: The mayor cut the ribbon to open the new library.
sentences.zh: 市長剪綵為新圖書館啟用。

sentences.en: My sister won a blue ribbon at the science fair.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹在科學展覽拿到了一條藍緞帶獎。

sentences.en: The dress has a long white ribbon at the back.
sentences.zh: 這件洋裝後面有一條長長的白色緞帶。

sentences.en: Do you have any ribbon to wrap this present?
sentences.zh: 你有任何緞帶可以包這個禮物嗎？

gloss_note: get rid of 擺脫；be rid of 擺脫了

sentences.en: I need to get rid of these old clothes.
sentences.zh: 我得把這些舊衣服處理掉。

sentences.en: How do I get rid of this headache?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼擺脫這個頭痛？

sentences.en: We finally got rid of the ants in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我們終於把廚房裡的螞蟻清掉了。

sentences.en: She wanted to rid her room of old toys.
sentences.zh: 她想把房間裡的舊玩具清掉。

sentences.en: Are you ready to get rid of your old phone?
sentences.zh: 你準備好要處理掉你的舊手機了嗎？

sentences.en: I'm glad to be rid of that noisy neighbor.
sentences.zh: 我很高興擺脫了那個吵鬧的鄰居。

gloss_note: ripe fruit 熟透的水果；反義 unripe

sentences.en: These mangoes are ripe and sweet.
sentences.zh: 這些芒果熟了，很甜。

sentences.en: How can you tell if a banana is ripe?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼知道香蕉熟了沒？

sentences.en: Let the tomatoes get ripe on the windowsill.
sentences.zh: 讓番茄在窗台上自己熟。

sentences.en: Don't pick the apples until they are ripe.
sentences.zh: 蘋果熟了再摘。

sentences.en: The strawberries at the farm are ripe in May.
sentences.zh: 農場的草莓五月會成熟。

sentences.en: Are the peaches ripe enough to eat?
sentences.zh: 這些桃子熟到可以吃了嗎？

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortybot assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: take a risk 冒險；at risk 處於風險中

sentences.en: Driving in heavy snow is a big risk.
sentences.zh: 在大雪中開車風險很大。

sentences.en: Is it worth the risk to quit your job?
sentences.zh: 辭掉工作值得冒這個險嗎？

sentences.en: Smoking raises the risk of lung disease.
sentences.zh: 吸菸會提高肺部疾病的風險。

sentences.en: She took a risk and moved to a new city.
sentences.zh: 她冒險搬到一個新城市。

sentences.en: I don't want to risk losing my phone at the beach.
sentences.zh: 我不想冒著在海邊弄丟手機的風險。

sentences.en: What is the biggest risk of this plan?
sentences.zh: 這個計畫最大的風險是什麼？

gloss_note: the roar of ... 某物的轟鳴聲

sentences.en: The lion let out a loud roar at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 那頭獅子在動物園發出一聲巨吼。

sentences.en: We heard the roar of the crowd from outside.
sentences.zh: 我們在外面就聽到觀眾的歡呼聲轟然作響。

sentences.en: Did you hear that roar from the highway?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到公路那邊的轟隆聲嗎？

sentences.en: The motorcycle roared past our house.
sentences.zh: 那輛機車轟隆地從我們家門口開過。

sentences.en: Waves roared against the rocks during the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間，海浪轟隆地拍打岩石。

sentences.en: Did you hear the roar of the engine?
sentences.zh: 你有聽到引擎的轟鳴聲嗎？

gloss_note: roast chicken 烤雞；roast beef 烤牛肉

sentences.en: Mom is roasting a chicken for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 媽媽今晚要烤一隻雞當晚餐。

sentences.en: Do you want some roast beef on your sandwich?
sentences.zh: 你的三明治要加烤牛肉嗎？

sentences.en: We roasted marshmallows over the campfire.
sentences.zh: 我們在營火上烤棉花糖。

sentences.en: The smell of roast turkey filled the whole house.
sentences.zh: 烤火雞的香味飄滿了整間屋子。

sentences.en: I'll have the roast chicken with potatoes, please.
sentences.zh: 我要烤雞佐馬鈴薯，謝謝。

sentences.en: How long should I roast the potatoes?
sentences.zh: 馬鈴薯應該烤多久？

gloss_note: bank robbery 銀行搶案；armed robbery 持械搶劫

sentences.en: The movie is about a bank robbery in a small town.
sentences.zh: 這部電影講的是小鎮上的一起銀行搶案。

sentences.en: Police are looking into a robbery at the jewelry store.
sentences.zh: 警方正在調查珠寶店的一起搶案。

sentences.en: Have you seen the news about the robbery downtown?
sentences.zh: 你有看到市區那起搶案的新聞嗎？

sentences.en: The detective in the game solves a famous robbery.
sentences.zh: 遊戲裡的偵探破解了一起有名的搶案。

sentences.en: Nobody was hurt in the robbery, and the store reopened.
sentences.zh: 搶案中沒有人受傷，商店也重新開張了。

sentences.en: Was the robbery in the movie based on a true story?
sentences.zh: 電影裡的那起搶案是根據真實故事改編的嗎？

gloss_note: bathrobe 浴袍；graduation robe 畢業袍

sentences.en: I put on my robe after taking a shower.
sentences.zh: 我洗完澡穿上浴袍。

sentences.en: The judge wore a long black robe.
sentences.zh: 那位法官穿著一件黑色長袍。

sentences.en: Where is my fluffy white robe?
sentences.zh: 我那件蓬鬆的白色浴袍在哪裡？

sentences.en: The students wore blue robes at the graduation.
sentences.zh: 學生們在畢業典禮穿著藍色長袍。

sentences.en: The hotel gives guests a free robe and slippers.
sentences.zh: 旅館提供客人免費的浴袍和拖鞋。

sentences.en: Why is the judge wearing a robe?
sentences.zh: 為什麼法官要穿長袍？

gloss_note: launch a rocket 發射火箭；model rocket 模型火箭

sentences.en: The rocket will launch tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 火箭明天早上要發射。

sentences.en: My brother built a small model rocket for science class.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟為自然課做了一個小模型火箭。

sentences.en: Did you watch the rocket launch on TV?
sentences.zh: 你有看電視上的火箭發射嗎？

sentences.en: It doesn't take a rocket scientist to see the problem.
sentences.zh: 要看出這個問題不需要什麼天才。

sentences.en: The rocket carried a new satellite into space.
sentences.zh: 火箭把一顆新衛星送上太空。

sentences.en: How fast can a rocket travel?
sentences.zh: 火箭可以飛多快？

gloss_note: romantic movie 愛情片；romantic dinner 浪漫晚餐

sentences.en: They had a romantic dinner by the lake.
sentences.zh: 他們在湖邊吃了一頓浪漫的晚餐。

sentences.en: I don't like romantic movies; I prefer action.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡愛情片，我比較喜歡動作片。

sentences.en: Is it romantic to bring flowers on a first date?
sentences.zh: 第一次約會帶花算浪漫嗎？

sentences.en: The little cafe has a quiet, romantic feeling.
sentences.zh: 這間小咖啡店有一種安靜浪漫的氣氛。

sentences.en: He's such a romantic that he writes letters by hand.
sentences.zh: 他是個很浪漫的人，會親手寫信。

sentences.en: Why do people think Paris is so romantic?
sentences.zh: 為什麼大家都覺得巴黎那麼浪漫？

gloss_note: rot away 爛掉；n. 腐爛、腐朽

sentences.en: Leave the apples out and they will rot.
sentences.zh: 把蘋果擺在外面，它們就會爛掉。

sentences.en: The wood in the old fence began to rot.
sentences.zh: 舊籬笆的木頭開始腐爛了。

sentences.en: Too much candy can rot your teeth.
sentences.zh: 吃太多糖果會讓牙齒蛀掉。

sentences.en: Don't let the vegetables rot in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 別讓蔬菜在冰箱裡爛掉。

sentences.en: Do bananas rot faster in a hot room?
sentences.zh: 香蕉在很熱的房間裡爛得比較快嗎？

sentences.en: Why do vegetables rot so fast in summer?
sentences.zh: 為什麼夏天蔬菜爛得那麼快？

gloss_note: rotten egg 臭蛋；口語 I feel rotten 我覺得很難受

sentences.en: Something smells rotten in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 冰箱裡有東西聞起來爛掉了。

sentences.en: Throw away the rotten apples before they spoil the rest.
sentences.zh: 在其他蘋果被傳染之前，把爛掉的丟掉。

sentences.en: I feel rotten about forgetting her birthday.
sentences.zh: 我忘了她的生日，覺得很糟。

sentences.en: Is that a rotten egg I smell, or is it the garbage?
sentences.zh: 我聞到的是臭蛋，還是垃圾？

sentences.en: We had rotten luck with the weather on our trip.
sentences.zh: 我們旅行時天氣運氣超差。

sentences.en: Is this fish rotten, or does it just smell strong?
sentences.zh: 這條魚爛掉了，還是只是味道重？

gloss_note: rough hands 粗糙的手；a rough day 難熬的一天

sentences.en: The wall feels rough under my hand.
sentences.zh: 牆摸起來手感很粗糙。

sentences.en: It has been a rough week at work.
sentences.zh: 這週工作上過得很辛苦。

sentences.en: Are you okay? You look like you had a rough night.
sentences.zh: 你還好嗎？你看起來昨晚過得很糟。

sentences.en: The road is too rough for a small car.
sentences.zh: 這條路對小車來說太崎嶇了。

sentences.en: The sea was rough, and many passengers felt sick.
sentences.zh: 海面波濤洶湧，許多乘客覺得不舒服。

sentences.en: Why was the sea so rough yesterday?
sentences.zh: 昨天海面為什麼那麼不平靜？

gloss_note: roughly + 數字 大約；也可指動作粗魯

sentences.en: The trip takes roughly two hours by train.
sentences.zh: 搭火車大約要兩個小時。

sentences.en: Roughly half of my class likes pizza.
sentences.zh: 我們班大約有一半的人喜歡披薩。

sentences.en: Can you tell me roughly how much it costs?
sentences.zh: 你可以大概告訴我要多少錢嗎？

sentences.en: There were roughly fifty people at the party.
sentences.zh: 派對上大約有五十個人。

sentences.en: It's roughly a ten-minute walk from my house.
sentences.zh: 從我家走過去大約十分鐘。

sentences.en: Roughly how far is it to the airport?
sentences.zh: 到機場大概有多遠？

gloss_note: daily routine 日常作息；routine check 例行檢查

sentences.en: My morning routine starts with a cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 我的早晨作息從一杯咖啡開始。

sentences.en: Do you have a bedtime routine for your kids?
sentences.zh: 你替孩子們安排固定的睡前流程嗎？

sentences.en: I go to the gym every day, and it has become a routine.
sentences.zh: 我每天去健身房，這已經變成固定習慣了。

sentences.en: The doctor said it was just a routine check.
sentences.zh: 醫生說這只是例行檢查。

sentences.en: Doing the same routine every day can feel boring.
sentences.zh: 每天做一樣的例行公事可能會覺得無聊。

sentences.en: What is your daily routine like on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你週末的日常作息是什麼樣子？

gloss_note: area rug 地毯；rug 通常比 carpet 小

sentences.en: We bought a soft rug for the living room.
sentences.zh: 我們替客廳買了一張柔軟的小地毯。

sentences.en: The cat sleeps on the rug every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓每天下午都睡在小地毯上。

sentences.en: Can you help me roll up this rug?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這張地毯捲起來嗎？

sentences.en: I spilled juice on the new rug.
sentences.zh: 我把果汁灑在新地毯上了。

sentences.en: The rug under the table is from my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 桌子底下的小地毯是我奶奶送的。

sentences.en: Where did you get this nice rug?
sentences.zh: 你這張漂亮的小地毯是在哪裡買的？

gloss_note: spread a rumor 散布謠言；Rumor has it ... 據傳

sentences.en: I heard a rumor that school will start late.
sentences.zh: 我聽說一個謠言，學校會晚點開學。

sentences.en: Don't spread rumors about your classmates.
sentences.zh: 不要散布關於同學的謠言。

sentences.en: Is it true, or is it just a rumor?
sentences.zh: 那是真的，還是只是謠言？

sentences.en: There's a rumor that the store will close next month.
sentences.zh: 有傳聞說這家店下個月要關了。

sentences.en: It was rumored that the singer would visit our town.
sentences.zh: 傳聞那位歌手要來我們鎮上。

sentences.en: Who started the rumor about the test?
sentences.zh: 是誰傳出那個關於考試的謠言？

gloss_note: rust 不可數；rust away 鏽蝕

sentences.en: My old bike is covered in rust.
sentences.zh: 我的舊腳踏車滿是鏽。

sentences.en: Metal tools will rust if you leave them in the rain.
sentences.zh: 金屬工具放在雨裡會生鏽。

sentences.en: How can I get rust off this knife?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼把這把刀上的鏽去掉？

sentences.en: The gate began to rust after years of salty air.
sentences.zh: 經過多年鹹鹹的海風，這扇大門開始生鏽。

sentences.en: Dad painted the fence to stop it from rusting.
sentences.zh: 爸爸把圍欄上漆，防止它生鏽。

sentences.en: Is there any rust on the old bridge?
sentences.zh: 那座老橋上有生鏽的地方嗎？

gloss_note: a sack of potatoes 一袋馬鈴薯

sentences.en: He carried a heavy sack of potatoes into the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他把一大袋沉重的馬鈴薯扛進廚房。

sentences.en: Do you need a paper sack for your groceries?
sentences.zh: 你的雜貨需要紙袋嗎？

sentences.en: The farmer filled each sack with rice.
sentences.zh: 農夫把每個麻袋都裝滿了米。

sentences.en: Grandpa keeps tools in an old canvas sack.
sentences.zh: 爺爺把工具放在一個舊帆布袋裡。

sentences.en: The kids dragged a big sack of leaves to the curb.
sentences.zh: 孩子們把一大袋落葉拖到路邊。

sentences.en: Where did you put the sack of flour?
sentences.zh: 你把那袋麵粉放哪裡了？

gloss_note: annual salary 年薪；salary 為固定月薪或年薪

sentences.en: My mom's salary goes up every year.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽的薪水每年都會調升。

sentences.en: What salary are you hoping for in this job?
sentences.zh: 你希望這份工作的薪水是多少？

sentences.en: He took a lower salary to work at a small company.
sentences.zh: 他為了到小公司工作，接受了較低的薪水。

sentences.en: Her salary is paid on the last day of the month.
sentences.zh: 她的薪水在每月最後一天發放。

sentences.en: The teacher's salary depends on her years of experience.
sentences.zh: 老師的薪水取決於她的年資。

sentences.en: Is the salary good enough to live in this city?
sentences.zh: 這份薪水夠在這座城市生活嗎？

gloss_note: satisfactory result；常指「合格」，不到「很棒」

sentences.en: The restaurant's service was satisfactory but not great.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的服務還算令人滿意，但不算很棒。

sentences.en: Is this answer satisfactory, or should I add more?
sentences.zh: 這個答案夠好嗎，還是我該再補充？

sentences.en: The test results were satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 檢查結果令人滿意。

sentences.en: He got a satisfactory grade on his science report.
sentences.zh: 他的自然報告拿到了令人滿意的成績。

sentences.en: The repair was not satisfactory, so I asked for my money back.
sentences.zh: 修理的結果不令人滿意，所以我要求退錢。

sentences.en: Was the hotel room satisfactory?
sentences.zh: 那間旅館房間讓你滿意嗎？

gloss_note: 可數；常見 Italian sausage、breakfast sausage

sentences.en: I had eggs and sausage for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我早餐吃了蛋和香腸。

sentences.en: Dad is grilling sausages in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 爸爸在後院烤香腸。

sentences.en: Do you want sausage or bacon on your plate?
sentences.zh: 你的盤子裡要香腸還是培根？

sentences.en: This pizza has mushrooms and Italian sausage on top.
sentences.zh: 這片披薩上面有蘑菇和義式香腸。

sentences.en: A street vendor sells hot sausage at the night market.
sentences.zh: 街邊小販在夜市賣熱香腸。

sentences.en: Would you like some sausage with your eggs?
sentences.zh: 你的蛋要配香腸嗎？

gloss_note: on a large scale 大規模；bathroom scale 體重計

sentences.en: The company is growing on a large scale.
sentences.zh: 這家公司正在大規模成長。

sentences.en: I stepped on the scale and felt a little shocked.
sentences.zh: 我踩上體重計，有點被嚇到。

sentences.en: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫的規模讓所有人都很驚訝。

sentences.en: This year's fire was on a much larger scale.
sentences.zh: 今年的火災規模大得多。

sentences.en: Can I use your kitchen scale to weigh the flour?
sentences.zh: 我可以用你的廚房磅秤稱麵粉嗎？

sentences.en: Do you have a scale to weigh this package?
sentences.zh: 你有磅秤可以秤這個包裹嗎？

gloss_note: be scarce 稀少；make oneself scarce 溜走

sentences.en: Fresh water is scarce in the desert.
sentences.zh: 沙漠裡淡水很稀少。

sentences.en: Good jobs were scarce after the factory closed.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉後，好工作變得很少。

sentences.en: Are tickets for the concert really that scarce?
sentences.zh: 演唱會的票真的那麼難買嗎？

sentences.en: Food was scarce in the village during the winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天時，村子裡的食物很缺乏。

sentences.en: Jobs are scarce in this small town.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮工作機會很少。

sentences.en: Why is water so scarce in some places?
sentences.zh: 為什麼有些地方的水這麼稀少？

gloss_note: scary movie 恐怖片；口語常用

sentences.en: That movie was so scary that I couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 那部電影太可怕了，我睡不著。

sentences.en: Is the haunted house really that scary?
sentences.zh: 那間鬼屋真的有那麼嚇人嗎？

sentences.en: Driving on the highway in the rain is scary.
sentences.zh: 雨天在高速公路上開車很嚇人。

sentences.en: My little brother wore a scary mask for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟萬聖節戴了一個嚇人的面具。

sentences.en: It's scary to speak in front of the whole school.
sentences.zh: 在全校面前演講好可怕。

sentences.en: Was the roller coaster scary for you?
sentences.zh: 那個雲霄飛車讓你覺得可怕嗎？

gloss_note: scatter sth over/on ... 把東西撒在...上

sentences.en: The kids scattered when the ball rolled into the street.
sentences.zh: 球滾到馬路上時，孩子們四散跑開。

sentences.en: Scatter some seeds on the soil and water them.
sentences.zh: 在土壤上撒一些種子再澆水。

sentences.en: Toys were scattered all over the living room floor.
sentences.zh: 玩具散落在客廳地板各處。

sentences.en: Why did you scatter your clothes around the room?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼把衣服丟得房間到處都是？

sentences.en: The birds scatter whenever someone walks near the lake.
sentences.zh: 只要有人走近湖邊，鳥就會四散飛開。

sentences.en: Who scattered these papers all over the floor?
sentences.zh: 是誰把這些紙散落在整個地板上？

gloss_note: 指有專門研究的人，不是一般學生

sentences.en: My aunt is a famous scholar of ancient history.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨是一位研究古代史的知名學者。

sentences.en: The scholar spent ten years studying old books.
sentences.zh: 那位學者花了十年研究古書。

sentences.en: Do you think you could become a scholar one day?
sentences.zh: 你覺得自己有一天會成為學者嗎？

sentences.en: Scholars from many countries came to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 來自許多國家的學者參加了這場會議。

sentences.en: She is a scholar who writes about Chinese poetry.
sentences.zh: 她是一位研究中國詩的學者。

sentences.en: Who is the scholar speaking at the school today?
sentences.zh: 今天到學校演講的學者是誰？

gloss_note: win a scholarship 拿到獎學金；scholarship to ...

sentences.en: She won a scholarship to a college in California.
sentences.zh: 她拿到加州一所大學的獎學金。

sentences.en: Are you going to apply for the scholarship?
sentences.zh: 你要申請那個獎學金嗎？

sentences.en: My brother paid for college with a sports scholarship.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥靠運動獎學金付大學學費。

sentences.en: The scholarship covers books and part of the tuition.
sentences.zh: 這份獎學金涵蓋書本費和一部分學費。

sentences.en: You have to write an essay to get this scholarship.
sentences.zh: 你要寫一篇文章才能拿到這份獎學金。

sentences.en: How many students got the scholarship this year?
sentences.zh: 今年有多少學生拿到獎學金？

gloss_note: scientist 是科學家；science 是科學

sentences.en: Scientific research takes a lot of patience.
sentences.zh: 科學研究需要很大的耐心。

sentences.en: Is there any scientific proof for that?
sentences.zh: 這個說法有任何科學證據嗎？

sentences.en: Our class built a scientific model of the solar system.
sentences.zh: 我們班做了一個太陽系的科學模型。

sentences.en: He has a scientific mind and loves solving puzzles.
sentences.zh: 他有科學頭腦，很愛解謎題。

sentences.en: Scientific studies show that sleep helps memory.
sentences.zh: 科學研究顯示，睡眠有助於記憶。

sentences.en: Do you know the scientific name for a house cat?
sentences.zh: 你知道家貓的學名是什麼嗎？

gloss_note: 複數形，用 a pair of scissors 數

sentences.en: Can you pass me the scissors, please?
sentences.zh: 可以把剪刀遞給我嗎？

sentences.en: These scissors are too dull to cut paper.
sentences.zh: 這把剪刀太鈍了，剪不斷紙。

sentences.en: I need a pair of scissors to open this package.
sentences.zh: 我需要一把剪刀來拆這個包裹。

sentences.en: Don't run with scissors in your hand.
sentences.zh: 不要手裡拿著剪刀亂跑。

sentences.en: Where did you put the kitchen scissors?
sentences.zh: 你把廚房的剪刀放哪裡了？

sentences.en: She cut the ribbon with a sharp pair of scissors.
sentences.zh: 她用一把鋒利的剪刀剪斷了緞帶。

gloss_note: talent scout 是星探；the Scouts 是童軍團

sentences.en: Our team sent a scout to check the road ahead.
sentences.zh: 我們的隊伍派了一名偵察員去查看前方的路。

sentences.en: Scouts from three colleges came to watch him play.
sentences.zh: 三所大學的球探來看他比賽。

sentences.en: My little brother joined the scouts last year.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟去年加入了童軍團。

sentences.en: Can you scout the area for a good camping spot?
sentences.zh: 你能去這一帶找找看有沒有適合露營的地點嗎？

sentences.en: A talent scout noticed her at the mall.
sentences.zh: 一位星探在購物中心注意到了她。

sentences.en: We scouted the neighborhood before choosing an apartment.
sentences.zh: 我們先把附近環境探查一遍，才選定公寓。

gloss_note: scream at 是對某人大吼

sentences.en: Why did you scream like that?
sentences.zh: 你剛剛為什麼那樣尖叫？

sentences.en: I heard a loud scream from next door.
sentences.zh: 我聽到隔壁傳來很大的尖叫聲。

sentences.en: The kids screamed with joy on the roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在雲霄飛車上開心地尖叫。

sentences.en: She let out a scream when the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 燈一熄，她就尖叫了一聲。

sentences.en: Don't scream at me, I'm right here!
sentences.zh: 不要對我大吼，我就在這裡！

sentences.en: Fans screamed as the band walked on stage.
sentences.zh: 樂團走上舞台時，歌迷尖叫起來。

audio.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Dvortygirl assumed (based on copyright claims).

gloss_note: 常用 scrub off／scrub away 刷掉

sentences.en: Scrub the pot until it's clean.
sentences.zh: 把鍋子刷到乾淨為止。

sentences.en: I spent an hour scrubbing the bathroom floor.
sentences.zh: 我花了一個小時刷浴室的地板。

sentences.en: Can you give the tub a good scrub?
sentences.zh: 你可以把浴缸好好刷一下嗎？

sentences.en: Doctors scrub their hands before every surgery.
sentences.zh: 醫生每次手術前都要仔細刷洗雙手。

sentences.en: Use a brush to scrub the mud off your shoes.
sentences.zh: 用刷子把鞋上的泥巴刷掉。

sentences.en: Why do I always have to scrub the pots?
sentences.zh: 為什麼總是我要刷鍋子？

gloss_note: 動詞是封住；名詞可指封條或海豹

sentences.en: Please seal the bag so the chips stay fresh.
sentences.zh: 請把袋子封好，洋芋片才會保持酥脆。

sentences.en: A seal swam right up to our boat.
sentences.zh: 一隻海豹游到我們的船邊。

sentences.en: Did you seal the envelope before mailing it?
sentences.zh: 你寄信前有把信封封好嗎？

sentences.en: The seals at the aquarium love to show off.
sentences.zh: 水族館裡的海豹很愛表演。

sentences.en: Check the seal on the jar before you buy it.
sentences.zh: 買之前先檢查罐子上的封口。

sentences.en: Dad sealed the leaky window with tape.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用膠帶把漏風的窗戶封起來。

gloss_note: 別和 sensitive（敏感的）搞混

sentences.en: Wearing a coat today is a sensible choice.
sentences.zh: 今天穿外套是明智的選擇。

sentences.en: She gave me some sensible advice about money.
sentences.zh: 她給了我一些關於金錢的實用建議。

sentences.en: Be sensible and go to bed early tonight.
sentences.zh: 理智一點，今晚早點睡。

sentences.en: Is it sensible to drive in this storm?
sentences.zh: 在這種暴風雨中開車明智嗎？

sentences.en: Those are sensible shoes for a long hike.
sentences.zh: 那是適合長途健行的實用鞋子。

sentences.en: That sounds like a sensible plan to me.
sentences.zh: 我覺得這個計畫聽起來很合理。

gloss_note: separation anxiety 是分離焦慮

sentences.en: The separation of trash and recycling is required here.
sentences.zh: 這裡規定垃圾和回收物要分開。

sentences.en: The long separation from her family made her sad.
sentences.zh: 與家人分隔那麼久，讓她很難過。

sentences.en: Is there a clear separation between work and home?
sentences.zh: 你的工作和生活有清楚的界線嗎？

sentences.en: After a long separation, the twins finally met again.
sentences.zh: 分開很久之後，雙胞胎終於重逢。

sentences.en: Separation anxiety is common in puppies.
sentences.zh: 分離焦慮在小狗身上很常見。

sentences.en: Is the separation of trash and recycling required here?
sentences.zh: 這裡規定要把垃圾和回收物分開嗎？

gloss_note: 動詞可指跟蹤；in the shadow of 在…的陰影下

sentences.en: Look at your long shadow on the ground.
sentences.zh: 看看你在地上的長長影子。

sentences.en: The big tree casts a cool shadow on the yard.
sentences.zh: 那棵大樹在院子裡投下一片涼涼的影子。

sentences.en: My little sister follows me like a shadow.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹像影子一樣跟著我。

sentences.en: Why is my dog afraid of his own shadow?
sentences.zh: 我的狗為什麼連自己的影子都怕？

sentences.en: A detective shadowed the suspect for three days.
sentences.zh: 一名偵探跟蹤了那名嫌犯三天。

sentences.en: He stood in the shadow of the building.
sentences.zh: 他站在大樓的陰影裡。

gloss_note: 反義詞 deep；也可形容人膚淺

sentences.en: The water is shallow here, so kids can play.
sentences.zh: 這裡的水很淺，所以小朋友可以玩水。

sentences.en: Is this part of the pool too shallow to dive?
sentences.zh: 泳池這一段是不是太淺不能跳水？

sentences.en: She took a shallow breath and tried to relax.
sentences.zh: 她淺淺地吸了一口氣，試著放鬆。

sentences.en: I don't like shallow people who only care about looks.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡只在乎外表、很膚淺的人。

sentences.en: Use a shallow bowl for the pasta.
sentences.zh: 義大利麵請用淺碗盛。

sentences.en: The river is shallow enough to walk across.
sentences.zh: 這條河淺到可以走過去。

gloss_note: 動詞是用洗髮精洗；日常說 wash my hair 更常見

sentences.en: I ran out of shampoo this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上洗髮精用完了。

sentences.en: Which shampoo do you use for dry hair?
sentences.zh: 乾燥的頭髮你用哪一種洗髮精？

sentences.en: This shampoo smells like green apples.
sentences.zh: 這瓶洗髮精聞起來像青蘋果。

sentences.en: Mom shampooed my hair when I was little.
sentences.zh: 我小時候都是媽媽幫我洗頭。

sentences.en: Add shampoo to the shopping list.
sentences.zh: 把洗髮精加到購物清單裡。

sentences.en: The hotel gives you free shampoo and towels.
sentences.zh: 這間旅館提供免費的洗髮精和毛巾。

gloss_note: German shepherd 是德國狼犬

sentences.en: The shepherd led his sheep up the hill.
sentences.zh: 牧羊人帶著羊群走上山坡。

sentences.en: A shepherd and his dog watched the sheep.
sentences.zh: 牧羊人和他的狗看守著羊群。

sentences.en: Does the old shepherd still live in the village?
sentences.zh: 那位老牧羊人還住在村子裡嗎？

sentences.en: The shepherd counted his sheep every night.
sentences.zh: 牧羊人每晚都會清點他的羊。

sentences.en: We saw a shepherd and his dog on the mountain road.
sentences.zh: 我們在山路上看到一位牧羊人和他的狗。

sentences.en: My neighbor has a German shepherd named Max.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居養了一隻叫麥克斯的德國狼犬。

gloss_note: 指表面光亮，不是自己會發光

sentences.en: She wore shiny red shoes to the party.
sentences.zh: 她穿著閃亮的紅鞋去參加派對。

sentences.en: Your new car is so shiny!
sentences.zh: 你的新車好亮喔！

sentences.en: Polish the spoons until they're shiny.
sentences.zh: 把湯匙擦到發亮為止。

sentences.en: Why is the floor so shiny today?
sentences.zh: 今天地板怎麼這麼亮？

sentences.en: The kid picked up a shiny coin from the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 那個小孩從人行道上撿起一枚亮晶晶的硬幣。

sentences.en: His shiny new phone caught everyone's eye.
sentences.zh: 他那支閃亮的新手機引人注目。

gloss_note: 反義詞 lengthen；衣服改短也用它

sentences.en: Can you shorten these pants for me?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我把這件褲子改短嗎？

sentences.en: The coach shortened practice because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，教練縮短了練習時間。

sentences.en: Let's shorten this speech to five minutes.
sentences.zh: 我們把這篇演講縮短到五分鐘吧。

sentences.en: Taking the highway will shorten the trip by an hour.
sentences.zh: 走高速公路可以把車程縮短一個小時。

sentences.en: Would it help to shorten the title?
sentences.zh: 把標題縮短會比較好嗎？

sentences.en: A new bridge shortened the trip to school.
sentences.zh: 一座新橋讓上學的路程縮短了。

gloss_note: 常見 shortly after／before 在…之後／之前不久

sentences.en: The movie will start shortly.
sentences.zh: 電影馬上就要開始了。

sentences.en: He left shortly after lunch.
sentences.zh: 他午餐後不久就離開了。

sentences.en: Will the doctor see me shortly?
sentences.zh: 醫生很快會看我嗎？

sentences.en: I'll call you back shortly.
sentences.zh: 我待會就回電給你。

sentences.en: Shortly before midnight, the power went out.
sentences.zh: 接近午夜時，電力中斷了。

sentences.en: The manager will be with you shortly.
sentences.zh: 經理馬上就來為您服務。

gloss_note: snow shovel 是鏟雪鏟

sentences.en: Dad grabbed a shovel to clear the snow.
sentences.zh: 爸爸拿起一把鏟子去清雪。

sentences.en: I shoveled the driveway for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我花了一個小時鏟車道上的雪。

sentences.en: Where's the shovel? I need to plant this tree.
sentences.zh: 鏟子在哪裡？我要種這棵樹。

sentences.en: Can you shovel the sand into the bucket?
sentences.zh: 你可以把沙子鏟進水桶裡嗎？

sentences.en: Workers used shovels to dig the ditch.
sentences.zh: 工人用鏟子挖水溝。

sentences.en: Who is going to shovel the walkway this morning?
sentences.zh: 今天早上誰要來鏟人行道上的雪？

gloss_note: 過去式 shrank，過去分詞 shrunk

sentences.en: My sweater shrank in the dryer.
sentences.zh: 我的毛衣在烘衣機裡縮水了。

sentences.en: Did these jeans shrink in the wash?
sentences.zh: 這條牛仔褲是不是洗過就縮水了？

sentences.en: The lake has shrunk a lot in recent years.
sentences.zh: 這座湖近年來縮小了很多。

sentences.en: Don't wash wool in hot water, or it will shrink.
sentences.zh: 羊毛不要用熱水洗，不然會縮水。

sentences.en: Our budget keeps shrinking every year.
sentences.zh: 我們的預算每年都在縮減。

sentences.en: The team shrank after the company cut its budget.
sentences.zh: 公司削減預算後，團隊規模縮小了。

gloss_note: 常用 a sigh of relief 鬆了一口氣

sentences.en: She let out a deep sigh and sat down.
sentences.zh: 她深深嘆了一口氣，坐了下來。

sentences.en: Why are you sighing? Is something wrong?
sentences.zh: 你怎麼一直嘆氣？出了什麼事嗎？

sentences.en: Dad sighed when he saw the mess.
sentences.zh: 爸爸看到一團亂時嘆了口氣。

sentences.en: We all breathed a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 我們都鬆了一口氣。

sentences.en: He gave a sigh and closed the book.
sentences.zh: 他嘆了口氣，把書闔上。

sentences.en: My teacher sighed at the noisy class.
sentences.zh: 老師對著吵鬧的班級嘆了口氣。

gloss_note: 手機訊號、紅綠燈、手勢示意都用

sentences.en: I can't get a signal in this building.
sentences.zh: 我在這棟大樓裡收不到訊號。

sentences.en: The traffic signal turned red.
sentences.zh: 紅綠燈變成紅燈了。

sentences.en: Please signal before you turn left.
sentences.zh: 左轉前請先打方向燈。

sentences.en: A bell is the signal for lunch.
sentences.zh: 鐘聲是午餐時間到的信號。

sentences.en: Is the Wi-Fi signal strong in your room?
sentences.zh: 你房間的 Wi-Fi 訊號強嗎？

sentences.en: She signaled the waiter for the check.
sentences.zh: 她向服務生示意要結帳。

gloss_note: significant other 指另一半

sentences.en: This is a significant step forward for our team.
sentences.zh: 這對我們團隊來說是重大的一步。

sentences.en: Is there a significant difference between the two?
sentences.zh: 這兩個之間有顯著的差異嗎？

sentences.en: Sales rose by a significant amount last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月的銷售額大幅成長。

sentences.en: Her graduation was a significant day for the family.
sentences.zh: 她的畢業典禮對全家人來說是重要的日子。

sentences.en: Doctors found a significant change in his health.
sentences.zh: 醫生發現他的健康狀況有明顯的變化。

sentences.en: Is there a significant gap between their scores?
sentences.zh: 他們的分數差距很大嗎？

gloss_note: 不可數；Silk Road 是絲路

sentences.en: This scarf is made of pure silk.
sentences.zh: 這條圍巾是純絲做的。

sentences.en: Silk feels smooth against the skin.
sentences.zh: 絲綢貼著皮膚很滑順。

sentences.en: Is that dress silk or cotton?
sentences.zh: 那件洋裝是絲的還是棉的？

sentences.en: We learned about the Silk Road in history class.
sentences.zh: 我們在歷史課學到了絲路。

sentences.en: She bought a silk tie for her father.
sentences.zh: 她買了一條絲質領帶給爸爸。
