sentences.zh: 這支蠟燭是天然蠟做的嗎？

sentences.en: She waxed the floor until it shone.
sentences.zh: 她把地板打蠟打到發亮。

sentences.en: Bees make wax to build their homes.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂分泌蠟來築巢。

gloss_note: weaken sb／sth；相反詞 strengthen

sentences.en: The long illness weakened my grandpa.
sentences.zh: 漫長的病讓爺爺虛弱了許多。

sentences.en: Strong winds can weaken old trees.
sentences.zh: 強風會讓老樹變得脆弱。

sentences.en: Do you think missing practice will weaken the team?
sentences.zh: 你覺得缺席練習會削弱球隊實力嗎？

sentences.en: Did the storm weaken before it reached land?
sentences.zh: 風暴在登陸前減弱了嗎？

sentences.en: Too much sugar can weaken your teeth.
sentences.zh: 吃太多糖會讓牙齒變脆弱。

sentences.en: Don't let one bad grade weaken your confidence.
sentences.zh: 別讓一次考不好削弱了你的信心。

gloss_note: wealthy family 有錢人家

sentences.en: Her family is very wealthy, but she's still humble.
sentences.zh: 她家很有錢，但她仍然很謙虛。

sentences.en: Do you think a wealthy person is always happy?
sentences.zh: 你覺得有錢人一定快樂嗎？

sentences.en: A wealthy businessman gave money to the school.
sentences.zh: 一位富商捐了錢給學校。

sentences.en: That wealthy neighborhood has huge houses and big yards.
sentences.zh: 那個富人區有大房子和大院子。

sentences.en: How did he become wealthy by running a small online shop?
sentences.zh: 他是怎麼靠經營小型網路商店致富的？

sentences.en: In the story, a wealthy king loses everything.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，一位富有的國王失去了一切。

gloss_note: 常見於新聞、歷史、電玩；weapons 多為複數

sentences.en: The museum has a room full of ancient weapons.
sentences.zh: 博物館有一間展示古代武器的展廳。

sentences.en: In this video game, you can upgrade your weapon.
sentences.zh: 在這款電玩裡，你可以升級自己的武器。

sentences.en: Does airport security check for any kind of weapon?
sentences.zh: 機場安檢會檢查任何種類的武器嗎？

sentences.en: What was the main weapon used in medieval battles?
sentences.zh: 中世紀戰役中使用的主要武器是什麼？

sentences.en: The knight in the movie carries a heavy sword as his weapon.
sentences.zh: 電影裡的騎士帶著一把沉重的劍當武器。

sentences.en: Leaders met to talk about limiting weapons around the world.
sentences.zh: 各國領袖開會討論限制全球武器的問題。

gloss_note: weave a basket 編籃子

sentences.en: My grandma can weave baskets out of straw.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶會用稻草編籃子。

sentences.en: Did you weave this blanket by yourself?
sentences.zh: 這條毯子是你自己織的嗎？

sentences.en: Spiders weave webs to catch insects.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛織網來捕捉昆蟲。

sentences.en: Do artists in the village weave rugs by hand?
sentences.zh: 村子裡的工匠用手工編織地毯嗎？

sentences.en: She is weaving colorful threads into the cloth.
sentences.zh: 她正把彩色的線織進布裡。

sentences.en: It takes hours to weave a rug this size.
sentences.zh: 要織一條這麼大的地毯得花好幾個小時。

gloss_note: the Web 指全球資訊網；spider web 蜘蛛網

sentences.en: I found the answer on the web in two minutes.
sentences.zh: 我在網路上兩分鐘就找到了答案。

sentences.en: Do you know how to build a web page?
sentences.zh: 你知道怎麼做網頁嗎？

sentences.en: A spider web shone in the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛網在晨光中閃閃發亮。

sentences.en: There's a big web in the corner of the garage.
sentences.zh: 車庫角落有一個大蜘蛛網。

sentences.en: Why does my brother spend hours surfing the web?
sentences.zh: 我弟弟為什麼花好幾個小時在網路上瀏覽？

sentences.en: A fly got stuck in the web and could not escape.
sentences.zh: 一隻蒼蠅被黏在蜘蛛網上逃不掉。

gloss_note: 較文學或正式；口語常說 get married

sentences.en: They plan to wed in a small garden next June.
sentences.zh: 他們打算明年六月在一座小花園裡結婚。

sentences.en: Did the couple wed in a church or on the beach?
sentences.zh: 這對情侶是在教堂還是海灘結婚的？

sentences.en: She wed her high school sweetheart after college.
sentences.zh: 她大學畢業後嫁給了高中時的戀人。

sentences.en: The prince and his bride will wed on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 王子與新娘將於週六完婚。

sentences.en: In the story, the farmer's daughter wed a young king.
sentences.zh: 故事裡，農夫的女兒嫁給了一位年輕的國王。

sentences.en: Did your grandparents wed in the 1950s?
sentences.zh: 你的祖父母是在 1950 年代結婚的嗎？

gloss_note: pull weeds 拔草

sentences.en: There are weeds growing all over the yard.
sentences.zh: 院子裡到處都長滿了雜草。

sentences.en: Can you help me pull the weeds this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 你今天下午可以幫我拔草嗎？

sentences.en: I need to weed the garden before it rains.
sentences.zh: 下雨前我得把花園裡的雜草除一除。

sentences.en: How can a weed grow through a crack in the sidewalk?
sentences.zh: 雜草怎麼能從人行道的裂縫長出來？

sentences.en: Grandpa spends every Sunday morning digging out weeds.
sentences.zh: 爺爺每個週日早上都在挖除雜草。

sentences.en: Weeds can take water away from the flowers.
sentences.zh: 雜草會搶走花朵需要的水分。

gloss_note: weekly meeting 週會

sentences.en: We have a weekly meeting every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 我們每週一早上都有週會。

sentences.en: Do you get a weekly allowance from your parents?
sentences.zh: 你爸媽每週給你零用錢嗎？

sentences.en: The newspaper comes out weekly.
sentences.zh: 這份報紙每週出刊一次。

sentences.en: Do you take a weekly yoga class at the gym?
sentences.zh: 你每週在健身房上一堂瑜伽課嗎？

sentences.en: She writes a weekly column for the school paper.
sentences.zh: 她替校刊每週寫一篇專欄。

sentences.en: Check the weekly deals at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 看一下超市的每週特價。

gloss_note: 比 cry 文學、書面；weep for/over

sentences.en: She began to weep when she heard the sad news.
sentences.zh: 她聽到壞消息時開始哭泣。

sentences.en: Many people wept at the end of the movie.
sentences.zh: 許多人在電影結尾時哭了。

sentences.en: Why does she weep every time she hears that song?
sentences.zh: 為什麼她每次聽到那首歌都會流淚？

sentences.en: Why did the old man begin to weep at the wedding?
sentences.zh: 那位老先生為什麼在婚禮上哭了起來？

sentences.en: The poem tells of a mother who weeps for her son.
sentences.zh: 這首詩寫一位為兒子哭泣的母親。

sentences.en: He tried not to weep in front of his classmates.
sentences.zh: 他努力不在同學面前掉淚。

gloss_note: wheat bread 全麥麵包

sentences.en: Farmers in Kansas grow a lot of wheat.
sentences.zh: 堪薩斯州的農民種了很多小麥。

sentences.en: Do you want white bread or wheat bread?
sentences.zh: 你要白吐司還是全麥吐司？

sentences.en: A golden field of wheat waved in the wind.
sentences.zh: 一片金黃的麥田隨風搖擺。

sentences.en: Is flour made by grinding wheat?
sentences.zh: 麵粉是磨小麥做成的嗎？

sentences.en: I'm allergic to wheat, so I can't eat regular pasta.
sentences.zh: 我對小麥過敏，所以不能吃一般的義大利麵。

sentences.en: The price of wheat rose after the dry summer.
sentences.zh: 乾燥的夏天過後，小麥價格上漲了。

gloss_note: whipped cream 鮮奶油

sentences.en: The cowboy in the old movie carried a long whip.
sentences.zh: 老電影裡的牛仔帶著一條長鞭。

sentences.en: Whip the cream until it gets thick and fluffy.
sentences.zh: 把鮮奶油打發到濃稠蓬鬆。

sentences.en: Can you whip some eggs for the pancakes?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫鬆餅打一些蛋嗎？

sentences.en: Mom whipped the cream for the pie after dinner.
sentences.zh: 媽媽晚餐後把派用的鮮奶油打發。

sentences.en: The rider cracked his whip, and the horse ran faster.
sentences.zh: 騎士甩響鞭子，馬就跑得更快了。

sentences.en: Do you want whipped cream on your hot chocolate?
sentences.zh: 你的熱可可要加鮮奶油嗎？

gloss_note: blow a whistle 吹哨子

sentences.en: My dad can whistle any song he hears.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸聽過的歌都能吹口哨吹出來。

sentences.en: The referee blew his whistle to stop the game.
sentences.zh: 裁判吹哨讓比賽暫停。

sentences.en: Did you hear the train whistle last night?
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有聽到火車的汽笛聲嗎？

sentences.en: Why did the coach blow the whistle so loudly?
sentences.zh: 教練為什麼吹哨吹得那麼大聲？

sentences.en: She whistled happily while she walked her dog.
sentences.zh: 她遛狗時開心地吹著口哨。

sentences.en: The kettle's whistle means the water is hot.
sentences.zh: 水壺的哨音響起表示水燒開了。

gloss_note: 常見於童話、故事

sentences.en: The wicked witch in the story tricked the children.
sentences.zh: 故事裡邪惡的女巫騙了那些孩子。

sentences.en: Is the villain in this movie really that wicked?
sentences.zh: 這部電影裡的反派真的有那麼邪惡嗎？

sentences.en: The wicked queen was jealous of the pretty girl in the story.
sentences.zh: 邪惡的皇后嫉妒故事裡那位漂亮的女孩。

sentences.en: My little sister loves to dress up as a wicked fairy for Halloween.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹萬聖節最愛打扮成壞心的仙女。

sentences.en: Why did he have a wicked grin as he hid the toy?
sentences.zh: 他藏玩具的時候為什麼露出壞笑？

sentences.en: In the old tale, a wicked king took all the village's gold.
sentences.zh: 在古老的故事裡，一位邪惡的國王奪走了村子所有的金子。

gloss_note: widen the road 拓寬道路

sentences.en: The city plans to widen the main road next year.
sentences.zh: 市政府計劃明年拓寬主要幹道。

sentences.en: Her eyes widened when she saw the surprise party.
sentences.zh: 她看到驚喜派對時眼睛睜得好大。

sentences.en: Can you widen the gap a little so I can get through?
sentences.zh: 你可以把縫隙弄寬一點讓我過去嗎？

sentences.en: Can reading widen your view of the world?
sentences.zh: 閱讀能拓寬你看世界的視野嗎？

sentences.en: The river begins to widen near the lake.
sentences.zh: 河流在靠近湖的地方開始變寬。

sentences.en: We had to widen the doorway to fit the new couch.
sentences.zh: 我們得把門口拓寬，新沙發才進得來。

gloss_note: wipe the table 擦桌子

sentences.en: Can you wipe the table after dinner?
sentences.zh: 晚餐後你可以擦一下桌子嗎？

sentences.en: Wipe your feet before you come in.
sentences.zh: 進來之前先把鞋底擦乾淨。

sentences.en: She wiped the tears from her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她擦掉了眼角的淚水。

sentences.en: Do you have a wipe for my hands?
sentences.zh: 你有濕紙巾讓我擦手嗎？

sentences.en: The waiter quickly wiped up the spilled juice.
sentences.zh: 服務生很快擦掉了灑出來的果汁。

sentences.en: Use a soft cloth to wipe your phone screen.
sentences.zh: 用軟布擦你的手機螢幕。

gloss_note: words of wisdom 金玉良言

sentences.en: My grandpa always shares his wisdom over dinner.
sentences.zh: 我爺爺總在晚餐時分享他的智慧。

sentences.en: Do you think wisdom comes with age?
sentences.zh: 你覺得智慧會隨著年紀增長嗎？

sentences.en: It takes wisdom to know when to stay quiet.
sentences.zh: 要有智慧才知道什麼時候該保持沉默。

sentences.en: The old teacher is known for her wisdom and kindness.
sentences.zh: 那位年長的老師以智慧和善良聞名。

sentences.en: Is there any wisdom in this old saying?
sentences.zh: 這句老話裡有什麼智慧嗎？

sentences.en: Thank you for your words of wisdom.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你的金玉良言。

gloss_note: wrap up 包好；也指結束

sentences.en: Can you wrap this gift for me?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我把這份禮物包起來嗎？

sentences.en: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她在脖子上圍了一條暖暖的圍巾。

sentences.en: Should I wrap the leftover pizza in foil?
sentences.zh: 我要把剩下的披薩用鋁箔紙包起來嗎？

sentences.en: I'll have a chicken wrap and a small salad.
sentences.zh: 我要一份雞肉捲餅和一份小沙拉。

sentences.en: Let's wrap the leftovers up and go home.
sentences.zh: 我們把剩菜包起來回家吧。

sentences.en: The baby was wrapped in a soft blue blanket.
sentences.zh: 寶寶被包在一條柔軟的藍色毯子裡。

gloss_note: yearly checkup 年度健檢

sentences.en: I go to the dentist for a yearly checkup.
sentences.zh: 我每年去看牙醫做一次檢查。

sentences.en: Is there a yearly fee for this gym?
sentences.zh: 這間健身房有收年費嗎？

sentences.en: The town holds a yearly festival in the fall.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮每年秋天都會舉辦慶典。

sentences.en: We take a yearly trip to see my aunt in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我們每年都會去德州探望阿姨。

sentences.en: Our school sends out a yearly report to all parents.
sentences.zh: 我們學校每年會寄一份年度報告給所有家長。

sentences.en: Do you pay the insurance monthly or yearly?
sentences.zh: 你的保險是按月還是按年繳？

gloss_note: egg yolk 蛋黃；egg white 蛋白

sentences.en: I like my eggs with a runny yolk.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡吃蛋黃流動的蛋。

sentences.en: Separate the yolk from the white before you mix.
sentences.zh: 混合之前先把蛋黃和蛋白分開。

sentences.en: Is the yolk the yellow part of the egg?
sentences.zh: 蛋黃就是蛋裡面黃色的部分嗎？

sentences.en: The yolk broke when I dropped the egg in the pan.
sentences.zh: 我把蛋打進鍋裡時，蛋黃破了。

sentences.en: Is egg yolk rich in vitamins?
sentences.zh: 蛋黃含有豐富的維他命嗎？

sentences.en: Dad only eats the egg white and gives me the yolk.
sentences.zh: 爸爸只吃蛋白，把蛋黃給我。

gloss_note: 語氣親切稍老派，常指孩子或年輕人

sentences.en: Does the youngster next door help you carry groceries?
sentences.zh: 隔壁那個小朋友有幫你提雜貨嗎？

sentences.en: Many youngsters come to this park to play basketball.
sentences.zh: 許多年輕人來這座公園打籃球。

sentences.en: When I was a youngster, we only had one TV.
sentences.zh: 我小時候，家裡只有一台電視。

sentences.en: Is this game too hard for a youngster?
sentences.zh: 這個遊戲對小孩來說會不會太難？

sentences.en: The coach gave the youngsters some tips on hitting.
sentences.zh: 教練給那群年輕球員一些打擊的建議。

sentences.en: The library runs a reading program for local youngsters.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為當地的孩子們辦了閱讀計畫。

gloss_note: zip up 拉上拉鍊；美式 zipper，英式 zip

sentences.en: My jacket zipper is stuck again.
sentences.zh: 我外套的拉鍊又卡住了。

sentences.en: Can you pull up the zipper on my dress?
sentences.zh: 你可以幫我拉上洋裝的拉鍊嗎？

sentences.en: The zipper on my backpack broke on the way to school.
sentences.zh: 我背包的拉鍊在上學途中壞掉了。

sentences.en: Is there a zipper on the side, or is it a button?
sentences.zh: 側邊是拉鍊還是釦子？

sentences.en: He closed the zipper and checked the bag again.
sentences.zh: 他拉上拉鍊，又檢查了一次包包。

sentences.en: A tiny zipper keeps the pocket safe from thieves.
sentences.zh: 一條小拉鍊讓口袋不怕被扒手偷。

gloss_note: time zone 時區

sentences.en: Slow down, we're in a school zone.
sentences.zh: 慢一點，我們進入學童通行區了。

sentences.en: What time zone is New York in?
sentences.zh: 紐約在哪個時區？

sentences.en: This area is a no-parking zone.
sentences.zh: 這一區禁止停車。

sentences.en: The city has a new zone for food trucks.
sentences.zh: 市區新增了一個餐車專區。

sentences.en: Stay out of the danger zone near the construction site.
sentences.zh: 別靠近工地附近的危險區域。

sentences.en: Is this a safe zone for kids to ride bikes?
sentences.zh: 這一區讓小孩騎腳踏車安全嗎？
